scripts.text:
[Promotional Staff]
We are looking for adventurers who are super curious and extremely brave.
Join us for a wonderful adventure!
scripts.translation:
[宣傳人員]
我們正在尋找好奇心旺盛且極其勇敢的冒險者。
加入我們，一起踏上精彩的冒險之旅吧！

scripts.text:
[Promotional Staff]
Hey, you're a knowledgeable person, right? Are you interested in my story?
scripts.translation:
[宣傳人員]
嘿，你看起來是個見多識廣的人，對吧？對我的故事感興趣嗎？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text: No, thanks.
scripts.translation: 不用了，謝謝。

scripts.text:
[Promotional Staff]
You're a real adventurer.
Good for you!
You won't regret it.
scripts.translation:
[宣傳人員]
你真是個真正的冒險者。
真不錯！
你不會後悔的。

scripts.text:
[Promotional Staff]
I usually send adventurers to
newly found places for research.
It's quite challeging, as nobody's ever been to these places.
scripts.translation:
[宣傳人員]
我通常派遣冒險者去新發現的地方進行考察。
這相當具有挑戰性，因為從來沒有人去過這些地方。

scripts.text:
[Promotional Staff]
The missions are quite dangerous,
so only those who are courageous
are qualified for the challenge
of this mission.
scripts.translation:
[宣傳人員]
任務相當危險，
所以只有那些勇敢的人
才有資格接受
這項任務的挑戰。

scripts.text:
[Promotional Staff]
I'm not sure that you're strong enough, but you seem brave. How about going to the kingdom receptionist? He should be in the first room of Prontera Castle.
scripts.translation:
[宣傳人員]
我不確定你是否足夠強大，但你看起來很勇敢。不如去見見王宮的接待員吧？他應該在普隆德拉王宮的第一間房間裡。

scripts.text:
[Promotional Staff]
From what I've heard about this place... It's not a new continent.
I don't know where it is.
Hmm... Inside of the sky?
scripts.translation:
[宣傳人員]
據我所知這個地方...它不是新的大陸。
我不知道它在哪裡。
嗯...是在天空之中嗎？

scripts.text:
[Promotional Staff]
Could just be a rumor,
but I don't know exactly.
It's not my business.
scripts.translation:
[宣傳人員]
可能只是謠言，
我也不太清楚。
這不是我該管的事。

scripts.text:
[Promotional Staff]
Anyway, I'm supposed to inform many adventurers about it.
There's no time to waste!
scripts.translation:
[宣傳人員]
總之，我本該通知許多冒險者這件事。
沒時間浪費了！

scripts.text:
[Promotional Staff]
Huh, I thought you were a real adventurer. You're missing a big opportunity. You're definitely not brave. Absolutely not!
scripts.translation:
[宣傳人員]
哈，我還以為你是個真正的冒險者呢。你錯過了一個大好機會。你絕對不夠勇敢。完全不夠！

scripts.text:
[Alliance Manager]
If we'd had the initiative over Schwarzwald, we could take advantage over them! But we lost the opportunity.
scripts.translation:
[聯盟管理員]
如果我們能在修瓦魯茲巴魯德佔據先機，就能對他們形成優勢！但我們失去了這個機會。

scripts.text:
[Alliance Manager]
Though we are allied with them, that's nothing more than a formality.
We will take advantage over them.
scripts.translation:
[聯盟管理員]
雖然我們與他們是盟友，但這不過是形式上的。
我們將利用這一點來佔上風。

scripts.text:
[Alliance Manager]
Do you know what we are here for? These are the things that help to have control over multiple countries and get to know their magic.
scripts.translation:
[聯盟管理員]
你知道我們在這裡的目的嗎？這些東西有助於控制多個國家並瞭解它們的魔法。

scripts.text:
[Alliance Manager]
Whatever. Though the things are not useful to us, we'd better destroy them, to prevent them from being used by others.
scripts.translation:
[聯盟管理員]
算了。雖然這些東西對我們沒什麼用，但我們最好還是銷燬它們，以防被他人利用。

scripts.text:
[Alliance Manager]
Anything except things which are not found on Rune-Midgarts... keep them hidden. Just let us know of whatever you are holding.
scripts.translation:
[聯盟管理員]
除了那些在盧恩·米德加茲找不到的東西...請把它們藏好。只要讓我們知道你手裡有什麼就行。

scripts.text:
[Alliance Manager]
...Do you have any business with me?
scripts.translation:
[聯盟管理員]
...你有什麼事找我嗎？

scripts.text:
[Alliance Manager]
Hm... The boss had you come to me,
to talk about the issues? Ok!
scripts.translation:
[聯盟管理員]
嗯...老闆讓你來找我，
談談那些問題？好吧！

scripts.text:
[Alliance Manager]
So, everything is going well?
You're allied with Schwarzwald?
They will join with you.
I know this.
scripts.translation:
[聯盟管理員]
那麼，一切進展順利嗎？
你和修瓦魯茲巴魯德結盟了？
他們會加入你們。
我知道這一點。

scripts.text:
[Alliance Manager]
Hm....ok.
scripts.translation:
[聯盟管理員]
嗯...好吧。

scripts.text:
[Alliance Manager]
You are all going, forward through
the dimensional rift...
scripts.translation:
[聯盟管理員]
你們都要一起出發，
穿過次元裂縫...

scripts.text:
[Alliance Manager]
Good. It's started.
We also need to be preparted to not
let ourselves be convinced to turn over.
scripts.translation:
[聯盟管理員]
很好，已經開始了。
我們也需要做好準備，
絕不能被說服而倒戈。

scripts.text:
[Alliance Manager]
We are so-called 'allies',
so we can't take advantages over
each other in public, but we can do
it secretly.
scripts.translation:
[聯盟管理員]
我們所謂的“盟友”，
在公開場合不能互相佔便宜，
但私下裡可以。

scripts.text:
[Alliance Manager]
The Schwarzwald... they are all
snobs. I know what they did.
They'll try to get what they can
with little or no work. I know
their dirty tricks.
scripts.translation:
[聯盟管理員]
修瓦魯茲巴魯德...他們全是勢利眼。
我知道他們幹了什麼。
他們總想不勞而獲，坐享其成。
我瞭解他們那些下三濫的手段。

scripts.text:
[Alliance Manager]
We shouldn't loose anything to them,
no way! We are not as powerful as
most of them.
scripts.translation:
[聯盟管理員]
我們絕不能在他們面前示弱，
絕對不行！我們的實力不如他們中的大多數。

scripts.text:
[Alliance Manager]
We only have a strange dimensional
rift in our reserves, but nothing
else... Only we are about to trick
them, to win over them!
scripts.translation:
[聯盟管理員]
我們儲備中只有一個奇怪的次元裂縫，
除此之外別無他物...但我們即將欺騙他們，
從而戰勝他們！

scripts.text:
[Alliance Manager]
You are a member of our alliance.
Always be careful not to get lost.
scripts.translation:
[聯盟管理員]
你是我們聯盟的成員。
務必小心，不要迷路。

scripts.text:
[Alliance Manager]
Thanks for reporting to us.
We are better prepared.
Good job. You can go now.
scripts.translation:
[聯盟管理員]
謝謝你的彙報。
我們準備得更充分了。
幹得好，你可以走了。

scripts.text:
[Alliance Manager]
Do you have any business here?
scripts.translation:
[聯盟管理員]
你在這裡有什麼事嗎？

scripts.text:
[Member of Alliance]
If we have absolute power, we wouldn't have to get along with Schwarzwald and Arunafeltz.
scripts.translation:
[聯盟成員]
如果我們擁有絕對的力量，
就不必和修瓦魯茲巴魯德以及阿魯納菲茲和睦相處了。

scripts.text:
[Member of Alliance]
I don't know when Satan Morocc will attack us, and whether we're powerful enough to detect him.
scripts.translation:
[聯盟成員]
我不知道魔王夢羅克什麼時候會襲擊我們，
也不知道我們是否有足夠的力量去獵鷹尋敵。

scripts.text:
[Member of Alliance]
We couldn't avoid cooperating with them. We don't have many choices left.
scripts.translation:
[聯盟成員]
我們無法避免與他們合作。
我們已沒有多少選擇了。

scripts.text:
[Member of Alliance]
So we will take advantage over them in secret, in this dimensional rift.
scripts.translation:
[聯盟成員]
所以我們將在這個次元裂縫中，
在私下裡佔他們的便宜。

scripts.text:
[Member of Alliance]
If we'd have had more power,
we wouldn't be like this now.
Strength is most important.
scripts.translation:
[聯盟成員]
如果我們擁有更多的力量，
現在就不會這樣了。
力量是最重要的。

scripts.text:
[Recruiter]
Why have you come again?
You'd better go to Schwarzwald to register.
scripts.translation:
[招募員]
你怎麼又來了？
你最好去修瓦魯茲巴魯德登記。

scripts.text:
[Recruiter]
What? You came to here to convey a story? Go ahead.
scripts.translation:
[招募員]
什麼？你來這裡是想傳達什麼訊息？說吧。

scripts.text:
[Recruiter]
Move to the side. There's a Manager who is dealing with all of us, and is involved in international relations here on Midgard.
scripts.translation:
[招募員]
請讓一下。這裡有一位管理員負責處理我們所有人的事務，
並參與米德加爾特的外交關係。

scripts.text:
[Recruiter]
Just talk to him.
scripts.translation:
[招募員]
直接和他談吧。

scripts.text:
[Recruiter]
Just go there.
You can get nothing from me.
Let's rush to
^FF0000Lighthalzen^000000, which is the original place for the three kingdoms...
scripts.translation:
[招募員]
直接去吧。
從我這裡你什麼也得不到。
讓我們趕緊去^FF0000裡希塔樂鎮^000000，
那是三王國的發源地...

scripts.text:
[Recruiter]
I've heard of you.
You've finished the tests from the Promotional Staff?
scripts.translation:
[招募員]
我聽說過你。
你已經通過了宣傳人員的測試？

scripts.text:
[Recruiter]
You are definitely brave enough to venture to this new land.
I will now appoint you to detect and have adventures in Ash-Vacuum.
scripts.translation:
[招募員]
你絕對有勇氣探索這片新土地。
我現在任命你去阿什-真空地帶進行獵鷹尋敵和冒險。

scripts.text: Ash-Vacuum?
scripts.translation: 阿什-真空地帶？

scripts.text:
[Recruiter]
Hm. That's the code name of the place where you will have your adventure. Frankly, we don't know exactly what it is, but we call it 'Ash-Vacuum'.
scripts.translation:
[招募員]
嗯。那是你即將開始冒險的地方的代號。老實說，我們也不確切知道那是什麼，但我們稱它為“阿什-真空地帶”。

scripts.text:
[Recruiter]
Believe it or not,
it's definitely true.
So listen carefully.
Please.
scripts.translation:
[招募員]
信不信由你，
但這絕對是事實。
所以請仔細聽。
拜託了。

scripts.text:
[Recruiter]
Ash-Vacuum... is a living place... that's totally different from where we are living now.
scripts.translation:
[招募員]
阿什-真空地帶...是一個活著的地方...與我們現在生活的地方完全不同。

scripts.text:
[Recruiter]
It's an unknown place.
We don't know what's there,
or who is living there.
It's beyond our guess.
Nobody knows.
scripts.translation:
[招募員]
那是一個未知的地方。
我們不知道那裡有什麼，
也不知道那裡住著誰。
這超出了我們的猜測。
沒有人知道。

scripts.text:
[Recruiter]
Only the brave, like you, deserve to go there. There will be many dangerous things around you, but you must explore it on behalf of Midgard.
scripts.translation:
[招募員]
只有像你這樣勇敢的人，才配去那裡。那裡會有許多危險的東西圍繞著你，但你必須代表米德加爾特去探索它。

scripts.text:
[Recruiter]
Hmm......

[Recruiter]
Anyway, I am sure that there are many opportunities for fame and fortune there...
scripts.translation:
[招募員]
總之，我確信那裡有很多獲得名聲和財富的機會...

scripts.text:
[Recruiter]
First, you should go to ^FF0000Lighthalzen^000000 to register for the United Midgard Alliance. I believe they are meeting at the Rekenber Corporation Headquarters...
scripts.translation:
[招募員]
首先，你應該去^FF0000裡希塔樂鎮^000000註冊加入米德加爾特聯盟。我相信他們正在雷根貝勒總部開會...

scripts.text:
[Recruiter]
You can get a detailed guide, better than me, there. Go there and find him...
scripts.translation:
[招募員]
在那裡你可以得到比我更詳細的指南。去那裡找到他...

scripts.text:
[Recruiter]
I've done what I can. Go there, and get to it!
scripts.translation:
[招募員]
我已經盡力了。去吧，開始行動！

scripts.text:
[Recruiter]
Remember, go to ^FF0000Lighthalzen^000000, then follow the directions of the guide there.
scripts.translation:
[招募員]
記住，去^FF0000裡希塔樂鎮^000000，然後聽從那裡嚮導的指示。

scripts.text:
[Recruiter]
Just go there!
And listen carefully
about your mission!
I'm done here...
scripts.translation:
[招募員]
就只是去那裡！
仔細聽
關於你的任務！
我說完了...

scripts.text:
[Recruiter]
What're you doing here?
Just go to ^FF0000Aldebaran^000000, and find the ^FF0000Promotional Staff^000000. As I advised you, you'd better save time.
scripts.translation:
[招募員]
你在這裡做什麼？
直接去^FF0000亞爾達班^000000，找到^FF0000宣傳人員^000000。正如我建議你那樣，你最好節省時間。

scripts.text:
[Recruiter]
Brave ones! Come to me!
Real brave people!
Would you mind trying a challenging mission?
scripts.translation:
[招募員]
勇敢的人！來找我！
真正的勇敢者！
你們願意嘗試一個具有挑戰性的任務嗎？

scripts.text:
[Recruiter]
I am a recruiter looking for brave people in Prontera! My goal is to recruit the bravest adventurers for this mission.
scripts.translation:
[招募員]
我是普隆德拉的一名招募員，正在尋找勇敢的人！我的目標是為這個任務招募最勇敢的冒險者。

scripts.text:
[Recruiter]
Would you like to join?
This is always open to you.
I know, you're super curious.
Just try whatever you want.
scripts.translation:
[招募員]
你想加入嗎？
這對你來說總是開放的。
我知道，你非常好奇。
隨便嘗試你想做的任何事。

scripts.text: Yes, I am interested.
scripts.translation: 是的，我感興趣。

scripts.text: No, thanks.
scripts.translation: 不用了，謝謝。

scripts.text:
[Recruiter]
Oh! Yes! You're quite curious!
You're a real adventurer.
A genuine desire for adventure.
Ok! Let me start by telling you the story of the mission!!
scripts.translation:
[招募員]
哦！是的！你非常好奇！
你是一名真正的冒險者。
對冒險有著真正的渴望。
好吧！讓我先給你講講這個任務的故事！！

scripts.text:
[Recruiter]
All of this of course, the Promotional Staff can tell you, but they're not that reliable. So, let me explain to you. Just listen carefully.
scripts.translation:
[招募員]
當然，宣傳人員也可以告訴你這些，但他們不太可靠。所以，讓我來向你解釋。請仔細聽。

scripts.text:
[Recruiter]
Um... There's not that much to tell you...
...
scripts.translation:
[招募員]
嗯...其實也沒什麼好說的...
...

scripts.text:
[Recruiter]
The point is that we want someone who is curious and brave, to go to new places. And I choose you!!
scripts.translation:
[招募員]
總之，我們需要一個充滿好奇心且勇敢的人，去探索新的地方。我選中你了！！

scripts.text:
[Recruiter]
This is a special place among unknown places. Quite special! I can't tell you much just now. Just believe me that it is truly uncommon!
scripts.translation:
[招募員]
這是未知之地中一個特別的地方。非常特別！我現在不能告訴你太多。請相信我，那裡真的不尋常！

scripts.text:
[Recruiter]
So, now, let me test you.
Once I get you qualified,
I will tell you everything.
scripts.translation:
[招募員]
那麼，現在，讓我測試一下你。
一旦你通過了資格考核，
我會告訴你一切。

scripts.text:
[Recruiter]
Just go to the ^FF0000Promotional Staff^000000 in Aldebaran and get permission. They can judge you more carefully than me. Go ahead.
scripts.translation:
[招募員]
直接去艾爾戴巴找^FF0000宣傳人員^000000申請許可吧。他們能比我更仔細地評估你。去吧。

scripts.text:
[Recruiter]
They will take care of everything, if you say that you've been sent by the Recruiter in Prontera.
scripts.translation:
[招募員]
如果你告訴他們你是普隆德拉的招募員派來的，他們會處理一切。

scripts.text:
[Recruiter]
Time is zeny, just go.
As soon as you visit the Promotional Staff, you will be allowed to travel to the unknown land.
scripts.translation:
[招募員]
時間就是Zeny，快去吧。
只要你拜訪了宣傳人員，就可以前往那片未知的土地了。

scripts.text:
[Recruiter]
Are you seriously enjoying your adventures? You're not that curious.
scripts.translation:
[招募員]
你真的很享受冒險嗎？你看起來並不怎麼好奇。

scripts.text:
[Recruiter]
Just go about your business!
scripts.translation:
[招募員]
快去忙你的事吧！

scripts.text:
[Recruiter]
-Muttering and complaining...-
scripts.translation:
[招募員]
-低聲抱怨著...-

scripts.text:
[Promotional Staff]
Did you try out for the test, or are you already enjoying your adventures?
scripts.translation:
[宣傳人員]
你是來參加考試，還是已經在享受冒險了？

scripts.text:
[Promotional Staff]
Just visit the ^FF0000Promotional Staff in Geffen^000000. You have no business with me anymore. Bless you. I wish you a safe adventure.
scripts.translation:
[宣傳人員]
直接去吉芬找^FF0000宣傳人員^000000吧。你和我已經沒有關係了。祝福你。祝你冒險旅途平安。

scripts.text:
[Promotional Staff]
Don't forget to bring... ^FF0000300 Jellopy^000000.
Got it? ^FF0000300 Jellopy^000000!
Let me know once you got them.
scripts.translation:
[宣傳人員]
別忘了帶上... ^FF0000300個傑勒比結晶^000000。
記住了嗎？^FF0000300個傑勒比結晶^000000！
拿到後告訴我一聲。

scripts.text:
[Promotional Staff]
Hey! Let me know once you collect all of them.
Don't disturb me anymore. I'm a busy man... What a waste.
scripts.translation:
[宣傳人員]
嘿！收集齊了告訴我一聲。
別再打擾我了。我很忙...真是浪費。

scripts.text:
[Promotional Staff]
Hm? Did you bring all of them?
No! It's quite an annoying job
I'm impressed that you managed to do such a menial thing to bring 300 Jellopy!
scripts.translation:
[宣傳人員]
嗯？你都帶來了？
不！這可是個麻煩的差事。
你能完成收集300個傑勒比結晶這種瑣事，我很驚訝！

scripts.text:
[Promotional Staff]
You have guts kid!
You're a good-willed person!
Ok, you win!
You pass!!
scripts.translation:
[宣傳人員]
真有膽量，小孩！
你是個心地善良的人！
好吧，你贏了！
你通過了！！

scripts.text:
[Promotional Staff]
Adventurers like you
are not common
A hard-boiled soldier!
Stronger than me!
scripts.translation:
[宣傳人員]
像你這樣的冒險者
並不多見
是個硬漢士兵！
比我更強！

scripts.text:
[Promotional Staff]
Now can you go to the
Promotional Staff in Geffen?
He will test you again.
scripts.translation:
[宣傳人員]
現在你能去
吉芬找宣傳人員了嗎？
他會再次測試你。

scripts.text:
[Promotional Staff]
You know this isn't an easy quest.
You resolved to carry it out, didn't you?
Brace yourself for it.
scripts.translation:
[宣傳人員]
你知道這可不是個簡單的任務。
你下定決心要完成它，對吧？
做好心理準備。

scripts.text:
[Promotional Staff]
Anyway you did the first step.
Bless you!
scripts.translation:
[宣傳人員]
不管怎樣，你邁出了第一步。
祝福你！

scripts.text:
[Promotional Staff]
We want the adventurers who are super curious and extremely brave. Join us for a wonderful adventure!
scripts.translation:
[宣傳人員]
我們需要好奇心極強且無比勇敢的冒險者。加入我們，開啟精彩的冒險吧！

scripts.text:
[Promotional Staff]
Hey, you're a well-versed person, right? Are you interested in my story?
scripts.translation:
[宣傳人員]
嘿，你是個見多識廣的人，對吧？對我的故事感興趣嗎？

scripts.text: I have something for you.
scripts.translation: 我有東西給你

scripts.text:
[Promotional Staff]
For me??
I hate annoying stuff.
scripts.translation:
[宣傳人員]
給我？？
我最討厭這種麻煩事了。

scripts.text:
[Promotional Staff]
Ahh... I sensed that I would get your request.
The recruiter sent you here to get tested?
Hmm.
scripts.translation:
[宣傳人員]
啊...我就知道會有人來找我。
是招募員派你來接受測試的嗎？
嗯。

scripts.text:
[Promotional Staff]
Ah! They always push me,
to suffer from so much work
I live a hard life!
scripts.translation:
[宣傳人員]
啊！他們總是給我施壓，
讓我承受這麼多工作，
我活得真辛苦！

scripts.text:
[Promotional Staff]
My job is testing if you are strong and brave enough for this adventure.
What a bother!
scripts.translation:
[宣傳人員]
我的工作就是測試你是否足夠強壯和勇敢，以勝任這次冒險。
真是煩死了！

scripts.text:
[Promotional Staff]
I will accept you if you bring me ^FF0000300 Jellopy^000000.
I believe that you can bring them to me.
Are you ready?
scripts.translation:
[宣傳人員]
如果你能給我帶^FF0000300個傑勒比結晶^000000，我就接受你。
我相信你能把它們帶給我。
準備好了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Promotional Staff]
Just go ahead and hunt monsters, or whatever and collect 300 jellopies.
Then we can go forward.
scripts.translation:
[宣傳人員]
去獵殺魔物，或者做點別的，收集300個傑勒比結晶。
然後我們才能繼續。

scripts.text:
[Promotional Staff]
Did you take the test?
Or are you already enjoying your adventure?
scripts.translation:
[宣傳人員]
你接受測試了嗎？
還是說你已經開始享受你的冒險了？

scripts.text:
[Promotional Staff]
You didn't visit ^FF0000Izlude^000000, did you?
Or do you have any business in Geffen?
scripts.translation:
[宣傳人員]
你還沒去過^FF0000依斯魯得島^000000，對吧？
或者你在吉芬有什麼事要辦？

scripts.text:
[Promotional Staff]
^FF00001 Ruby!!^000000.
Don't you forget it!
Hurry up! Time is zeny!
scripts.translation:
[宣傳人員]
^FF00001顆紅寶石！！^000000
別忘了這個！
快點！時間就是Zeny！

scripts.text:
[Promotional Staff]
Wow, you brought a genuine Jewel.
You are absolutely qualified.
I can tell these things.
scripts.translation:
[宣傳人員]
哇，你帶來了一顆真正的寶石。
你絕對合格。
我看得出來。

scripts.text:
[Promotional Staff]
Am I exaggerating?
It's true that you're
considerably strong.
scripts.translation:
[宣傳人員]
我是不是誇張了？
但你確實
相當強大。

scripts.text:
[Promotional Staff]
Ok! My job is done.
Good job!!
scripts.translation:
[宣傳人員]
好！我的任務完成了。
幹得好！！

scripts.text:
[Promotional Staff]
Next step is Izlude!
You can get tested by the Promotional Staff there.
Hurry up!
scripts.translation:
[宣傳人員]
下一步是依斯魯得島！
你可以去那裡找宣傳人員接受測試。
快點！

scripts.text:
[Promotional Staff]
The unknown place...
It is a very dangerous place so you must go through these tests before we can send you....
We're pretty picky.
scripts.translation:
[宣傳人員]
那個未知的地方...
那裡非常危險，所以在你出發前必須通過這些測試....
我們很挑剔。

scripts.text:
[Promotional Staff]
I hope you can do it!
Good luck!
scripts.translation:
[宣傳人員]
希望你能做到！
祝你好運！

scripts.text:
[Promotional Staff]
The one you should bring me is
^FF0000Emerald^000000. Can you get it?
scripts.translation:
[宣傳人員]
你需要給我帶的是
^FF0000綠寶石^000000。你能拿到嗎？

scripts.text:
[Promotional Staff]
You brought it so soon!
You're a real adventurer!
I will accept this Emerald as evidence.
scripts.translation:
[宣傳人員]
你這麼快就帶來了！
你真是名符其實的冒險者！
我會收下這顆綠寶石作為證明。

scripts.text:
[Promotional Staff]
This isn't something I wanted to keep for myself.
You know that, right?
scripts.translation:
[宣傳人員]
這並不是我想自己留下的東西。
你知道的，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Promotional Staff]
Next bring me ^FF00001 Ruby^000000.
I can't judge you with only one jewel.
So I need one more stone.
scripts.translation:
[宣傳人員]
接下來給我帶^FF00001顆紅寶石^000000。
光憑一顆寶石我無法判斷你。
所以我還需要一顆石頭。

scripts.text:
[Promotional Staff]
Please bring me a Ruby.
As I mentioned, this is the second request.
I will wait until you bring me a stone again.
scripts.translation:
[宣傳人員]
請給我帶一顆紅寶石。
正如我提到的，這是第二個要求。
我會等你再次帶石頭給我。

scripts.text:
[Promotional Staff]
We are recruiting adventurers who are strong and curious. Try your life at something more challenging.
scripts.translation:
[宣傳人員]
我們正在招募強大且充滿好奇心的冒險者。去挑戰更艱難的事物吧。

scripts.text:
[Promotional Staff]
Hey, you're a knowledgeable person, right? Are you interested in my story?
scripts.translation:
[宣傳人員]
嘿，你看起來是個見多識廣的人，對吧？對我的故事感興趣嗎？

scripts.text: The Staff in Aldebaran sent me.
scripts.translation: 是艾爾戴巴的職員派我來的。

scripts.text:
[Promotional Staff]
Oh he did?
scripts.translation:
[宣傳人員]
哦，是嗎？

scripts.text:
[Promotional Staff]
Ok, I guess that it's time for the second part of your test.
scripts.translation:
[宣傳人員]
好吧，看來是時候進行你測試的第二部分了。

scripts.text:
[Promotional Staff]
I need you to gather some stones for me.
scripts.translation:
[宣傳人員]
我需要你為我收集一些石頭。

scripts.text:
[Promotional Staff]
I will accept you if you bring ^FF00001 Emerald^000000.
Are you ready?
scripts.translation:
[宣傳人員]
如果你能帶^FF00001顆綠寶石^000000來，我就接受你。
你準備好了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Promotional Staff]
Just bring me ^ff00001 Emerald^000000.
That isn't hard for you right?
Then we can go forward.
scripts.translation:
[宣傳人員]
只要給我帶^ff00001顆綠寶石^000000就行。
這對你來說不難吧？
那樣我們就能繼續前進了。

scripts.text:
[Promotional Staff]
I bless you for your future! May it be full of happiness!
scripts.translation:
[宣傳人員]
我祝福你的未來！願它充滿幸福！

scripts.text:
[Promotional Staff]
The test is done!
If you have any other business, go to the palace.
scripts.translation:
[宣傳人員]
測試結束了！
如果你還有其他事，請去宮殿。

scripts.text:
[Promotional Staff]
You don't look that strong.
Nothing but skin and bones!
Not reliable.
You should level up more before
considering this adventure.
scripts.translation:
[宣傳人員]
你看起來並不強壯。
瘦骨嶙峋！
不可靠。
你應該再提升等級，
再考慮這次冒險。

scripts.text:
[Promotional Staff]
I don't need adventurers who are
body-builders... but at least
someone not so little!!
scripts.translation:
[宣傳人員]
我不需要那些
肌肉發達的冒險者...但至少
不能這麼瘦小！！

scripts.text:
[Promotional Staff]
Wow! You are considerably
stronger than before!
Let me see...
You look different!
scripts.translation:
[宣傳人員]
哇！你比之前
強多了！
讓我看看...
你看起來不一樣了！

scripts.text:
[Promotional Staff]
Um...
scripts.translation:
[宣傳人員]
嗯...

scripts.text:
[Promotional Staff]
Ok, it's done!
You seemed a sore weak of a soul,
but now, you're quite stronger than
before. Great! You will do!!
scripts.translation:
[宣傳人員]
好吧，結束了！
你看起來像個虛弱的人，
但現在，你比之前強多了。很好！你會成功的！！

scripts.text:
[Promotional Staff]
We have quite high expectations to meet.
Though the new place is dangerous,
no need to check thoroughly
anymore.
scripts.translation:
[宣傳人員]
我們有相當高的期望標準。
雖然新地方很危險，
但不再需要徹底檢查了。

scripts.text:
[Promotional Staff]
It's not a hell-hole!
Ukk!
scripts.translation:
[宣傳人員]
那裡不是地獄！
嗚！

scripts.text:
[Promotional Staff]
Anyway, just go back to the
Recruiter. I will forward to him
that you passed all the steps. Good
job, friend!
scripts.translation:
[宣傳人員]
總之，回到招募員那裡吧。我會告訴他
你通過了所有步驟。幹得好，朋友！

scripts.text:
[Promotional Staff]
Bless all of your heart,
for your great future!
scripts.translation:
[宣傳人員]
願福佑你的心靈，
為了你光明的未來！

scripts.text:
[Promotional Staff]
We are recruiting adventurers
who are quite strong and curious.
scripts.translation:
[宣傳人員]
我們正在招募
強大且充滿好奇心的冒險者。

scripts.text:
[Promotional Staff]
Hey, you're a knowledgeable adventurer. Are you interested in my story?
scripts.translation:
[宣傳人員]
嘿，你是一位見多識廣的冒險者。
你對我的故事感興趣嗎？

scripts.text: I have something for you.
scripts.translation: 我有東西給你

scripts.text:
[Promotional Staff]
Um, you're the one sent to be tested, correct? You are in the right place. I'm the Promotional Staff in Izlude.
scripts.translation:
[宣傳人員]
嗯，你就是被派來接受測試的人，對吧？
你找對地方了。我是依斯魯得島的宣傳人員。

scripts.text:
[Promotional Staff]
I guess you're qualified enough to go... I think no more testing is needed.
scripts.translation:
[宣傳人員]
我想你的資格已經足夠了...
我覺得不需要再進行更多測試了。

scripts.text:
[Promotional Staff]
Let me see...
scripts.translation:
[宣傳人員]
讓我看看...

scripts.text:
[Promotional Staff]
I think you're good enough!
No more testing!!
Ok! You pass!
scripts.translation:
[宣傳人員]
我覺得你足夠優秀了！
不需要再測試了！！
好的！你通過了！

scripts.text:
[Promotional Staff]
We have quite high expectations to meet.
Though the new place is dangerous,
no need to check thoroughly right now.
scripts.translation:
[宣傳人員]
我們有相當高的期望標準。
雖然新地方很危險，
但現在不需要徹底檢查了。

scripts.text:
[Promotional Staff]
It's not a hell-hole!
Ukk...
scripts.translation:
[宣傳人員]
那裡不是地獄！
嗚...

scripts.text:
[Promotional Staff]
Anyway, just go back to the recruiter.
I will forward to him that you passed all the steps.
Good job, friend!
scripts.translation:
[宣傳人員]
總之，回到招募員那裡吧。
我會告訴他你通過了所有步驟。
幹得好，朋友！

scripts.text:
[Promotional Staff]
May Freya bless you,
for your great future!
scripts.translation:
[宣傳人員]
願弗蕾雅保佑你，
為了你光明的未來！

scripts.text:
[Promotional Staff]
Hmm...
scripts.translation:
[宣傳人員]
嗯...

scripts.text:
[Promotional Staff]
You don't look that strong.
Nothing but skin and bones!
Not reliable.
I can't let you pass.
scripts.translation:
[宣傳人員]
你看起來並不強壯。
瘦骨嶙峋的！
不可靠。
我不能讓你通過。

scripts.text:
[Promotional Staff]
Please level up a little more. I
can't accept that you're strong
enough. Sorry.
scripts.translation:
[宣傳人員]
請再提升一點等級。
我無法接受你足夠強大。
抱歉。

scripts.text:
[Guide]
Welcome! You've arrived at Lighthalzen, which is the base of three kingdoms.
scripts.translation:
[嚮導]
歡迎！你已抵達裡希塔樂鎮，
這裡是三個王國的基地。

scripts.text:
[Guide]
You have to register your name. Go to the 2nd floor in Rekenbereu on the northwest side.
scripts.translation:
[嚮導]
你必須登記你的名字。
去西北側的雷肯貝魯二樓。

scripts.text:
[Guide]
Be careful not to lose your way!
scripts.translation:
[嚮導]
小心不要迷路！

scripts.text:
[Guide]
Welcome! You've arrived at Lighthalzen, which is the base of three kingdoms.
scripts.translation:
[嚮導]
歡迎！你已抵達裡希塔樂鎮，
這裡是三個王國的基地。

scripts.text: -At this spot, it's possible to overhear something. Listen carefully through the wall...-
scripts.translation: -在這個位置，有可能聽到一些動靜。仔細透過牆壁聽...-

scripts.text:
[Munkenro]
You're a good buddy!
But...
scripts.translation:
[蒙肯羅]
你是個好夥伴！
但是...

scripts.text:
[Munkenro]
We can't avoid this...
You know better than I!
We can't go through this,
in this current status.
scripts.translation:
[蒙肯羅]
我們無法避免...
你比我更清楚！
以我們目前的狀態，
我們無法度過這一關。

scripts.text:
[Munkenro]
I did all I could do...
Please...
scripts.translation:
[蒙肯羅]
我已經盡力了...
拜託了...

scripts.text:
[Munkenro]
......

[{0}]
There's no avoiding it.
Ok, I need to try.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
無法迴避了。
好吧，我必須嘗試一下。

scripts.text:
[Munkenro]
You are ready to try this...
scripts.translation:
[蒙肯羅]
你準備好嘗試了...

scripts.text:
[Munkenro]
Oh! My friend...
scripts.translation:
[蒙肯羅]
哦！我的朋友...

scripts.text:
[Munkenro]
Nothing can be controlled anymore... Am I trying this...?
scripts.translation:
[蒙肯羅]
一切已無法控制...我這是在嘗試嗎...

scripts.text:
[Munkenro]
Peace for the three kingdoms...?
Isn't it impossible...?
scripts.translation:
[蒙肯羅]
三個王國的和平...？
這難道不可能嗎...？

scripts.text:
[Munkenro]
Are you sure that
you can do that?
scripts.translation:
[蒙肯羅]
你確定你能做到嗎？

scripts.text:
[Munkenro]
Nothing shall prevent me from doing my duty. Nothing!
scripts.translation:
[蒙肯羅]
沒有什麼能阻止我履行職責。什麼都沒有！

scripts.text:
[Munkenro]
Sikaiz is a kind and upright person. But he can't be cautious about everything. It could cause serious problems.
scripts.translation:
[蒙肯羅]
西凱茲是個善良正直的人。但他不可能事事謹慎。這可能會引發嚴重的問題。

scripts.text:
[Munkenro]
So that's why I am here for him. I always worry about him...
scripts.translation:
[蒙肯羅]
所以我才在這裡守護他。我總是為他憂心...

scripts.text:
[Munkenro]
I don't know what I would do if something were to happen...
scripts.translation:
[蒙肯羅]
我不知道如果發生什麼意外，我會怎麼做...

scripts.text:
[Munkenro]
......

[Sikaiz]
Please come to me ASAP.
I hope you play an active part.
scripts.translation:
[西凱茲]
請儘快來找我。
我希望你能積極參與。

scripts.text:
[Sikaiz]
We all expect you to make the biggest impact.
scripts.translation:
[西凱茲]
我們都期待你能發揮最大的作用。

scripts.text:
[Sikaiz]
Only thing you should do is write down your name and show me your great face
scripts.translation:
[西凱茲]
你只需要寫下你的名字，並讓我看看你那張偉大的臉

scripts.text:
[Sikaiz]
I already accept you. Just write down your name here. Go ahead.
scripts.translation:
[西凱茲]
我已經接受你了。就在這裡寫下你的名字吧。請。

scripts.text:
[Sikaiz]
Don't you know your own name?
Write it again.
scripts.translation:
[西凱茲]
你不知道自己的名字嗎？
再寫一遍。

scripts.text:
[Sikaiz]
Ok. I got your name, {0}. Great name! Registration is done!
You've become a member of the three kingdoms!
scripts.translation:
[西凱茲]
好的。我記下你的名字了，{0}。很棒的名字！註冊完成！
你已成為三個王國的成員！

scripts.text:
[Sikaiz]
All done.
Go to the field Officer of Schwarzwald. He should be in the banquet hall of this building downstairs.
scripts.translation:
[西凱茲]
全部辦妥了。
請去修瓦魯茲巴魯德找軍官。他應該就在這棟樓下的宴會廳裡。

scripts.text:
[Sikaiz]
Only thing left for you is to go to the Officer to say that you are leaving now.
scripts.translation:
[西凱茲]
你現在只需要去找軍官，告訴他你要離開了。

scripts.text:
[Sikaiz]
As soon as you tell him,
come back to me again.
You are not the only one expecting this great challenge. I am too.
scripts.translation:
[西凱茲]
告訴他之後，再回來找我。
期待這場偉大挑戰的並不只有你，我也一樣。

scripts.text:
[Sikaiz]
I believe you can do it!
It would bear watching you.
scripts.translation:
[西凱茲]
我相信你能做到！
我很期待看到你的表現。

scripts.text:
[Sikaiz]
See you then.
scripts.translation:
[西凱茲]
到時候見。

scripts.text:
[Sikaiz]
You came back!
Fast learner!
I love that you're a member of my alliance.
scripts.translation:
[西凱茲]
你回來了！
學得真快！
很高興你是我們同盟的成員。

scripts.text:
[Sikaiz]
Our preparations will soon be complete.
scripts.translation:
[西凱茲]
我們的準備工作很快就要完成了。

scripts.text:
[Sikaiz]
We will surely share all our information with the three kingdoms, and study them.
scripts.translation:
[西凱茲]
我們一定會與三個王國共享所有情報，並加以研究。

scripts.text:
[Sikaiz]
Definitely, you are the one to face all the trials and tribulations.
scripts.translation:
[西凱茲]
毫無疑問，你就是那個要面對所有試煉與磨難的人。

scripts.text:
[Sikaiz]
The important thing is that we need to share all the current information relevant to this place.
scripts.translation:
[西凱茲]
重要的是，我們需要共享所有與這個地方相關的最新情報。

scripts.text:
[Sikaiz]
I advise you,
if you get friendly with
the creatures in there,
that's a kind source to know.
I'll believe you.
scripts.translation:
[西凱茲]
我建議你，
如果你能與裡面的生物
建立友好關係，
那將是一個很好的情報來源。
我相信你。

scripts.text:
[Sikaiz]
Let's conclude.
You need to investigate and report to us as much as possible. That's not that tough.
scripts.translation:
[西凱茲]
總結一下。
你需要儘可能多地調查並彙報給我們。這並不難。

scripts.text:
[Sikaiz]
Don't worry so much.
We will support you.
As we can.
So I will tell you the last step to becoming a member of the alliance.
scripts.translation:
[西凱茲]
別擔心。
我們會支援你。
盡我們所能。
所以，我要告訴你成為同盟成員的最後一個步驟。

scripts.text:
[Sikaiz]
In ^FF0000Cheshrumnir in Rachel^000000,
there is a Manager.
scripts.translation:
[西凱茲]
在^FF0000拉赫的瑟斯隆尼勒^000000，
有一位管理員。

scripts.text:
[Sikaiz]
You already met someone like that from Rune-Midgarts. So no more explanation is needed.
scripts.translation:
[西凱茲]
你在盧恩·米德加茲已經見過類似的人了。所以不需要再多解釋了。

scripts.text:
[Sikaiz]
Ok, so we should talk about
the tasks we should go through.
These are about it...
scripts.translation:
[西凱茲]
好的，那麼我們應該談談
我們需要完成的任務。
大概就是這樣...

scripts.text:
[Munkenro]
Hey, sorry for interrupting you. I also have information to send to Arunafeltz.
scripts.translation:
[蒙肯羅]
嘿，抱歉打斷你們。我也有情報要發給阿魯納菲茲。

scripts.text:
[Munkenro]
We're in a hurry.
scripts.translation:
[蒙肯羅]
我們很趕時間。

scripts.text:
[Sikaiz]
Hey! You hear that? Sorry I'm sure that you've got many things to do. Can I request one more thing? I can't deal with it myself.
scripts.translation:
[西凱茲]
嘿！你聽到了嗎？抱歉，我知道你有很多事要做。我能再請求一件事嗎？我自己處理不了。

scripts.text:
[Sikaiz]
I feel like I am forcing you, but I hope to get your help. Go to the ^FF0000Cheshrumnir Guard^000000 in Rachel and deliver Munkenro's message for me.
scripts.translation:
[西凱茲]
我覺得我在強迫你，但我希望能得到你的幫助。請去拉赫找^FF0000切什魯姆尼爾衛兵^000000，幫我轉達蒙肯羅的資訊。

scripts.text:
[Sikaiz]
It's the same mission you did for Rune-Midgarts, so it shouldn't be that hard. I hope you can do it.
scripts.translation:
[西凱茲]
這和你在盧恩·米德加茲做過的任務一樣，應該不會太難。希望你能順利完成。

scripts.text:
[Sikaiz]
You did it already?
You are a quick worker.
scripts.translation:
[西凱茲]
你已經完成了？
你的動作真快。

scripts.text:
[Sikaiz]
Anyway, I promised to tell you about the three kingdoms... This is kind of a long story, so please listen carefully.
scripts.translation:
[西凱茲]
總之，我答應過要告訴你關於三個王國的事... 這有點長，請仔細聽。

scripts.text:
[Sikaiz]
The adventurers for Ash-vacuum! The alliance for the three kingdoms! Rune-Midgarts, Schwarzwald, Arunafeltz!
Three kingdoms united for one thing!
scripts.translation:
[西凱茲]
為了阿什真空！三個王國的聯盟！盧恩·米德加茲、修瓦魯茲巴魯德、阿魯納菲茲！
三個王國為了同一個目標而聯合！

scripts.text:
[Sikaiz]
Frankly, there's a Dimensional Rift in the Sograt desert, so they can inspect it themselves, but it's not that good of a place to inspect the rift's magic well.
scripts.translation:
[西凱茲]
說實話，蘇克拉特沙漠裡有一個次元裂縫，他們自己也可以去檢查，但那裡並不是檢查裂縫魔力井的好地方。

scripts.text:
[Sikaiz]
We are a little bit better in magic, but not that much developed in science as compared with Schwarzwald, and not as wise compared with Arunafeltz.
scripts.translation:
[西凱茲]
我們在魔法上稍微強一點，但科技不如修瓦魯茲巴魯德發達，智慧也不如阿魯納菲茲。

scripts.text:
[Sikaiz]
So we need to get help from other countries, because the Ash-vacuum is quite a profitable place. That is why we made the Alliance to get into the Ash-Vacuum.
scripts.translation:
[西凱茲]
所以我們需要其他國家的幫助，因為阿什真空是一個非常有利的地方。這就是我們建立聯盟進入阿什真空的原因。

scripts.text:
[Sikaiz]
The three kingdoms were enemies before. Fortunately, it's going well now. It's fine.
scripts.translation:
[西凱茲]
這三個王國以前是敵人。幸運的是，現在情況還不錯。沒問題。

scripts.text:
[Sikaiz]
This alliance is a first step for peace among the three kingdoms. You know they are all for themselves, so this needs harmony. That's the one thing to pursue, as head of an alliance.
scripts.translation:
[西凱茲]
這個聯盟是三個王國和平的第一步。你知道他們都只顧自己，所以需要和諧。作為聯盟的首領，這是唯一需要追求的目標。

scripts.text:
[Sikaiz]
Honestly, I am also forced by my kingdom, to further our own interests and not others.
scripts.translation:
[西凱茲]
老實說，我也被我的王國施壓，要求我進一步追求我們自己的利益，而不是別人的。

scripts.text:
[Sikaiz]
But the most valuable thing is the unity. Not each kingdom's interest. If we spoil the greatest plans, it's too regrettable.
scripts.translation:
[西凱茲]
但最有價值的是團結。不是每個王國的利益。如果我們破壞了最偉大的計劃，那就太遺憾了。

scripts.text:
[Sikaiz]
Though I belong to Schwarzwald, I need to balance the three kingdoms, as a leader... so I can't support my kingdom too much over the others.
scripts.translation:
[西凱茲]
雖然我屬於修瓦魯茲巴魯德，但作為領袖... 我需要平衡三個王國，所以我不能過度偏袒我的王國。

scripts.text:
[Sikaiz]
Anyway, I believe that my friend can assist me well.
Though he is from another kingdom, he's supported me thus far.
scripts.translation:
[西凱茲]
總之，我相信我的朋友能很好地協助我。
雖然他是來自另一個王國的人，但他一直支援我。

scripts.text:
[Sikaiz]
He's the man to my left.
We call him Munk.
His real name is... Munkenro.
scripts.translation:
[西凱茲]
他是我左邊的那個男人。
我們叫他蒙克。
他的真名是... 蒙肯羅。

scripts.text:
[Sikaiz]
He is a kind of manager for Schwaltzvald and he is the main contact point of the kingdom's people, since he's quite closely in communication with them.
scripts.translation:
[西凱茲]
他是修瓦魯茲巴魯德的一種管理員，也是王國人民的主要聯絡人，因為他與他們溝通得很密切。

scripts.text:
[Sikaiz]
That's enough talk about the three kingdoms. Now, let's move on to the next stories.
scripts.translation:
[西凱茲]
關於三個王國的話就說到這裡。現在，讓我們繼續下一個話題。

scripts.text:
[Sikaiz]
Go to Prontera in Rune-Midgarts and find the Manager there. Tell him that the Alliance is doing well and that we are entering the rift.
scripts.translation:
[西凱茲]
去盧恩·米德加茲的普隆德拉，找到那裡的管理員。告訴他聯盟進展順利，並且我們正在進入裂縫。

scripts.text:
[Sikaiz]
So, what do you want to know more of? You already know about the Ash-Vacuum. Is there anything else you'd like me to tell you?
scripts.translation:
[西凱茲]
那麼，你還想知道什麼？你已經知道關於阿什真空的事了。還有什麼你想讓我告訴你的嗎？

scripts.text: The three kingdoms...
scripts.translation: 三個王國...

scripts.text:
[Sikaiz]
Ah, I need to tell you about the alliance, but first, may I ask something?
scripts.translation:
[西凱茲]
啊，我需要告訴你關於聯盟的事，但首先，我可以問個問題嗎？

scripts.text:
[Sikaiz]
I need to report its status to the managers in Rune-Midgarts. I can't do it right now. May I ask you a favor?
scripts.translation:
[西凱茲]
我需要向盧恩·米德加茲的管理員彙報情況，但現在無法離開。能請你幫個忙嗎？

scripts.text:
[Sikaiz]
It's not that difficult. Just tell them to prepare for the trip to the Dimensional Rift. It's quite easy, isn't it?
scripts.translation:
[西凱茲]
這並不難。只要告訴他們為前往次元裂縫的旅程做準備即可。很簡單，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Sikaiz]
We're running out of time, so I will answer you when you come back. Ok?
scripts.translation:
[西凱茲]
時間不多了，等你回來我再回答你的問題。好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Sikaiz]
Whew......

[Sikaiz]
You come to be registered as an adventurer? Then I'm the one to talk to. I am Sikaiz, the head of the United Midgard Alliance.
scripts.translation:
[西凱茲]
你是來登記成為冒險者的嗎？那你找對人了。我是西凱茲，米德加爾特聯合聯盟的領袖。

scripts.text:
[Sikaiz]
You come here from Prontera? Then you have been sent by the Recruiter. Didn't he tell you about the stories? Maybe he thought that I would tell you everything.
scripts.translation:
[西凱茲]
你是從普隆德拉來的？那你應該是招募員派來的。他沒有告訴你那些故事嗎？也許他覺得我會把一切都告訴你。

scripts.text:
[Sikaiz]
I can tell you, but, he's so obstinate. So many kinds of people are living in this world, but quite few are as obstinate as him.
scripts.translation:
[西凱茲]
我可以告訴你，但他太固執了。這個世界上有各種各樣的人，但像他這麼固執的卻很少。

scripts.text:
[Sikaiz]
The registration is also important now, but I will tell you about our status here. May I begin?
scripts.translation:
[西凱茲]
登記現在也很重要，但我會先告訴你我們在這裡的情況。我可以開始講了嗎？

scripts.text: Sure.
scripts.translation: 當然。

scripts.text:
[Sikaiz]
Ok. Let me tell you about the Ash-Vacuum. It's quite a long story. So please bear with me.
scripts.translation:
[西凱茲]
好的。讓我給你講講阿什真空。故事有點長，請耐心聽我說。

scripts.text:
[Sikaiz]
^FF0000Ash-Vacuum^000000....
This isn't the world of mortals.
Then what is it...
Nobody knows.
scripts.translation:
[西凱茲]
^FF0000阿什真空^000000....
這不是凡人的世界。
那麼它是什麼...
沒有人知道。

scripts.text:
[Sikaiz]
Now, we only know that there are living beings there, and that they are not approachable by everyone.
scripts.translation:
[西凱茲]
現在，我們只知道那裡有生物存在，而且並非所有人都能接近它們。

scripts.text:
[Sikaiz]
The name, 'Ash-Vacuum', is so we can identify it easily.
scripts.translation:
[西凱茲]
“阿什真空”這個名字，只是為了方便識別它。

scripts.text:
[Sikaiz]
You're probably wondering how we got there...
The answer lies with Satan Morocc.
scripts.translation:
[西凱茲]
你大概會好奇我們是怎麼到達那裡的...
答案與魔王夢羅克有關。

scripts.text:
[Sikaiz]
Can you imagine?
Why did Satan Morocc
run away from there???
That's the important thing.
scripts.translation:
[西凱茲]
你能想像嗎？
魔王夢羅克為什麼從那裡逃跑了？？？
這才是關鍵所在。

scripts.text:
[Sikaiz]
He made a gate to run away, by himself. It's very unlike him.
scripts.translation:
[西凱茲]
他獨自打開了一扇門逃了出來。這非常不像他的作風。

scripts.text:
[Sikaiz]
But he did make some mistakes. He left an opened gate. Nobody knows if it was intentional... or maybe...
scripts.translation:
[西凱茲]
但他犯了一些錯誤。他留下了一扇開啟的門。沒人知道這是故意的...還是說...

scripts.text:
[Sikaiz]
We call the dimensional rift:
Time-Gap of Dimension.
Who knows what secrets lie in that world beyond.
scripts.translation:
[西凱茲]
我們將這個次元裂縫稱為：
次元時間裂隙。
誰知道那個世界之外隱藏著什麼秘密。

scripts.text:
[Sikaiz]
So we've inspected it.
And there's not much info to get from it. We can't guess if it's from the past... or the future... Even WE don't know where it is.
scripts.translation:
[西凱茲]
所以我們調查了它。
但從中獲取的資訊並不多。我們無法判斷它是來自過去...還是未來...甚至我們也不知道它在哪裡。

scripts.text:
[Sikaiz]
That's the place!
Ash-Vacuum!
We are all in this together!
scripts.translation:
[西凱茲]
那就是那個地方！
阿什真空！
我們都在同一條船上！

scripts.text:
[Sikaiz]
Is that enough?
Though I am the head of the Alliance, I don't know much else about it. That's why we are all here. To do some research.
scripts.translation:
[西凱茲]
這些夠了嗎？
雖然我是聯盟的領袖，但我對它的瞭解也不多。這就是我們都在這裡研究的原因。

scripts.text:
[Sikaiz]
Anyway, I told you about Ash-Vacuum. What I know about it all. Though you still don't know much about it, that's all I can tell you.
scripts.translation:
[西凱茲]
總之，我已經把關於阿什真空我知道的一切都告訴你們了。雖然你們對它的瞭解依然有限，但我能說的就只有這些了。

scripts.text:
[Sikaiz]
If you have any other questions, you can still ask me...
scripts.translation:
[西凱茲]
如果你們還有其他問題，儘管問我...

scripts.text:
- The man standing in front -
- is delivering a speech. -
- Let's listen. -
scripts.translation:
- 站在前面的那個男人 -
- 正在發表演講。 -
- 讓我們聽聽吧。 -

scripts.text:
[Sikaiz]
I, Sikaiz, make it a point that we should pursue the great development of the Midgard continent with the research of the newly discovered Ash-Vacuum.
scripts.translation:
[西凱茲]
我，西凱茲，在此鄭重提議：我們應當通過對新發現的阿什真空的研究，推動米德加爾特大陸的偉大復興。

scripts.text:
[Sikaiz]
So we must not fight for own interests, we must not forget the mission. We are all together on this, to go through all the same trials.
scripts.translation:
[西凱茲]
因此，我們絕不能只顧私利，更不能忘記使命。我們同舟共濟，將共同經歷所有的考驗。

scripts.text:
[Sikaiz]
This mission shouldn't be for each kingdom's interest alone. If we are not strongly allied for our mission, we will not succeed in discovering the unknown places of Ash-Vacuum.
scripts.translation:
[西凱茲]
這項使命不應僅僅為了某個王國的利益。如果我們不能為了使命而緊密結盟，就無法成功探索阿什真空中的未知之地。

scripts.text:
[Sikaiz]
Now we should think we are all belonging to the Midgard continent. That's home for all of us.
scripts.translation:
[西凱茲]
現在，我們應該意識到我們都屬於米德加爾特大陸。那是我們共同的家園。

scripts.text:
[Sikaiz]
We will leave for Ash-Vacuum, through the dimensional rift soon.
You all should be relaxed about completing this mission. If there are more adventurers to register, let them come to me.
scripts.translation:
[西凱茲]
我們將很快通過次元裂隙前往阿什真空。
請放輕鬆，去完成這項使命吧。如果有更多冒險者想要登記，讓他們來找我。

scripts.text:
- The speech has ended. -
- Let's move on. -
scripts.translation:
- 演講結束了。 -
- 讓我們繼續前進吧。 -

scripts.text:
[Sikaiz]
......

[Guard]
You're not allowed to enter.
All of you are instructed to go to the Time-Gap of Dimension on Rune-Midgarts!
scripts.translation:
[衛兵]
禁止入內。
你們所有人都被指示前往盧恩·米德加茲的次元時間裂隙！

scripts.text:
[Guard]
You've come here
to register as a member of the three kingdoms?
scripts.translation:
[衛兵]
你們是來這裡登記成為三國聯盟成員的？

scripts.text:
[Guard]
You are not allowed
to enter.
scripts.translation:
[衛兵]
禁止入內。

scripts.text:
[Guard]
Just go there.
This is a restricted area.
scripts.translation:
[衛兵]
就待在那裡吧。
這是限制區域。

scripts.text:
[Guard]
Enter.
scripts.translation:
[衛兵]
請進。

scripts.text:
[Guard]
You're not allowed to enter.
All of you are instructed to go to the Time-Gap of Dimension on Rune-Midgarts!
scripts.translation:
[衛兵]
禁止入內。
你們所有人都被指示前往盧恩·米德加茲的次元時間裂隙！

scripts.text:
[Guard]
Just go there.
This is a restricted area.
scripts.translation:
[衛兵]
就待在那裡吧。
這是限制區域。

scripts.text:
[Guard]
Will you go to the dimensional rift right now?
scripts.translation:
[衛兵]
您現在要前往次元裂隙嗎？

scripts.text:
[Guard]
If you want,
I can send you to the Time-Gap of Dimension.
scripts.translation:
[衛兵]
如果您願意，
我可以送您去次元時間裂隙。

scripts.text: Send me there.
scripts.translation: 送我過去

scripts.text: I will go there myself.
scripts.translation: 我自己去

scripts.text:
[Guard]
Ok, I will send you to the dimensional rift. Once you get there, just find the head of the alliance.
scripts.translation:
[衛兵]
好的，我將送您前往次元裂隙。到達後，請找到聯盟的領袖。

scripts.text:
[Guard]
You are something of an adventurer... Ok. I got it...
scripts.translation:
[衛兵]
看來您是個不錯的冒險者... 好的，我明白了...

scripts.text:
[Guard]
Once you get there, just find the head of the alliance.
scripts.translation:
[衛兵]
到達那裡後，請找到聯盟的領袖。

scripts.text:
[Guard]
You've come here
to register as a member of the three kingdoms?
scripts.translation:
[衛兵]
你們是來這裡登記成為三國聯盟成員的？

scripts.text:
[Guard]
Enter.
scripts.translation:
[衛兵]
請進。

scripts.text:
[Guard]
You are not allowed
to enter.
scripts.translation:
[衛兵]
禁止入內。

scripts.text: -Munkenro and Sakaiz don't seem to be getting along very well anymore.-
scripts.translation: -蒙肯羅和西凱茲似乎相處得不太融洽了。-

scripts.text:
[Member of Alliance]
Hm, ok!
That's right.
scripts.translation:
[聯盟成員]
嗯，好的！
沒錯。

scripts.text: -You should probably head over to the dimensional rift next to Morocc and find the Guard there-
scripts.translation: -您最好前往莫洛奇旁邊的次元裂隙，並找到那裡的衛兵。-

scripts.text:
[Member of Alliance]
The heads of the alliance, Sikaiz and Munkenro...
scripts.translation:
[聯盟成員]
聯盟的領袖，西凱茲和蒙肯羅...

scripts.text:
[Member of Alliance]
They have different values,
so that sometimes causes conflict, but nothing serious has happened so far.
scripts.translation:
[聯盟成員]
他們的價值觀不同，
這有時會導致衝突，但到目前為止還沒有發生嚴重的事情。

scripts.text:
[Member of Alliance]
Friendship is the most valuable in this world.
scripts.translation:
[聯盟成員]
在這個世界裡，友誼是最寶貴的。

scripts.text: -You're still here? You're a member of the alliance now so you should head to the dimensional rift next to Morocc and find the Guard there-
scripts.translation: -您還在這裡？既然您現在是聯盟成員了，就應該前往莫洛奇旁邊的次元裂隙，並找到那裡的衛兵。-

scripts.text:
[Member of Alliance]
I know we are all to go to the dimensional rift. That's why we are allied strongly. But we gather here... so far from there...
scripts.translation:
[聯盟成員]
我知道大家都要去次元裂隙。正因如此，我們的聯盟才如此緊密。但我們聚集在這裡... 離那裡那麼遠...

scripts.text:
[Member of Alliance]
I think we'd better gather in Prontera on Rune-Midgarts, where I am living.
scripts.translation:
[聯盟成員]
我覺得我們最好在盧恩·米德加茲的普隆德拉聚集，我就住在那裡。

scripts.text:
[Member of Alliance]
Or just warp for commuting.
I would hope so.
scripts.translation:
[聯盟成員]
或者乾脆用傳送來通勤。
我希望是這樣。

scripts.text: -I'm sure they'll settle their little dispute somehow. You should be heading to the dimensional rift next to Morocc and find the Guard there-
scripts.translation: -我相信他們會以某種方式解決他們的小分歧。您應該前往莫洛奇旁邊的次元裂隙，並找到那裡的衛兵。-

scripts.text:
[Member of Alliance]
Hm...
scripts.translation:
[聯盟成員]
嗯...

scripts.text:
[Member of Alliance]
Hm...
scripts.translation:
[聯盟成員]
嗯...

scripts.text:
[Member of Alliance]
Whoosh...
scripts.translation:
[聯盟成員]
呼...

scripts.text:
[Member of Alliance]
I am concentrating now!!
Don't worry!
scripts.translation:
[聯盟成員]
我現在正在集中精神！！
別擔心！

scripts.text: -Maybe Munk is a better leader instead of Sakaiz. Anyways you should be heading to the dimensional rift next to Morocc and find the Guard there-
scripts.translation: -也許蒙肯羅比西凱茲更適合當領袖。無論如何，您應該前往莫洛奇旁邊的次元裂隙，並找到那裡的衛兵。-

scripts.text:
[Member of Alliance]
The head of the alliance, Sikaiz... doesn't look healthy.
scripts.translation:
[聯盟成員]
聯盟的領袖，西凱茲... 看起來不太健康。

scripts.text:
[Member of Alliance]
But his upright eyes
are quite reliable.
scripts.translation:
[聯盟成員]
但他堅定的眼神
相當可靠。

scripts.text:
[Member of Alliance]
Munkenro looks so willing to do anything for success. As well as he also seems flexible...
scripts.translation:
[聯盟成員]
蒙肯羅看起來為了成功願意做任何事。而且他似乎也很靈活...

scripts.text: -I'm so bored!!! You should be heading to the dimensional rift next to Morocc and find the Guard there. It's probably less boring there than it is here-
scripts.translation: -我好無聊啊！！！你應該去莫洛奇旁邊的次元裂隙，找到那裡的衛兵。那裡應該比這裡沒那麼無聊。-

scripts.text:
[Member of Alliance]
I am almost dying of boredom!
scripts.translation:
[聯盟成員]
我快無聊死了！

scripts.text:
[Member of Alliance]
So boring!
scripts.translation:
[聯盟成員]
好無聊啊！

scripts.text:
[Member of Alliance]
I am not in a good mood.
scripts.translation:
[聯盟成員]
我現在心情不太好。

scripts.text: -We haven't even started and we're already bickering. Just ignore the politics and head to the dimensional rift next to Morocc and find the Guard there-
scripts.translation: -我們還沒開始就已經在爭吵了。別管那些政治鬥爭，去莫洛奇旁邊的次元裂隙，找到那裡的衛兵吧。-

scripts.text:
[Member of Alliance]
Three kingdoms for world peace...
Will it be successful?
scripts.translation:
[聯盟成員]
為了世界和平的三個王國...
這會成功嗎？

scripts.text: -You shouldn't stay around here and listen to all the complaining. You should be heading to the dimensional rift next to Morocc and find the Guard there-
scripts.translation: -你不該留在這裡聽這些抱怨。你應該去莫洛奇旁邊的次元裂隙，找到那裡的衛兵。-

scripts.text:
[Member of Alliance]
Why is there so much complaining?
scripts.translation:
[聯盟成員]
為什麼有這麼多抱怨？

scripts.text:
[Member of Alliance]
I'm going along for the benefit of my country.
scripts.translation:
[聯盟成員]
我是為了國家的利益才參與的。

scripts.text:
[Member of Alliance]
I wonder if the managers are all talk.
scripts.translation:
[聯盟成員]
不知道那些管理員是不是隻會說空話。

scripts.text:
[Manager]
With blessings from the Goddess Freya! We three kingdoms will know success! It's all we want. ...Khkhkhkh...
scripts.translation:
[管理員]
在女神芙蕾雅的祝福下！我們三個王國一定會成功的！這是我們所期望的。...呵呵呵呵...

scripts.text:
[Manager]
What brings you here, if you won't worship Freya? Just go away.
scripts.translation:
[管理員]
如果你不崇拜芙蕾雅，來這裡做什麼？快滾。

scripts.text:
[Manager]
Hm, you've come here to report the status of the alliance? Ok, let me listen.
scripts.translation:
[管理員]
嗯，你是來彙報聯盟狀況的嗎？好吧，讓我聽聽。

scripts.text:
[Manager]
Hm, everything is going well
and almost prepared for a good start... Hm-hmm...
scripts.translation:
[管理員]
嗯，一切進展順利，
幾乎已經為良好的開端做好了準備... 嗯嗯...

scripts.text:
[Manager]
I hate to meet people from Rune-Midgarts, but I can't avoid it.
scripts.translation:
[管理員]
我不喜歡見到來自盧恩·米德加茲的人，但我無法避免。

scripts.text:
[Manager]
We're all together for this mission now... They would sacrifice for Freya.
scripts.translation:
[管理員]
我們現在為了這個任務聚在一起... 他們會為芙蕾雅犧牲。

scripts.text:
[Manager]
Now you can go back.
Just say I received the report of the status well.
scripts.translation:
[管理員]
現在你可以回去了。
就說我收到了狀況彙報。

scripts.text:
[Manager]
Goddess Freya, keep us forever!!
scripts.translation:
[管理員]
女神芙蕾雅，永遠保佑我們！！

scripts.text:
[Manager]
Ash-Vacuum...
It will be mine soon...
Khkhkh!
scripts.translation:
[管理員]
阿什-真空...
很快它就是我的了...
呵呵呵！

scripts.text:
[Officer]
Why don't you go back there?
Are you afraid to go back?
Khkhkh!
scripts.translation:
[軍官]
你為什麼不回去？
你不敢回去嗎？
呵呵呵！

scripts.text:
[Officer]
Just go back to the meeting room.
Your allies are there together.
Khkhkh!
Nevermind.
Bye.
scripts.translation:
[軍官]
快回會議室去吧。
你的盟友都在那裡。
呵呵呵！
算了。
再見。

scripts.text:
[Officer A]
So why do you come to me?
What's wrong?
scripts.translation:
[軍官 A]
那你為什麼來找我？
怎麼了？

scripts.text:
[Officer B]
Got any business?
scripts.translation:
[軍官 B]
有什麼事嗎？

scripts.text:
[Officer A]
I think not.
You come to tell me that you're leaving for the mission.
Am I right?
scripts.translation:
[軍官 A]
我想不是。
你是來告訴我你要出發去執行任務的吧。
我猜得對嗎？

scripts.text:
[Officer B]
You were sent by Sikaiz...
Right?
scripts.translation:
[軍官 B]
你是西凱茲派來的...
對吧？

scripts.text:
[Officer A]
Ok, I got your report.
Just go back there.
Good luck.
scripts.translation:
[軍官 A]
好，我收到你的報告了。
快回去吧。
祝你好運。

scripts.text:
[Officer B]
Just do your best
...or whatever you do...
scripts.translation:
[軍官 B]
盡力就好
...或者隨你怎麼做...

scripts.text:
[Officer A]
Just return there. Good job.
scripts.translation:
[軍官 A]
快回去吧。幹得好。

scripts.text:
[Officer A]
Sikaiz isn't understandable...
I can't help it...
scripts.translation:
[軍官 A]
西凱茲真是讓人難以理解...
我也沒辦法...

scripts.text:
[Officer B]
His voice for peace is
only his own way.
Three kingdoms for one mission...
No peace...
We even get no advantage.
scripts.translation:
[軍官 B]
他口中的和平
只是他的一己之見。
三個王國為了同一個任務...
沒有和平...
我們甚至得不到任何優勢。

scripts.text:
[Officer A]
We can't leave them as they are now. Though I am the leader among them, I'm just a figurehead.
scripts.translation:
[軍官 A]
我們不能任由他們這樣下去。雖然我是他們中的首領，但我只是個傀儡。

scripts.text:
[Officer A]
Is there any way to change their ways?
scripts.translation:
[軍官 A]
有沒有什麼辦法能改變他們的做法？

scripts.text:
[Officer B]
If they changed,
we wouldn't get in trouble.
But he is not compromising.
scripts.translation:
[軍官 B]
如果他們改變了，
我們就不會陷入麻煩。
但他不肯妥協。

scripts.text:
[Officer A]
So what??
We wouldn't get our interests,
and just do nothing for ourselves?
scripts.translation:
[軍官 A]
那又怎樣？
我們得不到利益，
難道就什麼都不做嗎？

scripts.text:
[Officer B]
There's always Munkenro.
scripts.translation:
[軍官 B]
還有蒙肯羅。

scripts.text:
[Officer A]
So what...?
scripts.translation:
[軍官 A]
那又怎樣...？

scripts.text:
[Officer B]
As honest as Sikaiz...
As flexible as Sikaiz...
But easy to go over him...
scripts.translation:
[軍官 B]
像西凱茲一樣誠實...
像西凱茲一樣靈活...
但很容易越過他...

scripts.text:
[Officer B]
We can't cut him out,
so just take the lead from Munkenro. It's easier!
scripts.translation:
[軍官 B]
既然不能把他排除在外，
那就聽從蒙肯羅的領導吧。這樣更輕鬆！

scripts.text:
[Officer A]
Oh!!
That's a good idea.
Anyway...
Some visitors are coming.
Let's talk about it later.
scripts.translation:
[軍官 A]
哦！！
這是個好主意。
不管怎樣...
有訪客要來了。
我們稍後再談。

scripts.text:
[Officer B]
Um, what's your business?
scripts.translation:
[軍官 B]
嗯，你有什麼事？

scripts.text:
[Officer A]
For our own interest,
we need to abandon other kingdoms.
scripts.translation:
[軍官 A]
為了我們自身的利益，
我們需要放棄其他王國。

scripts.text:
[Officer]
Why don't you go back there?
Are you afraid to go back?
Khkhkh!
scripts.translation:
[軍官]
你為什麼不回去？

呵呵呵！

Khkhkh!

Bye.

哦！！

我們稍後再談。

scripts.text:
[Officer B]
Um, what's your business?
scripts.translation:
[軍官 B]
嗯，你有什麼事？

scripts.text:
[Officer B]
The most important things are money and power. If we don't get at least one, we're just like the slummy poor.
scripts.translation:
[軍官 B]
最重要的是金錢和權力。
如果我們得不到其中至少一樣，
我們就和那些貧民窟的窮人沒什麼兩樣。

scripts.text:
[Guard]
Ah, you are a member of the alliance that discovered the dimensional rift? Welcome. Everything is prepared. Just enter and find the camp when you pass through the rift.
scripts.translation:
[衛兵]
啊，你是發現次元裂縫的聯盟成員嗎？
歡迎。一切準備就緒。
只需進入裂縫，穿過它就能找到營地。

scripts.text:
[Guard]
The new head of the alliance, Munkenro, will direct all of us.
scripts.translation:
[衛兵]
聯盟的新首領蒙肯羅將指揮我們所有人。

scripts.text:
[Guard]
Then you will pass.
Are you ready?
scripts.translation:
[衛兵]
那麼你可以通過了。
你準備好了嗎？

scripts.text: Yes, sure.
scripts.translation: 是的，準備好了。

scripts.text: Please wait.
scripts.translation: 請稍等。

scripts.text:
[Guard]
Good luck.
scripts.translation:
[衛兵]
祝你好運。

scripts.text:
[Guard]
Just tell me once you are ready. I will let you pass right away.
scripts.translation:
[衛兵]
準備好了就告訴我一聲。
我會立刻讓你通過。

scripts.text:
[Guard]
You're not allowed to enter here.
If you have any business, just ask the guard behind me, or just leave.
scripts.translation:
[衛兵]
你不允許進入這裡。
如果你有事，就去找我身後的衛兵，或者離開。

scripts.text:
[Guard]
Are you the new adventurer?
If you're going to the other side of the rift, the head of the alliance will guide you there.
scripts.translation:
[衛兵]
你是新來的冒險者嗎？
如果你要去裂縫的另一邊，聯盟的首領會指引你過去。

scripts.text:
[Guard]
He should be near the center of the Gorge. He is stronger than the former one, so be careful with your words.
scripts.translation:
[衛兵]
他應該在峽谷的中心附近。
他比前任更強，所以說話要小心。

scripts.text:
[Guard]
If you want to run away from here, just let me know, I will guide you.
scripts.translation:
[衛兵]
如果你想從這裡逃跑，告訴我一聲，我會指引你。

scripts.text: Escape.
scripts.translation: 逃跑。

scripts.text: Nah.
scripts.translation: 不了。

scripts.text:
[Guard]
Ok.
Follow me, I will let you out of here.
scripts.translation:
[衛兵]
好的。
跟我來，我會帶你出去。

scripts.text:
[Guard]
Ok, just go ahead for yourself.
scripts.translation:
[衛兵]
好的，那就隨你便吧。

scripts.text:
[Guard]
Are you new here?
You look like you need to find the head of the alliance. You can find him near the center of the dimensional rift.
scripts.translation:
[衛兵]
你是新來的嗎？
看起來你需要找聯盟的首領。
你可以在次元裂縫的中心附近找到他。

scripts.text:
[Guard]
Just right there.
There's a pillar of stone.
Very close!
scripts.translation:
[衛兵]
就在那裡。
有一根石柱。
非常近！

scripts.text:
[Munkenro]
Are you ready to discover Ash-Vacuum?
scripts.translation:
[蒙肯羅]
你準備好探索阿什-真空了嗎？

scripts.text: Yes, of course!
scripts.translation: 是的，當然！

scripts.text: Please, wait...
scripts.translation: 請等一下...

scripts.text:
[Munkenro]
I wish you good luck!
I hope you are successful in your adventures in Ash-Vacuum!
scripts.translation:
[蒙肯羅]
祝你好運！
希望你在阿什-真空的冒險中一切順利！

scripts.text:
[Munkenro]
(...I just follow your lead!)
(I remember you're strong-willed.)
(Though I am guilty,)
(I will do my best.)
scripts.translation:
[蒙肯羅]
（...我只是跟著你的腳步走！）
（我記得你意志堅定。）
（雖然我有罪，）
（但我會盡力的。）

scripts.text:
[Munkenro]
Go prepare.
scripts.translation:
[蒙肯羅]
去準備吧。

scripts.text:
[Munkenro]
I am the head of the Three Kingdoms Alliance. You've come here for the discovery of the dimensional rift. Am I right?
scripts.translation:
[蒙肯羅]
我是三國聯盟的首領。你是為了發現次元裂縫而來的，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Munkenro]
Um. You're the one that
did some favors before...
Your name is {0}?
I remember you.
scripts.translation:
[蒙肯羅]
嗯。你是之前幫過忙的那個人...
你的名字是{0}？
我記得你。

scripts.text:
[Munkenro]
Sikaiz retired from his position urgently. I am his replacement.
scripts.translation:
[蒙肯羅]
西凱茲緊急辭去了他的職位。我是他的繼任者。

scripts.text:
[Munkenro]
You don't need to know in detail all about it now. That's not important to you. Is it?
scripts.translation:
[蒙肯羅]
你現在不需要知道所有細節。那對你來說並不重要，不是嗎？

scripts.text:
[Munkenro]
You are here for the discovery of the dimensional rift. I can't send you there right away. I know that you've passed your tests, but that's the past. You have not been tested by me. ~
scripts.translation:
[蒙肯羅]
你是為了發現次元裂縫而來的。我不能馬上送你去那裡。我知道你通過了之前的測試，但那是過去的事了。你還沒有經過我的測試。~

scripts.text:
[Munkenro]
So you need to be tested again. I don't have too much time to test you now. So let's just do a short test.
scripts.translation:
[蒙肯羅]
所以你需要重新接受測試。我現在沒有太多時間測試你。所以我們就做一個簡短的測試吧。

scripts.text:
[Munkenro]
Now the soldiers here will start to attack you... If you survive, I will approve of you. Just do it in good time.
scripts.translation:
[蒙肯羅]
現在這裡計程車兵們將開始攻擊你...如果你能存活下來，我就會認可你。只要在限定時間內完成即可。

scripts.text:
[Munkenro]
This can prove that you're strong enough. That's the minimum test I can perform.
scripts.translation:
[蒙肯羅]
這可以證明你足夠強大。這是我所能進行的最低限度的測試。

scripts.text:
[Munkenro]
Once you get ready,
just let me know.
scripts.translation:
[蒙肯羅]
準備好後，
告訴我一聲。

scripts.text:
[Munkenro]
Are you ready??
Let's start!
scripts.translation:
[蒙肯羅]
準備好了嗎？
開始！

scripts.text: Ready!!
scripts.translation: 準備好了！！

scripts.text: Please, wait...
scripts.translation: 請等一下...

scripts.text:
[Munkenro]
Ok, just have a good adventure.
scripts.translation:
[蒙肯羅]
好的，祝你冒險愉快。

scripts.text:
[Munkenro]
If you are too late,
it will be considered as a failure, so come back soon.
scripts.translation:
[蒙肯羅]
如果你太遲了，
將被視為失敗，所以請快點回來。

scripts.text:
[Munkenro]
If you hesitate,
it means you fail.
I will give you one more chance. Go ahead.
scripts.translation:
[蒙肯羅]
如果你猶豫了，
那就意味著你失敗了。
我再給你一次機會。去吧。

scripts.text:
[Munkenro]
You're quite shrewd...
How come you passed the test
before? I can't believe this.
scripts.translation:
[蒙肯羅]
你相當精明...
你是怎麼通過之前的測試的？
我簡直不敢相信。

scripts.text:
[Munkenro]
I will give you one more chance.
Don't make any mistakes again.
scripts.translation:
[蒙肯羅]
我再給你一次機會。
別再犯錯了。

scripts.text:
[Munkenro]
Once you get ready,
just let me know,
to start!
scripts.translation:
[蒙肯羅]
準備好了就告訴我，
我們開始！

scripts.text:
[Munkenro]
We are testing the other adventurers, so unless you have any business with me, visit me later.
scripts.translation:
[蒙肯羅]
我們正在測試其他冒險者，
如果你沒有別的事，請稍後再來。

scripts.text:
[Munkenro]
Good! You did a good job!
Though we didn't get enough time to test, I think it's almost perfect.
scripts.translation:
[蒙肯羅]
很好！你做得不錯！
雖然時間不夠，沒能進行完整的測試，
但我覺得已經接近完美了。

scripts.text:
[Munkenro]
You can feel I am too strict... I'm just doing what I need to do as head of the Alliance.
scripts.translation:
[蒙肯羅]
你可能覺得我太嚴格了...
我只是在履行作為聯盟首領的職責。

scripts.text:
[Munkenro]
If I can't manage the alliance well, I will feel guilty, that I am not doing Sikaiz's job any justice. Anyway, I will do my best.
scripts.translation:
[蒙肯羅]
如果我管理不好聯盟，
我會覺得對不起西凱茲的期望。
無論如何，我會盡力的。

scripts.text:
[Munkenro]
Huh? I'm just whining.
You don't need to hear this.
Just forget it.
scripts.translation:
[蒙肯羅]
啊？
我只是在發牢騷。
你不用聽這些。
忘了吧。

scripts.text:
[Munkenro]
I will let you go there.
Let me know once you are ready.
scripts.translation:
[蒙肯羅]
我會讓你過去的。
準備好了就告訴我。

scripts.text:
[Guard]
Are you the new adventurer?
If you're going to the other side of the rift, the head of the alliance will guide you there.
scripts.translation:
[衛兵]
你是新來的冒險者嗎？
如果你要去裂縫的另一邊，聯盟的首領會指引你過去。

scripts.text:
[Guard]
He should be near the center of the Gorge. He is stronger than the former one, so be careful with your words.
scripts.translation:
[衛兵]
他應該在峽谷的中心附近。
他比前任更強，所以說話要小心。

scripts.text:
[Guard]
If you want to run away from here, just let me know, I will guide you.
scripts.translation:
[衛兵]
如果你想從這裡逃跑，告訴我一聲，我會指引你。

scripts.text: Escape.
scripts.translation: 逃跑。

scripts.text: Nah.
scripts.translation: 不了。

scripts.text:
[Guard]
Ok.
Follow me, I will let you out of here.
scripts.translation:
[衛兵]
好的。
跟我來，我會帶你出去。

scripts.text:
[Guard]
Ok, just go ahead for yourself.
scripts.translation:
[衛兵]
好的，那就隨你便吧。

scripts.text:
[Guard]
- Trembling in fear. -
scripts.translation:
[衛兵]
- 嚇得瑟瑟發抖。 -

scripts.text:
[Guard]
- Trembling in fear. -
scripts.translation:
[衛兵]
- 嚇得瑟瑟發抖。 -

scripts.text:
[Guard]
Honestly, I should keep
to the dimensional rift,
but it's quite scary.
I ran away from it.
scripts.translation:
[衛兵]
說實話，我應該守在時空裂縫旁，
但那裡太可怕了。
我逃跑了。

scripts.text:
[Guard]
Ah?
You're quite brave!
And not scared about things around you. I envy you...
scripts.translation:
[衛兵]
啊？
你膽子真大！
而且對周圍的事物毫不畏懼。
我真羨慕你...

scripts.text:
[Guard]
I am a coward but,
I can send you through the dimensional rift. That's the only thing I can do for you.
scripts.translation:
[衛兵]
我雖然是個膽小鬼，
但我可以送你穿過時空裂縫。
這是我唯一能為你做的事。

scripts.text:
[Guard]
I send you there easily,
but don't tell others about me. Ok??
scripts.translation:
[衛兵]
我可以輕鬆把你送過去，
但別告訴別人我的事。好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Guard]
Then, do you want to go through the Time-Space Gap now??
scripts.translation:
[衛兵]
那麼，你現在想穿過時空裂縫嗎？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text: No, thanks.
scripts.translation: 不用了，謝謝。

scripts.text:
[Guard]
Ok, then I will send you there. As I already said, don't tell anybody about me. Anyway... good luck!!
scripts.translation:
[衛兵]
好的，那我送你過去。
就像我說的，別告訴任何人我的事。
總之...祝你好運！！

scripts.text:
[Guard]
It's ok.
Just don't tell anybody about me. Please.
scripts.translation:
[衛兵]
沒關係。
只是別告訴任何人我的事。
拜託了。

scripts.text:
[Guard]
- Trembling in fear. -
scripts.translation:
[衛兵]
- 嚇得瑟瑟發抖。 -

scripts.text:
[Guard]
onestly, I should keep
to the dimensional rift,
but it's quite scary.
I ran away from it.
scripts.translation:
[衛兵]
說實話，我應該守在時空裂縫旁，
但那裡太可怕了。
我逃跑了。

scripts.text:
[Guard]
- Trembling. -
Please keep the secret
about me being here.
I am so scared!!
scripts.translation:
[衛兵]
- 瑟瑟發抖。 -
請保守我在這裡的秘密。
我好害怕！！

scripts.text:
[Manager]
Please enter the password.
scripts.translation:
[管理員]
請輸入密碼。

scripts.text:
[Manager]
Incorrect password.
scripts.translation:
[管理員]
密碼錯誤。

scripts.text:
[Manager]
Please enter a password other then 0.
scripts.translation:
[管理員]
請輸入除0以外的密碼。

scripts.text:
[Manager]
Nevermind then.
scripts.translation:
[管理員]
那就算了。

scripts.text:
[Manager]
What would you like to do?
scripts.translation:
[管理員]
您想做什麼？

scripts.text: Reset the Allied Attacks.
scripts.translation: 重置聯盟攻擊。

scripts.text: Nothing.
scripts.translation: 沒什麼。

scripts.text:
[Manager]
Resetting the allied attacks.
scripts.translation:
[管理員]
正在重置聯盟攻擊。

scripts.text:
[Manager]
Nevermind then.
scripts.translation:
[管理員]
那就算了。

scripts.text:
[Marian]
You have too many items~
Drop some and come back to me.
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗安]
您的物品欄太滿了~
請丟棄一些物品後再來找我。

scripts.text:
[Marian]
You must be a stranger here.
Is this your first visit here?
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗安]
您一定是個陌生人。
這是您第一次來這裡嗎？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不。

scripts.text:
[Marian]
As expected~
I'm not lying, but usually
I never forget a face.
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗安]
果然如此~
我沒說謊，但我通常不會忘記一張臉。

scripts.text:
[Marian]
Well, anyway...
If this is your first time here,
you'd better see ^0000FFInstructor Lugen^000000.
He can help you adjust
to these surroundings.
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗安]
總之...
如果您是第一次來這裡，
最好去見^0000FF指導員 魯根^000000。
他能幫您適應這裡的環境。

scripts.text:
[Marian]
Go to the right to find
^0000FFInstructor Lugen^000000.
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗安]
往右走就能找到
^0000FF指導員 魯根^000000。

scripts.text:
[Marian]
Well~ It is weird~
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗安]
嗯~ 真奇怪~

scripts.text:
- ransacking - 
 - flap -
scripts.translation:
- 翻找 - 
 - 拍打 -

scripts.text:
[Marian]
Hmm, you're not
from around here.
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗安]
嗯，您不是
本地人。

scripts.text:
[Marian]
Go to the right along this way
and you'll find ^0000FFInstructor Lugen^000000.
Talk to him, first.
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗安]
沿著這條路往右走，
就能找到^0000FF指導員 魯根^000000。
請先和他談談。

scripts.text:
[Marian]
......
I'm sorry but,
I'm a bit busy now...
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗安]
......
抱歉，
我現在有點忙...

scripts.text:
[Marian]
Go to the right to see ^0000FFInstructor Lugen^000000.
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗安]
往右走就能見到^0000FF指導員 魯根^000000。

scripts.text:
[Marian]
Wow, good to see you again.
Do you feel comfortable around here?
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗安]
哇，很高興再次見到您。
您在這裡感覺還習慣嗎？

scripts.text:
[Marian]
Hey, how are you?
What brings you here?
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗安]
嘿，您好嗎？
什麼事讓您來到這裡？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
The instructor sent me.
He told me to get supplies from the motherland.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
指導員派我來的。
他讓我去母國領取補給品。

scripts.text:
[Marian]
Ah, you must be talking about~?
Let me see~~
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗安]
啊，您說的是~？
讓我看看~~

scripts.text:
[Marian]
This and that~~
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗安]
這個那個~~

scripts.text:
[Marian]
Hmm, not this one.
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗安]
嗯，不是這個。

scripts.text:
[Marian]
Ah, I got it!
Here they are!
And this is for you.
Go, go~~
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗安]
啊，找到了！
就是這些！
還有這個給您。
去吧，快去吧~~

scripts.text:
[Marian]
Ha! You misplaced the Supply Box?!
What the~~?
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗安]
哈！你把補給箱子弄丟了？！
真是的~~？

scripts.text:
[Marian]
Ok, I have spares.
Let me give one to you.
Don't misplace this one, ok?!
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗安]
好吧，我有備用的。
給你一個。
這次可別再弄丟了，好嗎？！

scripts.text:
[Marian]
Do your job, man~
And please say hello
to the instructor.
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗安]
好好工作，夥計~
還有，請代我向指導員問好。

scripts.text:
[Marian]
Hey~
How have you been recently?
I am busy all the time...
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗安]
嘿~
最近過得怎麼樣？
我一直都很忙...

scripts.text:
[Marian]
The supplies from the motherland are...
Ah...
Nothing, do not care...
Hohoho...
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗安]
來自母國的補給品是...
啊...
沒什麼，別在意...
呵呵呵...

scripts.text:
[Instructor Lugen]
You are carrying too much weight.
Please try again after losing some weight.
scripts.translation:
[指導員 魯根]
你攜帶的重量太重了。
請在減輕負重後再試一次。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Lugen]
Huuu, no time to rest.
When re-enforcements come.
scripts.translation:
[指導員 魯根]
呼，沒時間休息。
等增援部隊到來時。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Lugen]
Huuu, no time to rest.
When re-enforcements come.
scripts.translation:
[指導員 魯根]
呼，沒時間休息。
等增援部隊到來時。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Excuse me.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
打擾一下。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Lugen]
Hi!
What brings you here?
scripts.translation:
[指導員 魯根]
你好！
什麼事讓你來到這裡？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Marian sent me to here.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
瑪麗安派我來的。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Lugen]
Ah!
Are you from the motherland?
I am Lugen Jednic from.
the federal survey team,
in charge of educating.
new employees.
scripts.translation:
[指導員 魯根]
啊！
你來自母國？
我是聯邦調查隊的魯根·傑德尼克，
負責培訓新員工。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Lugen]
To join the team,
you simply need to register.
scripts.translation:
[指導員 魯根]
要加入隊伍，
你只需要進行登記。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Lugen]
Once you register, you
will be provided with
ccommodations and food.
There will be plenty of
missions for you.
scripts.translation:
[指導員 魯根]
一旦登記，
我們會為你提供住宿和食物。
會有很多工等著你。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Lugen]
Will you join the survey team?
scripts.translation:
[指導員 魯根]
你要加入調查隊嗎？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Lugen]
Registration is simple.
Go to the big building.
in the center and talk
to the receptionist.
scripts.translation:
[指導員 魯根]
登記很簡單。
去中間的大樓，
找接待員。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Lugen]
When you finish the
registration, come back
to me and I will assign
your accomodations.
scripts.translation:
[指導員 魯根]
登記完成後，
回來找我，
我會為你安排住宿。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Lugen]
You don't want to join?
If you change your mind, come back later.
scripts.translation:
[指導員 魯根]
你不想加入？
如果你改變主意，稍後再來。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Lugen]
Ah, you came back.
I have been waiting for you.
scripts.translation:
[指導員 魯根]
啊，你回來了。
我一直在等你。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Lugen]
Will ou join the survey team?
scripts.translation:
[指導員 魯根]
你要加入調查隊嗎？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不。

I will register...

Go to the big building.

scripts.translation:

你不想加入？
如果你改變主意，稍後再來。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Lugen]
To register, Go to the
big building in the center
and talk to the receptionist.
scripts.translation:
[指導員 魯根]
要登記的話，
去中間的大樓，
找接待員。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Lugen]
When you finish the
registration, come back
to me and I will assign
your accomodations.
scripts.translation:
[指導員 魯根]
登記完成後，
回來找我，
我會為你安排住宿。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Lugen]
I got a call from the receptionist.
Now take your nameplate and go
to your accomodations down
in the barracks.
scripts.translation:
[指導員 魯根]
接待員打過電話來了。
現在拿著你的名牌，
去下面的營房
入住你的住處。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Lugen]
So take some rest and I will
see you tomorrow morning.
scripts.translation:
[指導員 魯根]
好好休息，
明天早上見。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Lugen]
You need to share the barracks
with others, so make sure to
talk with them while you're there.
scripts.translation:
[指導員 魯根]
你需要和別人
共用營房，
所以在那裡
記得多和他們聊聊。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Lugen]
You need to share the barracks
with others, so make sure to
talk with them while you're there.
scripts.translation:
[指導員 魯根]
你需要和別人
共用營房，
所以在那裡
記得多和他們聊聊。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Lugen]
How was your stay here?
It is cold. Warm yourself
and try not to catch a cold.
scripts.translation:
[指導員 魯根]
在這裡住得怎麼樣？
天氣很冷，
注意保暖，
別感冒了。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Lugen]
And I have a request of you, {0}.
scripts.translation:
[指導員 魯根]
另外，我有個請求，{0}。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Lugen]
It is to distribute supplies
from the motherland,
It's not very difficult.
Just think of it as a way
to meet people here.
scripts.translation:
[指導員 魯根]
就是分發
來自母國的物資。
這並不難。
就當是
認識這裡的人吧。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Lugen]
Anyway, Go to Marian,
whom you met when
you first came here and
get the supplies from her.
scripts.translation:
[指導員 魯根]
總之，去找瑪麗安，
就是你剛來這裡時
見過的那個人，
從她那裡領取物資。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Lugen]
Anyway, Go to Marian,
whom you met when
you first came here and
get the supplies from her.
scripts.translation:
[指導員 魯根]
總之，去找瑪麗安，
就是你剛來這裡時
見過的那個人，
從她那裡領取物資。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Lugen]
Did you receive the supplies?
Can you show them to me, please?
scripts.translation:
[指導員 魯根]
你收到物資了嗎？
能給我看看嗎？

scripts.text:
[Instructor Lugen]
Hmm...
scripts.translation:
[指導員 魯根]
嗯...

scripts.text:
[Instructor Lugen]
Ok, then, please deliver
them to their receivers.
scripts.translation:
[指導員 魯根]
好的，那麼，
請把它們
交給收件人。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Lugen]
The first box should be sent to
Jan, northwest of the camp.
She may be around the fence.
scripts.translation:
[指導員 魯根]
第一個箱子
要寄給揚，
她在營地西北方。
她可能在圍欄附近。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Lugen]
It seems that they
are not enough.
Can you check them
with Marian, please?
scripts.translation:
[指導員 魯根]
看起來
數量不夠。
能麻煩你
和瑪麗安核對一下嗎？

[迭戈]
