^0000FF20根普通樹枝和20根結實的藤^000000
來修理這個。
請把它們帶給我！！！

scripts.text:
[Diego]
...
You're too harsh.
Sob...
scripts.translation:
[迭戈]
...
你太嚴厲了。
嗚...

scripts.text:
[Diego]
Oh!!
You finally brought
the materials!
I'm so grateful!!
scripts.translation:
[迭戈]
噢！！
你終於把材料帶來了！
太感謝了！！

scripts.text:
[Diego]
Ok, so while I hold this post,
please attach the branches
and tie it up with the vines.
scripts.translation:
[迭戈]
好的，在我固定住這根柱子的同時，
請把這些樹枝接上去，
並用藤蔓綁緊。

scripts.text:
[Diego]
I think we should be
able to fix this with
^0000FF20 Ordinary Branches and 20 Strong Vine^000000.
Please bring them to me!!!
scripts.translation:
[迭戈]
我想我們應該能用
^0000FF20根普通樹枝和20根結實的藤^000000
來修理這個。
請把它們帶給我！！！

scripts.text:
[Diego]
Ok, so while I hold this post,
please attach the branches
and tie it up with the vines.
scripts.translation:
[迭戈]
好的，在我固定住這根柱子的同時，
請把這些樹枝接上去，
並用藤蔓綁緊。

scripts.text:
[Diego]
Please do the same for the other one.
scripts.translation:
[迭戈]
請對另一根也做同樣的處理。

scripts.text:
- Wait a minute !! -
- Currently you're carrying -
- too many items with you. -
- Please try again -
- after you lose some weight. -
scripts.translation:
- 等等！！ -
- 您現在攜帶的物品 -
- 太多了。 -
- 請在減輕負重後 -
- 再試一次。 -

scripts.text:
[Diego]
Thanks to your help,
I can protect the barracks.
When I was in trouble,
you came along.
It's got to be fate.
scripts.translation:
[迭戈]
多虧你的幫助，
我才能保護這個營地。
在我陷入困境時，
你出現了。
這一定是命運。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No, I just...
I was assigned to stay
in these barracks.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不，我只是...
我被指派留在這個營地。

scripts.text:
[Diego]
Oh!!!
Then it this really is fate!!!
And this is the special
product of this camp,
^0000FFChocolate Pie^000000.
scripts.translation:
[迭戈]
噢！！！
那麼這真的是命運！！！
而且這是本營地的特產，
^0000FF巧克力派^000000。

scripts.text:
[Diego]
Please come in and
take some rest for the
expedition tomorrow!!
scripts.translation:
[迭戈]
請進來休息吧，
為了明天的遠征！！

scripts.text:
[Diego]
I'm busy right now!
scripts.translation:
[迭戈]
我現在很忙！

scripts.text:
- It's a neat and tidy bed -
- It seems that nobody used it. -
scripts.translation:
- 這是一張整潔的床 -
- 看起來沒有人使用過它。 -

scripts.text:
- It's a neat and tidy bed -
- It seems that I will use this one. -
scripts.translation:
- 這是一張整潔的床 -
- 看來我要用這張了。 -

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Haaaam~~~~~
what a good night!!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哈啊~~~~~
真是美好的一夜！！

scripts.text:
- I slept well -
- and feel better. -
- I think I need to go -
- to Instructor Lugen -
scripts.translation:
- 我睡得很好 -
- 感覺精神煥發。 -
- 我想我需要去 -
- 找指導員 魯根 -

scripts.text:
- The bed that I use -
- It is comfortable. -.
scripts.translation:
- 我用的這張床 -
- 很舒服。 -

scripts.text:
[Lucas]
...Hmm...
Replacement?
......

[Lucas]
The Federal team's still...
send us people using the
dangerous way.
scripts.translation:
[盧卡斯]
聯邦部隊還在...
通過那條危險的路
向我們派遣人員。

scripts.text: Dangerous way?
scripts.translation: 危險的路？

scripts.text: Disregard it.
scripts.translation: 不予理會。

scripts.text:
[Lucas]
......
I have been here for a long time.
scripts.translation:
[盧卡斯]
......
我在這裡很久了。

scripts.text:
[Lucas]
To breach the dimensional crack, the assassin team was deployed first...
scripts.translation:
[盧卡斯]
為了突破次元裂縫，刺客小隊最先被部署...

scripts.text:
[Lucas]
However, most of my men...
......
scripts.translation:
[盧卡斯]
然而，我的大多數部下...
......

scripts.text:
[Lucas]
No, just ignore what I said.
......
scripts.translation:
[盧卡斯]
不，請忽略我剛才說的話。
......

scripts.text:
[Lucas]
You seem to live hard all the time...
scripts.translation:
[盧卡斯]
你看起來總是過得很辛苦...

scripts.text:
[Lucas]
The motherland constantly
sends us people...
Is that passage safe?
scripts.translation:
[盧卡斯]
祖國不斷向我們派遣人員...
那條通道安全嗎？

scripts.text:
[Davi]
Ahhh, my body...
I walked too much...
and my body hurts.
scripts.translation:
[達維]
啊，我的身體...
走得太多了...
渾身都疼。

scripts.text:
[Jan]
Wawa, what is this~
Hey, is that for me?
scripts.translation:
[揚]
哇哇，這是什麼~
嘿，是給我的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Jan]
Ahhh, it's exciting~
I love it.
scripts.translation:
[揚]
啊，好興奮~
我好喜歡。

scripts.text:
[Jan]
I want to unwrap it right now~
Please tell the Instructor
I'm grateful~
Uhuhu.
scripts.translation:
[揚]
我現在就想拆開它~
請告訴指導員
我很感激~
呵呵呵。

scripts.text:
[Jan]
Why hasn't the product
that I ordered one month
ago come yet?
scripts.translation:
[揚]
為什麼我一個月前訂購的
商品還沒到？

scripts.text:
[Jan]
I really wanted it.
I really love it~~
scripts.translation:
[揚]
我真的好想要。
我超級喜歡~~

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What is... it~~?

[Jan]
It, it's a secret...
scripts.translation:
[揚]
這...這是個秘密...

scripts.text:
[Jan]
The more I study around here,
the more I find strange things.
scripts.translation:
[揚]
我在這附近研究得越多，
就發現越多奇怪的東西。

scripts.text:
[Jan]
It seems to stimulate my
passion as a scientist?
scripts.translation:
[揚]
這似乎激發了我
作為科學家的熱情？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Are you Gerard?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你是傑拉德嗎？

scripts.text:
[Gerard]
Yes, I am.
What brings you here?
scripts.translation:
[傑拉德]
是的，是我。
你找我有事嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Instructor Lugen sent
me for an errand.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
指導員 魯根派我
來送個東西。

scripts.text:
[Gerard]
Ah! Supplies.
The supplies that ran out.
scripts.translation:
[傑拉德]
啊！補給品。
就是那些用完了的補給品。

scripts.text:
[Gerard]
I am so hungry that
I was considering
going back to the camp.
I really appreciate this.
scripts.translation:
[傑拉德]
我餓得正考慮
要不要回營地。
真的太感謝你了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
...
You ran out of supplies, but
you didn't go back to the camp?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
...
你的補給品用完了，
但還沒回營地嗎？

scripts.text:
[Gerard]
Yes.
This place is really interesting
and I don't want to leave at all.
scripts.translation:
[傑拉德]
是的。
這裡真的很有趣，
我一點都不想離開。

scripts.text:
[Gerard]
Please tell the instructor that
I won't be back for some time.
scripts.translation:
[傑拉德]
請告訴指導員，
我還會在這裡待一段時間。

scripts.text:
[Gerard]
Hhhh, I am starving.
When will the supplies come?
It is killing me...
scripts.translation:
[傑拉德]
呼，我快餓死了。
補給品什麼時候能到？
真的快把我折磨死了...

scripts.text:
[Gerard]
Hu, I am full now.
Time to continue on
with the exploration!!!
scripts.translation:
[傑拉德]
呼，我吃飽了。
該繼續
探索了！！！

scripts.text:
[Gerard]
I was born in a desert
and have never seen
a field so green.
So, to study here.
is very interesting.
scripts.translation:
[傑拉德]
我出生在沙漠，
從未見過
如此翠綠的田野。
所以，在這裡研究
非常有意思。

scripts.text:
[Gerard]
By the way... is this a
mushroom or a tree?
scripts.translation:
[傑拉德]
順便問一下...
這是蘑菇還是樹？

scripts.text:
[Alberto]
Hhh, I am cold...
scripts.translation:
[阿爾貝托]
呼，好冷...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Mr. Alberto, take this.
The Instructor sent
me on an errand.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
阿爾貝托先生，拿著這個。
指導員派我
來送個東西。

scripts.text:
[Alberto]
I finally got it.
My coat...sniff.
It's freezing here.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾貝托]
終於拿到了。
我的外套...吸溜。
這裡冷得要命。

scripts.text:
[Alberto]
Sniff...
- rustling sound -
scripts.translation:
[阿爾貝托]
吸溜...
- 窸窸窣窣的聲音 -

scripts.text:
[Alberto]
Ah, I am sorry but...
My hands are so cold
that I cannot open it.
Can you open it for me?.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾貝托]
啊，不好意思...
我的手凍僵了，
打不開。能幫我開啟嗎？

scripts.text:
- rustling sound -
- Opening someone -
- else's stuff makes -
- me feel strange. -
scripts.translation:
- 窸窸窣窣的聲音 -
- 開啟別人的東西 -
- 讓我感覺有點奇怪。 -

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Here it is.
Hopefully it'll warm you up.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
給你。
希望能讓你暖和一點。

scripts.text:
[Alberto]
Yes I really appreciate it.
It makes me feel alive.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾貝托]
真的非常感謝。
我感覺自己活過來了。

scripts.text:
[Alberto]
Please tell the Instructor
that I am still alive.
Sniff.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾貝托]
請告訴指導員，
我還活著。
吸溜。

scripts.text:
[Alberto]
It's so cold here~~
the wind chills me to the bones~
scripts.translation:
[阿爾貝托]
這裡好冷~~
風冷得刺骨~

scripts.text:
[Alberto]
I am still cold even
with this heavy coat.
I need to order more clothes.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾貝托]
穿著這件厚外套
我還是覺得冷。
我得再訂幾件衣服。

scripts.text:
[Alberto]
What are these weird
structures set up
here and there?
scripts.translation:
[阿爾貝托]
這裡到處都豎著
這些奇怪的結構
是什麼？

scripts.text:
[Alix]
Huu, I made this and
this is really great.
When I am back
to the motherland,
I will open a shop for it!!
scripts.translation:
[阿利克斯]
呼，這是我做的，
真的很好吃。
等我回到祖國，
我要開個店賣這個！！

scripts.text:
[Alix]
Have you had it?
My chocolate pie!!!
This food is a real miracle!!
scripts.translation:
[阿利克斯]
你嚐嚐看？
我的巧克力派！！
這食物簡直是奇蹟！！

scripts.text:
[Biolay]
Sob...
Where is she?
scripts.translation:
[比奧萊]
嗚嗚...
她在哪裡？

scripts.text:
[Biolay]
I was just wandering
around Morocc and
became faint. then
I found myself here.
scripts.translation:
[比奧萊]
我剛才在莫洛奇
四處遊蕩，
然後暈倒了，
醒來就發現自己在這裡。

scripts.text:
[Biolay]
I want to go back to my house.
scripts.translation:
[比奧萊]
我想回家。

scripts.text:
- Wait a minute !! -
- Currently you're carrying -
- too many items with you. -
- Please try again -
- after you lose some weight. -
scripts.translation:
- 等等！！ -
- 您現在攜帶的物品 -
- 太多了。 -
- 請在減輕負重後 -
- 再試一次。 -

scripts.text:
- rustling sound -
- You find a branch -
scripts.translation:
- 沙沙聲 -
- 你發現了一根樹枝 -

scripts.text:
- Break! -
- Bomb, bomb~~ -
- You got the branch. -
scripts.translation:
- 咔嚓！ -
- 轟，轟~~ -
- 你拿到了樹枝。 -

scripts.text:
- Break! -
- Bomb, bomb~~ -
- This branch is decayed. -
scripts.translation:
- 咔嚓！ -
- 轟，轟~~ -
- 這根樹枝已經腐爛了。 -

scripts.text:
[{0}]
This is useless.
I need to find others...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這沒用。
我得去找別的...

scripts.text:
- rustling sound -
- There's nothing useful. -
scripts.translation:
- 沙沙聲 -
- 這裡沒有什麼有用的東西。 -

scripts.text:
- The posts of the -
- barracks are broken. -
scripts.translation:
- 營地的柱子 -
- 斷了。 -

scripts.text:
- The posts of the -
- barracks are broken. -
- You'd better go out and -
- find the materials to fix it. -
scripts.translation:
- 營地的柱子 -
- 斷了。 -
- 你最好出去 -
- 找些材料來修好它。 -

scripts.text:
- There are broken posts. -
- Unless they are fixed soon, -
- the barracks will collapse. -
scripts.translation:
- 這裡有斷掉的柱子。 -
- 如果不盡快修好， -
- 營地就會倒塌。 -

scripts.text: Attach the tree bar.
scripts.translation: 安裝樹枝

scripts.text: Tie it with the vines.
scripts.translation: 用藤蔓綁住

scripts.text:
- You attach the tree bar -
- to the broken post -
scripts.translation:
- 你將樹枝 -
- 固定在斷掉的柱子上 -

scripts.text: - You tie the broken post -
scripts.translation: - 你綁住了斷掉的柱子 -

scripts.text: - It seems that it's fixed -
scripts.translation: - 看起來修好了 -

scripts.text:
[Diego]
Oh! Now you need to
knot it and finish it.
scripts.translation:
[迭戈]
哦！現在你需要
打結並完成了。

scripts.text: Knot it.
scripts.translation: 打結

scripts.text: Leave it.
scripts.translation: 離開

scripts.text: - You tie a perfect knot -
scripts.translation: - 你打了一個完美的結 -

scripts.text:
[Diego]
And this post should be knotted.
Then please do it to that post.
scripts.translation:
[迭戈]
這根柱子需要打結固定。
請幫那根柱子也處理一下。

scripts.text: - You decide to leave -
scripts.translation: - 你決定離開 -

scripts.text:
- The branches slide down. -
- You failed to fix it. -
scripts.translation:
- 樹枝滑了下來。 -
- 你沒能修好它。 -

scripts.text:
[Diego]
...
Why aren't you helping?
scripts.translation:
[迭戈]
...
你為什麼不幫忙？

scripts.text:
- You fix the broken post -
- with the vines. -
- It seems that you-
- need more branches. -
scripts.translation:
- 你用藤蔓修好了斷掉的柱子 -
- 但看起來還需要更多的樹枝。 -

scripts.text:
[Diego]
This post is repaired.
Please do the same thing
on the other posts.
scripts.translation:
[迭戈]
這根柱子修好了。
請對其他柱子也做同樣的處理。

scripts.text:
- The post tied by the -
- vines seems unsteady -
- but my repair is perfect. -
scripts.translation:
- 用藤蔓綁住的柱子看起來不太穩 -
- 但我的修復很完美。 -

scripts.text:
- The posts of the -
- barracks are broken. -
scripts.translation:
- 營地的柱子 -
- 斷了。 -

scripts.text:
- The posts of the -
- barracks are broken. -
- You'd better go out and -
- find the materials to fix it. -
scripts.translation:
- 營地的柱子 -
- 斷了。 -
- 你最好出去 -
- 找些材料來修好它。 -

scripts.text:
- There are broken posts. -
- Unless they are fixed soon, -
- the barracks will collapse. -
scripts.translation:
- 這裡有斷掉的柱子。 -
- 如果不盡快修好， -
- 營地就會倒塌。 -
