scripts.translation: 安裝樹枝

scripts.text: Tie it with the vines.
scripts.translation: 用藤蔓綁住

scripts.text:
- You attach the tree bar -
- to the broken post -
scripts.translation:
- 你將樹枝 -
- 固定在斷掉的柱子上 -

scripts.text: - You tie the broken post -
scripts.translation: - 你綁住了斷掉的柱子 -

scripts.text: - It seems that it's fixed -
scripts.translation: - 看起來修好了 -

scripts.text:
[Diego]
Oh! Now you need to knot it and
finish it.
scripts.translation:
[迭戈]
哦！現在你需要打結並完成了。

scripts.text: Knot it.
scripts.translation: 打結

scripts.text: Leave it.
scripts.translation: 離開

scripts.text: - You tie a perfect knot -
scripts.translation: - 你打了一個完美的結 -

scripts.text:
[Diego]
Ohhh!!!!
The broken posts are perfectly fixed!
scripts.translation:
[迭戈]
哦！！！！
斷掉的柱子完美地修好了！

scripts.text: - You decide to leave -
scripts.translation: - 你決定離開 -

scripts.text:
- The branches slide down. -
- You failed to fix it. -
scripts.translation:
- 樹枝滑了下來。 -
- 你沒能修好它。 -

scripts.text:
[Diego]
...
Why aren't you helping?
scripts.translation:
[迭戈]
...
你為什麼不幫忙？

scripts.text:
- You fix the broken post -
- with the vines. -
- It seems that you-
- need more branches. -
scripts.translation:
- 你用藤蔓修好了斷掉的柱子 -
- 但看起來還需要更多的樹枝。 -

scripts.text:
- The post tied by the -
- vines seems unsteady -
- but my repair is perfect. -
scripts.translation:
- 用藤蔓綁住的柱子看起來不太穩 -
- 但我的修復很完美。 -

scripts.text:
[Monster Scholar]
Who... Who are you?
Are you from the other
side of the space gap?
Say, are you a scholar,
soldier, or village
representative?
scripts.translation:
[怪物學者]
你...你是誰？
你是來自空間裂縫另一邊的嗎？
請問，你是學者、士兵，還是村莊代表？

scripts.text:
[Monster Scholar]
Oh, I'm sorry.
You don't have to tell
me if you don't want to...
scripts.translation:
[怪物學者]
哦，抱歉。
如果你不想說，就不必告訴我...

scripts.text:
[Monster Scholar]
Who... Who are you?
Are you from the other
side of the space gap?
Say, are you a scholar,
soldier, or village
representative?
scripts.translation:
[怪物學者]
你...你是誰？
你是來自空間裂縫另一邊的嗎？
請問，你是學者、士兵，還是村莊代表？

scripts.text:
[Monster Scholar]
Oh, I'm sorry.
You don't have to tell
me if you don't want to...
scripts.translation:
[怪物學者]
哦，抱歉。
如果你不想說，就不必告訴我...

scripts.text:
[Monster Scholar]
Please go ahead and do
what you have to do.
Oh, me? Don't worry.
I'm fine by myself.
scripts.translation:
[怪物學者]
請繼續做你需要做的事吧。
哦，我嗎？別擔心。
我一個人沒問題。

scripts.text: Who are you?
scripts.translation: 你是誰？

scripts.text:
[Monster Scholar]
I'm Rumis Block, and
I'm working here on behalf of
the monsternomics academy
from the Schwarzwald Republic.
Botanist Terris Block is
my older twin brother.
scripts.translation:
[怪物學者]
我是魯米斯·布洛克，
我代表修瓦魯茲巴魯德共和國的怪物經濟學學院在此工作。
植物學家泰瑞斯·布洛克是我的雙胞胎哥哥。

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
This place is freezing. Not only
that, it's deserted and too
quiet... Everything around us is
watching and threatening us.
You know, I didn't want to
come here...
scripts.translation:
[魯米斯·布洛克]
這裡冷得要命。不僅如此，這裡荒無人煙，太安靜了...周圍的一切都在注視著我們，威脅著我們。
你知道嗎，我本來不想來這裡的...

scripts.text: How did you get here?
scripts.translation: 你是怎麼來到這裡的？

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
In fact, none of us
wanted to come here.
I mean, no one knows
what kind of danger lurks
in this unknown world.
scripts.translation:
[魯米斯·布洛克]
其實，我們誰都不想來這裡。
我是說，沒人知道這個未知世界裡潛伏著什麼樣的危險。

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
It was my brother Terris who
wanted me to come along.
He was selected first as the
botanist of the continental
expedition. He had to drag me
here 'cuz I didn't want to come.
scripts.translation:
[魯米斯·布洛克]
是我哥哥泰瑞斯讓我一起來的。
他首先被選為大陸探險隊的植物學家。因為他不想一個人來，所以硬把我拖到了這裡。

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
I guess he didn't want to be
alone in this world far away
from civilization. Instead, he
decided to drag me here and
force me to join the expedition
so he doesn't feel lonely!
scripts.translation:
[魯米斯·布洛克]
我想他是不想在這個遠離文明的世界裡獨自一人。於是，他決定把我拖到這裡，強迫我加入探險隊，這樣他就不會感到孤單了！

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
What's with that dirty look?
Why, do I sound like
someone blaming someone
else for the misery in his life?
scripts.translation:
[魯米斯·布洛克]
你那嫌棄的眼神是怎麼回事？
怎麼，聽起來像是我在把生活中的不幸怪罪給別人嗎？

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
I'm telling you, it's the truth.
There are people that want 
to escape the expedition by
getting themselves sick on purpose.
scripts.translation:
[魯米斯·布洛克]
我告訴你，這是事實。
有些人為了逃避探險，故意讓自己生病。

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
I know it's too late to
complain now, but...
scripts.translation:
[魯米斯·布洛克]
我知道現在抱怨已經太遲了，但是...

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
Every day I pray to God to
let me go back home safely.
That's the only thing that
keeps me going. Everything
around here is watching me.
It's suffocating, you know?
scripts.translation:
[魯米斯·布洛克]
每天我都祈禱上帝能讓我平安回家。
這是支撐我活下去的唯一動力。
這裡的一切都在注視著我。
令人窒息，你知道嗎？

scripts.text: When do you go back?
scripts.translation: 你們什麼時候回去？

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
That's the problem.
We Specialists are required
to submit our study reports
to the expedition's leaders.
We are here to explore
and study this world.
scripts.translation:
[魯米斯·布洛克]
這就是問題所在。
我們專家必須向探險隊首領提交研究進度報告。
我們在這裡是為了探索和研究生這個世界的。

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
I'm sure the management will
tell me when to go back, but
I don't expect it to be any time
soon. It'll be at least after
I submit my report.
scripts.translation:
[魯米斯·布洛克]
我相信管理層會告訴我什麼時候能回去，
但我預計不會很快。
至少也要等我提交完報告之後。

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
I must tell you,
I hate this place!
It gives me the creeps!
scripts.translation:
[魯米斯·布洛克]
我必須告訴你，
我討厭這個地方！
它讓我毛骨悚然！

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
Yes, I'm a monster scholar
But I've been afraid of creatures even when I was on the Midgard Continent...
scripts.translation:
[魯米斯·布洛克]
是的，我是一名怪物學者，
但即使是在米德加爾特大陸時，我也害怕生物...

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
No, but can't you see?
This place is totally new to me,
and everything is so unknown...
scripts.translation:
[魯米斯·布洛克]
不，難道你看不到嗎？
這個地方對我來說完全陌生，
一切都那麼未知...

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
I may be a monster scholar,
but I'm afraid...
Of many things...
scripts.translation:
[魯米斯·布洛克]
我可能是一名怪物學者，
但我害怕...
害怕很多東西...

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
The president of United
Midgard Corporation has
asked me to find some
monsters that are edible.
scripts.translation:
[魯米斯·布洛克]
聯合米德加爾特公司的總裁
要求我尋找一些可以食用的魔物。

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
But look outside. Look!
Do you see Mandragoras
hiding in the icy bushes?
Those are called ^3131FFNepentheses^000000.
scripts.translation:
[魯米斯·布洛克]
但看看外面。看！
你看到藏在冰草叢中的曼陀羅魔花了嗎？
那些叫做^3131FF豬籠草^000000。

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
Aren't they quite savage-
looking and intimidating?
They look as if they
want to sting me with
those sharp thorns!
Argh...
scripts.translation:
[魯米斯·布洛克]
它們看起來不是很野蠻、很嚇人嗎？
它們看起來好像想用那些尖刺
刺我一樣！
啊...

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
I'd rather starve to
death than study
those dangerous and
grotesque monsters!
I'm not going to go
outside of my tent.
scripts.translation:
[魯米斯·布洛克]
我寧願餓死，
也不願研究那些危險且怪異的魔物！
我不會走出我的帳篷。

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
Not ever.
No one can dare
venture through
such a threatening
environment!
scripts.translation:
[魯米斯·布洛克]
永遠都不會。
沒人敢涉足
如此充滿威脅的環境！

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
I'm not going to go
outside of my tent.
Not ever.
scripts.translation:
[魯米斯·布洛克]
我不會走出我的帳篷。
永遠都不會。

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
I'm scared of this place.
But I'm not going to ask
my brother for help
He hates me.
scripts.translation:
[魯米斯·布洛克]
我害怕這個地方。
但我不會向哥哥求助，
他討厭我。

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
If a Nepenthes
approaches me
with a smile and
speaks to me kindly...
scripts.translation:
[魯米斯·布洛克]
如果一隻豬籠草
微笑著靠近我，
並且溫柔地與我對話...

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
*Sigh* I sound crazy, don't I?
...This is why I didn't want
to leave my lab...
scripts.translation:
[魯米斯·布洛克]
*嘆氣* 我聽起來很瘋狂，對吧？
...這就是為什麼我不想離開我的實驗室...

scripts.text: Show loot from Nepentheses.
scripts.translation: 檢視豬籠草的掉落物

scripts.text: Scold him.
scripts.translation: 責罵他

scripts.text: Comfort him.
scripts.translation: 安慰他

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hey, take a look here...
These Nepentheses aren't
any more brutal or grotesque
than the ones back home.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嘿，你看這裡...
這些豬籠草
並不比家鄉的
更兇殘或可怕。

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
...What's this?
Isn't this from
the Nepentheses?
scripts.translation:
[魯米斯·布洛克]
...這是什麼？
這不是
豬籠草掉落的嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
That's right!
I took care of them.
It was easy, haha!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
沒錯！
我處理掉了它們。
很簡單，哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
I can't believe you really
took care of them! Tell me,
who are you really?
Are you a soldier?
Captain? Or agent?
scripts.translation:
[魯米斯·布洛克]
真不敢相信你
真的處理掉了它們！告訴我，
你究竟是誰？
是士兵？
船長？還是特工？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No, I'm just a wandering
adventurer. I've come here
to challenge this new place
and to help people out~
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不，我只是一個
流浪的冒險者。我來這裡
是為了挑戰這個新地方，
並幫助人們~

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
I... I see.
I've heard about adventurers
that have made positive
impacts on Midgard.
You're one of them, huh?
scripts.translation:
[魯米斯·布洛克]
我...我明白了。
我聽說過
對米德加爾特
產生積極影響的冒險者。
你也是其中之一，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
...That's great!
I think I've finally found
a silver lining. God has
sent me a savior.
And I think that's you!
scripts.translation:
[魯米斯·布洛克]
...太好了！
我想我終於
看到了一絲希望。神
派來了救世主。
我想那就是你！

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
Please, don't say you
don't want to help me.
Can't you see that.
I'm shivering in fear?
Please help me. Will you?
scripts.translation:
[魯米斯·布洛克]
求求你，別說
你不想幫我。
難道你看不見嗎？
我嚇得發抖？
請幫幫我，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
As I told you earlier,
I have an elder twin
brother, Terris Block...
scripts.translation:
[魯米斯·布洛克]
正如我之前所說，
我有一個年長的雙胞胎
哥哥，特里斯·布洛克...

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
He's a botanist. He's
extremely strong and
extroverted, unlike me.
I think he hates me because
I represent weakness, and
he is the complete opposite.
scripts.translation:
[魯米斯·布洛克]
他是一名植物學家。他
非常強壯且
外向，不像我。
我想他討厭我，因為
我代表著軟弱，而
他恰恰相反。

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
...Oh, that's not what I wanted
to say. I wanted to show my
discovery regarding the
Nepentheses to my brother.
scripts.translation:
[魯米斯·布洛克]
...哦，這不是
我想說的。我想
向哥哥展示我
關於豬籠草的發現。

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
I need a Nepenthes specimen,
but I don't have the tools to
make one, my luggage is still
on transfer. And it's not like
I've packed enough tools, so...
scripts.translation:
[魯米斯·布洛克]
我需要豬籠草標本，
但我沒有製作標本的工具，
我的行李還在
轉移中。而且
我也沒帶足夠的工具，所以...

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
To make my specimen tools,
I need ^3131FF1 Empty Bottle,
5 Holy Waters, and
30 Sticky Mucus^000000.
scripts.translation:
[魯米斯·布洛克]
為了製作標本工具，
我需要 ^3131FF1 個空瓶，
5 瓶聖水，以及
30 份粘稠液體^000000。

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
You know what I'm.
asking here, don't you?
Help me, help me, please.
scripts.translation:
[魯米斯·布洛克]
你知道我
在請求什麼，對吧？
幫幫我，幫幫我，求你了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You call yourself a monster
scholar, and yet you're afraid
of practicing your expertise.
You're nothing but a coward.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你自稱怪物學者，
卻害怕實踐你的專長。
你不過是個膽小鬼。

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
I can take your criticism,
but I can't hide my true feelings.
scripts.translation:
[魯米斯·布洛克]
我可以接受你的批評，
但我無法隱藏我的真實感受。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Come on, you're a respected
monster scholar. You'll find
that the monsters in this world
aren't that different from the
ones in Midgard. Why don't
you see for yourself?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
拜託，你是一位受人尊敬的
怪物學者。你會發現
這個世界的魔物
與米德加爾特的那些
沒什麼不同。為什麼
不親自去看看呢？

scripts.text:
- Rumis didn't seem -
- to be convinced. -
- He shook his head in refusal. -
scripts.translation:
- 魯米斯似乎 -
- 並不信服。 -
- 他搖頭拒絕了。 -

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
I'm not going to go
outside of my tent.
Not ever.
scripts.translation:
[魯米斯·布洛克]
我不會走出我的帳篷。
永遠都不會。

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
Thank you.
you've brought the materials.
scripts.translation:
[魯米斯·布洛克]
謝謝你。
你帶來了材料。

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
While you were collecting the
materials, I've sent out soldiers
to catch a few Nepentheses.
scripts.translation:
[魯米斯·布洛克]
在你收集材料的時候，
我已經派士兵去
捕捉了幾隻豬籠草。

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
Nepenthes looks extremely
similar to Mandragora on
the Midgard Continent.
scripts.translation:
[魯米斯·布洛克]
豬籠草看起來
與米德加爾特大陸的
曼陀羅魔花
極其相似。

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
Both of them must share the
same ancestor, but apparently
Nepenthes has evolved to
become stronger and more
aggressive due to this
barren environment.
scripts.translation:
[魯米斯·布洛克]
它們一定擁有
共同的祖先，但顯然，
豬籠草在這種
貧瘠的環境中
進化得
更強壯、更具攻擊性。

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
I wonder how the ancestors
were scattered over
two different worlds...
scripts.translation:
[魯米斯·布洛克]
我想知道祖先們
是如何分散到
兩個不同的世界的...

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
Maybe they went through
the World Tree Yggdrasil?
Maybe it came along with
other creatures such as
Satan Morocc and traversed
through time and space.
scripts.translation:
[魯米斯·布洛克]
也許它們穿過了
世界樹 尤克特拉希爾？
也許它們伴隨著
魔王夢羅克等其他生物，
穿越了時間和空間。

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
The characteristics of this species are...
scripts.translation:
[魯米斯·布洛克]
這個物種的特徵是...

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
Oh, where are my manners?
I'm sorry if I bored you by
talking academic nonsense...
Let's talk about something
else, shall we?
scripts.translation:
[魯米斯·布洛克]
哦，我的失禮了。
抱歉讓你聽我
講這些學術上的廢話...
我們聊點別的，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
Do you think...
My brother will be happy to
see this Nepenthes specimen?
You know, Nepenthes is a
plant monster, and that's
my brother's specialty.
scripts.translation:
[魯米斯·布洛克]
你覺得...
我哥哥看到
這個豬籠草標本
會高興嗎？
你知道的，豬籠草是
植物魔物，
這正是我哥哥的專長。

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
Please deliver this specimen to Terris Block
He's near the expedition camp.
No, you won't have to sit through my brother's reaction... If it's bad.
scripts.translation:
[魯米斯·布洛克]
請把這個標本交給特里斯·布洛克。
他在探險營地附近。
不，你不用留下來聽我哥哥的反應...如果反應不好的話。

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
- You have received a-
- Nepenthes Specimen -
- from Rumis Block. -
scripts.translation:
[魯米斯·布洛克]
- 你從魯米斯·布洛克那裡 -
- 獲得了一個 -
- 豬籠草標本 -

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
To make my specimen tools,
I need ^3131FF1 Empty Bottle, 5 Holy Waters, and 30 Sticky Mucus^000000.
scripts.translation:
[魯米斯·布洛克]
為了製作我的標本工具，
我需要^3131FF1 1個空瓶、5瓶聖水，以及30份粘稠液體^000000。

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
You know what I'm asking here, don't you? Thank you in advance.
scripts.translation:
[魯米斯·布洛克]
你知道我在要求什麼，對吧？
提前謝謝你了。

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
Did you deliver the Nepenthes Specimen to my brother Terris?
He's at the east of the camp.
scripts.translation:
[魯米斯·布洛克]
你把豬籠草標本
交給我哥哥特里斯了嗎？
他在營地的東邊。

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
...Welcome back.
Oh, you don't have to tell me what my brother said,
because someone from his side already came by. His report really impressed management, huh?
scripts.translation:
[魯米斯·布洛克]
...歡迎回來。
哦，你不用告訴我哥哥說了什麼，
因為他那邊已經有人來過了。他的報告讓管理層印象深刻，是吧？

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
Yes, that's my brother......
scripts.translation:
[魯米斯·布洛克]
是的，那是我哥哥......

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
...Anyways, one of the soldiers that captured Nepentheses for me has given me some interesting information.
scripts.translation:
[魯米斯·布洛克]
...總之，為我捕捉豬籠草的
其中一名士兵
給了我一些有趣的資訊。

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
Over the eastern bridge, he found a new type of monster.
scripts.translation:
[魯米斯·布洛克]
在東邊的橋上，
他發現了一種新的魔物。

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
According to his description, the monster is suspected to be a member of the long-haired Cat family. I'd like to see it with my own eyes, but...
scripts.translation:
[魯米斯·布洛克]
根據他的描述，
這種魔物疑似是
長毛貓家族的成員。
我想親眼看看，但是...

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
As you know, I'm not yet ready to face any types of monsters in this world...
scripts.translation:
[魯米斯·布洛克]
你知道的，
我還沒有準備好
面對這個世界的
任何型別的魔物...

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
Can you escort me while I'm studying that species?
Please, I'm begging you!
scripts.translation:
[魯米斯·布洛克]
在我研究那個物種的時候，
你能護送我嗎？
拜託了，我求你了！

scripts.text: Okay.
scripts.translation: 好的。

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不。

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
Wow, thanks!
Then I'd better pack my stuff right away...
scripts.translation:
[魯米斯·布洛克]
哇，太感謝了！
那我得趕緊收拾行李了...

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
It won't take long. Can you please go wait for me over the eastern bridge?
Don't... Don't go too far from the bridge!
scripts.translation:
[魯米斯·布洛克]
不會花太久的。你能去東邊的橋上等我嗎？
別...別離橋太遠！

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
Oh.........

[Rumis Block]
I'll pack my stuff and follow you. Can you please go wait for me over the rightward bridge?
Don't... Don't go too far from the bridge!
scripts.translation:
[魯米斯·布洛克]
我會收拾好東西跟上你的。你能去右邊的橋上等我嗎？
別...別離橋太遠！

scripts.text: - Rumis is hurriedly packing his stuff. -
scripts.translation: - 魯米斯正在匆忙地收拾行李。 -

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
......
scripts.translation:
[魯米斯·布洛克]
......

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
Apparently, an extremely intelligent creature inhabits Ash Vaccum.
scripts.translation:
[魯米斯·布洛克]
據說，在阿什·瓦庫姆棲息著一種極其聰明的生物。

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
An explorer went over the rightward bridge to find some wood. In the darkness, something really big rushed at him from far away.
scripts.translation:
[魯米斯·布洛克]
一位探險者過右邊的橋去砍柴。在黑暗中，一個巨大的東西從遠處衝向他。

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
When he came back to his senses, there was nothing but a tricorn hat left on the ground.
scripts.translation:
[魯米斯·布洛克]
等他回過神來，地上只剩下一頂三角帽了。

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
The tricorn is woven in a way that was never introduced to Midgard, and its materials are also unidentifiable.
scripts.translation:
[魯米斯·布洛克]
這頂三角帽的編織方式從未在米德加爾特出現過，其材質也無法辨認。

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
Does it mean another race of human resides here? Would they be fairies or something else?
scripts.translation:
[魯米斯·布洛克]
這意味著這裡還居住著另一個人類種族嗎？會是精靈還是其他什麼？

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
What if they've detected us and tried to drive us away... Wah!
scripts.translation:
[魯米斯·布洛克]
如果他們發現了我們並試圖驅趕我們...哇！

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
Even thinking of them send chills down on my spine! Can you please go check what kind of races reside at the end of the land over the rightward bridge?
I want to know if they're friendly or hostile to us.
scripts.translation:
[魯米斯·布洛克]
光是想想就讓我脊背發涼！你能去檢查一下右邊橋盡頭居住的是什麼種族嗎？
我想知道他們對我們是否友好。

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
Welcome back. Did you find out about them?
scripts.translation:
[魯米斯·布洛克]
歡迎回來。你查明他們的情況了嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well, let's see...

[{0}]
The owner of the tricorn hat
is a monster called...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這頂三角帽的主人
是一種叫做...的魔物

scripts.text: ^FF0000Tatacho^000000

[{0}]
{1}...? I don't think that was the name...

[{0}]
The size of Tatacho is about...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
噠噠喬的大小大概是...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Tatachos are usually sitting on the ground, but they roll around if their body temperature goes down too low because of the cold weather.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
噠噠喬通常坐在地上，但如果天氣太冷導致體溫過低，它們就會在地上打滾。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
About that tricorn hat, I've concluded, based on my opinion about their appearance and their movement patterns, that it is not active or productive at all:
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
關於那頂三角帽，根據我對它們外貌和運動模式的觀察，我得出的結論是：它們完全不具備主動性和生產力：

scripts.text:
[{0}]
They are not intelligent enough to produce a sophisticated hat like that.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
它們的智力不足以製作出如此精緻的帽子。

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
......
You now sound like me... I guess I've stained you with my academic manner of speech. Oh, I'm not saying it is bad, but...
scripts.translation:
[魯米斯·布洛克]
......
你現在的說話方式聽起來像我...我想我讓你沾染了我的學術腔調。哦，我不是說這不好，只是...

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
Anyways, according to your conclusion, the hat must have been given to them by someone else, or they could have picked it up after another creature dropped it.
Thank you for such valuable information.
It's enough to write a report.
scripts.translation:
[魯米斯·布洛克]
總之，根據你的結論，這頂帽子一定是別人送給它們的，或者是它們撿到了其他生物掉落的帽子。
謝謝你提供瞭如此寶貴的資訊。
這足以寫一份報告了。

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
I should make a brief report and then submit it to management. Hopefully, a new monster scholar after me will do a better job in actually studying them.
scripts.translation:
[魯米斯·布洛克]
我應該寫一份簡短的報告並提交給管理層。希望在我之後的新怪物學者能更好地研究它們。

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
There are many cold places in my country, the Schwarzwald Republic, but none are as cold as this place. This weather is freezing my senses, dulling my passion toward my studies.
I shall go back home faster than anyone else in this camp. I'm tired of this world...
scripts.translation:
[魯米斯·布洛克]
在我的祖國修瓦魯茲巴魯德共和國，有很多寒冷的地方，但沒有像這裡這麼冷的。這天氣凍僵了我的感官，也磨鈍了我對研究的熱情。
我會比營地裡的任何人都更快回家。我受夠了這個世界...

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
...{0}, I thank you so much for helping me despite my self-centered behavior.
I really appreciate it
scripts.translation:
[魯米斯·布洛克]
...{0}，非常感謝你在我如此自私的情況下還幫助我。
我真的非常感激。

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
I'll repay your favor as soon as I go back home.
I hope you'll make yourself known in Ash Vacuum with your great accomplishments.
scripts.translation:
[魯米斯·布洛克]
等我回到家，我會報答你的恩情。
希望你在阿什能憑藉偉大的成就聲名遠揚。

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
Can you please go check what kind of races reside at the end of the land over the rightward bridge? I want to know if they're friendly or hostile to us.
scripts.translation:
[魯米斯·布洛克]
你能去檢查一下右邊那座橋盡頭居住著哪些種族嗎？我想知道它們對我們是否友好。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Mr. Rumis! Take a look at this!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
魯米斯先生！請看這個！

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
...Oh, hello.
I'm extremely frustrated. I feel helpless because I wasn't able to go back home last time...
scripts.translation:
[魯米斯·布洛克]
...哦，你好。
我非常沮喪。因為上次沒能回家，我感到很無助...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I've found this horn from a monster in the Splendide Area.
That monster was very mysterious, and its body was covered with grass.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我在輝煌領域從一隻魔物身上發現了這隻鍬形蟲。
那隻魔物非常神秘，身體上覆蓋著草。

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
Ho... Covered with grass?
...I know you're excited, but that doesn't sound interesting to me. Sorry.
scripts.translation:
[魯米斯·布洛克]
哦...覆蓋著草？
...我知道你很興奮，但這聽起來並不有趣。抱歉。

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
Let me take a look at the horn.
scripts.translation:
[魯米斯·布洛克]
讓我看看這隻鍬形蟲。

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
Hmm.
scripts.translation:
[魯米斯·布洛克]
嗯。

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
Uhmm...
scripts.translation:
[魯米斯·布洛克]
嗯...

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
Huh...?
scripts.translation:
[魯米斯·布洛克]
咦...？

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
...This is remarkable.
...This horn looks very similar to that of the Hillsrions that inhabit the Manuk area.
scripts.translation:
[魯米斯·布洛克]
...這很了不起。
...這隻鍬形蟲看起來非常像棲息在馬努克地區的丘陵獅的鍬形蟲。

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
I wonder if they're related,
or if this is an evolved Hillsrion.
scripts.translation:
[魯米斯·布洛克]
我想知道它們是否有親緣關係，
或者這是一隻進化後的丘陵獅。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Ah, and there's the possibility of mutation caused by the environment.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
啊，還有可能是由環境引起的變異。

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
...What do you mean?
Are you saying the monster has been mutated by environmental causes?
scripts.translation:
[魯米斯·布洛克]
...你這是什麼意思？
你是說魔物是因為環境原因發生了變異嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well, that's possible, isn't it? Haha!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯，這也有可能，不是嗎？哈哈！

scripts.text: - You told Rumis what you've heard from Botanist Terris: some plants are already showing signs of mutation. -
scripts.translation: - 你告訴了魯米斯你從植物學家泰瑞斯那裡聽到的事：有些植物已經出現了變異的跡象。 -

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
Oh, that's interesting.
If such a device really exists, it's possible to cause abnormal growth to monsters by injecting them with special energy.
scripts.translation:
[魯米斯·布洛克]
哦，這很有趣。
如果這種裝置真的存在，那麼通過注入特殊能量，確實有可能導致魔物發生異常生長。

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
By the way, who came up with the idea of that device?
scripts.translation:
[魯米斯·布洛克]
順便問一下，是誰想出了這個裝置的主意的？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I have no idea. Haha!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我完全不知道。哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
I see...
Mutants caused by a man-made device... Then there might be more mutated creatures in addition to Tendrillion.
scripts.translation:
[魯米斯·布洛克]
原來如此...
由人造裝置造成的變異...那麼除了三角獸之外，可能還有其他變異的生物。

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
...Now I'm very curious.
But... I want to go back home... It's no use studying them if the management will order me to return.
scripts.translation:
[魯米斯·布洛克]
...我現在非常好奇。
但是...我想回家...如果管理層命令我回去，研究它們也沒用了。

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
I guess my brother really likes this place.
I mean, he's working so hard to figure things out...
scripts.translation:
[魯米斯·布洛克]
看來我哥哥真的很喜歡這個地方。
我是說，他為了弄清楚事情真相，工作得非常努力...

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
Well, not everyone can live the same life.
I just hope he'll have a better understanding about me...
scripts.translation:
[魯米斯·布洛克]
嗯，並不是每個人都能過一樣的生活。
我只希望他能更理解我一些...

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
I don't know if people in Midgard will welcome me back.
Thanks to you, I at least have a few interesting stories to tell them.
scripts.translation:
[魯米斯·布洛克]
我不知道米德加爾特的人是否會歡迎我回去。
多虧了你，我至少有幾個有趣的故事可以講給他們聽。

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
If you're going to stick around here longer, please help my brother with his study.
I might want to come back later once this area is fully explored and developed...
scripts.translation:
[魯米斯·布洛克]
如果你打算在這裡多待一段時間，請幫我哥哥做研究。
等這個區域被完全探索和開發後，我可能會再回來...

scripts.text: - With a shy smile on the face, Rumis Block asked you to shake hands, and then turned around hurriedly. -
scripts.translation: - 魯米斯·布洛克臉上帶著羞澀的微笑，請你握手，然後匆匆轉身離開了。 -

scripts.text: - You really hope that Rumis will be able to go back home. -
scripts.translation: - 你真的希望魯米斯能回家。 -

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
...I submitted the report to the management, but they have not yet ordered me to go back home...
...*Sigh* I guess nothing's as easy as I'd hoped.
scripts.translation:
[魯米斯·布洛克]
...我向管理層提交了報告，但他們還沒有命令我回家...
...*嘆氣* 看來事情並沒有我想像的那麼順利。

scripts.text: - Rumis seems anxious and scatterbrained. -
scripts.translation: - 魯米斯看起來很焦慮，有些心神不寧。 -

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
When can I go back to Midgard...? *Sigh*
scripts.translation:
[魯米斯·布洛克]
我什麼時候能回米德加爾特...？*嘆氣*

scripts.text:
[Botanist]
This new land!
Undiscovered life!
Everything about this world excites me.
scripts.translation:
[植物學家]
這片新土地！
未被發現的生命！
這個世界的每一樣東西都讓我興奮。

scripts.text:
[Botanist]
Oh, okay... Ah-hah!
This is how it goes...
scripts.translation:
[植物學家]
哦，好的...啊哈！
事情就是這樣發展的...

scripts.text:
[Botanist]
This new land!
Undiscovered life!
Everything about this world excites me.
scripts.translation:
[植物學家]
這片新土地！
未被發現的生命！
這個世界的每一樣東西都讓我興奮。

scripts.text:
[Botanist]
Oh, okay... Ah-hah!
This is how it goes...
scripts.translation:
[植物學家]
哦，好的...啊哈！
事情就是這樣發展的...

scripts.text:
This new land!
Undiscovered life!
Everything about this world excites me.
scripts.translation:
這片新土地！
未被發現的生命！
這個世界的每一樣東西都讓我興奮。

scripts.text:
[Botanist]
Oh, okay... Ah-hah!
This is how it goes...
scripts.translation:
[植物學家]
哦，好的...啊哈！
事情就是這樣發展的...

scripts.text: Express your displeasure.
scripts.translation: 表達不滿

scripts.text: Agree with him.
scripts.translation: 表示贊同

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Your excitement agitates me.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你的興奮讓我感到煩躁。

scripts.text:
[Botanist]
Err? Ahahahaha!
Oh, come on! I'm just being happy.
By the way, is there anything I can help you with?
scripts.translation:
[植物學家]
誒？啊哈哈！
哎呀！我只是很開心而已。
對了，有什麼我可以幫你的嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I agree. There's so much to see around here!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我同意。這裡有很多值得看的東西！

scripts.text:
[Botanist]
Ahahaha!
Nice to meet you, my friend.
So, is there anything I can help you with?
scripts.translation:
[植物學家]
啊哈哈！
很高興認識你，我的朋友。
那麼，有什麼我可以幫你的嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Your brother wanted me to send this to you. Maybe it'll help with your study.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你哥哥讓我把這個帶給你。也許對你的研究有幫助。

scripts.text: - You have given the Nepenthes Specimen to the botanist. -
scripts.translation: - 你將豬籠草標本交給了植物學家。 -

scripts.text:
[Botanist]
Oh...? Isn't this?!
scripts.translation:
[植物學家]
哦...？這不是...！

scripts.text:
[Botanist]
...Well, I've got a ton of samples of this specimen. Sorry.
scripts.translation:
[植物學家]
...好吧，我有很多這種標本的樣本。抱歉。

scripts.text: - He points at a pile of specimens in the tent. -
scripts.translation: - 他指向帳篷裡的一堆標本。 -

scripts.text:
[Botanist]
Still, I'm impressed. I always thought my brother could never do anything on his own. But look, he was able to collect a Nepenthes specimen.
scripts.translation:
[植物學家]
不過，我還是很佩服。我一直以為我哥哥什麼都做不好。但看，他居然能採集到豬籠草標本。

scripts.text:
[Botanist]
Then again, I had this strong feeling that someone has helped him.
That someone was probably you, right?~
scripts.translation:
[植物學家]
話說回來，我有一種強烈的感覺，有人幫了他。
那個人應該就是你吧？~

scripts.text:
[Botanist]
Either way, I don't care.
I'm just happy that he cares about me...
scripts.translation:
[植物學家]
不管怎樣，我不在乎。
我只是很高興他關心我...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Why do you think that?
Can't you just thank him for trying to help you?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你為什麼這麼想？
難道不能感謝他試圖幫你嗎？

scripts.text:
[Botanist]
Well, you must forget that he and I are twins.
We are spiritually connected to each other.
scripts.translation:
[植物學家]
嗯，你一定忘了我和他是雙胞胎。
我們在精神上彼此相連。

scripts.text:
[Botanist]
Usually twins share the same feelings and ideas, I can see what he does or thinks if I try hard.
scripts.translation:
[植物學家]
通常雙胞胎會有相同的感受和想法，如果我努力的話，我能看到他在做什麼或想什麼。

scripts.text:
[Botanist]
Let me see what Rumis is doing right now... Oh, he's picking his nose with his left hand and eating a slice of bread with his right.
God, how disgusting!
scripts.translation:
[植物學家]
讓我看看魯米斯現在在做什麼...哦，他在用左手挖鼻孔，用右手吃一片面包。
天哪，真噁心！

scripts.text: Go check Rumis if it's true.
scripts.translation: 去檢查魯米斯是否屬實

scripts.text: Do not trust his word.
scripts.translation: 不要相信他的話。

scripts.text:
[Botanist]
Hahaha!
Muhahaha!
Let me guess, you want to go check Rumis to see if I'm telling the truth. Am I wrong?
Hahahaha! Sorry, but I lied. I mean, remote vision? Because we're twins?
scripts.translation:
[植物學家]
哈哈哈！
穆哈哈哈哈哈！
讓我猜猜，你是想去看看魯米斯，驗證我說的話是不是真的。我猜錯了嗎？
哈哈哈哈哈！抱歉，我騙你了。我是說，遠端視覺？因為我們是雙胞胎？

scripts.text:
[Botanist]
God, you're so funny. Hahaha~
You please me, just like the new creatures blooming on the World Tree.~
scripts.translation:
[植物學家]
天哪，你真有趣。哈哈哈~
你讓我很開心，就像世界樹上綻放的新奇生物一樣。~

scripts.text:
[Botanist]
Oh,
won't you cut me some slack? I was just joking to melt the ice.
This world is too barren and tough to live without good humor and jokes, you know?
scripts.translation:
[植物學家]
哦，
你就別怪我了，我只是開個玩笑來打破僵局。
這個世界太貧瘠、太艱難了，沒有幽默和玩笑怎麼活呢，你知道嗎？

scripts.text:
[Botanist]
Anyways, as I said, I've got a lot of Nepenthes specimens.
But I'll gratefully take this pretentious gift of his.
scripts.translation:
[植物學家]
總之，正如我所說，我有很多豬籠草標本。
但我也會欣然接受他這份自命不凡的禮物。

scripts.text:
[Botanist]
This may be an unexpected question, but... Are you interested in meeting dangerous girls playing on a field?
scripts.translation:
[植物學家]
這可能是一個意想不到的問題，但...你對在草地上玩耍的危險女孩感興趣嗎？

scripts.text: Dangerous girls?
scripts.translation: 危險的女孩？

scripts.text:
[Botanist]
Yes, femme fatales!
I've seen girls that are so beautiful.
They're too dangerous to get close, but that's what make them so irresistibly attractive. Do you understand what I'm saying?
scripts.translation:
[植物學家]
是的，致命女人！
我見過非常美麗的女孩。
她們太危險了，讓人不敢靠近，但正是這種危險讓她們具有不可抗拒的吸引力。你明白我的意思嗎？

scripts.text: It's... Hard to say.
scripts.translation: 這...很難說。

scripts.text:
[Botanist]
Have you explored the area over the bridge at the right side of the united expedition camp?
Then you know the area is so cold that it'll instantly freeze your heart.
scripts.translation:
[植物學家]
你探索過聯合遠征營右側橋上的區域了嗎？
那麼你知道那裡冷得能瞬間凍結你的心臟。

scripts.text:
[Botanist]
You should go across the leftward bridge, you'll be surprised to see what's ahead of you.
It's yet to be known how such a thing can happen.
scripts.translation:
[植物學家]
你應該走過左邊的橋，你會驚訝地看到前面有什麼。
目前還不知曉這樣的事是如何發生的。

scripts.text: What are you talking about?
scripts.translation: 你在說什麼？

scripts.text:
[Botanist]
Well...
I suppose I don't have the words to really describe such an amazing scene.
scripts.translation:
[植物學家]
嗯...
我想我找不到合適的詞語來描述如此美妙的景象。

scripts.text:
[Botanist]
I'll send a message to the garrison for you. Why don't you go see it with your own eyes? You won't be disappointed!
scripts.translation:
[植物學家]
我會給你發一條訊息給加里森。你何不親眼去看看？你不會失望的！

scripts.text:
[Botanist]
Of course, I'm offering such an extraordinary service because there's something I want in return. Ahahaha!
...Truth be told, I'm having some trouble. And I need someone to help me.
scripts.translation:
[植物學家]
當然，我提供如此非凡的服務，是因為我想要回報。啊哈哈！
...說實話，我遇到了一些麻煩。我需要有人幫我。

scripts.text:
[Botanist]
For now, you should go across the leftward bridge. Speak to a guard over there, and then just go ahead.
A group of beautiful girls will welcome you. I hope you'll enjoy having a conversation with them. Maybe you'll get to understand the mystery of nature.
scripts.translation:
[植物學家]
現在，你應該走過左邊的橋。和那裡的衛兵對話，然後直接過去。
一群美麗的女孩會歡迎你。我希望你能享受與她們的對話。也許你會理解自然的奧秘。

scripts.text:
[Botanist]
Yes, I only need... ^3131FF30^000000 of them.

[Botanist]
Welcome back! How was it?
It was amazing, wasn't it?
scripts.translation:
[植物學家]
歡迎回來！感覺如何？
很驚人，不是嗎？

scripts.text:
[Botanist]
On the right side of this united expedition camp,
we have a land surrounded by roaring blizzards.
scripts.translation:
[植物學家]
在這個聯合遠征營的右側，
有一片被呼嘯暴風雪包圍的土地。

scripts.text:
[Botanist]
And on the other side,
we have a peaceful green land
where we can enjoy Mother Nature's warm embrace.
scripts.translation:
[植物學家]
而在另一邊，
有一片寧靜的綠色土地，
我們可以享受母親大自然的溫暖懷抱。

scripts.text:
[Botanist]
Two completely different worlds coexist
within a short distance of each other.
Where else can you see such amazing contrasts at a glance?
scripts.translation:
[植物學家]
兩個截然不同的世界
在很短的距離內共存。
還有哪裡能一眼看到如此驚人的對比？

scripts.text:
[Botanist]
I'm curious to know all secrets about this world.
scripts.translation:
[植物學家]
我很好奇，想要了解這個世界的
所有秘密。

scripts.text:
[Botanist]
I'm so excited that I can't hide it!
*Pant Pant*
*Pant Pant*
scripts.translation:
[植物學家]
我太興奮了，根本藏不住！
*呼哧呼哧*
*呼哧呼哧*

scripts.text: What a mysterious world this is!
scripts.translation: 真是個神秘的世界啊！

scripts.text:
[Botanist]
Yes, it is...
Oh, right!
Actually I'm here to study this strange phenomenon.
scripts.translation:
[植物學家]
是的，確實如此...
啊，對了！
其實我來到這裡，是為了研究
這種奇怪的現象。

scripts.text:
[Botanist]
To understand the environmental conditions,
including temperature and humidity,
5.....and check the families and growth of plants,
I've installed several special environmental meters
in this area.
scripts.translation:
[植物學家]
為了瞭解包括溫度和溼度在內的
環境狀況，
5.....並檢查植物的科屬和生長情況，
我在這個區域安裝了
幾臺特殊的環境監測儀。

scripts.text:
[Botanist]
Unfortunately, some evil monsters
keep destroying the precious meters
with their ^3131FFHeinous Hoops^000000!
scripts.translation:
[植物學家]
不幸的是，一些邪惡的魔物
一直用它們^3131FF邪惡的環^000000
破壞著珍貴的監測儀！

scripts.text:
[Botanist]
The culprits are called Cornus.
I'd like to ask you to teach them not to destroy my devices again.
scripts.translation:
[植物學家]
罪魁禍首是飛馬。
我想請你教訓它們一下，
讓它們別再破壞我的裝置了。

scripts.text:
[Botanist]
How'd you like to hunt ^3131FF10 of them^000000 to set an example? Good luck!
scripts.translation:
[植物學家]
你願意獵殺^3131FF10只^000000給它們
立個榜樣嗎？祝你好運！

scripts.text:
[Botanist]
For now, you should go across the leftward bridge. Speak to a guard over there, and then just go ahead.
A group of beautiful girls will welcome you. I hope you'll enjoy having a conversation with them. Maybe you'll get to understand the mystery of nature.
scripts.translation:
[植物學家]
現在，你應該走過左邊的橋。和那裡的衛兵對話，然後直接過去。
一群美麗的女孩會歡迎你。我希望你能享受與她們的對話。也許你會理解自然的奧秘。

scripts.text:
[Botanist]
Hopefully the Cornuses have learned their lesson, and won't touch my special environmental meters anymore.
scripts.translation:
[植物學家]
希望飛馬們已經吸取了教訓，
不會再碰我的特殊環境監測儀了。

scripts.text:
[Botanist]
Oh Karyl, while you were away, I received an interesting report from one of my research machines that remained intact.
scripts.translation:
[植物學家]
哦，卡里爾，趁你不在的時候，
我收到了一份有趣報告，
來自一臺倖存的研究機器。

scripts.text:
[Botanist]
According to the report, The original weather condition of Ash Vacuum is cold and dry, just like the land on the right side.
scripts.translation:
[植物學家]
根據報告，阿什真空的原始天氣狀況
是寒冷乾燥的，
就像右側的土地一樣。

scripts.text:
[Botanist]
That means, somebody has artificially cultivated the leftward land.
scripts.translation:
[植物學家]
這意味著，有人人工培育了
左側的土地。

scripts.text:
[Botanist]
Do you remember seeing strange mushroom shaped buildings everywhere in the fields?
I suspect it to be an environmental purifier that converts barren land into lush, green fields.
scripts.translation:
[植物學家]
你還記得在田野裡隨處可見的
那些奇怪的蘑菇狀建築嗎？
我懷疑那是一種環境淨化器，
能將貧瘠的土地轉化為鬱鬱蔥蔥的綠色田野。

scripts.text:
[Botanist]
Let me show you.
Please take this rotting plant stem,
I'll meet you at the environmental purifier standing right next to the leftward bridge on the other side.
scripts.translation:
[植物學家]
讓我給你看看。
請拿著這根腐爛的植物莖，
我會在另一邊，緊挨著左側橋梁的
環境淨化器那裡等你。

scripts.text:
[Botanist]
Cornuses are breaking my special environmental meters!
Please show them the power of Midgardians!
scripts.translation:
[植物學家]
飛馬正在破壞我的特殊環境監測儀！
請向它們展示米德加爾特人的力量！

scripts.text:
[Botanist]
I'll meet you at the environmental purifier standing right next to the leftward bridge on the other side.
scripts.translation:
[植物學家]
我會在另一邊，緊挨著左側橋梁的
環境淨化器那裡等你。

scripts.text:
[Botanist]
I submitted a report to upper management.
I haven't received any response, but I'm sure they'll be as excited as I am once they read the report. Woohoo!
scripts.translation:
[植物學家]
我向高層提交了報告。
雖然還沒收到回覆，但我相信
他們讀了報告後，會和我一樣興奮的。耶！

scripts.text:
[Camp Guard]
Stop!
You're about to enter an area that has not been fully explored.
Only personnel--researchers and explorers--authorized by United Midgard and the garrison are allowed to enter the danger zone.
scripts.translation:
[營地衛兵]
站住！
你即將進入一個尚未完全探索的區域。
只有獲得聯合米德加爾特和駐軍授權的
人員——研究員和探險家——
才能進入危險區域。

scripts.text: I want to enter the next area.
scripts.translation: 我想進入下一個區域。

scripts.text: I want to stay.
scripts.translation: 我想留下來。

scripts.text:
[Camp Guard]
Please be careful out there.
If you encounter any threats or strange phenomenon, then please don't hesitate to report to us at the garrison.
scripts.translation:
[營地衛兵]
請在外面的時候小心。
如果遇到任何威脅或異常現象，
請隨時向駐軍報告。

scripts.text:
[Camp Guard]
No, you can't. Please return to the expedition camp.
scripts.translation:
[營地衛兵]
不，你不能進去。
請回到探險營地。

scripts.text:
[Botanist]
This is it.
scripts.translation:
[植物學家]
就是這裡了。

scripts.text:
[Botanist]
Look.
You can tell the pileus is creating drops of light which drip to the ground.
scripts.translation:
[植物學家]
看。
你可以看到菌蓋正在產生光滴，滴落到地面上。

scripts.text:
[Botanist]
Please try to plant the rotting stem in the ground.
scripts.translation:
[植物學家]
請嘗試將腐爛的莖種植在地裡。

scripts.text:
[Botanist]
Please try to plant the rotting stem in the ground.
scripts.translation:
[植物學家]
請嘗試將腐爛的莖種植在地裡。

scripts.text:
[Botanist]
Please try to plant the rotting stem in the ground.
scripts.translation:
[植物學家]
請嘗試將腐爛的莖種植在地裡。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
It's sprouted! That shoot looks healthy!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
發芽了！那株嫩芽看起來很健康！

scripts.text:
[Botanist]
See?
This giant mushroom, otherwise known as an Environmental Purifier, not only brings dying plants back to life, but also stimulates their growth.
scripts.translation:
[植物學家]
看到了嗎？
這種巨大的蘑菇，也被稱為環境淨化器，
不僅能起死回生，還能促進植物生長。

scripts.text:
[Botanist]
Isn't it amazing?!
This finding will surely stir up the academic world.
scripts.translation:
[植物學家]
是不是很神奇？！
這一發現肯定會轟動學術界。

scripts.text:
[Botanist]
Now, I should get back to work. I need to write a report based on my study results.
I can't wait to see how the expedition management will react to my report. Hahaha~
scripts.translation:
[植物學家]
好了，我該回去工作了。我需要基於研究結果寫一份報告。
真期待看到探險管理方對我的報告會有什麼反應。哈哈~

scripts.text:
[Botanist]
Oh, right... Rumis!
Can you please tell him that I've received his Nepenthes specimen safely?
scripts.translation:
[植物學家]
哦，對了...魯米斯！
能請你告訴他，我已經安全收到了他的豬籠草標本嗎？

scripts.text:
[Botanist]
And don't forget to tell him that I've produced great research results. That'll make him cry like a baby. Hahahaha!
scripts.translation:
[植物學家]
別忘了告訴他，我取得了很棒的研究成果。那會讓他感動得像個嬰兒一樣哭的。哈哈哈！

scripts.text: - You dug a hole into the ground, planted the rotting stem, and then watered it. -
scripts.translation: - 你在地上挖了個洞，種下腐爛的莖，然後澆了水。 -

scripts.text:
- Pzzzz -
- Ssshuhhhh -
scripts.translation:
- 噗滋滋 -
- 嘶嘶呼 -

scripts.text: - Something is growing out of the dirt. -
scripts.translation: - 有什麼東西從土裡長出來了。 -

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
This is it! Come to the small tree in the southeast direction!
scripts.translation:
[魯米斯·布洛克]
就是這裡！來東南方向的那棵小樹旁！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Knock, knock. Are you here?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
咚咚。你在上面嗎？

scripts.text: - Something is making loud noise near the top of the tree. -
scripts.translation: - 樹頂附近有什麼東西發出了很大的聲響。 -

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
...Oh, yes. Yes!
Monsters were looking at me, so I climbed up this tree without even thinking!
How can I get down now?
scripts.translation:
[魯米斯·布洛克]
...哦，是的。是的！
魔物在看我，所以我沒想就爬上了這棵樹！
現在我怎麼下去啊？

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
Oh wait, I can see everything so clearly from here.
I guess staying here will be much safer and easier for studying monsters.
scripts.translation:
[魯米斯·布洛克]
啊，等等，從這裡看得真清楚。
我想待在這裡觀察魔物會安全又方便得多。

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
...I'm looking at Hillsrion, the creature that people are talking about.
It's covered with soft fur that reminds me of soft ice flakes floating in the air.
...Oh, sorry.. I was just talking to myself.
scripts.translation:
[魯米斯·布洛克]
...我正在看著希爾里昂，就是人們口中談論的那種生物。
它身上覆蓋著柔軟的毛髮，讓我想起空氣中飄浮的柔軟冰晶。
...啊，抱歉...我剛才只是在自言自語。

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
I'll be watching the Hillsrions from this tree. {0}, can you please go collect ^3131FFHillsrion Horns^000000 for me?
scripts.translation:
[魯米斯·布洛克]
我會在這棵樹上觀察希爾里昂。{0}，能麻煩你幫我收集一些^3131FF希爾里昂的角^000000嗎？

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
Their horns might possess a special power. And I want to have them for further research.
...5 horns will be enough.
scripts.translation:
[魯米斯·布洛克]
它們的角可能擁有特殊的力量。我想收集一些用於進一步研究。
...5個就夠了。

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
I'd like to study Hillsrion's Horns. Please bring 5 of them for me, okay.
scripts.translation:
[魯米斯·布洛克]
我想研究希爾里昂的角。請幫我帶5個過來，好嗎。

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
...*Shiver*...
scripts.translation:
[魯米斯·布洛克]
...*顫抖*...

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
...*Shiver*...
...*Shiver*...

[Rumis Block]
...*Shiver*...
...*Shiver*...
...*Shiver*...

[Rumis Block]
Ah! You're back!
Phew...
scripts.translation:
[魯米斯·布洛克]
啊！你回來了！
呼...

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
Are you okay? Their fangs look so sharp and shiny...
Oh right, you're an expert when it comes to this kind of job. Hahaha, I don't have to worry about you anymore.
scripts.translation:
[魯米斯·布洛克]
你沒事吧？它們的牙齒看起來好鋒利、好閃亮...
對了，你是這方面的專家。哈哈，我不必再為你擔心了。

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
Have you brought Hillsrion's Horns?
Those are the horns in your hands?
scripts.translation:
[魯米斯·布洛克]
你帶希爾里昂的角回來了嗎？
就是你手裡拿著的那些角？

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
Oh...
scripts.translation:
[魯米斯·布洛克]
哦...

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
Ho...
scripts.translation:
[魯米斯·布洛克]
嗯...

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
Well, they appear to be ordinary horns with a spiral pattern.
Monsters with such horns are a dime a dozen in Midgard.
scripts.translation:
[魯米斯·布洛克]
嗯，它們看起來像是帶有螺旋紋路的普通角。
在米德加爾特，長著這種角的魔物隨處可見。

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
I, however, still have no idea how Hillsrions use their horns.
scripts.translation:
[魯米斯·布洛克]
不過，我仍然不知道希爾里昂是如何使用它們的角的。

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
If they have bad vision, they could use the horns as feelers, or... I know you don't want to hear me ramble on with my conjecture. Sorry.
scripts.translation:
[魯米斯·布洛克]
如果它們的視力不好，可能會把角當作觸角來用，或者...我知道你不想聽我瞎猜。抱歉。

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
We can call it a day for today. Thanks to you, I now feel confident enough to at least come to this tree by myself next time.
scripts.translation:
[魯米斯·布洛克]
今天我們就到此為止吧。多虧了你，我現在有信心下次至少能獨自來到這棵樹下了。

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
Let's go back to the camp. Shall we? I have something to discuss with you.
scripts.translation:
[魯米斯·布洛克]
我們回營地吧。好嗎？我有件事想和你商量。

scripts.text:
You find a little creature flying in the bushes.
It has tiny wings on the back...
It's a fairy!
scripts.translation:
你在灌木叢中發現了一隻飛舞的小生物。
它的背上長著小小的翅膀...
這是一隻妖精！

scripts.text:
[Small Fairy]
RLGHLRXLA TKANTLFDMS
WJACK TNAHRDNJSDMFH
WLSGHKWND !!
scripts.translation:
[小妖精]
RLGHLRXLA TKANTLFDMS
WJACK TNAHRDNJSDMFH
WLSGHKWND !!

scripts.text:
The fairy notices you, and looks very surprised.
It is saying something, but you don't understand.
scripts.translation:
小妖精注意到了你，看起來非常驚訝。
它正在說著什麼，但你聽不懂。

scripts.text:
You should report this to the united expedition quickly.
Perhaps the guard captain of the expedition is the right person to report to.
scripts.translation:
你應該儘快向聯合遠征隊報告這件事。
也許遠征隊的衛兵隊長是合適的彙報物件。

scripts.text:
[Small Fairy]
RLGHLRXLA TKANTLFDMS
WJACK TNAHRDNJSDMFH
WLSGHKWND !!
scripts.translation:
[小妖精]
RLGHLRXLA TKANTLFDMS
WJACK TNAHRDNJSDMFH
WLSGHKWND !!

scripts.text: The surprised fairy is saying something to you, but you cannot understand fairy language.
scripts.translation: 驚訝的小妖精正在對你說著什麼，但你聽不懂妖精語。

scripts.text:
[Small Fairy]
Who are you?! Are you looking for the Sapha!?
scripts.translation:
[小妖精]
你是誰？！你在找薩法嗎？！

scripts.text:
You have found something moving between dry branches.
It appears to be a tree at first glance, but it turns out to be a giant that is half tree and half man.
scripts.translation:
你在枯枝間發現了一個移動的東西。
乍看之下像是一棵樹，但仔細看卻是一個半樹半人的巨人。

scripts.text:
[Tree Giant]
TJDTMFJDNS CJFDI
TKADLFDMF QKATOS
EKDTLSDML DLFMADMS..
scripts.translation:
[樹巨人]
TJDTMFJDNS CJFDI
TKADLFDMF QKATOS
EKDTLSDML DLFMADMS..

scripts.text:
The giant notices you, and looks very surprised.
It is saying something, but you don't understand.
scripts.translation:
巨人注意到了你，看起來非常驚訝。
它正在說著什麼，但你聽不懂。

scripts.text:
You should report this to the united expedition quickly.
Perhaps the guard captain of the expedition is the right person to report to.
scripts.translation:
你應該儘快向聯合遠征隊報告這件事。
也許遠征隊的衛兵隊長是合適的彙報物件。

scripts.text:
[Tree Giant]
TJDTMFJDNS CJFDI
TKADLFDMF QKATOS
EKDTLSDML DLFMADMS..
scripts.translation:
[樹巨人]
TJDTMFJDNS CJFDI
TKADLFDMF QKATOS
EKDTLSDML DLFMADMS..

scripts.text: The surprised giant is saying something to you, but you cannot understand.
scripts.translation: 驚訝的巨人正在對你說著什麼，但你聽不懂。

scripts.text:
[Tree Giant]
Where are the Laphine reinforcements? I might have a problem.
scripts.translation:
[樹巨人]
拉斐恩的增援部隊在哪裡？我可能要遇到麻煩了。

scripts.text:
[Captain]
Good day. I'm here to protect the
peace and safety of explorers
working for United Midgard.
How may I help you?
scripts.translation:
[船長]
你好。我負責保護為聯合米德加爾特工作的探險者的和平與安全。
有什麼可以幫你的嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh, nothing.
Sorry to bother you.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哦，沒什麼。
抱歉打擾你了。

scripts.text: - You report your encounter with a small fairy in the Splandid area to the guard captain. -
scripts.translation: - 你向衛兵隊長報告了在Splandid區域遇到小妖精的情況。 -

scripts.text:
[Captain]
That sounds very important.
It's too early to say this, but we might have to dispatch an investigation group to the area.
scripts.translation:
[船長]
這聽起來非常重要。
現在說還太早，但我們可能不得不派遣調查組前往該區域。

scripts.text:
[Captain]
I'll discuss this more with the expedition management.
Thank you for your valuable information.
scripts.translation:
[船長]
我會和遠征隊管理層進一步討論此事。
感謝你的寶貴資訊。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh, nothing.
Sorry to bother you.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哦，沒什麼。
抱歉打擾你了。

scripts.text: - You report your encounter with a tree giant in the Manuk area to the guard captain. -
scripts.translation: - 你向衛兵隊長報告了在Manuk區域遇到樹巨人的情況。 -

scripts.text:
[Captain]
That sounds very important.
It's too early to say this, but we might have to dispatch an investigation group to the area.
scripts.translation:
[船長]
這聽起來非常重要。
現在說還太早，但我們可能不得不派遣調查組前往該區域。

scripts.text:
[Captain]
I'll discuss this more with the expedition management.
Thank you for your valuable information.
scripts.translation:
[船長]
我會和遠征隊管理層進一步討論此事。
感謝你的寶貴資訊。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh, nothing.
Sorry to bother you.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哦，沒什麼。
抱歉打擾你了。

scripts.text:
[United Research Official]
How come you've got so much to carry?
Are you perhaps on training or something?
scripts.translation:
[聯合研究官員]
你怎麼帶了這麼多東西？
你是在進行訓練什麼的嗎？

scripts.text:
[United Research Official]
Hmmmm...mmm...
scripts.translation:
[聯合研究官員]
嗯...唔...

scripts.text:
[United Research Official]
Oh! Hello there!
You must be the adventurer from Midgard.
scripts.translation:
[聯合研究官員]
哦！你好！
你一定是來自米德加爾特的那位冒險者吧。

scripts.text:
[United Research Official]
We've come all the way here to keep track of Satan Morocc, but... Now it seems that's not our priority anymore... Tsk,tsk...
scripts.translation:
[聯合研究官員]
我們大老遠來到這裡是為了追蹤魔王夢羅克，但...現在看來那已經不是我們的首要任務了...嘖，嘖...

scripts.text:
[United Research Official]
Well, since our research group has been gathered in such haste, many of our members collide too often.
I think it's just the process of trial and error, but this really slows things down.
scripts.translation:
[聯合研究官員]
既然我們的研究小組是匆忙集合起來的，成員之間經常發生碰撞。
我想這只是試錯的過程，但這確實拖慢了進度。

scripts.text:
[United Research Official]
Alas, the head office keeps pushing me to submit a report... As if I could perform miracles!
scripts.translation:
[聯合研究官員]
唉，總部一直催我提交報告...
我又不是會魔法，哪能憑空變出來啊！

scripts.text:
[United Research Official]
I can't go around and meet those people myself, mediate among troubled people... This is impossible!! Unless...Unless someone helps me with that ! I need... someone...
scripts.translation:
[聯合研究官員]
我沒法親自去見那些人，也沒法去調解那些麻煩事...
這根本做不到！！除非...除非有人能幫我處理一下！我需要...有人...

scripts.text:
- He stared at you -
- with sparkling -
- eyes as if he were -
- demanding for help! -
scripts.translation:
- 他盯著你 -
- 眼神閃爍 -
- 彷彿在 -
- 急切地請求幫助！ -

scripts.text:
[United Research Official]
Eh?! Oh, my... You really shouldn't. You must be extremely busy tracking down Satan Morocc!
scripts.translation:
[聯合研究官員]
誒？！哎呀...你千萬別這樣。
你肯定正忙著追蹤魔王夢羅克吧！

scripts.text:
[United Research Official]
But... if you say so, could I really use your help? Hahaha.
scripts.translation:
[聯合研究官員]
但是...既然你都這麼說了，我真的可以拜託你幫忙嗎？哈哈。

scripts.text:
[United Research Official]
Those researchers complain a lot these days. They're terribly stressed out and I think somebody should really listen to their problems.
scripts.translation:
[聯合研究官員]
最近那些研究員抱怨得特別多。他們壓力很大，我覺得真的應該有人聽聽他們的煩惱。

scripts.text:
[United Research Official]
Especially those dealing with document files that argue with each other so many times! You might wanna start by talking to them.
scripts.translation:
[聯合研究官員]
尤其是那些處理卷宗夾的研究員，他們總是互相爭吵！你可能得先從跟他們聊聊開始。

scripts.text:
[United Research Official]
Sounds good, huh? Please, you should go now.
scripts.translation:
[聯合研究官員]
聽起來不錯，對吧？請，你現在就出發吧。

scripts.text:
[United Research Official]
Those researchers complain a lot these days. They're terribly stressed out and I think somebody should really listen to their problems.
scripts.translation:
[聯合研究官員]
最近那些研究員抱怨得特別多。他們壓力很大，我覺得真的應該有人聽聽他們的煩惱。

scripts.text:
[United Research Official]
Especially those dealing with document files that argue with each other so many times! You might wanna start by talking to them.
scripts.translation:
[聯合研究官員]
尤其是那些處理卷宗夾的研究員，他們總是互相爭吵！你可能得先從跟他們聊聊開始。

scripts.text:
[United Research Official]
And, don't worry! I'm even willing to share my snacks with you if things go well. I'm not asking this for free, you got that~?
scripts.translation:
[聯合研究官員]
還有，別擔心！如果事情順利的話，我甚至願意把我的零食分給你。我可不是白求你幫忙的，懂嗎~？

scripts.text:
[United Research Official]
Aha!
scripts.translation:
[聯合研究官員]
啊哈！

scripts.text:
[United Research Official]
Isn't that an invitation to the meeting?
scripts.translation:
[聯合研究官員]
這不是會議的邀請函嗎？

scripts.text:
[United Research Official]
And...and I really get to sign this thing and approve it...? Hahaha!
scripts.translation:
[聯合研究官員]
而且...而且我真的可以簽署並批准這份檔案...？哈哈！

scripts.text:
[United Research Official]
This, this means I need to get prepared for the meeting! Finally!
Hahahaha!
scripts.translation:
[聯合研究官員]
這意味著我需要為會議做準備！終於！
哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[United Research Official]
Oh, by the way, did you get a rough idea of the atmosphere of this expedition?
scripts.translation:
[聯合研究官員]
哦，對了，你對這次遠征的氛圍有大概的瞭解嗎？

scripts.text:
[United Research Official]
Normally, researchers just take their own instruments and find their own tracks of Satan Morocc.
They don't really need to cooperate with other members.
scripts.translation:
[聯合研究官員]
通常，研究員們只是帶著自己的儀器，獨自尋找魔王夢羅克的蹤跡。
他們其實不需要與其他成員合作。

scripts.text:
[United Research Official]
Howerver, things get different when it comes to document files.
Those researchers in charge of document files must contact eachother for information, and this just makes for endless work.
scripts.translation:
[聯合研究官員]
然而，涉及到卷宗夾時情況就不同了。
負責卷宗夾的研究員必須互相聯絡以獲取資訊，這隻會帶來無窮無盡的工作。

scripts.text:
[United Research Official]
People can't always be perfect, so they stress out and get to arguing...
scripts.translation:
[聯合研究官員]
人不可能總是完美的，所以他們會感到壓力，進而發生爭吵...

scripts.text:
[United Research Official]
So... Could you do me a favor?
scripts.translation:
[聯合研究官員]
那麼...能幫我個忙嗎？

scripts.text:
[United Research Official]
As you've heard, about the 3 researchers, they don't agree with eachother too often. It's just too obvious that their meeting will turn out a disaster, and the whole research group could break down!
scripts.translation:
[聯合研究官員]
正如你所聽到的，關於那三位研究員，他們經常意見不合。很明顯，他們的會議會變成一場災難，整個研究小組都可能因此崩潰！

scripts.text:
[United Research Official]
Oh, just thinking about it scares the crap out of me.
scripts.translation:
[聯合研究官員]
光是想想就讓我嚇得要命。

scripts.text:
[United Research Official]
What I'm asking is that you participate in the meeting with them and help them negotiate.
scripts.translation:
[聯合研究官員]
我請求你參加與他們的會議，並協助他們進行談判。

scripts.text:
[United Research Official]
So, first! Can you go meet those 3 researchers and check on them to prepare for the meeting?
scripts.translation:
[聯合研究官員]
那麼，首先！你能去見見那三位研究員，確認一下他們的情況，為會議做準備嗎？

scripts.text:
[United Research Official]
How did it go?
scripts.translation:
[聯合研究官員]
情況如何？

scripts.text:
[United Research Official]
Did you talk to those researchers in charge of document files?
scripts.translation:
[聯合研究官員]
你和負責卷宗夾的那些研究員談過了嗎？

scripts.text:
[United Research Official]
Please, you should participate in the meeting and mediate them if anything goes wrong!
scripts.translation:
[聯合研究官員]
拜託了，你應該參加會議，如果發生任何意外，請出面調解！

scripts.text:
[United Research Official]
First, you should go meet those 3 researchers and check on them to prepare for the meeting. Hope they're not preparing any weapons though...
scripts.translation:
[聯合研究官員]
首先，你應該去見見那三位研究員，確認一下他們的情況，為會議做準備。希望他們沒在準備什麼武器...

scripts.text:
[United Research Official]
Ohhh, you came! How generous of you!
scripts.translation:
[聯合研究官員]
哦，你來了！真是大恩大德！

scripts.text:
[United Research Official]
The meeting's about to begin.
Whew... I think I'm too tense... My chest hurts... Aaaah.
scripts.translation:
[聯合研究官員]
會議馬上就要開始了。
呼...我覺得我太緊張了...胸口好痛...啊。

scripts.text:
- Somebody's knocking -
- on the door... -
scripts.translation:
- 有人在敲門 -
- ... -

scripts.text:
[United Research Official]
Finally, the meeting's starting.
You should come in.
scripts.translation:
[聯合研究官員]
終於，會議要開始了。
請進。

scripts.text:
[United Research Official]
So, everyone's here.
Let us begin our meeting.
First, I need to hear the report on the process of tracking Satan Morocc.
scripts.translation:
[聯合研究官員]
那麼，大家都到齊了。
讓我們開始會議吧。
首先，我需要聽取關於追蹤魔王夢羅克程序的彙報。

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
Alright. I'm Ryosen from Rune-Midgarts. We're certain that Satan Morocc came to this place through the crack of dimension, however, we failed to find any traces within the area we inspected.
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
好的。我是來自盧恩·米德加茲的Ryosen。我們確信魔王夢羅克是通過維度裂縫來到這裡的，然而，我們在檢查區域內未能找到任何蹤跡。

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
The Tripartite Union is doing whatever it takes to track down Satan Morocc's whereabouts, but the research in Ash-Vacuum is very limited.
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
三方聯盟正在竭盡全力追蹤魔王夢羅克的下落，但在阿什-真空的研究非常有限。

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
Supplies, reinforcements as wel as demanded goods are all insufficient, so we can't really go on.
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
物資、增援以及所需物品都不足，所以我們真的無法繼續。

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
I've heard the assassins took action in order to find the traces of Satan Morocc, but nothing's been reported so far.
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
我聽說刺客們為了尋找魔王夢羅克的蹤跡採取了行動，但到目前為止還沒有任何報告。

scripts.text:
[Hue]
I'm Hue from the Schwarzwald Republic.
scripts.translation:
[休]
我是來自修瓦魯茲巴魯德共和國的休。

scripts.text:
[Hue]
We're still researching on the crack of dimension that Satan Morocc has come through, and the false data research on the noise created when moving through the crack is currently being corrected.
scripts.translation:
[休]
我們仍在研究魔王夢羅克穿過的維度裂縫，關於穿越裂縫時產生的噪音的虛假資料研究目前正在修正中。

scripts.text:
[Hue]
The real cause of this problem has yet to be found, which makes it hard for us to provide any reinforcements or other supplies.
scripts.translation:
[休]
這個問題的真正原因尚未找到，這使得我們很難提供增援或其他物資。

scripts.text:
[United Research Official]
Ok. I see. How's it going with the research on Ash-Vacuum?
scripts.translation:
[聯合研究官員]
好的。我明白了。阿什-真空的研究進展如何？

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
Hi, I'm Hansenne from Arunafeltz. We have conclused that his world of Ash-Vacuum is nothing related to the continent of Midgard, as it is placed in a totally indipendent world dimension.
scripts.translation:
[漢森娜]
你好，我是來自阿魯納菲茲的漢森娜。我們已經得出結論，阿什-真空所在的世界與米德加爾特大陸毫無關聯，因為它位於一個完全獨立的維度世界中。

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
The environment of the fields on the East and West where we can work on the research has nothing in common with the environment within the boundrary of the Tripartite Union's army post.
scripts.translation:
[漢森娜]
我們可以在東西兩側的研究區域開展工作，那裡的環境與三方聯盟軍哨所邊界內的環境完全不同。

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
I also have been reported that the ecosystem in the researched are is different.
scripts.translation:
[漢森娜]
我還收到報告稱，研究區域的生態系統也有所不同。

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
We could not go further with the research on the ecosystem due to some violent living creatures which have never been found on the Midgard continent.
scripts.translation:
[漢森娜]
由於出現了一些在米德加爾特大陸從未發現過的兇猛生物，我們無法進一步研究那裡的生態系統。

scripts.text:
[United Research Official]
So... All in all, nothing has been clearly found. Any problems among the members of the United Research Group?
scripts.translation:
[聯合研究官員]
所以...總而言之，目前還沒有明確的發現。聯合研究組的成員之間有什麼問題嗎？

scripts.text: - The room is in awkward silence for a short while... -
scripts.translation: - 房間裡陷入了短暫的尷尬沉默... -

scripts.text:
[United Research Official]
Ha..... Hahahaha...
... Then, anything you need to request, or suggest, perhaps? Anything you want to complain about?
scripts.translation:
[聯合研究官員]
哈...哈哈哈哈哈...
...那麼，有什麼需要申請或建議的嗎？或者有什麼想抱怨的？

scripts.text:
- Ryosen, who was fidgeting with -
- his files, suddenly stops and -
- studies the others. Then, he takes -
- out something from the bottom of -
- the chair and puts it on the table. -
scripts.translation:
- Ryosen原本在擺弄檔案，突然停了下來，
- 審視著其他人。然後，他從椅子底下
- 拿出一樣東西，放在了桌子上。 -

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
I'm.... I... The document file...
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
我...我...那份檔案...

scripts.text:
[United Research Official]
Aaaaaahahhhhhhhhhhcckk!!!!!
scripts.translation:
[聯合研究官員]
啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊！！！！！

scripts.text:
- Hue, shocked by the sudden
scream, stands up frantically and
accidentally hits and drops the
object which Ryosen had taken out. -
scripts.translation:
- 休被突如其來的尖叫聲嚇到，慌亂地站起身，
- 不小心撞到了Ryosen拿出來的東西，
- 導致它掉在了地上。 -

scripts.text:
[United Research Official]
Kkkkhaaaaaaahhhhhhhh!!!
It's the Thief Bug!!!
scripts.translation:
[聯合研究官員]
咯咯咯咯咯咯咯咯！！！！
是浮勒盜蟲！！！

scripts.text:
- As the Official screamed, all the
researchers of the union started to
scream as well, and rushed out of
the room. -
scripts.translation:
- 隨著官員的尖叫，聯合研究組的所有
- 研究員也開始尖叫，並衝出了房間。 -

scripts.text:
[United Research Official]
Hhmm, hmmmm...
I really don't know what to say.
I mean... I'm totally OK with other monsters, mutants or whatever, but that black evil thing... Oh, I can't stand that one...
scripts.translation:
[聯合研究官員]
嗯...嗯嗯...
我真的不知道該說什麼了。
我是說...其他魔物、變異體之類的我都無所謂，但那個黑色的邪惡生物...哦，我受不了那個...

scripts.text:
- Knock, knock-
- The researchers come back into the room. -
scripts.translation:
- 咚咚咚-
- 研究員們回到了房間。 -

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
Uh-hmm! Sorry about the mess.
I... Something urgent came up...
............Aaaaaaaaahhhhhhhhh!
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
嗯哼！抱歉弄得一團糟。
我...有急事要處理...
............啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊！

scripts.text:
[United Research Official]
Whhhhhhaaattt!!!! What is it!!?
The Thief Bug, Again!!!???
scripts.translation:
[聯合研究官員]
什...什麼！！那是什麼！！？
又是浮勒盜蟲！！！？？

scripts.text: - Except for Ryosen, the rest spring out of their seats and run hurriedly for the door. -
scripts.translation: - 除了Ryosen，其餘人都從座位上彈起，慌忙衝向門口。 -

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
My... my strawberry cake!!!
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
我...我的草莓蛋糕！！！

scripts.text: - Ryosen picks up his strawberry cake, all squashed with some fingerprints. -
scripts.translation: - Ryosen撿起他的草莓蛋糕，上面全是被壓扁的指紋。 -

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
Stop! Freeze, everyone!
Move one more time and you'll be considered guilty!!
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
住手！都給我站住！
再動一下，我就當你們有罪了！！

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
This cake was just fine before that evil thing appeared, and there were only 4 of us here!
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
在那邪惡的東西出現之前，這塊蛋糕還好好的，而且這裡只有我們4個人！

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
One of you must be guilty of ruining my Rune-Midgarts' Strawberry Cake!!!
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
你們之中肯定有人毀了我的盧恩·米德加茲草莓蛋糕！！！

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
I can't help checking your hands! This must be a fingerprint! It's loud and clear!! Hmm, I bet this is the mark of an index finger!
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
我不得不檢查你們的手！這一定是指紋！非常清晰！！嗯，我猜這是食指的痕跡！

scripts.text:
[Hue]
Wait a minute! Wait! Stop treating us like criminals! What is wrong with you, it's only a cake!? Don't you think you're going a little too far?
scripts.translation:
[Hue]
等一下！等等！別把我們當罪犯一樣對待！你瘋了嗎，只是一塊蛋糕而已！你不覺得有點過分了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
Whatttttt!? Only a cake????
Aha, yeah, I just remembered. You people from Schwarzwald don't ever appreciate food at all, right?
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
什...什麼？？只是一塊蛋糕？？？
啊哈，我想起來了。你們修瓦魯茲巴魯德的人從來都不懂得欣賞食物，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
Especially when the food is NOT yours, huh? That's why you people sneak a taste of other people's food like my strawberry cake!!!
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
尤其是當食物不是你們自己的時候，對吧？所以你們才會偷偷嘗別人的食物，比如我的草莓蛋糕！！！

scripts.text:
[Hue]
Hmm, are you talking about Dusty?
He was expelled right after the incident and his job was taken away! I told you several times already!
scripts.translation:
[Hue]
嗯，你是在說Dusty嗎？
他在事件發生後立刻被開除了，工作也被收回了！我已經跟你說過好幾次了！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Ugh... You guys, I think you should calm down... This is ridiculous.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
唉...你們，我覺得你們應該冷靜一下...這太荒唐了。

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
Ughhhhh! It was I who did that!!!
scripts.translation:
[Hansenne]
唉...是我乾的！！！

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
Sorry, I was just too shocked by that thief bug and accidentally touched your cake with my finger!
scripts.translation:
[Hansenne]
抱歉，我被那隻浮勒盜蟲嚇到了，不小心用手指碰到了你的蛋糕！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
...Huh? No. Wait...

[Ryosen]
You again?!
I can't belive how careless you are all the time, like with the requested data and all!!
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
又是你？！
我真不敢相信你總是這麼粗心，就像對待那些要求的資料一樣！！

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
Ah, I forgot to say thank you.
Hue, thank you so much for restoring my documents!!!
Thanks!!!
Ahahahahaha. Hahahahaha.
scripts.translation:
[Hansenne]
啊，我忘了說謝謝。
Hue，非常感謝你幫我恢復了檔案！！！
謝謝！！！
哈哈哈哈哈。哈哈哈哈哈。

scripts.text:
[Hue]
No, I...
scripts.translation:
[Hue]
不，我...

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
Hey, stay on topic!!
You are...
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
嘿，回到正題！！
你是...

scripts.text:
[United Research Official]
Ahhhhhh! I guess we should call it a day now! Thanks for comingm all of you. Ok, let's go. Dismissed!
scripts.translation:
[聯合研究官員]
啊...我想我們今天到此為止吧！感謝大家前來。好了，走吧。解散！

scripts.text:
[United Research Official]
Come on!!!
scripts.translation:
[聯合研究官員]
快一點！！！

scripts.text: -The three researchers say nothing. They just stare at each other, standing still... Then they finally leave the room. -
scripts.translation: -三位研究員一言不發。他們只是互相凝視著，僵在原地... 最後終於離開了房間。-

scripts.text:
[United Research Official]
Ugh, I've got nothing to say.
All I wanted was to let those people be closter to each other, become more friendly. But, problems come up every single time.
scripts.translation:
[聯合研究官員]
唉，我無話可說。
我只是想讓那些人彼此親近一些，變得更友好。但每次都會出問題。

scripts.text:
[United Research Official]
Can you think of any idea how to get those people to get along??
scripts.translation:
[聯合研究官員]
你能想到什麼辦法讓他們和睦相處嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
... Actually... Hansenne is not the one who ruined that cake.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
... 其實... 弄壞蛋糕的不是漢森娜。

scripts.text:
[United Research Official]
Eh? What did you say?
scripts.translation:
[聯合研究官員]
誒？你說什麼？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
But... I don't understand why Hansenne would take the blame...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
但是... 我不明白漢森娜為什麼要替人背黑鍋...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
... Well, I should go now.

[United Research Official]
What? Ah, adventurer?!
scripts.translation:
[聯合研究官員]
什麼？啊，是冒險者！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
... Actually... Hansenne is not the one who ruined that cake.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
... 其實... 弄壞蛋糕的不是漢森娜。

scripts.text:
[United Research Official]
Eh? What did you say?
scripts.translation:
[聯合研究官員]
誒？你說什麼？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
But... I don't understand why Hansenne would take the blame...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
但是... 我不明白漢森娜為什麼要替人背黑鍋...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
... Well, I should go now.

[United Research Official]
What? Ah, adventurer?!
scripts.translation:
[聯合研究官員]
什麼？啊，是冒險者！

scripts.text:
[United Research Official]
How are they?
scripts.translation:
[聯合研究官員]
他們怎麼樣了？

scripts.text: - You tell the Official about the conversation that the 3 researchers had, in detail. -
scripts.translation: -你向官員詳細講述了三位研究員之間的對話。-

scripts.text:
[United Research Official]
Whew, I see.
scripts.translation:
[聯合研究官員]
呼，我明白了。

scripts.text:
[United Research Official]
Maybe I've been a little too worried.
scripts.translation:
[聯合研究官員]
也許是我太擔心了。

scripts.text:
[United Research Official]
How often they collide, it must be a natural thing for people from different countries with different personalities and customs.
scripts.translation:
[聯合研究官員]
他們經常發生衝突，對於來自不同國家、擁有不同個性和習俗的人來說，這也許是件很自然的事。

scripts.text:
[United Research Official]
Thank you for helping me.
scripts.translation:
[聯合研究官員]
謝謝你幫了我。

scripts.text:
[United Research Official]
Here, I'll offer you a cup of tea.
This is a really special drink I preserved. Please, drink it while it's nice and hot.
scripts.translation:
[聯合研究官員]
來，請喝杯茶。
這是我珍藏的一款特製飲品。趁熱喝吧。

scripts.text: - You feel so refreshed and light, as you drink the tea that the Official offered. -
scripts.translation: -喝著官員提供的茶，你感到神清氣爽，渾身輕鬆。-

scripts.text:
[United Research Official]
Now, I should get to work on the report I need to submit to the head office. Ah, and this is nothing big, but still... This might come in handy when you travel.
scripts.translation:
[聯合研究官員]
現在，我得去寫要提交給總部的報告了。啊，雖然不是什麼大事，但... 這個在你旅行時可能會用得上。

scripts.text:
[United Research Official]
Please, stop by and say hellp to us from time to time.
scripts.translation:
[聯合研究官員]
請偶爾來拜訪我們，打個招呼。

scripts.text:
[United Research Official]
Thank you for everything.
scripts.translation:
[聯合研究官員]
感謝你所做的一切。

scripts.text:
[United Research Official]
Please, stop by and say hellp to us from time to time.
scripts.translation:
[聯合研究官員]
請偶爾來拜訪我們，打個招呼。

scripts.text:
[United Research Official]
Oh, I'm not asking you to keep your eye on those 3 researchers. Don't get me wrong, hahaha.~
scripts.translation:
[聯合研究官員]
哦，我可不是讓你去盯著那三位研究員。別誤會，哈哈哈哈哈~

scripts.text:
[United Research Official]
...Mmmm? What brings you here?
scripts.translation:
[聯合研究官員]
...嗯？你找我有事嗎？

scripts.text:
[United Research Official]
I wouldn't be roaming around this place like that, if I were you.
It's very dangerous here, and people dwelling is this place are not that nice.
scripts.translation:
[聯合研究官員]
如果是我的話，不會像這樣四處遊蕩的。
這裡非常危險，而且住在這裡的人也不怎麼友善。

scripts.text:
[United Research Official]
Hmm? What did you just say?
scripts.translation:
[聯合研究官員]
嗯？你剛才說什麼？

scripts.text:
[United Research Official]
I can't really hear you. Could you speak louder?
scripts.translation:
[聯合研究官員]
我聽得不太清楚。能大聲點說嗎？

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
How come you've got so much to carry?
Are you perhaps on training or something?
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
你怎麼帶了這麼多東西？
難道是在進行什麼訓練嗎？

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
Please, keep your hands off my stuff!
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
請別碰我的東西！

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
Please, keep your hands off my stuff!
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
請別碰我的東西！

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
Ugh! My, my... What am I gonna do with this!? Files, files, files!!!
Ahhhhhkk!
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
啊！天哪...我該怎麼辦！？檔案，檔案，全是檔案！！！
啊啊啊啊！

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
What time is it now? Ugh... This is such a mess!!
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
現在幾點了？啊...真是亂成一團！！

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
What are they thinking!!? I don't get it. How come I have to work, while those guys from other countries are just praying for a breakthrough, every single day!
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
他們在想什麼！！？我不明白。為什麼我要在這裡工作，而其他國家的人每天都在祈禱突破極限！

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
This is so unfair!! My stress is growing geometrically every hour!
What a waste of time! Why do they have to pray! Why?! Why?! Why don't they work instead of pray!!
Ugh...!
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
這太不公平了！！我的壓力每小時都在幾何級數地增長！
真是浪費時間！他們為什麼要祈禱！為什麼？！為什麼？！他們為什麼不工作而去祈禱！！
啊...！

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
Nothing's appreciated! Nothing!
They're just so useless!
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
沒有任何人感激我！什麼都沒有！
他們簡直一無是處！

scripts.text:
- He took a deep breath -
- trying to calm down. -
scripts.translation:
- 他深吸了一口氣 -
- 試圖讓自己冷靜下來。 -

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
Anyway, who are you? This place is restricted.
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
總之，你是誰？這裡是限制區域。

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
Ah! You must be the one who came to help us track down that Satan Morocc, the bastard who made the giant hole and then was gone like the wind.
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
啊！你一定是來幫我們追蹤那個魔王夢羅克的人，那個挖了個大洞就消失得無影無蹤的傢伙。

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
Ugh. I should watch my mouth.
Sorry. You're on our side. I should just be polite, but it's just... I'm so stressed out.
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
啊。我該注意自己的言辭。
抱歉。你是我們這邊的人。我應該禮貌一點，只是...我太有壓力了。

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
How about having some tea here?
It's Rafflesia tea from Schwarzwald. Don't even expect taste, it's awful... But what can I do? It's the only thing I've got...
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
要不要在這裡喝點茶？
這是來自修瓦魯茲巴魯德的草精茶。別指望有什麼好味道，很難喝...但我能怎麼辦呢？這是唯一有的東西...

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
You must have heard about this, but this is the place where Satan Morocc landed through the crack of dimension.
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
你應該聽說過這件事，這裡是魔王夢羅克通過維度裂縫降落的地方。

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
As you see, this seems like a totally different world. It's nothing like the continent of Midgard, though we haven't found any concrete evidence. We decided to call this place Ash-Vacuum.
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
如你所見，這裡看起來完全像另一個世界。它和米德加爾特大陸完全不同，儘管我們還沒有找到確鑿的證據。我們決定把這個地方稱為阿什-真空。

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
We're doing everything we can, to track down Satan Morocc, but all those researchers from different countries couldn't help but wonder what this place really is.
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
我們正在竭盡全力追蹤魔王夢羅克，但來自不同國家的研究員們不禁開始懷疑，這個地方究竟是什麼。

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
Well, so we're all interested in one thing. However, the real problem lies on our structure of the group.
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
嗯，我們都對同一件事感興趣。然而，真正的問題在於我們團隊的架構。

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
Three different countries united to take down the comon enemy, Satan Morocc, byt they eventually started to gather and keep the information to themselves.
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
三個不同的國家聯合起來共同對抗敵人魔王夢羅克，但最終他們開始各自為政，將資訊據為己有。

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
So... frankly speaking...
Tracking Satan Morocc is not or major concern anymore. Our expedition was formed in such hase that so may things can cause problems in this group.
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
所以...坦白說...
追蹤魔王夢羅克已經不再是我們的主要關注點了。我們的遠征隊組建得如此倉促，導致團隊內部許多事情都可能引發問題。

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
People don't believe other members of the group except for the ones from their own countries. They're all so sensitive that every little thing hits a nerve.
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
除了本國成員外，人們並不信任團隊中的其他成員。他們都非常敏感，任何小事都會觸動他們的神經。

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
But what can we do? After all, we were gathered to achieve the same goal, and we researchers don't want to cause any trouble among countries. It's really hard for us to live with our complaints.
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
但我們能怎麼辦呢？畢竟，我們聚集在一起是為了實現同一個目標，而且我們研究人員不想在國家之間製造麻煩。帶著這些抱怨生活真的很難。

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
I mean... the situation here is... just like the taste of this tea.
Just awful!
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
我的意思是...這裡的情況...就像這茶的味道一樣。
糟透了！

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
Oh, I spent too much time talking.
I should be working now!
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
噢，我花了太多時間在閒聊上。
我現在應該去工作了！

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
Look at this pile of document files... We're supposed to share all the information within these documents...
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
看看這堆卷宗夾...我們本應該共享這些檔案中的所有資訊...

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
Oh, well... Maybe the same thing's happening at other offices. People from other countries might have hidden some important information behind my back.
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
噢，算了...也許其他辦公室也在發生同樣的事。來自其他國家的人可能在我背後隱瞞了一些重要資訊。

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
Whatever... Could you deliver this document to the Schwarzwald and Arunafeltz researchers?
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
無論如何...你能把這份檔案送到修瓦魯茲巴魯德和阿魯納菲茲的研究員那裡嗎？

scripts.text: Why me?
scripts.translation: 為什麼是我？

scripts.text: Alright.
scripts.translation: 好的。

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
... Eh? Didn't you come to help us?
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
...咦？你不是來幫我們的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
Whew~ Very good.
No one in our research group wants to visit the offices of the other countries!
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
呼~ 很好。
我們研究組裡沒人想去其他國家的辦公室！

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
Ok, now, please deliver the file to Hue and Hansenne. Hue's in charge of Schwarzwald's documents and Hansenne's in chare of Arunafeltz's.
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
好的，現在，請把檔案交給休和漢森娜。休負責修瓦魯茲巴魯德的檔案，漢森娜負責阿魯納菲茲的檔案。

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
The file contains the brief introduction and the schedule of the meesting.
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
檔案裡包含了簡要介紹和會議日程。

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
For your information, you should go see Hue at the Schwarzwald's office first. Otherwise, he'll be whining about it.
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
順便告訴你，你應該先去修瓦魯茲巴魯德的辦公室找休。否則，他會一直抱怨的。

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
You must check if they read and understand correctly after delivering it. Don't forget to get them to sign at the bottom of the page, just in case.
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
送交檔案後，你必須確認他們是否閱讀並正確理解了內容。別忘了讓他們在頁面底部簽字，以防萬一。

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
Go on now.
Just so you know, today's Desert Day. Midgard is sending some desserts through the crack of dimension, regularly.
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
去吧。
順便告訴你，今天是甜點日。米德加爾特會定期通過維度裂縫送來一些甜點。

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
Midgard's desserts are definitely the world's best.
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
米德加爾特的美食絕對是世界上最好的。

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
The only thing we enjoy here is that dessert we receive, once a week.
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
我們在這裡唯一享受的，就是每週收到的那份甜點。

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
Schwarzwald's Pineapple Jubilee is just awful. It tastes something like rusty steel.
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
修瓦魯茲巴魯德的菠蘿慶典蛋糕簡直糟糕透頂。吃起來就像生鏽的鋼鐵。

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
Arunafeltz's Desert Sandwich is nothing better than that. I think that sandwich's made of some old meat, otherwise, we wouldn't have been food poisoned so often!
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
阿魯納菲茲的沙漠三明治也好不到哪裡去。我覺得那三明治是用陳年肉做的，不然我們怎麼會經常食物中毒！

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
But, Rune-Midgarts' Strawberry Cake! It's the best.
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
但是，盧恩·米德加茲的草莓蛋糕！那是最好的。

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
Nice and soft spongecake covered with sweet-tasting whipped cream, lots of fresh strawberries on top!
Rune-Midgarts' top chef, Charles Orleans makes it himself!!!
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
鬆軟的海綿蛋糕，上面覆蓋著甜美的鮮奶油，還有滿滿的新鮮草莓！
盧恩·米德加茲的首席廚師查爾斯·奧爾良親自制作的!!!

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
Hurry, you must hurry up, or you won't be able to taste this wonderful cake!
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
快一點，你必須加快速度，否則就嘗不到這塊美妙的蛋糕了！

scripts.text:
- You got the Meeting -
- Invitation from Ryosen, -
- which briefly explains -
- the agenda and schedule -
- of the whole meeting! -
scripts.translation:
- 你獲得了會議 -
- 來自Ryosen的邀請函， -
- 簡要說明了 -
- 整個會議的議程和日程 -
- 安排！ -

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
Hurry up and deliver the document to Hue and Hansenne!
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
快把檔案送到休和漢森娜那裡！

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
Don't forget! Schwarzwald's Hue must get it first, otherwise, he'll nag us like crazy.
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
別忘了！必須先送到修瓦魯茲巴魯德的休那裡，否則他會像瘋了一樣嘮叨我們。

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
And you must get the document signed at the bottom before you bring it back.
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
而且，在你帶回來之前，必須讓他們在底部簽字。

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
Hurry, you must hurry up or you won't be able to taste this wonderfull cake!
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
快一點，你必須加快速度，否則就嘗不到這塊美妙的蛋糕了！

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
Ah, welcome back!
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
啊，歡迎回來！

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
Must've been hard to get them all signed. Well done!
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
讓他們全部簽字一定很不容易吧。幹得好！

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
Hue's so egotistic and stubborn. He thinks he's some kind of royale... and Hansenne... Whew~nobody ever gets what he's just talking about.
He's just ridiculous.
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
休太自戀又固執了。他覺得自己像是某種皇室... 還有漢森娜... 呼~沒人知道他到底在說什麼。
他真的很荒唐。

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
Thank you for dealing with those guys. I've got to go through the file now. Please give me the Invitation.
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
謝謝你處理了那些傢伙。我現在得審閱這份檔案了。請給我邀請函。

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
Please get Hue and Hansenne to sign the Inviation, then come back.
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
請讓休和漢森娜在邀請函上簽字，然後回來。

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
Hurry, you must hurry up or you won't be able to taste this wonderfull cake!
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
快一點，你必須加快速度，否則就嘗不到這塊美妙的蛋糕了！

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
Huhuhuhu, what a sight...!
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
呼呼呼，真是好一番景象...！

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
This autograph here looks like Hue's. See, the letters are all so strongly pressed down with his anger. This one here should be Hansenne's, scrawled without thinking.
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
這個簽名看起來像是休的。看，字跡都被他的怒氣重重地按下去了。這個應該是漢森娜的，寫得毫無章法。

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
How was it? Did you have a chance t find out what the problem is among us researchers?
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
怎麼樣？你有機會找出我們研究員之間的問題所在嗎？

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
This isn't all because of the different personalities. Lots of other members have similar problems. Howerver, the problem among us three: Hue, Hansenne and I... is just more visible than others.
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
這不僅僅是因為性格不同。很多其他成員也有類似的問題。然而，我們三個：休、漢森娜和我... 之間的問題比別人更明顯。

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
So, here we are. We are finally ordered to have a meeting and supposed to find the way to solve our problem.
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
就這樣，我們到了。我們終於被要求召開一次會議，並設法解決我們之間的問題。

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
But, do you know what really would be the best solution for us? It's to avoid meeting face to face.
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
但是，你知道對我們來說最好的解決方案是什麼嗎？就是避免面對面見面。

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
It wasn't our will to have this meeting, and I never imagined they'd sign this thing... Well, I just feel like I've been punched in the head or something.
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
這次會議並不是我們的本意，我也從沒想過他們會簽署這份檔案... 唉，我覺得自己像是被人狠狠揍了一拳。

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
Well, it's already spilled milk. I need to go to that meeting whether I like it or not. Could you please send this to the Official of the United Research?
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
算了，覆水難收。不管我喜不喜歡，我都得去參加那個會議。你能幫我把這個交給聯合研究所的官員嗎？

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
In the meantime, I should prepare myself for the meeting.
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
在此期間，我得為會議做點準備。

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
It wasn't our will to have this meeting, and I never imagined they'd sign this thing... Well, I just feel like I've been punched in the head or something.
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
這次會議並不是我們的本意，我也從沒想過他們會簽署這份檔案... 唉，我覺得自己像是被人狠狠揍了一拳。
