[Ryosen]
Well, it's already spilled milk. I need to go to that meeting whether I like it or not. Could you please send this to the Official of the United Research?
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
算了，覆水難收。不管我喜不喜歡，我都得去參加那個會議。你能幫我把這個交給聯合研究所的官員嗎？

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
In the meantime, I should prepare myself for the meeting.
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
在此期間，我得為會議做點準備。

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
Hi! Did you give that Invitation to the Official?
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
嗨！你把那份邀請函交給官員了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
Oh, goo to hear that it's delivered safely.
Anyway, what brings you here again?
Would you like some tea? We haven't got any dessert yet. I only have some tea to offer.
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
哦，很高興聽到它已經安全送達了。
不管怎樣，你這次又是什麼風把你吹來了？
想喝點茶嗎？我們還沒準備甜點，只有茶可以招待你。

scripts.text: Can I help you with anything?
scripts.translation: 有什麼我可以幫忙的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
Help?
Well, there are tons of things waiting for help!
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
幫忙？
嗯，有很多事情等著幫忙呢！

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
Nice Timing.
I've requested something from the Arunafeltz office but haven't gotten anything yet. Could you get it from Hansenne?
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
真是時候。
我向阿魯納菲茲辦事處申請了一些東西，但還沒收到。你能去漢森娜那裡取一下嗎？

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
I need that for the meeting, but he never sends it to me. He must've forgotten about it, again! You'll help me with this, right!?
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
我開會需要那個，但他從來都不寄給我。他肯定又忘了！你會幫我的，對吧！？

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
I've requested something from the Arunafeltz office but haven't gotten anything yet. Could you get it from Hansenne?
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
我向阿魯納菲茲辦事處申請了一些東西，但還沒收到。你能去漢森娜那裡取一下嗎？

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
I need that for the meeting, but he never sends it to me. He must've forgotten about it, again! You'll help me with this, right!?
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
我開會需要那個，但他從來都不寄給我。他肯定又忘了！你會幫我的，對吧！？

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
Huh? Are you serious???? Dropped it on a bridge while playing treasure hunting???
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
什麼？你是認真的？？？玩尋寶遊戲的時候掉到橋底下了？？？

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
Hansenne! What and itiot! I knew it! His brain must've been melted with hot air!
Aarrrrr!!!!! Can't believe this!!
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
漢森娜！你這個白痴！我就知道！他的腦子肯定是被熱氣給蒸熟了！
啊啊啊啊！！！真不敢相信！！

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
What the heck should I do??? The meesting's soon!!!
Oh my! I really, prefer to work alone. Oh, I hate those guys!
I hate foreigners.
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
我該怎麼辦？？？會議馬上就要開始了！！！
天哪！我真的更喜歡獨自工作。我討厭那些人！
我討厭外國人。

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
.....Whew... completely soaked, so loosely binded...torn here and there... I can't even read this thing!
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
......呼... 完全溼透了，綁得鬆鬆垮垮... 這裡那裡都破了... 我根本沒法讀這東西！

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
What is he expecting from me with this!!!!
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
他拿著這個想讓我幹什麼！！！

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
Aarrrrr!!!!! This is a nightmare!
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
啊啊啊啊！！！這簡直是場夢魘！

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
Huh? Are you serious???? Dropped it on a bridge while playing treasure hunting???
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
什麼？你是認真的？？？玩尋寶遊戲的時候掉到橋底下了？？？

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
Hansenne! What and idiot! I knew it! His brain must've been melted with hot air!
Aarrrrr!!!!! Can't believe this!!
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
漢森娜！你這個白痴！我就知道！他的腦子肯定是被熱氣給蒸熟了！
啊啊啊啊！！！真不敢相信！！

Oh my! I really, prefer to work alone. Oh, I hate those guys!
I hate foreigners.
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]

天哪！我真的更喜歡獨自工作。我討厭那些人！
我討厭外國人。

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
...Oh, this is...
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
...哦，這是...

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
This is the document I requested.
I thought the document was lost at some bridge and ruined completely, but then...
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
這就是我要找的檔案。
我以為它掉在橋底徹底毀了，結果...

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
Wow... this document is amazingly neat. Looks like Hue's the one who made this... He's really picky, if you know what I mean... Anyway, it's pretty impressive...
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
哇...這份檔案整理得真整齊。看來是休整理的...他做事真是一絲不苟，你懂的...總之，真的很厲害...

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
I'm so relieved I got this before the meeting. I've got to go now.
I'm running late.
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
能在會議前拿到真是太好了。我得走了。
我要遲到了。

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
But first, I have to find another document for the meeting. Could you please ask the Official to wait for me a bit?
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
不過在那之前，我得再找一份會議用的檔案。能麻煩你請那位官員稍等我一下嗎？

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
Please, the meeting's gonna begin soon.
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
拜託了，會議馬上就要開始了。

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
How could I go to the meeting without the research report??!
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
沒有研究報告我怎麼去參加會議？？！

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
Oh my! I really, prefer to work alone. Oh, I hate those guys!
I hate foreigners.
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
天哪！我真的更喜歡獨自工作。我討厭那些人！
我討厭外國人。

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
Could you please ask the Official to wait for me a bit?
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
能麻煩你請那位官員稍等我一下嗎？

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
I have to find another document for the meeting. Please, hurry.
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
我得再找一份會議用的檔案。拜託了，快一點。

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
Ah..... That... in that meeting room... Is.. everything alright now?
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
啊...那個...在那個會議室...現在...一切都還好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
Oh, I need to be left alone for a while.
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
哦，我需要一個人靜一靜。

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
Krrrrrrrr! Ugh...!
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
庫魯魯魯魯！呃...！

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
I know, I know! I went too far!
I was just so shocked and disappointed at the same time.
After all, it was just a cake...
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
我知道，我知道！我做得太過分了！
我當時既震驚又失望。
畢竟那只是一塊蛋糕...

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
I wasn't very mature.
Oh, what have I done?
I should go an apologize.
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
我做得很不成熟。
天哪，我幹了什麼？
我應該去道歉。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Wait! Hue wanted me to bring this to you.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
等等！休讓我把這個帶給你。

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
A report... ?
Ahhh... the one I left in the meeting room...
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
一份報告...？
啊...是我落在會議室的那份...

scripts.text:
- Ryosen takes the report -
- and gives a glance -
- at the memo stuck on it. -
scripts.translation:
- Ryosen 接過報告 -
- 瞥了一眼 -
- 貼在上面的備忘。 -

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
... ?
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
...？

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
Oh. What are you talking about?
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
哦。你在說什麼？

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
Ah. I'm so embarrassed.
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
啊。真讓人尷尬。

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
Oh, I didn't expect to get an apology. This is such a shame.
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
哦，沒想到會收到道歉。真是遺憾。

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
Now that I think of it. I didn't even say 'thank you' to him for restoring my documents...
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
說起來。我甚至沒對他說聲“謝謝”，感謝他幫我恢復了檔案...

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
Ok. I should setup another meeting ASAP. That way, we'd have a chance to get to know each other.
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
好吧。我應該儘快安排另一次會議。這樣，我們就有機會互相瞭解了。

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
So... Could you do me another favor?
Could you go see the Official in my stead and set up a meeting?
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
那麼...能再幫我個忙嗎？
你能替我去見那位官員，安排一次會議嗎？

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
Oh! And... Here's Rune-Midgarts' fresh strawberry cake. This is for you. I'm so sorry I haven't even offered you a piece. I was so distracted with stress, I think.
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
哦！還有...這是盧恩·米德加茲的新鮮草莓蛋糕。這是給你的。很抱歉我甚至沒給你分一塊。我想我因為壓力太大而分心了。

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
Thank you so much for everything you've done. And... pleade don't forget to do me this last favor, going to the Official and setting up a meeting.
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
非常感謝你為我做的一切。還有...拜託別忘了幫我這個最後的忙，去見那位官員並安排會議。

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
I... think I should prepare for the meeting again.
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
我...覺得我應該為會議再做些準備。

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
Again, thank you so much.
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
再次非常感謝。

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
Ok. I should setup another meeting ASAP. That way, we'd have a chance to get to know each other.
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
好吧。我應該儘快安排另一次會議。這樣，我們就有機會互相瞭解了。

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
Could you go see the Official in my stead and set up a meeting?
I... think I should prepare for the meeting again.
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
你能替我去見那位官員，安排一次會議嗎？
我...覺得我應該為會議再做些準備。

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
Thank you so much.
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
非常感謝。

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
Ah, hello adventurer!
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
啊，你好，冒險者！

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
I don't know how to thank you.
You can't imagine how greatful I feel!
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
我不知道該怎麼感謝你。
你無法想像我有多感激！

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
Oh, but then... Have you ever seen a ^0000ffMystic Horn^000000? I'd love to get one.
I heard you can get this thing from a monster named, 'Cornus' found in the fields.
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
哦，不過...你見過^0000ff魔力之角^000000嗎？我很想弄到一個。
我聽說可以從一種叫“飛馬”的魔物身上獲得，它們生活在野外。

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
Or... do you have any ^0000ffMystic Horns^000000 with you? Of course, I'm not saying that I want it for free. If you'd give me ^0000ff2 Mystic Horns^000000, I'd give you my Rune-Midgarts' Strawberry Cake.
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
或者...你身上有^0000ff魔力之角^000000嗎？當然，我不是說我要白拿。如果你給我^0000ff2個魔力之角^000000，我就把我的盧恩·米德加茲草莓蛋糕給你。

scripts.text: I haven't seen such a thing.
scripts.translation: 我沒見過這種東西。

scripts.text: Oh, ok, I'll give you!
scripts.translation: 哦，好的，我送給你！

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
Mmmmmmm~
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
嗯嗯嗯~

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
If by any chance you find one, please come back to me.
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
如果你碰巧找到了一個，請回來找我。

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
Huh?
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
咦？

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
You have Rune-Midgarts' Strawberry Cake?
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
你居然有盧恩·米德加茲的草莓蛋糕？

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
How come you haven't had it yet?
You should quickly finish that cake or else, somebody would steal it from you.
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
怎麼還沒吃呢？
快把它吃完吧，不然別人會偷走的。

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
I don't need it!
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
我不需要！

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
... Haha, I'm joking...
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
...哈哈，我開玩笑的...

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
Are you really, honestly, positively sure you want to exchange them for my cake?
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
你真的、真的、真的確定要用它們換我的蛋糕嗎？

scripts.text: No way.
scripts.translation: 不行。

scripts.text: Yeah... I'll exchange.
scripts.translation: 是的...我要交換。

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
Ahhh...
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
啊...

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
Come back any time if you change your mind.
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
如果你改變主意了，隨時歡迎回來。

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
I don't need it!
... Haha, I'm joking...
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
我不需要！
...哈哈，我開玩笑的...

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
I heard you could extract some magical energy form Mystic Horns and use it. Anyway, thank you!
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
我聽說可以從魔力之角中提取一些魔力並使用。總之，謝謝你了！

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
You lie! You don't even have any!!
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
你撒謊！你根本沒有！！

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
Please, if you find any Mystic Horns, come back to me!
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
拜託了，如果你找到魔力之角，請回來找我！

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
Please, don't touch anything!
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
拜託，不要碰任何東西！

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
You know somethig... Something comes out from this thing...
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
你知道的...有什麼東西從這東西里出來了...

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
If anyone tried to talk to you in the middle of the night, you should just walk away... Don't ever look back!!
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
如果半夜有人試圖和你說話，你應該直接走開...千萬不要回頭！！

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
And don't stare at the crack of dimension... or you'd be dragged to somewhere mysterious and never be able to come back...huhuhuhu...
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
也不要盯著維度的裂縫看...否則你會被拖到某個神秘的地方，再也回不來...呼呼呼...

scripts.text:
[Hue]
How come you've got so much to carry?
Are you perhaps on training or something?
scripts.translation:
[休]
你怎麼帶了這麼多東西？
你是在訓練什麼的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Hue]
What is it you want?
scripts.translation:
[休]
你想要什麼？

scripts.text:
[Hue]
Don't walk around this place without thinking.
After all, it'll be you who'd be in trouble.
scripts.translation:
[休]
不要不假思索地四處走動。
畢竟，會有麻煩的是你自己。

scripts.text:
[Hue]
What is it you want?
scripts.translation:
[休]
你想要什麼？

scripts.text:
[Hue]
You can't just come and go around as you please here. This is a restricted area.
scripts.translation:
[休]
你不能在這裡隨心所欲地進出。這是限制區域。

scripts.text: Sorry...
scripts.translation: 抱歉...

scripts.text: I came to show you this.
scripts.translation: 我來給你看這個。

scripts.text:
[Hue]
You're just helpless, aren't you?
scripts.translation:
[休]
你真是沒用啊。

scripts.text:
[Hue]
What's that?
scripts.translation:
[休]
那是什麼？

scripts.text:
[Hue]
...An invitation to the meeting... ?
scripts.translation:
[休]
...會議邀請函...？

scripts.text:
[Hue]
Haha. You expect me to accept this?
As always, scheduling things as they want, report to us to accept it...
scripts.translation:
[休]
哈哈。你居然指望我接受這個？
一如既往，想怎麼安排就怎麼安排，然後讓我們去接受...？

scripts.text:
[Hue]
I can't think of any other words to describe them, except for this word: RUDE!
scripts.translation:
[休]
除了“無禮”這個詞，我找不到其他詞來形容他們了。

scripts.text:
[Hue]
Never ever asking for our opinion and always delivering things through some strangers... By the way, no offense...
scripts.translation:
[休]
從來不徵求我們的意見，總是通過一些陌生人來傳達...順便說一句，別介意...

scripts.text:
[Hue]
THey don't ever take the official route! Rune-Midgartish way of reporting! Very unprofessional!
scripts.translation:
[休]
他們從來不走正規渠道！盧恩·米德加茲式的彙報方式！太不專業了！

scripts.text:
[Hue]
Anyway, what is this meeting about?
Give it to me. I should read it at least.
scripts.translation:
[休]
總之，這個會議是關於什麼的？
給我看看。我至少應該讀一下。

scripts.text:
[Hue]
You should have some Sand chips while I'm reading this. Don't expect any taste, it's from Arunafeltz.
scripts.translation:
[休]
在我讀這個的時候，你可以吃點沙粒。別指望有什麼味道，這是從阿魯納菲茲來的。

scripts.text:
[Hue]
What are you doing here?
scripts.translation:
[休]
你在這裡做什麼？

scripts.text:
[Hue]
You can't go around this place as you want. This is a restricted area.
scripts.translation:
[休]
你不能在這裡隨心所欲地走動。這是限制區域。

scripts.text:
[Hue]
...Meeting Schedule, on the Xth day, from hh:mm to hh:mm...
Location... Rune-Midgarts' camp...
Ha! I knew it. Rune-Midgarts' camp again!
scripts.translation:
[休]
...會議日程，X日，從hh:mm到hh:mm...
地點...盧恩·米德加茲的營地...
哈！我就知道。又是盧恩·米德加茲的營地！

scripts.text:
[Hue]
Objectives... to report on the researching progress of tracking Satan Morocc and the Ash-Vacuum!
scripts.translation:
[休]
目標...彙報追蹤魔王夢羅克和阿什真空的研究進展！

scripts.text:
[Hue]
Having some time to get to know each other??? Haaaaa!
scripts.translation:
[休]
有些時間讓大家互相認識一下？？？哈啊！

scripts.text:
[Hue]
Well, thank you for entertaining me. You should tell Ryosen that.
scripts.translation:
[休]
好吧，謝謝你逗我開心。你應該告訴료森這一點。

scripts.text: Ok, I will.
scripts.translation: 好的，我會的。

scripts.text: Please sign the invitation.
scripts.translation: 請簽署邀請函。

scripts.text:
[Hue]
Well, you should also tell him that I think he's very talented in settin up comedy. Hahaha.
scripts.translation:
[休]
嗯，你也應該告訴他，我覺得他在設定喜劇方面很有天賦。哈哈哈。

scripts.text:
[Hue]
... Sign this thing???

[Hue]
You mean this meeting's for real???
scripts.translation:
[休]
你是說這個會議是真的？？？

scripts.text:
[Hue]
Oh my!
I have never seen an official invitation to be this stupid-looking!
scripts.translation:
[休]
天哪！
我從未見過這麼醜的正式邀請函！

scripts.text: - Hue got so furious and pressed the pen so hard that the ball point got pushed in. Then he threw the document after signing it. -
scripts.translation: - 休氣得把筆按得太緊，筆芯都戳進去了。簽完字後，他把檔案扔了出去。 -

scripts.text:
[Hue]
Well, at least I respect that Ryosen hasn't forgotten the reporting order. So, you're off to Arunafeltz now?
scripts.translation:
[休]
好吧，至少我尊重ryo森沒有忘記彙報順序。那麼，你現在要去阿魯納菲茲了？

scripts.text:
[Hue]
You'll experience some hard time talking to Hansenne... It'll be like testing your patience.
Good luck!
scripts.translation:
[休]
和漢森娜打交道會很辛苦...這簡直是在考驗你的耐心。
祝你好運！

scripts.text:
[Hue]
Come on, what's the hurry?
Wait a few more minutes, I didn't finish reading it!
scripts.translation:
[休]
急什麼？
再等幾分鐘，我還沒讀完呢！

scripts.text:
[Hue]
You should have some Sand chips while I'm reading this. Don't expect any taste, it's from Arunafeltz.
scripts.translation:
[休]
在我讀這個的時候，你可以吃點沙粒。別指望有什麼味道，這是從阿魯納菲茲來的。

scripts.text:
[Hue]
I'm not sure if everyone from Arunafeltz is like him, but, it'll be like testing your patience to get Hansenne to read this thing.
You can trust me on that one. Good luck.
scripts.translation:
[休]
我不確定阿魯納菲茲的人是不是都像他那樣，但讓漢森娜讀這份檔案簡直是在考驗你的耐心。
這一點你可以相信我。祝你好運。

scripts.text:
[Hue]
What is this stupid looking pile of documents?
scripts.translation:
[休]
這堆看起來愚蠢的檔案是什麼？

scripts.text:
[Hue]
Is this the file Ryosen requested from Hansenne??? The one which is all ruined...?
scripts.translation:
[休]
這是ryo森向漢森娜索取的那份檔案？？？就是那份被毀得亂七八糟的...？

scripts.text:
[Hue]
Ha! Tsk,tsk! Is this some kind of joke?! Who'd manage the files like this? I'd never know!
scripts.translation:
[休]
哈！嘖，嘖！這是某種玩笑嗎？！誰會這樣管理檔案？我完全不知道！

scripts.text:
[Hue]
Whew... I can't even stand looking at it! Oh just, give it to me!
scripts.translation:
[休]
呼...我甚至無法直視它！哦，算了，給我吧！

scripts.text:
[Hue]
Too bad I'm not in Schwarzwald. I could use our document restoring machine back at home... Ugh! Now I gotta do everything manually.
scripts.translation:
[休]
真可惜我不在修瓦魯茲巴魯德。我可以用家裡的檔案修復機器...唉！現在只能手動處理了。

scripts.text:
[Hue]
Hmmm. It's completely soaked. I Should dry this thing first and iron these crumples. Then, I should restore the texts.
scripts.translation:
[休]
嗯。完全溼透了。我應該先把它弄乾，熨平這些褶皺。然後，再修復文字。

scripts.text:
[Hue]
I need some materials. You gotta help me on this. I need ^0000ff1 Fan, 1 Old Frying Pan, 1 Flame Stone, 1 Chinese Ink^000000.
scripts.translation:
[休]
我需要一些材料。你得幫我。我需要^0000ff1把扇子，1個破舊平底鍋，1個火焰能量石，1瓶中國墨水^000000。

scripts.text:
[Hue]
Hey, hey... don't look at me like that. I know you're not delighted to do these things but think about it, what about me? Why should I restore this garbage?
scripts.translation:
[休]
嘿，嘿...別那樣看著我。我知道你對做這些事並不高興，但想想看，我呢？我為什麼要修復這堆垃圾？

scripts.text:
[Hue]
Listen, sometimes, we've got to do things we don't like in order to get things accomplished.
scripts.translation:
[休]
聽著，有時候，為了達成目標，我們不得不做一些不喜歡的事。

scripts.text:
[Hue]
Just don't gorget that the file will be restored as fast as you prepare those things for me.
scripts.translation:
[休]
只要別忘了，你為我準備好這些東西的速度，決定了檔案修復的速度。

scripts.text:
[Hue]
I wonder if the preparation for the meeting's going ok.
scripts.translation:
[休]
不知道會議的準備進行得怎麼樣了。

scripts.text:
[Hue]
I heard Ryosen say that the file he requested from Hansenne is all ruined. I hope I dont get involved in that trouble.
scripts.translation:
[休]
我聽說ryo森說他從漢森娜那裡要的檔案全毀了。希望我不會捲入那個麻煩。

scripts.text:
[Hue]
Impressive. That was fast enough.
scripts.translation:
[休]
令人印象深刻。速度夠快。

scripts.text:
[Hue]
Give them to me.
I have no time to waste.
scripts.translation:
[休]
把它們給我。
我沒時間浪費。

scripts.text:
[Hue]
Could you please sit there and wait for me while I restore this file?
scripts.translation:
[休]
請坐在那裡等我，我要修復這份檔案。

scripts.text:
[Hue]
Hmmm. It's completely soaked. I Should dry this thing first and iron these crumples. Then, I should restore the texts.
scripts.translation:
[休]
嗯。完全溼透了。我應該先把它弄乾，熨平這些褶皺。然後，再修復文字。

scripts.text:
[Hue]
I need some materials. You gotta help me on this. I need ^0000ff1 Fan, 1 Old Frying Pan, 1 Flame Stone, 1 Chinese Ink^000000.
scripts.translation:
[休]
我需要一些材料。你得幫我。我需要^0000ff1把扇子，1個破舊平底鍋，1個火焰能量石，1瓶中國墨水^000000。

scripts.text:
[Hue]
Just don't gorget that the file will be restored as fast as you prepare those things for me.
scripts.translation:
[休]
只要別忘了，你為我準備好這些東西的速度，決定了檔案修復的速度。

scripts.text:
[Hue]
There!
scripts.translation:
[休]
好了！

scripts.text:
[Hue]
The binding was too loose, so I re-arranged and bound the file all over again. This is how the true official document should look like. I really think they should learn how to arrange files.
scripts.translation:
[休]
裝訂太鬆了，所以我重新整理並裝訂了這份檔案。這才是正式檔案該有的樣子。我真覺得他們應該學學怎麼整理檔案。

scripts.text:
[Hue]
Please, deliver this file before it's too late. The meeting's gonna begin soon.
scripts.translation:
[休]
請趕在太晚之前把這份檔案送過去。會議馬上就要開始了。

scripts.text:
[Hue]
Hey, stop pushing me.
scripts.translation:
[休]
嘿，別推我。

scripts.text:
[Hue]
I have to be extra careful with this kind of work, ok? Can't you sit quietly over there? Take a nap or something.
scripts.translation:
[休]
這種工作我必須格外小心，明白嗎？你能不能在那邊安靜地坐著？或者打個盹什麼的。

scripts.text:
[Hue]
The binding was too loose, so I re-arranged and bound the file all over again. This is how the true official document should look like. I really think they should learn how to arrange files.
scripts.translation:
[休]
裝訂太鬆了，所以我重新整理並裝訂了這份檔案。這才是正式檔案該有的樣子。我真覺得他們應該學學怎麼整理檔案。

scripts.text:
[Hue]
Please, deliver this file before it's too late. The meeting's gonna begin soon.
scripts.translation:
[休]
請趕在太晚之前把這份檔案送過去。會議馬上就要開始了。

scripts.text:
[Hue]
Well, finally... It's time for the meeting.
scripts.translation:
[休]
嗯，終於...該開會了。

scripts.text:
[Hue]
Like it or not... I should go in.
scripts.translation:
[休]
不管願不願意...我都得進去了。

scripts.text:
[Hue]
.....Ittt....Is... it still there... ?
- Looks like he's thinking about something... very seriously. -
scripts.translation: - 看起來他正在非常認真地思考著什麼... -

scripts.text:
[Hue]
I just decided I can't stay like this.
scripts.translation:
[休]
我剛下定決心，不能再這樣下去了。

scripts.text:
[Hue]
I couldn't confess the truth when Hansenne said he ruined the cake instead of me.
scripts.translation:
[休]
當漢森娜說是他弄壞了蛋糕而不是我時，我沒能說出真相。

scripts.text:
[Hue]
I was so bewildered that I lost the chance to say anything... but... I was such a coward to admit that I was the one who caused the trouble.
scripts.translation:
[休]
我當時太慌亂，錯過了開口的機會...但是...承認是我惹了麻煩，我實在太懦弱了。

scripts.text:
[Hue]
I must apologize.
But then...
scripts.translation:
[休]
我必須道歉。
但是...

scripts.text:
[Hue]
Oh, I'm so embarrassed to see him face to face. Or.. how about...
scripts.translation:
[休]
啊，和他面對面太尷尬了。或者...不如...

scripts.text:
[Hue]
Here, this is the Rune-Midgarts' report I took with me when everything went messy in the meeting room. Could you please give this to Ryosen?
scripts.translation:
[休]
這個，是我在會議室一片混亂時帶走的盧恩·米德加茲的報告。能請你把這個交給ryo森嗎？

scripts.text:
[Hue]
I'm sorry to ask you this but...
Could you? For this, I'll give you some Schwarzwald's Pineapple Jubilee.
scripts.translation:
[休]
不好意思麻煩你了，但是...
你能幫我嗎？作為回報，我會給你一些修瓦魯茲巴魯德的菠蘿慶典。

scripts.text:
[Hue]
Please give this report to Ryosen.
Thank you.
scripts.translation:
[休]
請把這份報告交給ryo森。
謝謝。

scripts.text:
[Hue]
Oh, I'm so embarrassed to see him face to face. Or.. how about...
scripts.translation:
[休]
啊，和他面對面太尷尬了。或者...不如...

scripts.text:
[Hue]
Here, this is the Rune-Midgarts' report I took with me when everything went messy in the meeting room. Could you please give this to Ryosen?
scripts.translation:
[休]
這個，是我在會議室一片混亂時帶走的盧恩·米德加茲的報告。能請你把這個交給ryo森嗎？

scripts.text:
[Hue]
I'm sorry to ask you this but...
Could you?
scripts.translation:
[休]
不好意思麻煩你了，但是...
你能幫我嗎？

scripts.text:
[Hue]
Ah, hello!
scripts.translation:
[休]
啊，你好！

scripts.text:
[Hue]
If it weren't for you, we wouldn't be able to get along at all.
I don't know how to thank you!
scripts.translation:
[休]
如果不是你，我們根本沒法相處。
真不知道該怎麼感謝你！

scripts.text:
[Hue]
Have you ever seen something called, ^0000ffFur^000000 ?
I hear you can get it from the monsters called 'Tatacho' and 'Hillsrion' in the fields.
scripts.translation:
[休]
你聽說過叫^0000ff毛皮^000000的東西嗎？
聽說在野外可以從叫“噠噠喬”和“希爾裡恩”的怪物身上獲得。

scripts.text:
[Hue]
Could you bring ^0000ffFur^000000 if you get some? I'm not asking it for free.
I'll give you my Pineapple Jubilee from Schwarzwald, if you bring me ^0000ff2 Furs^000000.
scripts.translation:
[休]
如果你能弄到^0000ff毛皮^000000，能帶給我嗎？我不是白拿的。
如果你給我^0000ff2個毛皮^000000，我就把修瓦魯茲巴魯德的菠蘿慶典給你。

scripts.text: I don't have any, right now.
scripts.translation: 我現在沒有。

scripts.text: Oh, I'll give you Fur.
scripts.translation: 哦，我給你毛皮。

scripts.text:
[Hue]
Alright, you don't have any.
scripts.translation:
[休]
好吧，你現在沒有。

scripts.text:
[Hue]
Please give me some when you get some.
scripts.translation:
[休]
等你弄到了請給我一些。

scripts.text:
[Hue]
Ah, oh my.
scripts.translation:
[休]
啊，哎呀。

scripts.text:
[Hue]
You already have the Pineapple Jubilee from Schwarzwald!
scripts.translation:
[休]
你已經擁有修瓦魯茲巴魯德的菠蘿慶典了！

scripts.text:
[Hue]
I think you should drin that thing fast. Otherwise, all the ice will melt and it'll taste like some kinda medicine!
scripts.translation:
[休]
我覺得你應該快點喝掉那個東西。不然冰都化了，味道就像某種藥一樣！

scripts.text:
[Hue]
Ah, are you sure you want to exchange?
scripts.translation:
[休]
啊，你確定要交換嗎？

scripts.text:
[Hue]
Oh, so it's the thing called, Fur??
scripts.translation:
[休]
哦，就是那個叫毛皮的東西嗎？

scripts.text:
[Hue]
Are you sure you want to exchange this for my Pineapple Jubilee?
scripts.translation:
[休]
你確定要用這個換我的菠蘿慶典嗎？

scripts.text: No way.
scripts.translation: 不行。

scripts.text: Sure.
scripts.translation: 當然。

scripts.text:
[Hue]
Ahhhhh...

[Hue]
Come back any time if you change your mind.
scripts.translation:
[休]
如果你改變主意，隨時歡迎回來。

scripts.text:
[Hue]
Thank you so much.
scripts.translation:
[休]
非常感謝。

scripts.text:
[Hue]
I always needed this because the weather here is colder then I expected. I'm sure this will keep me warm.
scripts.translation:
[休]
我一直需要這個，因為這裡的天氣比我預期的要冷。我相信這個能讓我暖和起來。

scripts.text:
[Hue]
Well, I don't think you have any Fur.
scripts.translation:
[休]
嗯，我想你應該沒有毛皮。

scripts.text:
[Hue]
Please come back if you find any Fur.
scripts.translation:
[休]
如果你找到毛皮，請回來找我。

scripts.text:
[Hue]
Don't walk around this area. It's restricted.
scripts.translation:
[休]
不要在這個區域走動。這裡是禁區。

scripts.text:
[Hue]
What are you doing here?
scripts.translation:
[休]
你在這裡做什麼？

scripts.text:
[Hue]
Don't walk around this place without thinking.
After all, it'll be you who'd be in trouble.
scripts.translation:
[休]
不要不假思索地四處走動。
畢竟，會有麻煩的是你自己。

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
How come you've got so much to carry?
Are you perhaps on training or something?
scripts.translation:
[漢森娜]
你怎麼帶了這麼多東西？
難道是在進行什麼訓練嗎？

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
Who's there?
scripts.translation:
[漢森娜]
誰在那裡？

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
Who's here?
scripts.translation:
[漢森娜]
誰在這裡？

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
Haha, hahaha, hahahahahahahahaha.
scripts.translation:
[漢森娜]
哈哈，哈哈哈，哈哈哈哈哈哈。

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
Hmmm? What brings you here?
scripts.translation:
[漢森娜]
嗯？什麼事把你帶到這裡來了？

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
Of course, your feet brought you here!?!
scripts.translation:
[漢森娜]
當然，是你的腳把你帶到這裡來的！？

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
Haha, hahaha, hahahahahahahahaha.
scripts.translation:
[漢森娜]
哈哈，哈哈哈，哈哈哈哈哈哈。

scripts.text: Come and look at this.
scripts.translation: 過來看看這個

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
What are you looking at?
Something I said?
scripts.translation:
[漢森娜]
你在看什麼？
是我剛才說的話嗎？

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
What's that?
scripts.translation:
[漢森娜]
那是什麼？

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
An invitation to the meeting?
scripts.translation:
[漢森娜]
會議的邀請函？

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
Hmm, Ryosen from Rune-Midgarts made it and... Hue from Schwarzwald agreed to sign it too?
scripts.translation:
[漢森娜]
嗯，盧恩·米德加茲的Ryosen製作的，而且...修瓦魯茲巴魯德的休也同意簽署了？

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
Hmmm, that's not funny at all.
scripts.translation:
[漢森娜]
嗯，這一點也不好笑。

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
They're so boring. They always report to me after making all the decisions. No sense of humor... so stubborn and strict... They're totally not my style.
scripts.translation:
[漢森娜]
他們真無聊。總是先做完所有決定，然後再向我彙報。一點幽默感都沒有...固執又嚴厲...完全不是我的風格。

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
Anyway, give it to me.
I should have a look at least.
scripts.translation:
[漢森娜]
總之，把它給我。
我至少應該看一眼。

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
You should take a rest, while I'm reading this. Oh, have some Poring Candy from Rune-Midgarts. It's terribly sour and sometimes salty. Funny taste, huh?
scripts.translation:
[漢森娜]
趁我讀這個的時候，你休息一下。哦，吃點盧恩·米德加茲的波利糖果吧。味道非常酸，有時還有點鹹。味道挺特別的，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
Hmmm? Are you from Rune-Midgarts?
scripts.translation:
[漢森娜]
嗯？你是盧恩·米德加茲的人？

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
Then where's the person from Rude Midgard? Hahahahah, do you get my joke?
scripts.translation:
[漢森娜]
那盧恩·米德加茲的人在哪裡呢？哈哈哈，你懂我的玩笑嗎？

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
Haha, hahaha, hahahahahahahahaha.
scripts.translation:
[漢森娜]
哈哈，哈哈哈，哈哈哈哈哈哈。

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
Mmmmmm~
scripts.translation:
[漢森娜]
嗯嗯嗯~

scripts.text:
- Hansenne picks up the file -
- and suddenly gets serious -
- while turning the pages... -
scripts.translation:
- 漢森娜拿起檔案 -
- 突然變得嚴肅起來 -
- 翻動著書頁... -

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
Mmmmmm~
scripts.translation:
[漢森娜]
嗯嗯嗯~

scripts.text: - Hansenne drops some kind of liquid on the file document, and carefully looks at it. -
scripts.translation:
- 漢森娜在檔案上滴了一些液體，
- 然後仔細端詳著。 -

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
Meeting Schedule... on the Umpth day, from then-o'clock to later-o'clock
Haha, hahaha, hahahahahahahahaha.
Meeting Schedule, shmeating schedule... Beating Schedule!!
scripts.translation:
[漢森娜]
會議日程... 在Umpth日，從then-o'clock到later-o'clock
哈哈，哈哈哈，哈哈哈哈哈哈。
會議日程，什麼會議日程... 毆打日程！！

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
Location... Rune-Midgarts' camp!
Rude-Midgard's camp!?!?
Are they camping in that place??
Haha, hahaha, hahahahahahahahaha.
scripts.translation:
[漢森娜]
地點... 盧恩·米德加茲的營地！
盧恩·米德加茲的營地！？！？
他們居然在那個地方露營？？
哈哈，哈哈哈，哈哈哈哈哈哈。

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
Objectives... to report on the researching progress of tracking Satan Morocc and of the Ash-Vacuum!
scripts.translation:
[漢森娜]
目標... 彙報對魔王夢羅克和阿什真空的研究進展！

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
Ash-Vacuum!
Ash-Vacuum... what is that, a homemaker's device???
Haha, hahaha, hahahahahahahahaha.
scripts.translation:
[漢森娜]
阿什真空！
阿什真空... 那是什麼，家用裝置？？？
哈哈，哈哈哈，哈哈哈哈哈哈。

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
...and a very useless one which vacuums only ash!
Haha, hahaha, hahahahahahahahaha.
scripts.translation:
[漢森娜]
...而且是一個只吸灰燼的非常無用的裝置！
哈哈，哈哈哈，哈哈哈哈哈哈。

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
Ehhhhh? And what's this? Having some time to get to know each other??? ...Pffthahahahaha...
Aaahahahahaha.
scripts.translation:
[漢森娜]
誒誒誒？這是什麼？還有時間互相認識一下？？？ ...噗嗤哈哈哈哈哈...
啊哈哈哈哈哈哈。

scripts.text: What's so funny?!
scripts.translation: 有什麼好笑的？！

scripts.text: Hey, just sign this thing.
scripts.translation: 嘿，就在這上面籤個字吧。

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
Haha...get to know each other...
Pffftahahaha.
Haha, hahaha, hahahahahahahahaha.
scripts.translation:
[漢森娜]
哈哈...互相認識一下...
噗嗤哈哈哈哈哈。
哈哈，哈哈哈，哈哈哈哈哈哈。

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
Phew! Excuse me!
I can't help it! I can't stand this! What the heck!!! What do we have to know about each other???
Hahaha!
scripts.translation:
[漢森娜]
呼！抱歉！
我忍不住了！我受不了這個！到底要互相瞭解什麼啊？？？
哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
- Hansenne signs the paper -
- with a shaking hand -
- still laughing out loud. -
scripts.translation:
- 漢森娜簽了那張紙 -
- 手還在顫抖 -
- 依然在大聲笑著。 -

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
Puhhh-haha, this is unbelievable.
Ryosen's avery funny guy. Well, he wouldn't know how funny he is...
Haha, you should tell him that.
Haha, hahaha, hahahahahahahahaha.
scripts.translation:
[漢森娜]
呼哈哈，這太不可思議了。
Ryosen真是個有趣的人。不過，他自己可能不知道他有多有趣...
哈哈，你應該告訴他。
哈哈，哈哈哈，哈哈哈哈哈哈。

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
Ahhh, wait. I didn't finish reading it.
scripts.translation:
[漢森娜]
啊，等等。我還沒讀完。

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
I didn't finish reading it.
scripts.translation:
[漢森娜]
我還沒讀完。

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
Haha, hahaha, hahahahahahahahaha.
scripts.translation:
[漢森娜]
哈哈，哈哈哈，哈哈哈哈哈哈。

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
Hush! Please don't talk! We must pray now!
scripts.translation:
[漢森娜]
噓！請別說話！我們現在必須祈禱！

scripts.text:
- He takes a bow silently, -
- toward the sky, -
- with his eyes firmly closed. -
scripts.translation:
- 他默默地鞠躬， -
- 面向天空， -
- 雙眼緊閉。 -

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
I got it, I got it. I should go to the meeting. Ryosen's really a funny guy, if you know what I mean.
Please, thank him for entertaining me. Haha, hahaha,
hahahahahahahahaha.
scripts.translation:
[漢森娜]
我知道了，我知道了。我該去開會了。Ryosen真是個有趣的人，如果你懂我的意思的話。
請替我謝謝他逗我開心。哈哈，哈哈哈，
哈哈哈哈哈哈。

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
Hmmm? You again?
scripts.translation:
[漢森娜]
嗯？又是你？

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
What are you doing here?
scripts.translation:
[漢森娜]
你在這裡做什麼？

scripts.text: I missed you.
scripts.translation: 我想你了。

scripts.text: I came to pick up the requested document.
scripts.translation: 我來領取所需的檔案。

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
You what?
scripts.translation:
[漢森娜]
你說什麼？

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
You missed me? Don't expect a kiss!
Haha, hahaha, hahahahahahahahaha.
scripts.translation:
[漢森娜]
你想我了？別指望我會親你哦！
哈哈，哈哈哈，哈哈哈哈哈哈。

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
A requested document? Did Ryosen send you?
scripts.translation:
[漢森娜]
所需的檔案？是Ryosen派你來的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
Hmmmmm.
Wait for me here. Now, where did I put it...?
scripts.translation:
[漢森娜]
嗯嗯。
在這裡等我一下。對了，我把它放哪兒了...？

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
Hmmmmm~?
scripts.translation:
[漢森娜]
嗯嗯~？

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
Ahhhh!
Hmmmmm, right, right!
scripts.translation:
[漢森娜]
啊！
嗯嗯，對了，對了！

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
It's gone!
scripts.translation:
[漢森娜]
不見了！

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
I lost it. I think I might have dropped it into the river or something when I played treasure-hunting on a bridge!
scripts.translation:
[漢森娜]
我弄丟了。我想我可能在橋上玩尋寶遊戲的時候，不小心把它掉進河裡了！

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
But you know, the funny thing is... I heard my parents picked me up on a bridge when I was a baby, and now I lost the document on a bridge! What a coincidence! Haha, hahaha, hahahahahahahahaha.
scripts.translation:
[漢森娜]
不過你知道嗎，有趣的是...我聽說我父母是在橋上撿到嬰兒時期的我的，而現在我又在橋上弄丟了檔案！真是巧合啊！哈哈，哈哈哈，哈哈哈哈哈哈。

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
It'll take time to make it all over. Although... Hmm... Should I go fishing and catch that thing~?
Those pussycats on the South-West can teach us fishing, you know.
scripts.translation:
[漢森娜]
重新制作需要時間。不過...嗯...我要不要去釣魚，把那個東西撈上來~？
你知道的，西南邊的那些傢伙很會釣魚。

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
Maybe we can catch that document with a fishing rod if we're lucky!
Wow!
scripts.translation:
[漢森娜]
也許我們運氣好的話，可以用魚竿把那份檔案釣上來！
哇！

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
I lost it. I think I might have dropped it into the river or something when I played treasure-hunting on a bridge!
scripts.translation:
[漢森娜]
我弄丟了。我想我可能在橋上玩尋寶遊戲的時候，不小心把它掉進河裡了！

scripts.text:

But you know, the funny thing is... I heard my parents picked me up on a bridge when I was a baby, and now I lost the document on a bridge! What a coincidence! Haha, hahaha, hahahahahahahahaha.
scripts.translation:
[漢森娜]
不過你知道嗎，有趣的是...我聽說我父母是在橋上撿到嬰兒時期的我的，而現在我又在橋上弄丟了檔案！真是巧合啊！哈哈，哈哈哈，哈哈哈哈哈哈。

scripts.text:

It'll take time to make it all over. Although... Hmm... Should I go fishing and catch that thing~?
Those pussycats on the South-West can teach us fishing, you know.
scripts.translation:
[漢森娜]
重新制作需要時間。不過...嗯...我要不要去釣魚，把那個東西撈上來~？
你知道的，西南邊的那些傢伙很會釣魚。

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
Cool, you found it!
scripts.translation:
[漢森娜]
酷，你找到了！

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
Mmmm, I'm sure this is the one I made, just by looking at this overall shape.
scripts.translation:
[漢森娜]
嗯，光看這個整體形狀，我就確定這是我做的那份。

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
Hmmmmm, but then... I'm afraid Ryosen would explode when he sees this! Boom!!!
scripts.translation:
[漢森娜]
嗯嗯，但是...我恐怕Ryosen看到這份檔案會氣炸的！轟！！！

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
Schwarzwald people have some talent in restoring things like this... Why don't you ask Hue to restore this?
scripts.translation:
[漢森娜]
修瓦魯茲巴魯德的人擅長修復這類東西...你為什麼不請休來修復一下呢？

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
He'd scream so hard and the windows might break. But he'll do it.
Haha, hahaha, hahahahahahahahaha.
scripts.translation:
[漢森娜]
他肯定會尖叫得很大聲，窗戶可能會被震碎。但他還是會做的。
哈哈，哈哈哈，哈哈哈哈哈哈。

I lost it. I think I might have dropped it into the river or something when I played treasure-hunting on a bridge!

你知道的，西南邊的那些傢伙很會釣魚。

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
Hmmmmm, it's all screwed up. I'm afraid Ryosen would explode when he sees this! Boom!!!
scripts.translation:
[漢森娜]
嗯嗯，全亂了。我恐怕Ryosen看到這份檔案會氣炸的！轟！！！

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
Schwarzwald people have some talent in restoring things like this... Why don't you ask Hue to restore this?
scripts.translation:

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
He'd scream so hard and the windows might break. But he'll do it.
Haha, hahaha, hahahahahahahahaha.
scripts.translation:
[漢森娜]
他肯定會尖叫得很大聲，窗戶可能會被震碎。但他還是會做的。
哈哈，哈哈哈，哈哈哈哈哈哈。

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
Hmmmmm~ It's about time.
scripts.translation:
[漢森娜]
嗯嗯~ 差不多該到了。

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
I don't wanna get in trouble. I should hurry up.
scripts.translation:
[漢森娜]
我不想惹麻煩。我得趕緊走了。

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
Haha, hahaha....
scripts.translation:
[漢森娜]
哈哈，哈哈哈....

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
That friend of yours never gets my jokes... My sense of humor is... just... out of his league!! Haha, hahaha, hahahahahahahahaha.
scripts.translation:
[漢森娜]
你那朋友從來都聽不懂我的笑話... 我的幽默感... 簡直... 高他好幾個等級！！哈哈，哈哈哈，哈哈哈哈哈哈。

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
Huh? You again?
scripts.translation:
[漢森娜]
咦？又是你？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Why did you do that?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你為什麼要那樣做？

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
Hehhhhh??? What are you talking about? If you wanna blame me for anything, tell me the reason first~
Haha, hahaha, hahahahahahahahaha.
scripts.translation:
[漢森娜]
嘿？？？你在說什麼？如果你想怪我，先告訴我理由嘛~
哈哈，哈哈哈，哈哈哈哈哈哈。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I know you're not the one who ruined the cake. I saw it. It was Hue! I saw him clearly when he pressed his hand on the cake when the Thief Bug came out.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我知道破壞蛋糕的不是你。我看見了。是休！當浮勒盜蟲出現時，我清楚地看到他按在了蛋糕上。

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
Well... Who cares who did it?
It was just a mistake. Nothing's gonna change even if we find out who did it. The cake is still ruined, isn't it?
scripts.translation:
[漢森娜]
嗯... 誰做的有什麼關係？
只是個意外而已。就算查出來是誰做的，也沒什麼改變。蛋糕還是毀了，不是嗎？

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
Hmmmmm... or... I don't know. Maybe I'm thanlful that he restored my garbage looking file... ?
scripts.translation:
[漢森娜]
嗯嗯... 或者... 我不知道。也許我有點感激他修復了我那看起來像垃圾一樣的檔案...？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
But... You were blamed for it.
Aren't you feeling bad? It's unfair!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
但是... 你被責怪了。
你不覺得難過嗎？這不公平！

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
Well, not really.
Ryosen could be very rhough when he gets freaked out, but he will forget about all that soon...
scripts.translation:
[漢森娜]
嗯，還好吧。
Ryosen 情緒激動時可能會很粗暴，但他很快就會忘記這些事的...

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
I understand. He was upset.
scripts.translation:
[漢森娜]
我理解。他當時很生氣。

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
You see, he brought that cake for all of us in there. He wouldn't normally do that, but I guess he wanted to be nice. But then, poof~ the cake was ruined.
scripts.translation:
[漢森娜]
你看，他是為了我們大家才帶那個蛋糕來的。他平時不會這麼做，但我想他是想表現得好一點。結果，噗~ 蛋糕毀了。

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
He must've been so upset that we all couldn't share that cake. Isn't it kinda cute?
Haha, hahaha, hahahahahahahahaha.
scripts.translation:
[漢森娜]
他一定很沮喪，因為我們大家都沒能分享那個蛋糕。是不是有點可愛？
哈哈，哈哈哈，哈哈哈哈哈哈。

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
Well, it's nothing big. Don't you think?
scripts.translation:
[漢森娜]
嗯，沒什麼大不了的。你不覺得嗎？

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
He'll be ok soon. He'll get to thinking that it wasn't actually a big deal.
scripts.translation:
[漢森娜]
他很快就會沒事的。他會想通這其實沒什麼大不了的。

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
But the thing is that... the relationship between Ryosen and Hue isn't looking good at all.
Why don't you help them get along with each other?
scripts.translation:
[漢森娜]
但是問題是... Ryosen 和休的關係看起來一點都不好。
你為什麼不幫他們和好一下呢？

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
Sorry for asking these things of you. And... here's Arunageltz's Desert Sandwich. It's nothing special but... tastes pretty good.
scripts.translation:
[漢森娜]
抱歉讓你幫忙處理這些。還有... 這是阿魯納格爾特茲的沙漠三明治。沒什麼特別的，但... 味道還不錯。

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
Thank you for doing me a favor.
Haha, hahaha, hahahahahahahahaha.
scripts.translation:
[漢森娜]
謝謝你的幫忙。
哈哈，哈哈哈，哈哈哈哈哈哈。

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
The relationship between Ryosen and Hue isn't looking good at all.
Why don't you help them get along with each other?
scripts.translation:
[漢森娜]
Ryosen 和休的關係看起來一點都不好。
你為什麼不幫他們和好一下呢？

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
Ah, it's you adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[漢森娜]
啊，是你啊，冒險者。

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
I heard about you from the Official. Thank you so much for helping us.
scripts.translation:
[漢森娜]
我從官方那裡聽說了你的事。非常感謝你幫我們的忙。

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
Anyways.. I wonder if you have seen a ^0000ffPeaked Hat^000000. I heard the monster, 'Tatacho' has that hat.
scripts.translation:
[漢森娜]
話說回來... 不知道你有沒有見過^0000ff紅色高帽^000000。我聽說怪物“噠噠喬”身上有那頂帽子。

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
Can you give me a ^0000ffPeaked Hat^000000 if you have any? I'm not asking for free.
For ^0000ff2 Peaked Hats^000000, I'll give you my special dessert!
scripts.translation:
[漢森娜]
如果你有的話，能給我一頂^0000ff紅色高帽^000000嗎？我不是白拿的。
用^0000ff2頂紅色高帽^000000，我就把我的特製甜點給你！

scripts.text: No way.
scripts.translation: 不行。

scripts.text: Sure.
scripts.translation: 當然。

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
No way?
scripts.translation:
[漢森娜]
不行嗎？

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
I'd say, yes way?
Haha, hahaha, hahahahahahahahaha.
scripts.translation:
[漢森娜]
我覺得，行吧？
哈哈，哈哈哈，哈哈哈哈哈哈。

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
... Huh?
scripts.translation:
[漢森娜]
... 咦？

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
Oh, it loos like you already have the Arunafeltz's Desert Sandwich.
scripts.translation:
[漢森娜]
哦，看起來你已經有了阿魯納菲茲的沙漠三明治。

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
You should eat that up before it gets rotten. Maybe it's gone bad already.
Haha, hahaha, hahahahahahahahaha.
scripts.translation:
[漢森娜]
你應該在它腐爛之前把它吃掉。也許它已經變質了。
哈哈，哈哈哈，哈哈哈哈哈哈。

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
Ah!!! You have it?
scripts.translation:
[漢森娜]
啊！！！你有嗎？

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
Oh, you really have those!
scripts.translation:
[漢森娜]
哦，你真的有那些！

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
Are you sure you want to give these to me?
scripts.translation:
[漢森娜]
你確定要把這些給我嗎？

scripts.text: No way.
scripts.translation: 不行。

scripts.text: Sure.
scripts.translation: 當然。

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
No way. Yes way. This way. That way.
Haha, hahaha, hahahahahahahahaha.
scripts.translation:
[漢森娜]
不行。行。這樣。那樣。
哈哈，哈哈哈，哈哈哈哈哈哈。

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
Ohhhhh, thank you!
Ehhmmm, thank you!
Geeeee, thank you!
Haha, hahaha, hahahahahahahahaha.
scripts.translation:
[漢森娜]
噢噢噢，謝謝你！
呃嗯，謝謝你！
哎呀呀，謝謝你！
哈哈，哈哈哈，哈哈哈哈哈哈。

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
You haven't got any.
scripts.translation:
[漢森娜]
你還沒有啊。

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
How about getting some?
Haha, hahaha, hahahahahahahahaha.
scripts.translation:
[漢森娜]
要不要去弄一些？
哈哈，哈哈哈，哈哈哈哈哈哈。

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
Sasquatch Hydra!!!
scripts.translation:
[漢森娜]
雪熊海葵！！！

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
Haha, hahaha, hahahahahahahahaha.
scripts.translation:
[漢森娜]
哈哈，哈哈哈，哈哈哈哈哈哈。

scripts.text:
[Taab]
How may I help you?
scripts.translation:
[塔布]
有什麼可以幫您的嗎？

scripts.text: What is this place?
scripts.translation: 這是什麼地方？

scripts.text: I'm here for a job.
scripts.translation: 我來找工作的。

scripts.text: No, thanks.
scripts.translation: 不用了，謝謝。

scripts.text:
[Taab]
This is where we keep creatures
captured here in Ash Vacuum.
We study them to understand
their characteristics and habits.
scripts.translation:
[塔布]
這裡存放著我們在阿什真空捕獲的生物。
我們研究它們，以瞭解它們的特徵和習性。

scripts.text:
[Taab]
Of course, scholars and
specialists perform the studies.
I'm here to tame and breed
dangerous monsters.
scripts.translation:
[塔布]
當然，研究和專業工作是由學者和專家進行的。
我負責馴服和繁殖危險的魔物。

scripts.text:
[Taab]
...I hope I can carry them
around as my pets.
Hillstions are so cute.
You can't find such an
animal on the mainland,
you know?
scripts.translation:
[塔布]
...我希望能把它們當作我的寵物帶著。
希爾里昂太可愛了。
你在大陸上是找不到這種動物的，你知道嗎？

scripts.text:
[Taab]
I'm sorry, but I don't need any assistance right now.
I'll make an official anouncement if I need help.
Please come back then.
scripts.translation:
[塔布]
抱歉，我現在不需要任何幫助。
如果需要幫忙，我會發布正式公告的。
請到時候再來。

scripts.text:
[Taab]
Welcome.
Your job is simple:
help me out by gathering
the animals' feed or by
cleaning their cages.
These are the available jobs.
scripts.translation:
[塔布]
歡迎。
你的工作很簡單：
幫我收集動物的飼料，或者清理它們的籠子。
以下是可用的工作。

scripts.text:
[Taab]
Please bring me 50 Fresh Fish.
They're feed for Tatachoes.
I'm fresh out, and I'll need to restock very soon.
scripts.translation:
[塔布]
請給我帶50個美味的魚。
它們是塔塔喬的飼料。
我剛好用完了，很快就需要補充。

scripts.text:
[Taab]
You can find them from Tatachoes in the fields.
Strange, isn't it?
I don't know where they've caught the fish.
scripts.translation:
[塔布]
你可以在田地裡從塔塔喬那裡找到它們。
奇怪，不是嗎？
我不知道它們是從哪裡抓到的魚。

scripts.text:
[Taab]
Thank you in advance.
Please bring me feed for Tatachoes: ^4d4dff50 Fresh Fish^000000.
scripts.translation:
[塔布]
提前謝謝你了。
請給我帶塔塔喬的飼料：^4d4dff50個美味的魚^000000。

scripts.text:
[Taab]
I've just run out of
feed for Cornuses.
Can you please bring me
^4d4dff30 Great Leaves and 30 Brown Roots^000000?
scripts.translation:
[塔布]
我剛好用完了科努斯的飼料。
你能幫我帶^4d4dff30片大葉子和30個褐色樹根^000000嗎？

scripts.text:
[Taab]
You can find them from
Pinguiculas in the fields.
Thank you in advance.
scripts.translation:
[塔布]
你可以在田地裡從捕蟲堇那裡找到它們。
提前謝謝你了。

scripts.text:
[Taab]
I've just run out of
feed for Hillsrions.
Scholars think these
guys are members
of the cat family.
I've been trying to feed
them various things.
scripts.translation:
[塔布]
我剛好用完了希爾里昂的飼料。
學者們認為這些傢伙是貓科動物。
我一直在嘗試餵它們各種東西。

scripts.text:
[Taab]
This time... I'd like to
try Monster's Feed.
Can you please bring me
^4d4dff20 Monster's Feeds and 30 Pet Foods^000000?
scripts.translation:
[塔布]
這次...我想試試魔物飼料。
你能幫我帶^4d4dff20個魔物飼料和30個寵物飼料^000000嗎？

scripts.text:
[Taab]
Thank you in advance.
Don't forget the
20 Monster's Feeds
and 30 Pet Foods.
I hope the Hallsrions
will like them.
scripts.translation:
[塔布]
提前謝謝你了。
別忘了
20個魔物飼料
和30個寵物飼料。
我希望希爾里昂會喜歡它們。

scripts.text:
[Taab]
This is perfect because
I was going to try some
new feed for Hillsrions.
I tried Monster's Feed,
but I don't know if they
liked it or not.
scripts.translation:
[塔布]
這正好，因為我正打算給希爾里昂試試新的飼料。
我試過魔物飼料，
但不知道它們喜不喜歡。

scripts.text:
[Taab]
I want to try Meat this time.
Can you please bring me
^4d4dff50 Meat^000000 and ^4d4dff30 Pet Foods^000000?
scripts.translation:
[塔布]
這次我想試試肉。
你能幫我帶^4d4dff50個肉^000000和^4d4dff30個寵物飼料^000000嗎？

scripts.text:
[Taab]
Thank you in advance.
Don't forget the
^4d4dff50 Meat^000000 and ^4d4dff30 Pet Foods^000000
I really hope they'll like the Meat.
scripts.translation:
[塔布]
提前謝謝你了。
別忘了
^4d4dff50個肉^000000和^4d4dff30個寵物飼料^000000。
我真的希望它們會喜歡肉。

scripts.text:
[Taab]
Oh, I always wanted to put something warm on the floor for my creatures.
I was thinking of using fur.
I can also use fur to cover the cage during rainy days, you know?
scripts.translation:
[塔布]
哦，我一直想給這些生物在地上鋪點暖和的東西。
我在考慮用毛皮。
下雨天也可以用毛皮蓋住籠子，你知道嗎？

scripts.text:
[Taab]
Can you please bring me ^4d4dff30 scraps of fur^000000?
It sounds easy, doesn't it?
I think the fur of Tatachoes and Hillsrions will be perfect.
scripts.translation:
[塔布]
你能幫我帶^4d4dff30片毛皮^000000嗎？
聽起來很簡單，對吧？
我覺得塔塔喬和希爾里昂的毛皮會很完美。

scripts.text:
[Taab]
Of course, I'm not going to use them for the cages with the Tatachoes and Hillsrions.
Those furs will be for the Cornuses.
scripts.translation:
[塔布]
當然，我不會把它們用在關著塔塔喬和希爾里昂的籠子上。
那些毛皮是給飛馬用的。

scripts.text:
[Taab]
It seems Cornuses love being warm.
The weather in this area is so strange that I'm having a hard time optimizing the temperature for each kind of creature.
scripts.translation:
[塔布]
看來飛馬很喜歡暖和。
這裡的天氣很奇怪，我很難為每種生物找到最適宜的溫度。

scripts.text:
[Taab]
Thank you in advance.
Don't forget the 30 scraps of fur.
scripts.translation:
[塔布]
提前謝謝你了。
別忘了30片毛皮。

scripts.text:
[Taab]
Oh, I'm sorry, but no jobs are available right now.
Some other part-timers finished all the work.
scripts.translation:
[塔布]
哦，很抱歉，現在沒有工作可做。
其他兼職人員已經把所有工作都做完了。

scripts.text:
[Taab]
I'm sorry for the trouble I must have caused you to come here. Haha...
I'll see you next time.
scripts.translation:
[塔布]
很抱歉讓你白跑一趟。哈哈...
下次再見。

scripts.text:
[Taab]
Please stay far away from the cages.
Sometimes, the creatures try to escape their cages.
scripts.translation:
[塔布]
請離籠子遠一點。
有時候，這些生物會試圖逃出籠子。

scripts.text:
[Taab]
Oh, thanks!
You brought them their food!
Just in time too: they look
like they're ready to chow down.
The Tatachoes will love these.
scripts.translation:
[塔布]
哦，謝謝！
你給它們帶來了食物！
正好趕上：它們看起來正準備大快朵頤。
塔塔喬會喜歡這些的。

scripts.text:
[Taab]
I really want to give you
something in return...
But I have nothing
material to give you.
How about a spiritual reward?
scripts.translation:
[塔布]
我真的想給你點什麼作為回報...
但我沒有什麼物質上的東西可以給你。
要不給你個精神獎勵？

30 Furs. They're for the Cornus' cage.

它們是給飛馬籠子的。

scripts.text:

Thank you for
helping me last time.
We have a constant
flow of part-time work.
I hope you'll come by
to help me again.

謝謝上次的幫忙。
我們一直有零工需求。
希望你會再來幫我。

scripts.text:

Thank you for your
help last time.

我有足夠的飼料
和物資可以撐一陣子。
謝謝上次的幫忙。

any assistance for now...
{0},
why don't you go rest?
scripts.translation:

什麼幫助了...
{0}，
你不如去休息一下吧？

scripts.text:

scripts.text:
[Taab]
Please step aside! It's dangerous
to get too close to those
creatures. You don't look like a
member of the expedition.
I guess you're not allowed
to be here. Please leave.
scripts.translation:
[塔布]
請讓開！
離那些生物太近很危險。
你看起來不像
是探險隊的一員。
我想你不被允許
待在這裡。請離開。

scripts.text:
It is hissing in a low voice.
Sometimes it purrs, too.
It must be in a happy mood.
scripts.translation:
它正用低沉的聲音嘶嘶作響。
有時還會打呼嚕。
它一定心情不錯。

scripts.text:
[Taab]
Oh, please don't disturb
it's sleep. It hates that.
By the way, doesn't it
remind you of something?
I mean, like maybe
a vagrant or a hobo?
scripts.translation:
[塔布]
哦，請別打擾
它睡覺。它討厭那樣。
順便問一下，它
有沒有讓你想起什麼？
我是說，比如
流浪漢或乞丐？

scripts.text:
[Taab]
Oh, please don't get
too close to it or try to
feed something strange.
It's pretty sensitive...
scripts.translation:
[塔布]
哦，請別靠得太近
或餵它奇怪的東西。
它很敏感...

scripts.text: No. thanks

I want to eat fish.
scripts.translation:

scripts.text:
[Cat Paw Agent]

scripts.translation:

scripts.text:
[Fluffy Gyaruk]
*Sniff Sniff* Can't you smell fish
around here?
scripts.translation:
[毛茸茸的 吉亞魯克]
*嗅嗅* 你聞不到附近有魚的味道嗎？

scripts.text:
[Fluffy Gyaruk]
Hmm?
Oh, did the Cat Paw Agent send you?
scripts.translation:
[毛茸茸的 吉亞魯克]
嗯？
哦，是貓爪特工派你來的嗎？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text:
[Fluffy Gyaruk]
Oh, okay...
Well, where should I begin.
(Mumble Mumble)
scripts.translation:
[毛茸茸的 吉亞魯克]
哦，好的...
那麼，我該從哪裡開始說起呢。
*咕噥咕噥*

scripts.text: What do you guys do?
scripts.translation: 你們公司是做什麼的？

scripts.text:
[Fluffy Gyaruk]
Oh, sure.
I can start from there.
You used Kafra Corporation services on the Midgard Continent, didn't you?
scripts.translation:
[毛茸茸的 吉亞魯克]
哦，當然可以。
我可以從那裡開始。
你在米德加爾特大陸使用過卡普拉公司的服務，對吧？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text:
[Fluffy Gyaruk]
Cat Trading is a new trading company based on this undeveloped continent.
scripts.translation:
[毛茸茸的 吉亞魯克]
貓貿易是一家基於這片未開發大陸的新興貿易公司。

scripts.text:
[Fluffy Gyaruk]
Well, frankly we wanted to join the Midgard Market, but it was too competitive...
Not only that, they don't have enough fish for all of us either... (Mumble Mumble)
scripts.translation:
[毛茸茸的 吉亞魯克]
說實話，我們本來想加入米德加爾特市場的，但那裡的競爭太激烈了...
而且，那裡的魚也不夠我們所有人吃的... *咕噥咕噥*

scripts.text: What services do you offer?
scripts.translation: 你們提供什麼服務？

scripts.text:
[Fluffy Gyaruk]
*Purr* Oh, our service range is similar to the Kafra's Location Saving, Storage Service, Warp Service, and more.
scripts.translation:
[毛茸茸的 吉亞魯克]
*呼嚕* 哦，我們的服務範圍與卡普拉的地點儲存、倉庫服務、傳送服務類似，還有更多。

scripts.text:
[Fluffy Gyaruk]
The only difference is that, our services are limited depending on the customer's credit.
scripts.translation:
[毛茸茸的 吉亞魯克]
唯一的區別是，我們的服務會根據顧客的信用額度而有所限制。

scripts.text: Credit?
scripts.translation: 信用額度？

scripts.text:
[Fluffy Gyaruk]
As you might know already, we're a considerably small company struggling to make ends meet in this niche market.
We desperately need your support to grow.
scripts.translation:
[毛茸茸的 吉亞魯克]
您可能已經知道了，我們是一家相當小的公司，在這個小眾市場中艱難求生。
我們迫切需要您的支援來發展壯大。

scripts.text:
[Fluffy Gyaruk]
You can increase your credit by helping us secure our food or by collecting minerals.
scripts.translation:
[毛茸茸的 吉亞魯克]
您可以通過幫助我們獲取食物或收集礦石來增加您的信用額度。

scripts.text:
[Fluffy Gyaruk]
The more credits you earn, the more services you can use. You can also apply for special events.
Say, how'd you like to make a membership contract with us?
scripts.translation:
[毛茸茸的 吉亞魯克]
您獲得的信用額度越多，能使用的服務就越多。您還可以申請參加特殊活動。
那麼，您願意與我們簽訂會員契約嗎？

scripts.text: Sure.
scripts.translation: 當然。

scripts.text: I need to think it over.
scripts.translation: 我需要再考慮一下。

scripts.text:
[Fluffy Gyaruk]
Excellent! Thank you for joining the Cat Trading membership service.
We hope you'll support our exploration of this unknown land.
scripts.translation:
[毛茸茸的 吉亞魯克]
太好了！感謝您加入貓貿易會員服務。
希望您能支援我們探索這片未知的土地。

scripts.text:
[Fluffy Gyaruk]
Please go speak to the Cat Paw Agent over there to use a basic service.
Oh, and please come back afterwards.
scripts.translation:
[毛茸茸的 吉亞魯克]
請去那邊和貓爪特工對話，以使用基礎服務。
哦，之後請回來找我。

scripts.text:
[Fluffy Gyaruk]
How disappointing!
But I understand.
scripts.translation:
[毛茸茸的 吉亞魯克]
真令人失望！
但我理解。

scripts.text:
[Fluffy Gyaruk]
We offer one service to new customers.
If you want to use more services, you must do some things for us.
scripts.translation:
[毛茸茸的 吉亞魯克]
我們為每位新顧客提供一次服務。
如果您想使用更多服務，就必須為我們做一些事情。

scripts.text: What kind of things?
scripts.translation: 做什麼樣的事情？

scripts.text:
[Fluffy Gyaruk]
For now...
Please catch the main dish of the Cat Trading employees, fish, and collect minerals once every day.
Your credit will increase each day if you do those things.
scripts.translation:
[毛茸茸的 吉亞魯克]
目前...
請每天捕捉貓貿易員工的主菜——魚，並收集一次礦石。
如果您每天完成這些任務，您的信用額度就會增加。

scripts.text:
[Fluffy Gyaruk]
Of course, we'll reward you with a reasonable amount of EXP for the services.
scripts.translation:
[毛茸茸的 吉亞魯克]
當然，我們會為您提供合理的經驗值作為服務的獎勵。

scripts.text:
[Fluffy Gyaruk]
This is a good opportunity to increase your credit and EXP ate the same time.
Doesn't that sound like a win-win situation?
Would you like to start now?
scripts.translation:
[毛茸茸的 吉亞魯克]
這是一個同時增加信用額度和經驗值的好機會。
聽起來是不是雙贏的局面？
您想現在開始嗎？

scripts.text: Sure.
scripts.translation: 當然。

scripts.text: I need to go prepare first.
scripts.translation: 我需要先準備一下。

scripts.text:
[Fluffy Gyaruk]
Excellent.
For more information about fishing and mining, please speak to the two Cat Agents standing at the river over there.
scripts.translation:
[毛茸茸的 吉亞魯克]
太好了。
如需瞭解釣魚和採礦的更多資訊，請去那邊河邊找兩位貓特工對話。

scripts.text:
[Fluffy Gyaruk]
No problem.
Please take your time.
scripts.translation:
[毛茸茸的 吉亞魯克]
沒問題。
請慢慢來。

scripts.text:
[Fluffy Gyaruk]
For more information about fishing and mining, please speak to the two Cat Agents standing at the river over there.
scripts.translation:
[毛茸茸的 吉亞魯克]
如需瞭解釣魚和採礦的更多資訊，請去那邊河邊找兩位貓特工對話。

scripts.text:
[Fluffy Gyaruk]
Your current credit points with us are ^0000FF{0}^000000.
scripts.translation:
[毛茸茸的 吉亞魯克]
您目前的信用額度為 ^0000FF{0}^000000。

scripts.text: How can I increase my points?
scripts.translation: 我該如何增加點數？

scripts.text: I'm not interested.
scripts.translation: 我不感興趣。

scripts.text:
[Cat Paw Agent]
You can increase them daily by fishing and mining, you need to submit caught Pieces of Fish to Gorurung and minerals to the Mining Agent.
scripts.translation:
[貓爪特工]
您可以通過每天釣魚和採礦來增加點數，您需要將捕獲的魚塊提交給戈魯魯格，將礦石提交給採礦特工。

scripts.text:
[Ferocious Gorurug]
Grrr....
scripts.translation:
[兇猛的 戈魯魯格]
咕嚕嚕....

scripts.text:
A cat purring like a lion
is looking into the water.
scripts.translation:
一隻像獅子一樣發出咕嚕聲的貓
正看著水面。

scripts.text:
[Ferocious Gorurug]
I'm busy.
I need to catch fish.
scripts.translation:
[兇猛的 戈魯魯格]
我很忙。
我需要抓魚。

scripts.text: Gyaruk has sent me.
scripts.translation: 吉亞魯克派我來的。

scripts.text:
[Ferocious Gorurug]
Gyaruk sent you?
Oh, you are here to fish? *Purr*
scripts.translation:
[兇猛的 戈魯魯格]
吉亞魯克派你來的？
哦，你是來釣魚的？*咕嚕*

scripts.text: What should I do?
scripts.translation: 我該做什麼？

scripts.text:
[Ferocious Gorurug]
You need to catch fish. There are schools of fish in the waters.
It's hard to see them but if you use your cursor to click around, you should be able to catch them.
scripts.translation:
[兇猛的 戈魯魯格]
你需要抓魚。水裡有魚群。
雖然很難看清，但如果你用游標在周圍點選，應該就能抓到它們。

scripts.text:
[Ferocious Gorurug]
It's easier to fish in the water outside the town.
If you're not afraid of monsters, you can go fishing over there.
*Purr*
scripts.translation:
[兇猛的 戈魯魯格]
在城鎮外的水域釣魚更容易。
如果你不怕魔物，可以去那邊釣魚。
*咕嚕*

scripts.text:
[Ferocious Gorurug]
Now, let me teach you how to fish.
It's simple: bring your cursor to a school of fish, and then click it to grab them.
scripts.translation:
[兇猛的 戈魯魯格]
現在，讓我教你怎麼釣魚。
很簡單：把游標移到魚群上，然後點選它們抓住它們。

scripts.text:
[Ferocious Gorurug]
You'll have a hard time to catch them at first, but you'll get better.
It gets easier with a bit of practice.
scripts.translation:
[兇猛的 戈魯魯格]
一開始你會很難抓到它們，但你會越來越熟練。
練習幾次就會變得容易了。

scripts.text:
[Ferocious Gorurug]
You've brough Pieces of Fish!
GOOD JOB!
scripts.translation:
[兇猛的 戈魯魯格]
你帶來了魚塊！
幹得好！

scripts.text: ^0000ffYou gain EXP {0}^000000

[Ferocious Gorurug]
Bring your cursor to a school of fish, then click it to grab them.
Don't move while doing it!
scripts.translation:
[兇猛的 戈魯魯格]
把游標移到魚群上，然後點選它們抓住它們。
操作時不要移動！

scripts.text:
[Ferocious Gorurug]
You've brough Pieces of Fish!
GOOD JOB!
scripts.translation:
[兇猛的 戈魯魯格]
你帶來了魚塊！
幹得好！

scripts.text: ^0000ffYou gain EXP 15,000^000000

[Ferocious Gorurug]
Do you want to fish again?
Don't forget to bring me
Pieces of Fish if you catch them.
scripts.translation:
[兇猛的 戈魯魯格]
你想再釣一次嗎？
如果你抓到了魚，
別忘了帶魚塊給我。

scripts.text:
[Ferocious Gorurug]
You've brough Pieces of Fish!
GOOD JOB!
scripts.translation:
[兇猛的 戈魯魯格]
你帶來了魚塊！
幹得好！

scripts.text: ^0000ffYou gain EXP 15,000^000000

[Ferocious Gorurug]
Hey, I've been waiting for you!
Good luck fishing today!
scripts.translation:
[兇猛的 戈魯魯格]
嘿，我一直在等你！
祝你今天釣魚順利！

scripts.text:
[Ferocious Gorurug]
You've brough Pieces of Fish!
GOOD JOB!
scripts.translation:
[兇猛的 戈魯魯格]
你帶來了魚塊！
幹得好！

scripts.text: ^0000ffYou gain EXP 15,000^000000
Gorurug looks happy to see you.
scripts.translation: 戈魯魯格看到你很高興。

scripts.text:
[Ferocious Gorurug]
What do you want to catch today? *Purr*
scripts.translation:
[兇猛的 戈魯魯格]
今天你想抓什麼？*咕嚕*

scripts.text:
[Ferocious Gorurug]
You've brough Pieces of Fish!
GOOD JOB!
scripts.translation:
[兇猛的 戈魯魯格]
你帶來了魚塊！
幹得好！

scripts.text: ^0000ffYou gain EXP 1,500^000000
Gorurung welcomes you with a happy purr.
scripts.translation: 戈魯魯格用快樂的咕嚕聲歡迎你。

scripts.text:
[Ferocious Gorurug]
Welcome!
You're here to give me fishes, aren't you?
scripts.translation:
[兇猛的 戈魯魯格]
歡迎！
你是來給我送魚的，對吧？

scripts.text: Ferocious Gorurug is asleep.
scripts.translation: 兇猛的 戈魯魯格正在睡覺。

scripts.text:
[Ferocious Gorurug]
*Yawn*
I'm sorry, but I'm off-duty.
I can't accept any fish right now.
Come back tomorrow, alright?
scripts.translation:
[兇猛的 戈魯魯格]
*打哈欠*
抱歉，我現在下班了。
我現在不能接收任何魚。
明天再來，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Ferocious Gorurug]
*Purr*
Another day has started, back to work!
You can now bring me fish if you catch them.
scripts.translation:
[兇猛的 戈魯魯格]
*咕嚕*
新的一天開始了，繼續工作！
如果你抓到了魚，現在可以帶給我了。

scripts.text: Nothing was caught.
scripts.translation: 沒有抓到任何東西。

scripts.text: Fish are swimming in the water.
scripts.translation: 魚在水裡遊動。

scripts.text:
[Henry Clifford]
Congratulations, you've caught a precious Marlin.
I'll give you 2 Cat Trading Points in exchange for your Marlin.
scripts.translation:
[亨利·克利福德]
恭喜，你抓到了一條珍貴的旗魚。
作為交換，我將給你2個貓爪積分。

scripts.text:
[Henry Clifford]
I got them from a black marketer,
but I guarantee the authenticity of these points.
Are you interested?
scripts.translation:
[亨利·克利福德]
這些積分是我從一個黑市商人那裡弄來的，
但我保證它們的真實性。
你有興趣嗎？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text: No, thanks.
scripts.translation: 不用了，謝謝。

scripts.text:
[Henry Clifford]
Thank you for the Marlin.
I've given you the points in return.
You may go check your points through the Cat Paw Agent.
scripts.translation:
[亨利·克利福德]
謝謝你的旗魚。
我已經把積分給你了。
你可以通過貓爪特工檢視你的積分。

scripts.text:
[Henry Clifford]
Alright, if you say so.
But feel free to come back if you change your mind.
scripts.translation:
[亨利·克利福德]
好吧，既然你這麼說。
如果你改變主意，隨時歡迎回來。

scripts.text:
[Henry Clifford]
You may have hear
about this already, but
this river is full of rare fish.
I've followed these cats
to see if the rumor is true.
scripts.translation:
[亨利·克利福德]
你可能已經聽說了，
這條河裡有很多稀有的魚。
我跟著這些貓來到這裡，
想看看傳聞是否屬實。

scripts.text:
[Henry Clifford]
Marlin, the legendary silver
fish is the best prey of all.
You can also catch precious
treasure floating in the river.
scripts.translation:
[亨利·克利福德]
旗魚，傳說中的銀色魚類，
是這裡最好的獵物。
你還可以抓到漂浮在河裡的珍貴寶物。

scripts.text:
[Henry Clifford]
If you happen to catch a Marlin,
please trade it with me.
I'll give you something
nice in return.
scripts.translation:
[亨利·克利福德]
如果你碰巧抓到旗魚，
請把它交給我。
我會給你一些不錯的回報。

scripts.text:
[Cat Paw Mining Agent]
Oh, wow~
Thank you for collecting minerals for me.
scripts.translation:
[貓爪採礦特派員]
哇哦~
謝謝你幫我收集礦石。

scripts.text: I'm freezing! Take them quickly.
scripts.translation: 我快凍死了！快收走它們。

scripts.text:
[Cat Paw Mining Agent]
Yes, yes~ I've received the mineral samples.
I'll go ahead and add points to your credit.
scripts.translation:
[貓爪採礦特派員]
是的，是的~ 我已經收到礦石樣本了。
我會把積分加到你的賬戶裡。

scripts.text:
[Cat Paw Mining Agent]
To collect minerals,
we have to go to the
frozen land to the east.
But for short-haired cats
like me, the weather
is unbearable.
scripts.translation:
[貓爪採礦特派員]
要收集礦石，
我們必須去東邊的凍土。
但對於像我這樣的短毛貓來說，
那裡的天氣太難以忍受了。

scripts.text:
[Cat Paw Mining Agent]
If the weather
is good tomorrow,
I might try to go,
but not today.
It looks freezing to
you too, doesn't it?
scripts.translation:
[貓爪採礦特派員]
如果明天天氣好，
我可能會去試試，
但今天不行。
看起來對你來說也很冷，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Cat Paw Mining Agent]
I hope you'll bring me minerals again tomorrow...
If you can. It's much better to wait for you to do it than go there on my own.
scripts.translation:
[貓爪採礦特派員]
希望明天你還能給我帶礦石來...
如果你能的話。等你去帶回來比我親自去好多了。

scripts.text:
[Cat Paw Mining Agent]
Umm... It's time to collect minerals.
How'd you like to collect minerals for me?
scripts.translation:
[貓爪採礦特派員]
嗯... 是時候收集礦石了。
你願意幫我收集礦石嗎？

scripts.text:
This rock contains unidentified minerals.
It's not possible to mine more than the limit.
scripts.translation:
這塊岩石含有未確認礦石。
無法開採超過上限的數量。

scripts.text:
Cat trading Point adjust
You can enter the number between 1~3000.
scripts.translation:
貓爪積分調整
你可以輸入1~3000之間的數字。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
*Sigh* Look at me, I used to command the desert of Morocc, but I've been deployed to a world that only God knows where...
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
*嘆氣* 看看我，我曾經指揮著摩洛哥的沙漠，但現在卻被部署到一個連上帝都不知道在哪裡的世界...

scripts.text:
[Staff Officer Abidal]
Come on'that's not ture. In fact, you used to be an official of a small town, and have been promoted to the commander of the expedition.
Your success is almost too good to be true.
scripts.translation:
[參謀 阿比達爾]
別這麼說。事實上，你以前只是一個小城鎮的官員，後來被提拔為遠征隊的指揮官。
你的成功簡直好得難以置信。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Igrid]
Hey, boss. Can we just go through the motions until we get out of here? This so-called Ash-Vacuum is boring. It's heaven for the kingdom's scholars, but it's not for me.
scripts.translation:
[指導員 伊格麗德]
嘿，老闆。我們能不能就敷衍了事，趕緊離開這裡？這個所謂的“阿什真空”太無聊了。對王國的學者來說這是天堂，但對我來說不是。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Geez, do you have to keep calling me boss? It's Commander, alright?
Hmpf! So disrespectful.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
天哪，你能不能別一直叫我老闆？我是指揮官，懂嗎？
哼！真沒禮貌。

scripts.text:
[Staff Officer Abidal]
Can you guys stop complaining?
God...
scripts.translation:
[參謀 阿比達爾]
你們能不能別抱怨了？
真是的...

scripts.text:
[Instructor Igrid]
Who are you? What business do you have with Commander Agip?
scripts.translation:
[指導員 伊格麗德]
你是誰？找阿吉普指揮官有什麼事？

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
What is it?
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
什麼事？

scripts.text:
[Staff Officer Abidal]
Err? Hey, aren't you that famous adventurer,{0}? I've heard many good things about you.
scripts.translation:
[參謀 阿比達爾]
咦？嘿，你難道就是那位著名的冒險者，{0}？我聽說過很多關於你的好事。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Igrid]
I don't know what you're talking about. Boss, do you know this adventurer?
scripts.translation:
[指導員 伊格麗德]
我不知道你在說什麼。老闆，你認識這位冒險者嗎？

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Stop calling me boss! Call me Commander, alright? Hey Abidal, is this adventurer really famous?
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
別叫我老闆！叫我指揮官，懂嗎？嘿，阿比達爾，這位冒險者真的很有名嗎？

scripts.text:
[Staff Officer Abidal]
Commander, haven't you read the report? The adventurer who helped the expedition solve the XX case was{0}.
scripts.translation:
[參謀 阿比達爾]
指揮官，您沒看報告嗎？幫助遠征隊解決XX事件的冒險者就是{0}。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
*Ahem Ahem* I see. I've been too busy to read all the reports. So what brings you here? A reward?
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
*咳咳* 原來如此。我最近太忙了，沒空看所有的報告。那你來這裡是為什麼？為了獎勵嗎？

scripts.text:
[Staff Officer Abidal]
This is perfect. I was going to send a messenger to you for an important discussion.
scripts.translation:
[參謀 阿比達爾]
真是巧了。我正準備派信使去找您，有一件重要的事要商量。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Hey Abidal, he's here to see me, not you. Remember?
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
嘿，阿比達爾，他是來見我的，不是見你的。記住了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Staff Officer Abidal]
Commander, please let me talk. {0}I'd like to talk to you privately. Can you come back later?
scripts.translation:
[參謀 阿比達爾]
指揮官，請讓我說。{0}我想和您私下談談。您能稍後再回來嗎？

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Why do you want to talk privately?
Is it because of me? Grrr... I'll be watching you, Abidal.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
為什麼要私下談？
是因為我嗎？哼...我會盯著你的，阿比達爾。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Igrid]
What are you still doing here? Go, go speak to Abidal.
scripts.translation:
[指導員 伊格麗德]
你還在這裡幹什麼？去吧，去和阿比達爾對話。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
I'm not the one who has business with you. You should go speak to Staff Officer Abidal.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
我才是和你有公事的人。你應該去和參謀 阿比達爾對話。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Oh yes, right... You're{0}, right? Abidal has told me good things about you.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
哦對了...你是{0}，對吧？阿比達爾跟我說過你的很多好事。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
We're lucky to have you, my friend... I hope you're as good as the stories play you up to be.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
能有你真是我們的幸運，我的朋友...希望你像傳說裡那樣優秀。

scripts.text:
[Staff Officer Abidal]
Commander, please!
scripts.translation:
[參謀 阿比達爾]
指揮官，求您了！

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Alright, alright. gosh will you stop yelling at me?
You're not going to live long if you get angry at all the little things.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
好了好了。天哪，你能不能別對我大吼大叫？
如果你因為一點小事就生氣，是活不長久的。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Anyways, I took some time to check your background and reports of your accomplishments.
I must say that I'm quite impressed.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
總之，我花了一些時間查閱了你的背景和業績報告。
不得不說，我相當印象深刻。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
As you know by now, I have to send out an expedition report to the national leaders of the Midgard continent, and I need someone that I can trust.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
想必你也知道了，我必須向米德加爾特大陸各國的領導人傳送遠征報告書，而我需要找一個值得信任的人。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
I'd go if I could, but my duty is to command, and my instructor over there is too dense. He'll embarrass me by acting stupid in front of the national leaders.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
要是能去的話我肯定親自去了，但我的職責是指揮。而且那邊的指導員太遲鈍了，他會在各國領導人面前做出蠢事，讓我丟臉的。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Igrid]
Come on, boss... Er, Commander!
Don't you think you're exaggerating?
scripts.translation:
[指導員 伊格麗德]
拜託了，老闆...啊不，指揮官！
您覺得您是不是有點誇張了？

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Hmm... Anyways, this is not a difficult mission. All you have to do is deliver this expedition report to officials of three countries of Midgard. Simple right?
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
嗯...總之，這並不是一項困難的任務。你只需要把這份遠征報告書送到米德加爾特三個國家的官員那裡就行了。很簡單吧？

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
The officials are ^0000FFMinister Laur^000000 of the Rune-Midgarts' Kingdom, ^0000FFPriest Nuria^000000 of Arunafeltz, and ^0000FFGerhart^000000 of the Schwatzvalt Republic.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
這些官員分別是：盧恩·米德加茲王國的^0000FF大臣 勞爾^000000、阿魯納菲茲的^0000FF牧師 努莉亞^000000，以及施瓦茨瓦爾特共和國的^0000FF格哈特^000000。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
A messenger, who will inform the official of your arrival, is waiting for you at the time-space gap to Midgard. You'd better find him before you leave.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
在通往米德加爾特的時間空間裂縫處，有一位信使在等你，他會通知官員你的到來。你最好在離開之前找到他。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Since the officials are busy attending to national matters, they won't meet you unless they're informed of your arrival beforehand. I doubt those pretentious guys would even want to see me.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
由於官員們正忙於處理國家事務，除非提前通知他們你的到來，否則他們不會見你。我懷疑那些自命不凡的傢伙甚至都不願意見我。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Travel safely, adventurer, and come back in one piece, alright?
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
旅途平安，冒險者，記得要全身而退，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Haven't you left yet? It's hard to make ends meet, isn't it?
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
你還沒走嗎？生活不易，不是嗎？

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
I mean, if you want to be paid, you'll have to work. Do you still not understand? I'm saying that you better proceed with your mission.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
我是說，如果你想拿報酬，就得幹活。你還沒明白嗎？我的意思是，你最好趕緊去執行任務。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Hmm...
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
嗯...

scripts.text:
[Staff Officer Abidal]
......
scripts.translation:
[參謀 阿比達爾]
......

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Alright, alright. I know why you've come to see me.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
好了好了。我知道你為什麼來見我了。

scripts.text:
[Staff Officer Abidal]
They haven't gotten the report yet. We should send out soldiers...
scripts.translation:
[參謀 阿比達爾]
他們還沒收到報告書。我們應該派士兵去...

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
That's not why I'm concerned. The problem is that the assignee failed to complete the mission and lost the report.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
我擔心的不是這個。問題是，負責的人沒能完成任務，並且丟失了報告書。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Anyways... It's alright. You don't have to feel bad. I understand you didn't mean it this way.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
總之...沒關係。你不用感到難過。我知道你不是故意的。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Igrid]
Commander, who might have done this? I will destroy him myself.
scripts.translation:
[指導員 伊格麗德]
指揮官，是誰幹的？我要親手毀了他。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Don't impose. Our troops aren't just from one nation, they are from thre different countries, and are here to pursue their country's own interest.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
別衝動。我們的部隊不僅僅來自一個國家，而是來自三個不同的國家，他們在這裡是為了追求各自國家的利益。

scripts.text:
[Staff Officer Abidal]
Hard to say... who is behind this. If I had to guess, either side could be behind this...
scripts.translation:
[參謀 阿比達爾]
很難說...幕後黑手是誰。如果非要我猜的話，可能是任何一方...

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
*Spit* This is why I don't trust politicians. Abidal, resolving this incident is your top priority.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
*啐* 這就是我不信任政客的原因。阿比達爾，解決這次事件是你的首要任務。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Igrid, evaluate the security of this camp and discipline among the soldiers.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
伊格麗德，評估一下這個營地的安全狀況以及士兵們的紀律。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Now it's your turn... Abidal disposed reports from various departments after he used them to compile the expedition report.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
現在輪到你了...阿比達爾在利用各部門的報告編寫遠征隊報告書後，就把它們處理掉了。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
We take the security of our documents seriously. So... There are no extra copies of the expedition report.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
我們非常重視檔案的安全。所以...沒有遠征隊報告書的副本。

scripts.text:
[Staff Officer Abidal]
I still remember at least 30% of the document. I might be able to rewrite another...
scripts.translation:
[參謀 阿比達爾]
我至少還記得那份檔案30%的內容。也許我能重新寫一份...

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
I need it to be perfect. What can we do with only 30%?
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
我需要它完美無缺。只有30%的內容有什麼用？

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Hey, you must find the report. If you bring as may pages of the report as you can, then Abidal will use them to fill missing parts.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
嘿，你必須找到那份報告書。如果你能找回儘可能多的頁面，阿比達爾就能用它們來填補缺失的部分。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Some of them might have be consumed by monsters, or have found their way to the sea, but I don't care. You'll find them at all costs, and that's my order.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
有些頁面可能已經被魔物吞食，或者流落到了海里，但我不管。不惜一切代價找到它們，這是我的命令。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
I hope you'll do your best. You need to finish what you've started. We'll do our best to help you. Am I right, guys? Abidal? Igrid?
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
我希望你能盡力。既然開始了，就要做完。我們會盡力協助你。對吧，大家？阿比達爾？伊格麗德？

scripts.text:
[Staff Officer Abidal]
Of Course, I'm happy to...
scripts.translation:
[參謀 阿比達爾]
當然，我很樂意...

scripts.text:
[Instructor Igrid]
......
scripts.translation:
[指導員 伊格麗德]
......

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Now, search everywhere for the pages of that report. Staff Officer Abidal will bind them into the full report for you.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
好了，到處去找那份報告書的頁面吧。參謀阿比達爾會把它們裝訂成完整的報告書。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Ah, and... I've received a report that you tried to hand out the report to our enemy when the situation happened.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
啊，還有...我收到報告說，在事發時你試圖把報告書交給我們的敵人。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Igrid]
Argh...
scripts.translation:
[指導員 伊格麗德]
啊...

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Hahaha! You're smart, my friend. Of course, I don't like smart soldiers.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
哈哈！你很聰明，我的朋友。當然，我不喜歡聰明計程車兵。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Let me tell you this: I can care less about justice or righteousness, but loyalty and faithfulness are very important. Keep that in mind for your own good, alright?
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
讓我告訴你：正義或公理我毫不在意，但忠誠和信義非常重要。為了你好，記住這一點，明白嗎？

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
I wish you good luck in finding the pages. Try to clean any smudges off them when you find them, alright?
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
祝你在尋找頁面時好運。找到後記得把上面的汙漬清理乾淨，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Hmm...
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
嗯...

scripts.text:
[Staff Officer Abidal]
......
scripts.translation:
[參謀 阿比達爾]
......

Alright, alright. I know why you've come to see me.

scripts.text:
[Instructor Igrid]
Commander, I'll go find those evil scoundrels...
scripts.translation:
[指導員 伊格麗德]
指揮官，我去找那些卑鄙小人...

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:

別衝動。我們的部隊不僅僅來自一個國家，而是來自三個不同的國家，他們在這裡是為了追求各自國家的利益。

scripts.text:

I wonder who's behind this. Frankly, I must say that every country is a suspect.
scripts.translation:
[參謀 阿比達爾]
不知道幕後黑手是誰。老實說，每個國家都是嫌疑人。

scripts.text:

*Spit* This is why I don't trust politicians. Abidal, resolving this incident is your top priority.

......

......

scripts.translation:

好了，到處去找那份報告書的頁面吧。參謀阿比達爾會把它們裝訂成完整的報告書。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Ah, and... I've received a report that you fought hard against the enemy to protect the report from them.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
啊，還有...我收到報告說，你為了從敵人手中保護報告書而奮力戰鬥。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Igrid]
Umm...
scripts.translation:
[指導員 伊格麗德]
嗯...

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Hahaha, you're fearless and I can make good use of a soldier like you at any time of the day.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
哈哈，你真是無所畏懼。像你這樣計程車兵，無論何時我都能派上用場。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Let me tell you this, loyalty and faithfulness are very, very important. They may cause you hardship sometimes, but those qualities will guarantee you the last laugh.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
讓我告訴你，忠誠和信義非常重要。它們有時可能會讓你陷入困境，但這些品質終將讓你笑到最後。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
I wish you good luck in finding the pages. Try to clean any smudges off them when you find them, alright?
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
祝你在尋找頁面時好運。找到後記得把上面的汙漬清理乾淨，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Talk to my staff officer until you're finisehd finding the pages of the lost report. Right now, I'm swarmed with work.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
在找到遺失報告的所有頁面之前，請和我的參謀多交流。我現在被工作包圍了，忙得不可開交。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
I'm sure you'll easily find those if you keep your eyes open. I must warn you about the monsters around this area though. Who knows? They might love the taste of paper.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
只要你留心觀察，應該很容易找到它們。不過我要提醒你，這一帶有很多魔物。誰知道呢？它們可能很喜歡紙張的味道。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
How have you been doing? I've heard Igrid has personally send out his soldiers to support you guys.
Haven't you met them?
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
最近過得怎麼樣？聽說伊格麗德親自派出了士兵來支援你們。
你們見過他們了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
While searching for the report, look around and meet our soldiers.
They've been sent to help you and Abidal. Ask their help if you think you need it.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
在尋找報告的過程中，四處看看，認識一下我們計程車兵吧。
他們被派來協助你和阿比達爾。如果你覺得需要幫助，儘管向他們求助。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
So, the report has been restored successfully?
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
那麼，報告已經成功復原了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
This was finished more quickly than I thought. Let me see...
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
這比我預想的完成得更快。讓我看看...

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
It looks alright. I don't have to read this thoroughly because I trust Abidal.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
看起來沒問題。因為我相信阿比達爾，所以我不需要逐字逐句地仔細檢查。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Now, let's go back to your original mission. I'd like you to deliver this to the national leaders of the three countries of Midgard.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
好了，讓我們回到你最初的任務上。我希望你能將這份報告送達米德加爾特三個國家的國家領導人手中。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Dont worry too much, my friend.
I've arranged troops in the time-space gap to protect the report.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
別太擔心，我的朋友。
我已經在時空裂隙中安排了部隊來保護這份報告。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Of course, you can't see them because they're undercover soldiers under my direct command. Hahaha!
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
當然，你看不見他們，因為他們是直接受我指揮的臥底士兵。哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Let me remind you again. The officials are these three people: ^0000FFMinister Laur^000000 of the Rune-Midgarts Kingdom, ^0000FFPriest Nuria^000000 of Arunafeltz and ^0000FFGerhart^000000 of the Schwarzwald Republic.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
讓我再提醒你一次。官員是這三位：盧恩·米德加茲王國的^0000FF大臣 勞爾^000000、阿魯納菲茲的^0000FF牧師 努莉亞^000000，以及修瓦魯茲巴魯德共和國的^0000FF格哈特^000000。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Make sure to deliver the report to them without fail. Come back in one piece, alright?
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
務必確保將報告送達他們手中。平安歸來，好嗎？

scripts.text:

Let me remind you again. The officials are these three people: ^0000FFMinister Laur^000000 of the Rune-Midgarts Kingdom, ^0000FFPriest Nuria^000000 of Arunafeltz and ^0000FFGerhart^000000 of the Schwarzwald Republic.

scripts.translation:

務必確保將報告送達他們手中。平安歸來，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Is something wrong? Alright, we'll write another report for you.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
出什麼事了嗎？好吧，我們會為你再寫一份報告。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Let me remind you again. The officials are these three people: ^0000FFMinister Laur^000000 of the Rune-Midgarts Kingdom, ^0000FFPriest Nuria^000000 of Arunafeltz and ^0000FFGerhart^000000 of the Schwarzwald Republic.
scripts.translation:

讓我再提醒你一次。官員是這三位：盧恩·米德加茲王國的^0000FF大臣 勞爾^000000、阿魯納菲茲的^0000FF牧師 努莉亞^000000，以及修瓦魯茲巴魯德共和國的^0000FF格哈特^000000。

scripts.text:
