scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
務必確保將報告送達他們手中。平安歸來，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Let me remind you again. The officials are these three people: ^0000FFMinister Laur^000000 of the Rune-Midgarts Kingdom, ^0000FFPriest Nuria^000000 of Arunafeltz and ^0000FFGerhart^000000 of the Schwarzwald Republic.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
讓我再提醒你一次。官員是這三位：盧恩·米德加茲王國的^0000FF大臣 勞爾^000000、阿魯納菲茲的^0000FF牧師 努莉亞^000000，以及修瓦魯茲巴魯德共和國的^0000FF格哈特^000000。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Make sure to deliver the report to them without fail. Come back in one piece, alright?
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
務必確保將報告送達他們手中。平安歸來，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Oh, how was your trip? Hey, you look better than you did when you left. Did you drop by your hometown and enjoy great food or something?
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
哦，旅途如何？嘿，你看起來比出發時氣色好多了。難道你順路回了趟家鄉，享受了美食之類的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
So tell me, did you bring the report to all three national leaders? Good job.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
那麼告訴我，你把報告帶給三位國家領導人了嗎？幹得好。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
I understand there were some unforeseen obstacles we didn't anticipate since we thought this mission was pretty trivial, but you still did your best.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
我聽說過程中出現了一些我們未曾預料的障礙，畢竟我們原本以為這項任務相當簡單，但你依然盡力了。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
I must warn you, however, this is not the end of these strange events. You're involved in this situation so deeply that you can't get out of it. Hahaha!
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
不過我必須警告你，這些奇怪的事件並沒有結束。你已深陷其中，無法脫身。哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Don't worry. I'm not here to fool around. Isn't that right?
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
別擔心。我可不是在這裡開玩笑的。對吧？

scripts.text:
[Staff Officer Abidal]
Yes, sir. We can't let the same thing happen again.
scripts.translation:
[參謀 阿比達爾]
是的，長官。我們不能讓同樣的事情再次發生。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Igrid]
I shall find out who's behind this, and destroy him.
scripts.translation:
[指導員 伊格麗德]
我會查明幕後黑手是誰，並將其消滅。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
So... I was hoping that you'll come back and help us once we figure out who's behind this. Will you?
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
那麼...等我們查明幕後黑手是誰後，希望你能回來幫助我們。你願意嗎？

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
And please take this small reward.
Thank you for your help so far.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
請收下這份小小的謝禮。
感謝你一直以來的幫助。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Then I'll see you next time. Keep yourself in one piece, alright?
Hahaha!
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
那我們下次再見。保重身體，別受傷了，好嗎？
哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Hey, how have you been? It's too early to say that we've figured out who's the mastermind.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
嘿，最近怎麼樣？現在就說我們已經查明瞭幕後黑手還為時過早。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Please be patient, I'll contact you when the time is right.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
請耐心等待，時機成熟時我會聯絡你。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Wait, have you explored this area yet? I mean the wide tundra and fields around the camp.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
等等，你探索過這片區域了嗎？我是說營地周圍廣闊的苔原和原野。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
There are many fun things outside. If you are an adventurer, go explore for yourself. Come back after you've explored the areas around the camp.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
外面有很多有趣的東西。既然你是冒險者，就自己去探索一下吧。探索完營地周圍的區域後再回來。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Ah, it's you again. So, are you accustomed to this area now?
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
啊，又是你。那麼，你現在習慣這片區域了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
What brings you here again? You seem to have something to say to me.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
你這次來有什麼事嗎？看起來你似乎有話想對我說。

scripts.text: I just want to say hello.
scripts.translation: 只是想打個招呼。

scripts.text: I found a weird portal below the mine cave.
scripts.translation: 我在礦洞下方發現了一個奇怪的傳送門。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Well hello then...
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
哦，你好啊...

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Please be patient. I'll contact you when the time is right.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
請耐心等待，時機成熟時我會聯絡你。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
What portal? I've never heard about it.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
什麼傳送門？我從未聽說過。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
That place must be where both races fight against each other. It might be dangerous there.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
那個地方應該是兩個種族互相戰鬥的地方。那裡可能很危險。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
I have no idea of what it is like. It is not in my field of expertise.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
我完全不知道那裡是什麼樣子。這不在我的專業範圍內。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
There is someone here who can help you. He is a historian from Rune-Midgarts. He may be aware of some relics or something that could help.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
這裡有一位能幫到你的人。他是來自盧恩·米德加茲的歷史學家。他可能瞭解一些遺蹟或其他能幫到你的東西。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Find the historian and see if he has any useful information for you.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
去找那位歷史學家，看看他是否有對你有用的資訊。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
He's at his post, you can't find him?
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
他就在他的崗位上，你找不到他？

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
His name is Magniffer... look for him.. he's somewhere around here...
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
他叫馬格尼弗...去找找他...他應該就在這附近...

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Did you talk with the scholar? Thesedays, I haven't seen him for a while.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
你和那位學者談過了嗎？最近這段時間，我沒怎麼見到他。

scripts.text:
[Staff Officer Abidal]
That's because you don't like talking to him.
scripts.translation:
[參謀 阿比達爾]
那是因為你不想和他說話。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Hey, don't judge me like that...the problem is only that I can't see him often.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
嘿，別那樣評判我...問題只是我很少見到他而已。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Whatever. Did something happen because he showed up to me? Tell me more.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
算了。是因為他向我顯現才發生了什麼事嗎？告訴我更多細節。

scripts.text: Tell the story.
scripts.translation: 講述故事

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Hmmm... umm... so...
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
嗯...唔...所以...

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
So, that's why that happened like that... It's so complicated...
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
原來事情是這樣發生的...真是複雜啊...

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
And you guys...you just take a task that you start up at first.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
還有你們...你們只是接手了一個一開始就開啟的任務。

scripts.text:
[Staff Officer Abidal]
You sent him to Doctor Magnifer first....
scripts.translation:
[參謀 阿比達爾]
你最初是讓他去找醫生馬格尼弗的....

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
I just thought that he needed someone to talk to.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
我只是覺得他需要有人傾訴。

scripts.text:
[Staff Officer Abidal]
Ah yeah... you're right.
scripts.translation:
[參謀 阿比達爾]
啊，是啊...你說得對。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Hmm... for example, you want to investigate a cave that you found, but you got on the Laphine and Sapha's nerves. right?
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
嗯...比如說，你想調查一個發現的洞穴，但這惹惱了拉芬和薩法。對吧？

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
And that two guys pay attention and stay quiet, but they are doing it for themselves..
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
而那兩個人雖然保持沉默並密切關注，但他們這麼做是為了他們自己..

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
The most important thing is that this place is the ground that the Yggdrasilberry takes root acording to Magnifer.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
最重要的是，根據馬格尼弗的說法，這裡是世界樹之果紮根之地。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Abidal, do you have anything to say about this?
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
阿比達爾，你對這件事有什麼看法嗎？

scripts.text:
[Staff Officer Abidal]
Our object is to make contact with one tribe and investgate this world and how adaptable it can be.
scripts.translation:
[參謀 阿比達爾]
我們的目標是與一個部落建立聯絡，並調查這個世界以及它的適應性。

scripts.text:
[Staff Officer Abidal]
Actually, we don't have to make this situation bigger than it already is.
scripts.translation:
[參謀 阿比達爾]
實際上，我們沒必要讓局勢比現在更嚴重。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Yeah right. I don't want to extend this thing anymore...
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
沒錯。我也不想把事情鬧得更大...

scripts.text:
[Staff Officer Abidal]
But the two tribes have remained neutral towards us up until now.
scripts.translation:
[參謀 阿比達爾]
不過到目前為止，這兩個部落對我們一直持中立態度。

scripts.text:
[Staff Officer Abidal]
We don't really know what attitude they have towards us.
scripts.translation:
[參謀 阿比達爾]
我們並不清楚他們對我們到底持什麼態度。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Yeah.. that makes sense... If they made a general attack, we would probably fail.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
嗯...有道理...如果他們發動全面進攻，我們恐怕會失敗。

scripts.text:
[Staff Officer Abidal]
We should map out a strategy. There is a method that uses Laphine and Sapha's together.
scripts.translation:
[參謀 阿比達爾]
我們應該制定一個策略。有一種方法可以結合拉芬和薩法的力量。

scripts.text:
[Staff Officer Abidal]
We send this guy to one of the tribes and ask for cooperation in our investigation.
scripts.translation:
[參謀 阿比達爾]
我們派這個人去其中一個部落，請求他們在調查中與我們合作。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Will they help us? They have already said threatening words...
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
他們會幫我們的忙嗎？他們之前已經說過威脅的話了...

scripts.text:
[Staff Officer Abidal]
Of course they will help us. if they reject our demand, we just say that we'll ask for help from the other tribe.
scripts.translation:
[參謀 阿比達爾]
當然會幫我們的。如果他們拒絕我們的要求，我們就說會向另一個部落求助。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Right, if we do that, they will have no other choice.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
沒錯，如果我們這麼做，他們別無選擇。

scripts.text:
[Staff Officer Abidal]
In this situation, they want to avoid showing that place to the other tribe.
scripts.translation:
[參謀 阿比達爾]
在這種情況下，他們不想讓另一個部落知道那個地方。

scripts.text:
[Staff Officer Abidal]
So, they have to cooperate with us.
scripts.translation:
[參謀 阿比達爾]
所以，他們必須與我們合作。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Oh, you have a malicious idea.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
哦，你有個陰險的主意。

scripts.text:
[Staff Officer Abidal]
That's called that Kuhotanrangjigea from east. I didn't make that by myself.
scripts.translation:
[參謀 阿比達爾]
這叫“以彼之道，還施彼身”。不是我一個人想出來的。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Whatever.. Hey, you there... your name is {0} right? Do you know what to do?
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
算了...嘿，你...你的名字叫{0}對吧？你知道該怎麼做嗎？

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Go to one of the tribes and ask for help officially. I'll send someone to the other tribe.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
去其中一個部落，正式請求他們的幫助。我會派人去另一個部落。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
I'm going to give you a choice. Which tribe do you want to go to?
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
我會給你一個選擇。你想去哪個部落？

scripts.text: Laphine
scripts.translation: 拉芬

scripts.text: Sapha
scripts.translation: 薩法

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Okay, then I place responsibility on you. from now on you focus on acquiring a good reputation with the Laphine.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
好吧，那麼責任就交給你了。從現在開始，你要專注於在拉芬那裡建立良好的聲譽。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
It won't be easy to get a good impression from the Sapha again.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
要在薩法那裡重新獲得好印象並不容易。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
So you must earn us a good reputation from the Laphine.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
所以，你必須為我們從拉芬那裡贏得良好的聲譽。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Will you choose the Laphine?
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
你會選擇拉芬嗎？

scripts.text: Choose Laphine.
scripts.translation: 選擇拉芬

scripts.text: Think again.
scripts.translation: 再考慮一下

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Good. You are now responsible with building our relationship with the Laphine tribe.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
很好。現在，建立我們與拉芬部落的關係就是你的責任了。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Go to the chief of the Laphine and if he doesn't accept our request, just say that you are going to ask for help from the Sapha.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
去找拉芬的首領，如果他不接受我們的請求，就告訴他你們打算向薩法尋求幫助。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
You have your orders! Now I'm going to look for an adventurer who is willing to be sent to the Sapha.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
任務已下達！現在我要去找一個願意被派往薩法的冒險者。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Yeah? Then think again and decide.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
是嗎？那就再考慮一下，做出決定吧。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Okay, then I place responsibility on you. from now on you focus on acquiring a good reputation with the Sapha.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
好吧，那麼責任就交給你了。從現在開始，你要專注於在薩法那裡建立良好的聲譽。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
It won't be easy to get a good impression from the Laphine again.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
要在拉芬那裡重新獲得好印象並不容易。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
So you must earn us a good reputation from the Sapha.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
所以，你必須為我們從薩法那裡贏得良好的聲譽。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Will you choose the Sapha?
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
你會選擇薩法嗎？

scripts.text: Choose Sapha.
scripts.translation: 選擇薩法

scripts.text: Think again.
scripts.translation: 再考慮一下

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Good. You are now responsible with building our relationship with the Sapha tribe.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
很好。現在，建立我們與薩法部落的關係就是你的責任了。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Go to the chief of the Sapha and if he doesn't accept our request, just say that you are going to ask for help from the Laphine.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
去找薩法的首領，如果他不接受我們的請求，就告訴他你們打算向拉芬尋求幫助。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
You have your orders! Now I'm going to look for an adventurer who is willing to be sent to the Laphine.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
任務已下達！現在我要去找一個願意被派往拉芬的冒險者。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Yeah? then think again and decide.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
是嗎？那就再考慮一下，做出決定吧。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Good. You are now responsible with building our relationship with the Laphine tribe.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
很好。現在，建立我們與拉芬部落的關係就是你的責任了。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Go to the chief of the Laphine and if he doesn't accept our request, just say that you are going to ask for help from the Sapha.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
去找拉芬的首領，如果他不接受我們的請求，就告訴他你們打算向薩法尋求幫助。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
I'm going to look for an adventurer who is willing to be sent to the Sapha.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
我要去找一個願意被派往薩法的冒險者。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Good. You are now responsible with building our relationship with the Sapha tribe.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
很好。現在，建立我們與薩法部落的關係就是你的責任了。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Go to the chief of the Sapha and if he doesn't accept our request, just say that you are going to ask for help from the Laphine.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
去找薩法的首領，如果他不接受我們的請求，就告訴他你們打算向拉芬尋求幫助。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
You have your orders! Now I'm going to look for an adventurer who is willing to be sent to the Laphine.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
任務已下達！現在我要去找一個願意被派往拉芬的冒險者。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
How's the activity in Laphine? They have a stern character.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
拉芬那邊的情況如何？他們的性格很嚴厲。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
I'm not cut out for matching with them...ew...
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
我不適合和他們打交道...嘔...

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
I'm going to send a few able men to the Sapha, you don't have to worry about it.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
我會派幾個得力的人去薩法，你不用擔心。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
How's the activity in Sapha? They have a stern character.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
薩法那邊的情況如何？他們的性格很嚴厲。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
I'm not cut out for matching with them...ew...
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
我不適合和他們打交道...嘔...

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
I'm going to send a few able men to the Laphine, you don't have to worry about it.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
我會派幾個得力的人去拉芬，你不用擔心。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
You've come back alive? Let us celebrate your immunity!
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
你竟然活著回來了？讓我們慶祝一下你的“不死之身”吧！

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Who would have thought that that outsiders would be treated so vulgar by the leaders of the other tribes?
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
誰能想到，那些外人竟然會被其他部落的首領如此粗魯地對待？

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
I have said before this thing is not the last, and certainly there is something waiting for us.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
我之前說過，事情還沒完，肯定……有什麼……在等著我們。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
It is time for us to head out, is it not, instructor?
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
是時候出發了，不是嗎，指導員？

scripts.text:
[Staff Officer Abidal]
Right... It's time...
scripts.translation:
[參謀 阿比達爾]
是的……是時候了...

scripts.text:
[Instructor Igrid]
I'm ready.
scripts.translation:
[指導員 伊格麗德]
我準備好了。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
I am looking forward to what will happen... Whew...
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
我很期待接下來會發生什麼...呼...

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
*Sigh* Look at me, I used to command the desert of Morocc, but I've been deployed to a world that only God knows where...
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
*嘆氣* 看看我，我曾經指揮著摩洛哥的沙漠，但現在卻被部署到一個連上帝都不知道在哪裡的世界...

scripts.text:
[Staff Officer Abidal]
Come on, that's not true. In fact, you used to be an official of a small town, and have been promoted to the commander of the expedition. Your success is almost too good to be true.
scripts.translation:
[參謀 阿比達爾]
拜託了，別這麼說。事實上，你以前只是個小城鎮的官員，現在卻成了遠征軍的指揮官。你的成功簡直好得難以置信。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Igrid]
Hey, boss. Can we just go through the motions until we get out of here? This so-called Ash-Vacuum is boring. It's heaven for the kingdom scholars, but it's not for me.
scripts.translation:
[指導員 伊格麗德]
嘿，老闆。我們能不能就敷衍一下，趕緊離開這裡？這個所謂的“阿什真空”太無聊了。這對王國的學者來說是天堂，但對我來說不是。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Geez, do you have to keep calling me boss? I'm the Commander, alright? So disrespectful.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
天哪，你能不能別叫我老闆？我是指揮官，懂嗎？太沒禮貌了。

scripts.text:
[Staff Officer Abidal]
Can you guys stop complaining? God...
scripts.translation:
[參謀 阿比達爾]
你們能不能別抱怨了？天哪...

scripts.text:
[Instructor Igrid]
Who are you? What business do you have with Commander Agip?
scripts.translation:
[指導員 伊格麗德]
你是誰？找阿吉普指揮官有什麼事？

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
What is it? If you have too much time on your hands, you'd better go outside and find something productive to do.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
怎麼了？如果你們閒得發慌，最好出去找點有意義的事情做。

scripts.text:
[Staff Officer Abidal]
Phew, I'm glad the mission is over. Thank you so much for your help.
scripts.translation:
[參謀 阿比達爾]
呼，很高興任務結束了。非常感謝你的幫助。

scripts.text:
[Staff Officer Abidal]
We'll contact you again when we have another mission for you. I hope we can count on your help again when the time comes.
scripts.translation:
[參謀 阿比達爾]
當我們有新的任務時，會再次聯絡你。希望到時候還能得到你的幫助。

scripts.text:
[Staff Officer Abidal]
I'm Staff Officer Abidal of the Midgard Expedition. How may I help you?
scripts.translation:
[參謀 阿比達爾]
我是米德加爾特遠征軍的參謀 阿比達爾。有什麼可以幫您的嗎？

scripts.text: Midgard Expedition Introduction
scripts.translation: 米德加爾特遠征軍介紹

scripts.text: Midgard Expedition's Achievement
scripts.translation: 米德加爾特遠征軍的成就

scripts.text: Situation in the Ash-Vacuum
scripts.translation: 阿什真空的情況

scripts.text: Quit
scripts.translation: 退出

scripts.text:
[Staff Officer Abidal]
The Midgard Expedition is conducted by a group of explorers from the three countries of Midgard and the Mercenary Association. We're here to explore the Ash-Vacuum.
scripts.translation:
[參謀 阿比達爾]
米德加爾特遠征軍由來自米德加爾特三國的探險家以及傭兵協會的成員組成。我們在此探索阿什真空。

scripts.text:
[Staff Officer Abidal]
Command Hibba Agip behind me is our commander. He may appear unreliable, but he has extensive knowledge and experience in exploration.
scripts.translation:
[參謀 阿比達爾]
站在我身後的指揮官是希巴·阿吉普。他看起來可能不太靠譜，但在探險方面擁有廣博的知識和豐富的經驗。

scripts.text:
[Staff Officer Abidal]
We have many aides and scholars to support our expedition.
scripts.translation:
[參謀 阿比達爾]
我們有許多助手和學者支援這次遠征。

scripts.text:
[Staff Officer Abidal]
Oh, you may know this already, but Commander Agip isn't from any of the three countries. Neither am I or Instructor Igrid.
scripts.translation:
[參謀 阿比達爾]
哦，您可能已經知道了，但指揮官阿吉普並不屬於三國中的任何一個。我和指導員 伊格麗德也是如此。

scripts.text:
[Staff Officer Abidal]
There's an obvious power struggle among the three countries to assign their officers to the commander position.
scripts.translation:
[參謀 阿比達爾]
三國之間在指派軍官擔任指揮官一職上存在明顯的權力鬥爭。

scripts.text:
[Staff Officer Abidal]
As a last resort, they had to select Commander Agip since he's unaffiliated with any of those countries, but is talented enough to lead the expedition.
scripts.translation:
[參謀 阿比達爾]
作為最後的手段，他們不得不選擇指揮官阿吉普，因為他不隸屬於任何一國，且具備領導遠征的才能。

scripts.text:
[Staff Officer Abidal]
We, the commanders, Igrid, and I aren't used to the leadership role. We're having trouble taking care of everything that's happening. *Sigh*
scripts.translation:
[參謀 阿比達爾]
我們——指揮官、伊格麗德和我——並不習慣領導角色。我們很難應對正在發生的一切。*嘆氣*

scripts.text:
[Staff Officer Abidal]
The members of the Midgard Expedition are conducting various kinds of research about the Ash-Vacuum searching for possible living creatures and studying what might be beneficial for the development of the mainland.
scripts.translation:
[參謀 阿比達爾]
米德加爾特遠征軍的成員正在進行各種研究，探索阿什真空，尋找可能的生物，並研究其對大陸發展的潛在益處。

scripts.text:
[Staff Officer Abidal]
If you look around, you'll find many people in need of your help. Enjoy your stay in the otherworld, and feel free to ask me if you have questions.
scripts.translation:
[參謀 阿比達爾]
如果您四處看看，會發現許多需要您幫助的人。祝您在這個異世界度過愉快的時光，如有任何問題，請隨時向我提問。

scripts.text:
[Staff Officer Abidal]
We're still at an early stage of the expedition, so we haven't made any major achievements. That's why we need help from adventurers like you.
scripts.translation:
[參謀 阿比達爾]
我們的遠征仍處於早期階段，因此尚未取得重大成就。這就是為什麼我們需要像您這樣的冒險者的幫助。

scripts.text:
[Staff Officer Abidal]
If you look around this camp, you'll find many opportunities to help us. We always welcome every bit of help.
scripts.translation:
[參謀 阿比達爾]
如果您看看這個營地，會發現許多幫助我們機會。我們歡迎任何形式的幫助。

scripts.text:
[Staff Officer Abidal]
So far, only a few truths about the Ash-Vacuum have been revealed.
scripts.translation:
[參謀 阿比達爾]
到目前為止，關於阿什真空的真相只揭示了一小部分。

scripts.text:
[Staff Officer Abidal]
We now know there's a demihuman race in this otherworld, but we're too busy figuring out the true nature of the time-space gap, let alone study the demihuman race in depth.
scripts.translation:
[參謀 阿比達爾]
我們現在知道這個異世界存在半人種族，但我們正忙於弄清時空裂隙的本質，更不用說深入研究半人種族了。

scripts.text:
[Staff Officer Abidal]
My advice for you will be to be careful when you encounter members of that race. Who knows? They might be extremely hostile toward other races.
scripts.translation:
[參謀 阿比達爾]
我的建議是，當您遇到該種族的成員時要小心。誰知道呢？他們可能對其他種族極度敵視。

scripts.text:
[Staff Officer Abidal]
Oh, and take heed, unidentified creatures appear outside the camp during nighttime. Be careful of them, too.
scripts.translation:
[參謀 阿比達爾]
哦，請注意，夜間營地外會出現不明生物。也要小心它們。

scripts.text:
[Staff Officer Abidal]
Oh, welcome back. I apologize for troubling you like this. I didn't feel to comfortable talking to you back there.
scripts.translation:
[參謀 阿比達爾]
哦，歡迎回來。很抱歉這樣打擾您。剛才在那裡和您說話時，我有點不自在。

scripts.text:
[Staff Officer Abidal]
In fact, I have a favor to ask of you. From what I know of your accomplishments you're the right person for this.
scripts.translation:
[參謀 阿比達爾]
事實上，我有一事相求。據我所知，您的成就表明您是合適的人選。

scripts.text:
[Staff Officer Abidal]
On behalf of the expedition, I'd like to give you a mission. Would you like to accept it?
scripts.translation:
[參謀 阿比達爾]
代表遠征軍，我想給您一個任務。您願意接受嗎？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不。

scripts.text:
[Staff Officer Abidal]
Thank you so much. I had a good feeling about you, and I was so sure that you'd be willing to help.
scripts.translation:
[參謀 阿比達爾]
非常感謝。我對您有一種良好的感覺，我確信您願意幫忙。

scripts.text:
[Staff Officer Abidal]
Let's cut to the chase. The mission is simple, deliver our expedition report to the three countries of Midgard.
scripts.translation:
[參謀 阿比達爾]
直入正題吧。任務很簡單，將我們的遠征報告送達米德加爾特三國。

scripts.text:
[Staff Officer Abidal]
But I have to tell you... We sent out three adventurers on this mission before you, and they all dissapeared. Please don't disclose this information to anyone.
scripts.translation:
[參謀 阿比達爾]
但我必須告訴您...在您之前，我們曾派出三名冒險者執行這項任務，但他們全都失蹤了。請不要將此事透露給任何人。

scripts.text:
[Staff Officer Abidal]
The commander or I cannot leave this camp, even though delivering the report is one of our most important duties. That's why I need someone reliable and trustworthy like you.
scripts.translation:
[參謀 阿比達爾]
指揮官和我都無法離開營地，儘管遞交報告是我們最重要的職責之一。所以我需要像您這樣可靠且值得信賴的人。

scripts.text:
[Staff Officer Abidal]
Phew, I'm so glad that you've accepted this mission. Now, please go receive the report from the commander. He'll officially assign you to the mission.
scripts.translation:
[參謀 阿比達爾]
呼，很高興您接受了這個任務。現在，請去指揮官那裡領取報告。他會正式指派您執行任務。

scripts.text:
[Staff Officer Abidal]
I'll prepare for your departure.
Please go speak to the commander.
scripts.translation:
[參謀 阿比達爾]
我會為您出發做好準備。
請去和指揮官對話。

scripts.text:
[Staff Officer Abidal]
Oh, I see... Then can you help me whenever you have some time?
scripts.translation:
[參謀 阿比達爾]
哦，我明白了...那麼，當您有空的時候，能幫幫我嗎？

scripts.text:
[Staff Officer Abidal]
This is urgent, please think it over and come back if you change your mind.
scripts.translation:
[參謀 阿比達爾]
這件事很緊急，請再考慮一下，如果您改變主意了，請回來找我。

scripts.text:
[Staff Officer Abidal]
I've reported to the commander about your decision to help us.
Please go speak to him.
scripts.translation:
[參謀 阿比達爾]
我已經向指揮官彙報了您決定幫助我們的事。
請去和他對話。

scripts.text:
[Staff Officer Abidal]
You've been assinged to the mission officially. Good luck, and I hope you'll come back safely.
scripts.translation:
[參謀 阿比達爾]
您已被正式指派執行任務。祝您好運，希望您能平安歸來。

scripts.text:
[Staff Officer Abidal]
I've heard the story. Why don't you go speak to the commander first?
scripts.translation:
[參謀 阿比達爾]
我聽說過這個故事。您不妨先去和指揮官對話？

scripts.text:
[Staff Officer Abidal]
It's as what the commander said. I still remember the contents of the report, even though it might not all be accurate without any references.
scripts.translation:
[參謀 阿比達爾]
正如指揮官所說。儘管沒有參考資料可能不完全準確，但我仍然記得報告的內容。

scripts.text:
[Staff Officer Abidal]
If you bring me the pages of the lost report, I'll fill the missing parts and be able to complete the report again.
scripts.translation:
[參謀 阿比達爾]
如果您能找回丟失的報告頁面，我會填補缺失的部分，從而重新完成這份報告。

scripts.text:
[Staff Officer Abidal]
Why don't you go check the site of the accident? You might find some clues of their whereabouts. and...
scripts.translation:
[參謀 阿比達爾]
您不妨去檢查一下事故現場？您可能會找到一些關於他們下落的線索。還有...

scripts.text:
[Staff Officer Abidal]
This is my opinion, but otherworldly creatures might have taken an interest in the pages.
scripts.translation:
[參謀 阿比達爾]
這只是我的個人看法，但異界生物可能會對那些頁面感興趣。

scripts.text:
[Staff Officer Abidal]
I'm thinking this because the report contains information about the ecology of the otherworldly creatures. It's also made of paper and ink, materials from the mainland that might seem interesting to those creatures.
scripts.translation:
[參謀 阿比達爾]
我這樣想是因為報告包含了關於異界生物生態的資訊。而且它是由紙張和墨水製成的，這些來自大陸的材料可能會引起那些生物的興趣。

scripts.text:
[Staff Officer Abidal]
Anyways, please bring the pages of the report in ^0000FFincrements of 10^000000 whenever you find them. I'll try to put them in order.
scripts.translation:
[參謀 阿比達爾]
總之，每當您找到報告頁面時，請每^0000FF10頁^000000交給我一次。我會嘗試將它們按順序整理好。

Anyways, please bring the pages of the report in ^0000FFincrements of 10^000000 whenever you find them. I'll try to put them in order.
scripts.translation:

總之，每當您找到報告頁面時，請每^0000FF10頁^000000交給我一次。我會嘗試將它們按順序整理好。

scripts.text:
[Staff Officer Abidal]
How have you been doing with finding the report's lost pages?
Feel free to tell me whenever you're ready.
scripts.translation:
[參謀 阿比達爾]
您尋找報告丟失頁面的進展如何？
隨時歡迎您告訴我。

scripts.text: Submit found pages.
scripts.translation: 提交找到的頁面

Oh, you've collected enough pages...

哦，您已經收集了足夠的頁面...

scripts.text:
[Staff Officer Abidal]
Have you brought me pages of the lost report? Please bring them to me in increments of 10.
scripts.translation:
[參謀 阿比達爾]
您帶來了丟失報告的頁面嗎？請每次提交10頁。

scripts.text:

Thank you. Let me try to put them in order.
scripts.translation:
[參謀 阿比達爾]

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:

scripts.text:
[Staff Officer Abidal]
Thank you for your hard work. We were able to restore one volume of the report.
scripts.translation:

scripts.text:

I'm glad that we were able to make this again. Please bring this report to the commander.
scripts.translation:
[參謀 阿比達爾]
很高興我們能把這份報告重新整理出來。請把它交給指揮官。

scripts.text:
[Staff Officer Abidal]
Phew, I'm glad we can resume the mission again.
scripts.translation:
[參謀 阿比達爾]
呼，太好了，我們可以繼續執行任務了。

scripts.text:
[Staff Officer Abidal]
...Aren't you leaving? I think you should.
scripts.translation:
[參謀 阿比達爾]
...您還不走嗎？我想您該離開了。

scripts.text:
[Staff Officer Abidal]
I heard that you got a new duty from Commander Agip.
scripts.translation:
[參謀 阿比達爾]
我聽說您從阿吉普指揮官那裡接到了新的任務。

scripts.text:
[Staff Officer Abidal]
...Aren't you leaving? I think you should.
scripts.translation:
[參謀 阿比達爾]
...您還不走嗎？我想您該離開了。

scripts.text:
[Staff Officer Abidal]
Hello, I'm Staff Officer Abidal. Safe travels, Adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[參謀 阿比達爾]
您好，我是參謀阿比達爾。一路順風，冒險者。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Igrid]
Hey, rookies. I guess you were lucky enough to complete the mission.
scripts.translation:
[指導員 伊格麗德]
嘿，新人。看來你們運氣不錯，順利完成了任務。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Igrid]
This is not the end. Keep yourself in one piece until we need your services again.
scripts.translation:
[指導員 伊格麗德]
這還不是結束。在我們需要你們再次服役之前，請保持好狀態。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Igrid]
I'm Instructor Igrid of the Midgard Expedition. I'm in charge of training and commanding soldiers.
scripts.translation:
[指導員 伊格麗德]
我是米德加爾特遠征隊的指導員伊格麗德。我負責士兵的訓練和指揮。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Igrid]
You must want to become an official member of our expedition.
I'm sorry, but you're too weak to endure my intensive training.
Give up before you get hurt.
scripts.translation:
[指導員 伊格麗德]
您一定想成為我們遠征隊的正式成員吧。
很抱歉，您太弱了，無法承受我的強化訓練。
在受傷之前放棄吧。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Igrid]
If you have too much time on your hands, look around. There's plenty of chores available for so-called adventurers's like you.
If you do your best to do them, I might accept you as a trainee on this expedition.
scripts.translation:
[指導員 伊格麗德]
如果你閒得發慌，就四處轉轉吧。像你這種所謂的冒險者，有的是雜活可以幹。
如果你能盡力完成，我或許會接受你成為這次遠征的學員。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Igrid]
I don't trust you. Hm. Sorry. I don't really have the right to say that if the commander has assigned you to the mission.
scripts.translation:
[指導員 伊格麗德]
我不信任你。嗯。抱歉。如果指揮官已經指派你執行任務，我其實沒有資格這麼說。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Igrid]
If you're going to give up, give up now. That'll be better for both of us.
scripts.translation:
[指導員 伊格麗德]
如果你打算放棄，現在就放棄吧。這樣對我們雙方都好。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Igrid]
I knew you couldn't do it. Didn't I tell you to give up when you had the chance?!
scripts.translation:
[指導員 伊格麗德]
我就知道你做不成。我是不是告訴過你，有機會就放棄？！

scripts.text:
[Instructor Igrid]
Do you think I'm doing this for you? No, I'm just using this chance to discipline idle soldiers.
scripts.translation:
[指導員 伊格麗德]
你以為我這麼做是為了你嗎？不，我只是借這個機會管教一下那些無所事事計程車兵。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Igrid]
What are you looking at? Go mind your own business!
scripts.translation:
[指導員 伊格麗德]
你在那看什麼？管好你自己的事！

scripts.text:
[Instructor Igrid]
I am Expedition Training Instructor Igrid, and the commander responsible for training soldiers.
scripts.translation:
[指導員 伊格麗德]
我是遠征隊訓練指導員伊格麗德，負責士兵訓練的指揮官。

scripts.text:
[Expedition Messenger]
Welcome, I've been waiting for you.
You must be {0}. Nice to meet you.
scripts.translation:
[遠征隊信使]
歡迎，我一直在等你。
想必你就是{0}吧。很高興見到你。

scripts.text:
[Expedition Messenger]
Let me check something quicly. You received the report directly from the commander, didn't you? May I see it?
scripts.translation:
[遠征隊信使]
讓我快速確認一下。你是直接從指揮官那裡收到報告的吧？可以給我看看嗎？

scripts.text:
[Expedition Messenger]
Excellent. Thank you. Then we'll go back to the mainland and let the leaders know that you, {0}, have departed.
scripts.translation:
[遠征隊信使]
很好。謝謝。那麼我們要回大陸了，並通知首領們，你，{0}，已經出發了。

scripts.text:
[Expedition Messenger]
Guys, it's time to go.
scripts.translation:
[遠征隊信使]
大家，該走了。

scripts.text:
[Expedition Messenger]
You, head to Schwaltzval Republic.
And you, take Arunafeltz. I'll visit Prontera Palace.
scripts.translation:
[遠征隊信使]
你，去施瓦茨瓦爾共和國。
你，去阿魯納菲茲。我要去普隆德拉王宮。

scripts.text:
[Expedition Messenger]
I'll see you guys later.
scripts.translation:
[遠征隊信使]
回頭見。

scripts.text:
[Expedition Messenger]
What's up? Why haven't you left...?
scripts.translation:
[遠征隊信使]
怎麼了？為什麼還沒走...？

scripts.text:
[Expedition Messenger]
Argh... Why are you doing this?!
scripts.translation:
[遠征隊信使]
啊...你為什麼要這麼做？！

scripts.text:
[???]
Give me the report.
scripts.translation:
[???]
把報告給我。

scripts.text: Give the report.
scripts.translation: 交出報告

scripts.text: Protect the report.
scripts.translation: 保護報告

scripts.text:
[Expedition Messenger]
Wha... What are you doing? You can't give up the report...
Awww...
scripts.translation:
[遠征隊信使]
什...你在做什麼？你不能交出報告...
啊...

scripts.text:
[???]
Give it to me, now!
scripts.translation:
[???]
現在，把它交給我！

scripts.text:
[Expedition Messenger]
*Cough* Oh, thank god! {0}, please take the report and run!
scripts.translation:
[遠征隊信使]
*咳* 謝天謝地！{0}，請拿著報告快跑！

scripts.text:
[???]
No... Noooo!

[Expedition Messenger]
Argh... {0}, are you alright? The report... The report...
scripts.translation:
[遠征隊信使]
呃...{0}，你沒事吧？報告...報告...

scripts.text:
[Expedition Agent]
We lost the report. The pages are blowing away!
scripts.translation:
[遠征隊特派員]
我們丟失了報告。紙張正在四處飛散！

scripts.text:
[???]
Haha, I may have failed to take the report, but it's better destroyed than in your hands!
scripts.translation:
[???]
哈哈，雖然我沒能拿到報告，但讓它被毀掉總比落在你們手裡好！

scripts.text:
[Expedition Agent]
Are you alright? What about the report... ?
scripts.translation:
[遠征隊特派員]
你沒事吧？報告怎麼樣了...？

scripts.text:
[Expedition Messenger]
*Cough* The report is out of our reach now...
scripts.translation:
[遠征隊信使]
*咳* 報告現在已經不在我們的掌控之中了...

scripts.text:
[Expedition Agent]
If we mobilize all our troops to search this entire area...
scripts.translation:
[遠征隊特派員]
如果我們動員所有部隊搜尋這一整個區域...

scripts.text:
[Expedition Messenger]
We must report this to the commander before anything else.
{0}, please report to the commander immidiatly. Let us take care of the rest.
scripts.translation:
[遠征隊信使]
在一切之前，我們必須向指揮官彙報此事。
{0}，請立即向指揮官彙報。剩下的交給我們處理。

scripts.text:
[Expedition Agent]
Yes, please report to the commander...
scripts.translation:
[遠征隊特派員]
是的，請向指揮官彙報...

scripts.text:
[???]
Oh, yeah? Then I'll have to use force!
scripts.translation:
[???]
哦，是嗎？那我只能動武了！

scripts.text:
[???]
Argh!

[Expedition Messenger]
*Cough* Oh, thank god! {0}, please take the report and run!
scripts.translation:
[遠征隊信使]
*咳* 謝天謝地！{0}，請拿著報告快跑！

scripts.text:
[???]
No... Noooo!

[Expedition Messenger]
Argh... {0}, are you alright? The report... The report...
scripts.translation:
[遠征隊信使]
呃...{0}，你沒事吧？報告...報告...

scripts.text:
[Expedition Agent]
We lost the report. The pages are blowing away!
scripts.translation:
[遠征隊特派員]
我們丟失了報告。紙張正在四處飛散！

scripts.text:
[???]
Haha, I may have failed to take the report, but it's better destroyed than in your hands!
scripts.translation:
[???]
哈哈，雖然我沒能拿到報告，但讓它被毀掉總比落在你們手裡好！

scripts.text:
[Expedition Agent]
Are you alright? What about the report... ?
scripts.translation:
[遠征隊特派員]
你沒事吧？報告怎麼樣了...？

scripts.text:
[Expedition Messenger]
*Cough* The report is out of our reach now...
scripts.translation:
[遠征隊信使]
*咳* 報告現在已經不在我們的掌控之中了...

scripts.text:
[Expedition Agent]
If we mobilize all our troops to search this entire area...
scripts.translation:
[遠征隊特派員]
如果我們動員所有部隊搜尋這一整個區域...

scripts.text:
[Expedition Messenger]
We must report this to the commander before anything else.
{0}, please report to the commander immidiatly. Let us take care of the rest.
scripts.translation:
[遠征隊信使]
在一切之前，我們必須向指揮官彙報此事。
{0}，請立即向指揮官彙報。剩下的交給我們處理。

scripts.text:
[Expedition Agent]
Yes, please report to the commander...
scripts.translation:
[遠征隊特派員]
是的，請向指揮官彙報...

scripts.text:
[Expedition Messenger]
Were you assigned to deliver the expedition report?
scripts.translation:
[遠征隊信使]
你是被指派來運送遠征隊報告書的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Expedition Messenger]
I'm sorry, but I don't see any report in your hands. Please bring me the report, so I can confirm your identification.
scripts.translation:
[遠征隊信使]
抱歉，我沒看到您手裡拿著報告書。請帶報告書來找我，以便我核實您的身份。

scripts.text:
[Expedition Messenger]
Please hurry up and report this incident to the commander.
scripts.translation:
[遠征隊信使]
請趕快向指揮官彙報這起事故。

scripts.text:
[Expedition Messenger]
Good day! I'm here, just waiting for someone. Well, that's my duty.
scripts.translation:
[遠征隊信使]
你好！我在這裡等人。嗯，這是我的職責。

scripts.text:
[Expedition Agent]
......
scripts.translation:
[遠征隊特派員]
......

scripts.text: - When you tried to talk to him, he disappeared into thin air. He looked like someone on a very important mission... -
scripts.translation: - 當你試圖與他交談時，他憑空消失了。他看起來像是正在執行一項非常重要的任務... -

scripts.text:
[Expedition Agent]
...
scripts.translation:
[遠征隊特派員]
...

scripts.text: - When you tried to talk to him, he disappeared into thin air. He looked like someone on a very important mission... -
scripts.translation: - 當你試圖與他交談時，他憑空消失了。他看起來像是正在執行一項非常重要的任務... -

scripts.text:
[Expedition Scout]
Good day. I'm from the Third Scout Party under direct command of the commander of the Midgard Expedition.
scripts.translation:
[遠征隊偵察兵]
你好。我是米德加爾特遠征隊指揮官直屬的第三偵察隊成員。

scripts.text:
[Expedition Scout]
I've been ordered by Instructor Igrid to conduct a search for something.
scripts.translation:
[遠征隊偵察兵]
我受指導員伊格麗德之命，正在搜尋某樣東西。

scripts.text: Ask about search results.
scripts.translation: 詢問搜尋結果

scripts.text: Chitchat.
scripts.translation: 閒聊

scripts.text: Quit.
scripts.translation: 退出。

scripts.text:
[Expedition Scout]
Oh, you must be{0}. I heard that you'll be delivering the report.
scripts.translation:
[遠征隊偵察兵]
哦，您一定是{0}。我聽說您負責運送報告書。

scripts.text:
[Expedition Scout]
Searching for lost pages was tougher then I expected. Please come back later when I'm finished making one round.
scripts.translation:
[遠征隊偵察兵]
搜尋丟失的紙張比我預想的要困難。請等我完成一輪搜尋後再來。

scripts.text:
[Expedition Scout]
Good news! I've found {0} pieces of paper that appear to be part of the report.
scripts.translation:
[遠征隊偵察兵]
好訊息！我找到了{0}張看起來像是報告書一部分的紙張。

scripts.text:
[Expedition Scout]
I'm doing my best, but I haven't found any pages yet.
scripts.translation:
[遠征隊偵察兵]
我正在盡力，但還沒找到任何紙張。

scripts.text:
[Expedition Scout]
Well then, keep up the good work!
scripts.translation:
[遠征隊偵察兵]
那麼，請繼續加油！

scripts.text:
[Expedition Scout]
Who are you? Why do you want to know about our search results? Are you from the army?
scripts.translation:
[遠征隊偵察兵]
你是誰？為什麼想知道我們的搜尋結果？你是軍隊的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Expedition Scout]
Man, don't you know that you can be arrested for interrupting a military operation?
scripts.translation:
[遠征隊偵察兵]
天哪，你不知道干擾軍事行動會被逮捕嗎？

scripts.text:
[Expedition Scout]
Please leave immediately.
scripts.translation:
[遠征隊偵察兵]
請立即離開。

scripts.text:
[Expedition Scout]
I'm sorry, but I'm on duty. Why don't we talk later when I'm off-duty?
scripts.translation:
[遠征隊偵察兵]
抱歉，我正在執勤。我們改天我下班後再聊吧？

scripts.text:
[Laur]
I'm Laur, the aide of the Home Minister of the Rune-Midgarts Kingdom. Do you have any business with me?
scripts.translation:
[勞爾]
我是勞爾，盧恩·米德加茲王國的大臣。您有什麼事嗎？

scripts.text:
[Laur]
Why are you back? You've delivered the report to me already. Are you suffering from amnesia or something?
scripts.translation:
[勞爾]
你怎麼又回來了？你不是已經把報告書交給我了嗎？你是失憶了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Laur]
Oh, you brought me the report from the Midgard Expedition. What took you so long? I received a message about your departure a long time ago.
scripts.translation:
[勞爾]
哦，你帶來了米德加爾特遠征隊的報告書。怎麼花了這麼久？我很久以前就收到你出發的訊息了。

scripts.text:
[Laur]
Well, tell the commander that I'm not happy with your tardiness. Now, give me the report.
scripts.translation:
[勞爾]
好吧，告訴指揮官我對你們的遲到很不滿意。現在，把報告書給我。

scripts.text:
[Laur]
I knew it was the wrong idea to out a mercenary in the commander position. See, nothing is done on time. Gosh!
scripts.translation:
[勞爾]
我就知道讓傭兵擔任指揮官是個錯誤的決定。看吧，什麼事都沒能準時完成。真是的！

scripts.text:
[Laur]
*Ahem Ahem* Thank you for bringing me the report. I guess I was wrong about the commander. This report is actually very well done.
scripts.translation:
[勞爾]
*咳咳* 謝謝你把報告書帶給我。看來是我誤會指揮官了。這份報告書做得非常好。

scripts.text:
[Laur]
But don't forget to tell him that I need the expedition reports on time from now on. Alright? *Ahem*
scripts.translation:
[勞爾]
但別忘了告訴他，從現在開始，米德加爾特遠征隊的報告書必須準時交上來。明白了嗎？*咳*

scripts.text:
[Laur]
You should leave and go back to your work.
scripts.translation:
[勞爾]
你該走了，回去工作吧。

scripts.text:
[Laur]
Can you sense the great disorder occuring on the Midgard Continent and the Rune-Midgarts' Kingdom?
scripts.translation:
[勞爾]
你能感受到米德加爾特大陸和盧恩·米德加茲王國正在發生的巨大動盪嗎？

scripts.text:
[Laur]
Still, there always a silver lining, no matter how dangerous this world may become.
scripts.translation:
[勞爾]
不過，無論這個世界變得多麼危險，總有一線希望。

scripts.text:
[Laur]
There is hope and opportunity beyond the chaos, and I see the world beyond the time-space gap as a source of new hope.
scripts.translation:
[勞爾]
在混沌之外，存在著希望與機遇。我透過時空裂隙看到的，正是新希望的源泉。

scripts.text:
[Nuria]
Welcome, stranger. How can I help you?
scripts.translation:
[努莉亞]
歡迎，陌生人。有什麼可以幫你的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Nuria]
Oh, right, I already received the report from you. Don't worry, you didn't forget.
scripts.translation:
[努莉亞]
哦，對了，我已經收到你的報告書了。別擔心，你沒有忘記。

scripts.text:
[Nuria]
Good day, stranger. May Freya bless you.
scripts.translation:
[努莉亞]
祝你有美好的一天，陌生人。願芙蕾雅保佑你。

scripts.text:
[Nuria]
Oh, I see. You've brought me a report from the expedition beyond the time-space gap.
scripts.translation:
[努莉亞]
哦，我明白了。你帶給我的是來自時空裂隙之外的遠征報告書。

scripts.text:
[Nuria]
I regret admitting that you've brought it much later than I expected, but... I'm glad it is here safely. Please give it to me.
scripts.translation:
[努莉亞]
很遺憾，你交得比我預期的晚了很多，但...很高興它安全地送到了。請把它給我。

scripts.text:
[Nuria]
I'm happy to see that they've made good progress so far. Please tell the commander to keep up the good work.
scripts.translation:
[努莉亞]
很高興看到他們取得了良好的進展。請告訴指揮官繼續保持。

scripts.text:
[Nuria]
Excuse me, but it's time to pray now. Please be safe on your travels.
scripts.translation:
[努莉亞]
抱歉，現在是祈禱的時間了。請一路平安。

scripts.text:
[Nuria]
Please be safe on your way back to the expedition camp.
scripts.translation:
[努莉亞]
請平安返回遠征營地。

scripts.text:
[Gerhart]
Welcome, {0}. What took you so long?
scripts.translation:
[格哈特]
歡迎，{0}。怎麼現在才來？

scripts.text:
[Gerhart]
What is it? Do you still have business with me?
scripts.translation:
[格哈特]
什麼事？你還有事找我？

scripts.text:
[Gerhart]
What is it? I don't have time for chitchat.
scripts.translation:
[格哈特]
什麼事？我沒時間閒聊。

scripts.text:
[Gerhart]
Oh, who am I? Let's say... That you can make ends meet because of me.
Make sense?
scripts.translation:
[格哈特]
哦，我是誰？這麼說吧...多虧了我，你才能勉強餬口。
懂嗎？

scripts.text:
[Gerhart]
Do you know how long I waited for this report? *Sigh* ...Fine, just give it to me.
scripts.translation:
[格哈特]
你知道我等這份報告書等了多久嗎？*嘆氣* ...算了，給我吧。

scripts.text:
[Gerhart]
Hmmm... This report is a clear demonstration of Commander Hibba Agip's competence... Well, that's great.
scripts.translation:
[格哈特]
嗯...這份報告書清楚地展示了指揮官希巴·阿吉普的能力...好吧，那很好。

scripts.text:
[Gerhart]
Thank you for bringing the report.
Please tell the commander to keep up the good work.
scripts.translation:
[格哈特]
謝謝你送來了報告書。
請告訴指揮官，繼續保持這種良好的工作狀態。

scripts.text:
[Gerhart]
Now excuse me, I must go back to work.
scripts.translation:
[格哈特]
那麼失陪了，我得回去工作了。

scripts.text:
[Gerhart]
I've received the report safely.
Please go back to the commander, and tell him to keep up the good work.
scripts.translation:
[格哈特]
報告書已安全收到。
請回到指揮官那裡，告訴他繼續保持這種良好的工作狀態。

scripts.text:
[Gerhart]
If you have business with me. please talk to my secretary and schedule an appointment. My office is on the second floor.
scripts.translation:
[格哈特]
如果您有公事找我，請和我的秘書預約時間。我的辦公室在二樓。

scripts.text: - You cannot proceed with the quest when you're carrying too many items with you. -
scripts.translation: - 攜帶物品過多時，無法繼續任務。 -

scripts.text:
[Echinacea]
Oh adventurer, you've come at the perfect time.
Since you and I both know that we can't waste time on idle chitchat,
I'll cut to the chase.
scripts.translation:
[紫錐菊]
哦，冒險者，你來得正是時候。
既然你我都知道不能把時間浪費在閒聊上，
那我就直入正題了。

scripts.text:
[Echinacea]
Most expeditions come to this area to explore the Ash Vacuum,
but we've come here for a different reason.
scripts.translation:
[紫錐菊]
大多數探險隊來到這片區域是為了探索阿什真空，
但我們來這裡是為了別的原因。

scripts.text:
[Echinacea]
You know about this space gap that was caused by Satan Morocc, don't you?
scripts.translation:
[紫錐菊]
你知道魔王夢羅克造成的這個空間裂隙，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Echinacea]
Our job is to pursue Satan Morocc and figure out how this all happened.
Your job is to assist us, and prove that you can be a good member of our expedition.
scripts.translation:
[紫錐菊]
我們的任務是追蹤魔王夢羅克，弄清楚這一切是如何發生的。
你的任務是協助我們，並證明你能成為我們探險隊的好成員。

scripts.text:
[Echinacea]
... Umm... So, you'll have to.. Let me think which job would be perfect for you.
Umm.. I remember someone said that he needed assistance...
scripts.translation:
[紫錐菊]
...嗯...所以，你得...讓我想想哪個職位最適合你。
嗯...我記得有人說過他需要助手...

scripts.text: Hey, excuse me.
scripts.translation: 嘿，打擾一下。

scripts.text:
[Echinacea]
Ah, I know what you can do!
There's a guy conducting an investigation near the space gap. You can go help him.
Just do what he asks you to do, alright?
Now go!
scripts.translation:
[紫錐菊]
啊，我知道你能做什麼了！
有個傢伙正在空間裂隙附近進行調查。你可以去幫他。
只要照他說的做就行了，好嗎？
現在去吧！

scripts.text:
[Echinacea]
......
By the way, adventurer,
What's your name?
scripts.translation:
[紫錐菊]
......
順便問一下，冒險者，
你叫什麼名字？

scripts.text:
[Echinacea]
Ah, you are
{0}.
Well, {1}, I've just assigned you as Mr. Kidd's assistant.
Good, everything's done on this end. I just needed to get your name on record.
scripts.translation:
[紫錐菊]
啊，你是
{0}。
好吧，{1}，我剛把你指派為基德先生的助手。
很好，這邊的手續都辦完了。我只是需要把你的名字記錄下來。

scripts.text:
[Echinacea]
What are you still doing here?
{0}, your job is to assist Mr. Kidd.
Please go help him, will you?
scripts.translation:
[紫錐菊]
你還在這裡幹什麼？
{0}，你的工作是協助基德先生。
請去幫他，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Echinacea]
What are you doing here?
Only authorized personnel can enter this area.
Go back to the mainland as quickly as possible.
scripts.translation:
[紫錐菊]
你在這裡做什麼？
只有授權人員才能進入這個區域。
請儘快返回大陸。

scripts.text:
[Echinacea]
Your job is to assist Mr. Kidd who's standing near the space gap, otherwise known as the gate.
Please go help him, okay?
scripts.translation:
[紫錐菊]
你的工作是協助站在空間裂隙——也就是大門——附近的基德先生。
請去幫他，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Echinacea]
Why are you back?
You're irresponsible. How could you abandon such an important duty?
If you don't want to work, why did you even come here to the Ash Vacuum in the first place?
scripts.translation:
[紫錐菊]
你怎麼回來了？
你真是不負責任。怎麼能拋棄這麼重要的職責？
如果你不想工作，當初為什麼要來阿什真空？

scripts.text:
[Echinacea]
Alas! There's no one I can trust!
You know, when I was working at the palace, I was.. *Blah Blah*...
scripts.translation:
[紫錐菊]
唉！沒有我可以信任的人！
你知道嗎，當我在宮殿工作時，我... *巴拉巴拉*...

scripts.text: - Her rant doesn't seem to be ending any time soon. You'd better go back and help Mr. Kidd, even if your heart's not in it. -
scripts.translation: - 她的抱怨似乎一時半會兒停不下來。你最好還是回去幫基德先生吧，哪怕心裡並不情願。 -

scripts.text:
[Echinacea]
Hm? Where are you going? I'm not finished!
Hey, hey!
scripts.translation:
[紫錐菊]
嗯？你要去哪裡？我還沒說完呢！
喂，喂！

scripts.text:
[Echinacea]
Mr. Kidd is such a great young man.
You should be thankful that I've assigned you to help him. Don't be lazy by neglecting your duties.
scripts.translation:
[紫錐菊]
基德先生是個很棒的年輕人。
你應該感激我派你去協助他。別偷懶，不要忽視你的職責。

scripts.text:
[Echinacea]
Oh, welcome back!
I knew you would successfully complete your duties.
So, tell me; how can I help you?
scripts.translation:
[紫錐菊]
哦，歡迎回來！
我就知道你能順利完成職責。
那麼，告訴我，有什麼可以幫你的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Echinacea]
A scholar who is familiar with magic?
What about that old man over there? If you couldn't tell, he comes from a distant country.
Why are you looking for a scholar, anyway?
scripts.translation:
[紫錐菊]
一位精通魔法的學者？
那邊那位老人怎麼樣？如果你沒認出來的話，他來自遙遠的國度。
你為什麼要找一位學者呢？

scripts.text:
[Echinacea]
Did Mr. Kidd ask you to find one?
I see. He's probably looking for a solution for the spell scroll.
Then yes, that old man would be the perfect person to ask.
scripts.translation:
[紫錐菊]
是基德先生讓你去找的嗎？
我明白了。他大概是在尋找解決魔法卷軸問題的辦法。
那麼是的，那位老人會是詢問的最佳人選。

scripts.text:
[Echinacea]
He's from Arunafeltz, and has extensive knowledge in magic as well as sacred power.
I'm sure he'll be able to help you.
scripts.translation:
[紫錐菊]
他來自阿魯納菲茲，對魔法和神聖力量都有廣泛的瞭解。
我相信他能幫到你。

scripts.text: Who?
scripts.translation: 誰？

scripts.text:
[Echinacea]
Do you see an old man over there? He's trying to make a fire with wet firewood to roast a sweet potato.
His name is Mr. ^4d4dffDefaria^000000.
scripts.translation:
[紫錐菊]
你看到那邊那位老人了嗎？他正試圖用溼柴生火烤紅薯。
他的名字是^4d4dff德法里亞^000000。

scripts.text:
[Echinacea]
Why don't you go show it to him? He might be able to help Mr. Kidd with what he is trying to do.
scripts.translation:
[紫錐菊]
你不妨去給他看看？他也許能幫基德先生解決他正在嘗試的事情。

scripts.text:
[Echinacea]
If you're seeking advice about the spell scroll, you should go talk to Mr. Defaria.
I don't practice magic, so I wouldn't know anything about it.
scripts.translation:
[紫錐菊]
如果你是在尋求關於魔法卷軸的建議，你應該去和德法里亞先生談談。
我不練習魔法，所以對此一無所知。

scripts.text:
[Echinacea]
Oh, welcome back.
How can I help you?
Oh... You've brought the journal..
scripts.translation:
[紫錐菊]
哦，歡迎回來。
有什麼可以幫你的嗎？
哦...你帶來了日記本...

scripts.text:
[Echinacea]
I see...
...Basically it all comes down to Rayan.
He's been abducted by Satan Morocc.
If we find Rayan using this location-tracing spell.
scripts.translation:
[紫錐菊]
我明白了...
...歸根結底，這都與拉揚有關。
他被魔王夢羅克綁架了。
如果我們用這個定位法術找到拉揚。

scripts.text: We'll find Satan Morocc too!
scripts.translation: 我們也能找到魔王夢羅克！

scripts.text:
[Echinacea]
That's right.
But it'll work only if Satan Morocc actually abducted Rayan.
scripts.translation:
[紫錐菊]
沒錯。
但這隻有在魔王夢羅克確實綁架了拉揚的情況下才有效。

scripts.text:
[Echinacea]
Say, what's the tracing pattern number?
scripts.translation:
[紫錐菊]
喂，追蹤圖案的編號是多少？

scripts.text:
[Echinacea]
[{0}]
...Ah, there it is.
scripts.translation:
[紫錐菊]
[{0}]
...啊，就是那個。

scripts.text:
[Echinacea]
[{0}]
It's not working for some reason.
I can't find a magic stone that has the same wavelength as yours.
scripts.translation:
[紫錐菊]
[{0}]
不知為何不起作用。
我找不到一塊與你波長相同的魔法之石。

scripts.text:
[Echinacea]
This location-tracing spell uses a pair of magic stones of the same wavelength...
We can use the spell with one stone to find the other stone with the matching wavelength.
scripts.translation:
[紫錐菊]
這個定位法術使用一對波長相同的魔法之石...
我們可以用法術通過其中一塊石頭來尋找另一塊波長匹配的石頭。

scripts.text:
[Echinacea]
We'll analyze this pattern number and detect the wavelength.
It'll take some time before we get the results.
scripts.translation:
[紫錐菊]
我們會解析這個編號並檢測波長。
得到結果還需要一些時間。

scripts.text:
[Echinacea]
This location-tracing spell uses a pair of magic stones of the same wavelength..
I can't find a magic stone that has the same wavelength as your pattern number.
scripts.translation:
[紫錐菊]
這個定位法術使用一對波長相同的魔法之石...
我找不到一塊與你的編號波長相同的魔法之石。

scripts.text:
[Echinacea]
Go check the number again.
scripts.translation:
[紫錐菊]
去再確認一下編號。

scripts.text:
[Echinacea]
Welcome, adventurer.
I hope they've been able to trace the wavelength by now.
How'd you like to go check the results?
scripts.translation:
[紫錐菊]
歡迎光臨，冒險者。
希望他們現在已經檢測出波長了。
要去看看結果嗎？

scripts.text:
[Echinacea]
To the south of this camp, you'll see a building with a mana detector attached to it.
Go ask the building manager about the trace results.
scripts.translation:
[紫錐菊]
在這個營地的南邊，你會看到一座裝有瑪娜探測器的建築。
去問問那裡的管理員關於追蹤結果的事。

scripts.text:
[Echinacea]
Tracing magic wavelength is not easy as you think.
Please be patient: the results will arrive soon enough.
scripts.translation:
[紫錐菊]
追蹤魔法波長並不像你想像的那麼容易。
請耐心等待：結果很快就會出來的。

scripts.text:
[Echinacea]
I'm in charge of tracing the wavelength from the Midgard Continent,
and the south camp is tracing it in this area.
scripts.translation:
[紫錐菊]
我負責追蹤米德加爾特大陸的波長，
南邊的營地負責追蹤這個區域的。

scripts.text:
[Echinacea]
I asked them to assign top priority to this task, so with any luck, they've finished it by now.
..What are you doing? I said, go ask the building manager about the trace results.
scripts.translation:
[紫錐菊]
我讓他們把這個任務列為最高優先順序，所以運氣好的話，他們現在已經完成了。
...你在幹什麼？我說，去問問管理員關於追蹤結果的事。

scripts.text:
[Echinacea]
How are the results?
scripts.translation:
[紫錐菊]
結果怎麼樣？

scripts.text: - You told her exactly what you were told by the soldier managing the building. -
scripts.translation: - 你告訴她，正如管理建築計程車兵所說的那樣。 -

scripts.text:
[Echinacea]
Oh, is that the case? I see.
That means.. The man called Rayan isn't on the Midgard Continent or in this Ash Vacuum.
scripts.translation:
[紫錐菊]
哦，是這樣嗎？我明白了。
也就是說...那個叫拉揚的男子不在米德加爾特大陸，也不在這個阿什真空區域。

scripts.text:
[Echinacea]
He must be somewhere else.
As I suspected, he must be with Satan Morocc.
scripts.translation:
[紫錐菊]
他一定在別的地方。
正如我所料，他一定和魔王夢羅克在一起。

scripts.text:
[Echinacea]
Pursuing Satan Morocc was supposed to be our last resort..
...I guess we have no choice now..
scripts.translation:
[紫錐菊]
追捕魔王夢羅克本來應該是我們的最後手段...
...看來我們現在別無選擇了...

scripts.text:
[Echinacea]
...I should log a report entry into this journal.
Our pursuit of Satan Morocc is at an end for now.
scripts.translation:
[紫錐菊]
...我應該在這本日誌裡記錄一下報告。
我們對魔王夢羅克的追捕暫時告一段落。

scripts.text:
[Echinacea]
You did a great job helping us, and went above and beyond my expectations.
Here, this is a reward for your help.
scripts.translation:
[紫錐菊]
你幫了大忙，表現超出了我的預期。
拿著，這是對你幫助的獎勵。

scripts.text:
[Echinacea]
Keep up the good work assisting the explorers in this camp.
scripts.translation:
[紫錐菊]
繼續協助這個營地的探險家們。

scripts.text:
[Echinacea]
....

[Echinacea]
Hmm..
scripts.translation:
[紫錐菊]
嗯..

scripts.text:
[Echinacea]
...Grr...!
What?! What do you want?
Why do you keep giving me that dirty look?!
scripts.translation:
[紫錐菊]
...嘎...!
什麼？你想要什麼？
你為什麼一直用那種眼神看我？!

scripts.text: Nothing.
scripts.translation: 沒什麼。

scripts.text: Something is bothering me...
scripts.translation: 我有些心事...

scripts.text:
[Echinacea]
Argh...!
Are you annoying me on purpose?
Go and find something else to do!
scripts.translation:
[紫錐菊]
啊...!
你是故意在煩我嗎？
去幹點別的吧！

scripts.text:
[Echinacea]
I'm stressed out and I've got a headache writing this report. I don't have the time to deal with you right now.
Do you understand?
scripts.translation:
[紫錐菊]
我壓力很大，寫這份報告讓我頭疼。我現在沒空理你。
你明白嗎？

scripts.text:
[Echinacea]
What is it that worries you?
Please, I've got enough worries already.
scripts.translation:
[紫錐菊]
你在擔心什麼？
拜託，我已經夠煩了。

scripts.text:
[Echinacea]
So, tell me, what is it?
{0}, you've done a great job helping us...
Oh, you must have questions about that last case, is that right?
scripts.translation:
[紫錐菊]
那麼，告訴我，是什麼事？
{0}，你幫了我們大忙...
哦，你肯定對上個案子有疑問，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Echinacea]
...Wait, are you worried because of him?
...I see, you're worried about him being supported by the country.
scripts.translation:
[紫錐菊]
...等等，你是因為他才擔心的嗎？
...我明白了，你擔心他受到國家的支援。

scripts.text:
[Echinacea]
This isn't a good time to disclose the truth. It'll cause more confusion.
I believe the diplomats and presidents of both countries are responsible for those national matters.
scripts.translation:
[紫錐菊]
現在不是揭露真相的好時機。那樣只會引起更多混亂。
我相信兩國的外交官和總統會負責處理這些國家事務。

scripts.text:
[Echinacea]
This is out of your hands, adventurer.
So stop worrying about it. Alright?
scripts.translation:
[紫錐菊]
這超出了你的能力範圍，冒險者。
所以別再擔心了。好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Echinacea]
No country wants to start a war, especially when we have a greater common enemy.
Just focus on what you can do to help us.
scripts.translation:
[紫錐菊]
沒有國家想要發動戰爭，尤其是當我們有更大的共同敵人時。
專注於你能做的，來幫助我們。

scripts.text:
[Echinacea]
We've stopped pursuing Satan Morocc, so you may go help the other explorers now.
I've already rewarded you for your services.
scripts.translation:
[紫錐菊]
我們已經停止追捕魔王夢羅克了，所以你現在可以去幫助其他探險者了。
我已經為你的服務給予獎勵了。

scripts.text:
[Echinacea]
Remember; don't open your mouth about this to anyone.
scripts.translation:
[紫錐菊]
記住；不要對任何人提起這件事。

scripts.text:
[Echinacea]
What is it? I thought you've been discharged from my service.
..What are these sweet potatoes?
Did that old man send these?
No way..! Are you..?
scripts.translation:
[紫錐菊]
怎麼了？我以為你已經解除我的服務了。
..這些是什麼？紅薯？
是那個老人送來的嗎？
不會吧..！你是..？

scripts.text: That's right.
scripts.translation: 沒錯。

scripts.text:
[Echinacea]
What do you not understand?
Nothing good can come out of this if it's released to the public.
Can't you see?
scripts.translation:
[紫錐菊]
你哪裡不明白？
如果這件事公之於眾，不會有任何好事發生。
你看不出來嗎？

scripts.text:
[Echinacea]
Arunafeltz has replaced their leaders with the moderates just recently.
Shoving the remnants of the radicals in front of them is extremely dangerous.
scripts.translation:
[紫錐菊]
阿魯納菲茲最近剛用溫和派替換了他們的領導人。
把激進派的殘餘推在他們面前是極其危險的。

scripts.text:
[Echinacea]
We've finally made a truce with them.
Their sins will not be forgiven, but we won't make a stupid attempt to get revenge and end up shedding more blood!
scripts.translation:
[紫錐菊]
我們終於與他們達成了停戰協議。
他們的罪行不會被原諒，但我們不會愚蠢地試圖復仇，從而流更多的血！

scripts.text:
[Echinacea]
Let the politicians do their job.
I assure you they won't lead us to the worst case scenario. That's what you're worried about, right?
scripts.translation:
[紫錐菊]
讓政治家們去做他們的工作。
我向你保證，他們不會讓我們陷入最壞的情況。這就是你擔心的，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Echinacea]
No, wait.. Do you..?
Do you want us to wage war against Arunafeltz over this?!
scripts.translation:
[紫錐菊]
不，等等.. 你是..？
你想讓我們因為這件事對阿魯納菲茲發動戰爭嗎？!

scripts.text:
[Echinacea]
Let me ask you to forget the past and focus on the present.
For everyone's sake, please just look toward the future and move forward.
scripts.translation:
[紫錐菊]
讓我請求你忘記過去，專注於現在。
為了大家，請只看向未來，向前看。

scripts.text:
[Echinacea]
We won't do anything that you'd morally oppose.
You believe in peace, don't you?
Tell him that I'm grateful for these sweet potatoes, anyway..
scripts.translation:
[紫錐菊]
我們不會做任何你在道德上反對的事。
你相信和平，對吧？
告訴他，我感謝這些紅薯，無論如何..

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Err? I don't have two Nice Sweet Potatoes..
Where can I get those?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
咦？我沒有兩個美味紅薯...
我該去哪裡弄到它們？

scripts.text:
[Echinacea]
Let us take care of the rest.
I'm not suggesting that we should pretend as if the past never happened. All I'm saying is that we should work towards achieving a greater cause.
scripts.translation:
[紫錐菊]
剩下的交給我們處理。
我並不是說我們要假裝過去沒有發生過。我只是說，我們應該為了更大的目標而努力。

scripts.text:
[Echinacea]
You're doing a great job.
I suppose I have an eye for people after all.
Yes, that must be right.
Keep up the good work, will you?
scripts.translation:
[紫錐菊]
你做得很好。
看來我確實有識人的眼光。
是的，一定是這樣。
請繼續保持，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Manager]
Everything's okay so far!
How may I help you?
scripts.translation:
[管理員]
目前一切正常！
有什麼可以幫您的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Manager]
Everything's okay so far!
How may I help you?
scripts.translation:
[管理員]
目前一切正常！
有什麼可以幫您的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Manager]
This device detects mana and magic wavelengths around this area. identifying what enemies we're dealing with.
It can be used to trace the wavelengths of location-tracing spells.
scripts.translation:
[管理員]
這個裝置可以探測這個區域的瑪娜和魔法波長，識別我們面對的敵人。
它還可以用來追蹤定位法術的波長。

scripts.text:
[Manager]
Did Captain Echinacea send you?
I have something to report to you.
scripts.translation:
[管理員]
是紫錐菊船長派您來的嗎？
我有件事要向您彙報。

scripts.text:
[Manager]
The magic wavelength of the requested pattern number has not been detected in this area.
It's not possible to trace the number around this area, but..
scripts.translation:
[管理員]
在這個區域沒有探測到指定編號的魔法波長。
無法在這個區域追蹤該編號，但是..

scripts.text: But?
scripts.translation: 但是？

scripts.text:
[Manager]
I can tell this magic pattern is supposed to be used to trace a human being.
You know tracing magic stones always come in pairs, don't you?
scripts.translation:
[管理員]
我可以斷定，這個魔法模式是用來追蹤人類的。
您知道追蹤用的魔法之石總是成對出現的，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Manager]
Now, magic stones specifically used to trace humans have a special feature.
scripts.translation:
[管理員]
現在，專門用於追蹤人類的魔法之石有一個特殊功能。

scripts.text:
[Manager]
When the target of the trace dies, the pair of stones are automatically destroyed.
Since this patterned magic stone is still intact..
scripts.translation:
[管理員]
當追蹤目標死亡時，成對的魔法之石會自動銷燬。
既然這塊帶有該模式的魔法之石還完好無損..

scripts.text:
[Manager]
Well, this magic stone serves as proof that the target of the trace is still alive somewhere in the world.
I'll keep watching.
Hopefully, we'll detect the same wavelength.
scripts.translation:
[管理員]
好吧，這塊魔法之石證明了追蹤目標仍然活在世界的某個地方。
我會繼續監視。
希望我們能探測到相同的波長。

scripts.text:
[Manager]
That's all for today.
scripts.translation:
[管理員]
今天就到這裡。

scripts.text:
[Manager]
Please report this to Captain Echinacea;
We've failed to trace the location of the target,
but he's still alive somewhere.
scripts.translation:
[管理員]
請向紫錐菊船長彙報；
我們未能追蹤到目標的位置，
但他仍然活在某個地方。

scripts.text:
[Manager]
It's a fantastic product made from a combination of magic and science.
The Ash Vacuum hasn't been fully explored, and we don't know what kind of dangers to expect in this area.
scripts.translation:
[管理員]
這是魔法與科學結合的傑出產品。
阿什真空尚未被完全探索，我們不知道在這個區域會遇到什麼樣的危險。

scripts.text:
[Manager]
By using this device, we can check the change and flow of mana around this area,
and prepare for any possible threats.
scripts.translation:
[管理員]
通過使用這個裝置，我們可以檢查這個區域瑪娜的變化和流動，
併為任何可能的威脅做好準備。

scripts.text: - You cannot proceed with the quest when you're carrying too many items with you. -
scripts.translation: - 攜帶物品過多時，無法繼續任務。 -

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
Hey, you.
Don't get too close to anything except the gate.
It's too dangerous.
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
嘿，你。
除了大門，不要靠近任何東西。
太危險了。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
......Do you have any business here?
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
......您有什麼事嗎？

scripts.text: Echinacea...
scripts.translation: 紫錐菊...

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
An assistant? I don't think I need one, but...
I guess I should give you something to do.
Do you mind if I entrust you with a chore?
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
助手？我覺得我不需要一個，但是...
我想我應該給你找點事做。
你介意我委託你一件雜務嗎？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text: No, I don't mind at all.
scripts.translation: 不，我完全不介意。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
Then why did you come all this way?
I didn't really need any help to begin with. If you don't want to work, then stop bothering me.
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
那你大老遠跑來這裡是做什麼？
我本來就不需要任何幫助。如果你不想工作，就別來煩我。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
If you don't want to help us out then go back to Echinacea and let her know yourself!
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
如果你不想幫忙，那就回紫錐菊那裡，親自告訴她！

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
......
I don't know if Echinacea told you this already, but we are here
to follow the traces of Satan Morocc.
Some of us are here in the Ash Vacuum, and the rest are on the Midgard Continent.
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
......
不知道紫錐菊是否已經告訴過你，我們在這裡是為了追蹤魔王夢羅克的蹤跡。
我們一部分人在阿什真空，另一部分人在米德加爾特大陸。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
We exchange information with our colleagues in Morocc on a regular basis, but we haven't heard from them for a while.
How'd you like to go gather some information for me?
It should be simple, so you I hope you'll be able to handle this.
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
我們定期與夢羅克那邊的同事交換情報，但已經有一段時間沒有收到他們的訊息了。
你要不要去幫我收集一些情報？
這應該很簡單，我希望你能搞定。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
At Southwest Morocc, you'll find an underground tavern.
Go find ^4d4dffRin^000000.
Tell her I've sent you, and she'll take care of you.
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
在西南夢羅克，你會找到一家地下酒館。
去找^4d4dff琳恩^000000。
告訴她是我派你來的，她會照顧你的。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
If you don't have any business here, then step aside. It's too dangerous.
You might not be able to return to this world if you enter a route that hasn't been properly identified.
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
如果你在這裡沒有正事，就請讓開。這裡太危險了。
如果你進入一條未被正確識別的路線，可能就無法回到這個世界了。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
I guess she forced you to do this, huh? Don't worry; you're not the first victim of her bossiness.
You should tell her if you really don't want to work for me.
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
看來她是逼你來做這個的，對吧？別擔心，你不是第一個被她強勢作風害苦的人。
如果你真的不想為我工作，就告訴她。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
I can tell you aren't so happy with this, huh?
While you're here, why don't you help us out and see where it goes?
Don't worry, I won't give you a hard time...
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
我看出來你對此並不太高興，是嗎？
既然你在這裡，為什麼不幫個忙，看看情況如何呢？
別擔心，我不會讓你太辛苦的...

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
......
I don't know if Echinacea told you this already, but we are here to follow the traces of Satan Morocc.
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
......
不知道紫錐菊是否已經告訴過你，我們在這裡是為了追蹤魔王夢羅克的蹤跡。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
Some of us are here in the Ash Vacuum, and the rest are on the Midgard Continent.
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
我們一部分人在阿什真空，另一部分人在米德加爾特大陸。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
We exchange information with our colleagues in Morocc on a regular basis, but we haven't heard from them for a while.
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
我們定期與夢羅克那邊的同事交換情報，但已經有一段時間沒有收到他們的訊息了。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
How'd you like to go gather some information for me?
It should be simple, so you I hope you'll be able to handle this.
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
你要不要去幫我收集一些情報？
這應該很簡單，我希望你能搞定。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
At Southwest Morocc, you'll find an underground tavern.
Go find ^4d4dffRin^000000.
Tell her I've sent you, and she'll take care of you.
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
在西南夢羅克，你會找到一家地下酒館。
去找^4d4dff琳恩^000000。
告訴她是我派你來的，她會照顧你的。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
Let me explain one more time.
Go speak to Rin in an underground tavern at Southwest Morocc.
You won't miss the tavern if you look for a boy named Jack standing out the front.
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
讓我再解釋一次。
去西南夢羅克地下酒館找琳恩對話。
如果你在門口看到一個叫傑克的男孩，就不會錯過那家酒館了。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
Are you helping Rin?
..I see.
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
你在幫琳恩嗎？
......我明白了。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
I heard Rin is wounded and bedridden...
What happened?
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
我聽說琳恩受傷了，臥床不起...
發生了什麼事？

scripts.text: - Instead of an answer, you gave him Rin's journal and the bloody crystal.-
scripts.translation: - 你沒有回答，而是把琳恩的日記和沾血的晶體遞給了他。-

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
...A journal? I see. Hopefully this'll help me understand the situation..
Hmm...
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
......日記？我明白了。希望這能幫我瞭解情況。
嗯...

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
*Sigh*..
So Rayan has finally been located, huh?
There was a skirmish at the mountain, and.. a raid...
..So, how is she?
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
*嘆氣*..
看來拉揚終於被找到了，是嗎？
山上發生了一場小規模衝突，還有...一次突襲...
......那麼，她現在情況如何？

scripts.text: Huh?
scripts.translation: 咦？

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
I mean Rin. How is she?
Is she seriously wounded?
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
我是說琳恩。她怎麼樣了？
傷勢嚴重嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
She needs to spend some time in bed,
but she's conscious and still in one piece.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
她需要臥床休息一段時間，
但意識清醒，身體也沒有大礙。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
She seems to have no problem taking care of herself,
but I'm worried because sometimes she looks extremely exhausted. She mentioned that her vision blurs when she's very tired..
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
她看起來還能自理，
但我有點擔心，因為她有時看起來極度疲憊。她提到自己非常累的時候視力會模糊...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Don't worry; I don't think it's serious because she still had the strength to yell while writing that journal.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
別擔心；我覺得不嚴重，因為她寫那篇日記的時候還有力氣大喊大叫。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
..Wh.. Who said I'm worried?
I asked about her because I don't want her injury to interfere with our schedule.
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
...誰...誰說我擔心了？
我問她是因為我不希望她的傷勢影響我們的日程。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
As for you, I want you to come back later.
You're my assistant, remember?
I need you to substitute for Rin until she recovers..
Is that understood?
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
至於你，我讓你稍後再回來。
別忘了，你是我的助手。
我需要你代替琳恩，直到她康復...
明白了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
Hm, thanks for all your help.
Now, would you leave me alone for a while? I need to write a report based on the findings in this journal.
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
嗯，謝謝你的幫忙。
現在，能讓我一個人待一會兒嗎？我需要根據這本日記的發現寫一份報告。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
(I was supposed to give him the 'Morocc Pursuit Journal' and a 'Bloody Crystal of the Darkness'...
Err? Where have they gone? I need to find them.)
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
（我本該把《莫洛克追蹤日記》和一顆“黑暗的結晶體”交給他...
咦？它們去哪了？我得找找看。）

scripts.text:
Kidd is standing at the side of the space gap, leafing through the journal's pages and taking notes.
The 'Bloody Crystal of Darkness' is sitting aside, and remains untouched.
scripts.translation:
基德站在空間裂縫旁，翻閱著日記的頁面並做著筆記。
“黑暗的結晶體”放在一旁，未被觸碰。

scripts.text:
I feel the crystal resonating with the space gap.
I suddenly have the urge to touch the crystal...
scripts.translation:
我感覺結晶體在與空間裂縫產生共鳴。
我突然有一種想要觸碰結晶體的衝動...

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
Err? What are you trying to do?
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
咦？你想做什麼？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No, nothing.
I'm sorry if I bothered you while you were writing your report.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不，沒什麼。
抱歉打擾你寫報告了。

scripts.text: - Kidd stopped you from touching the crystal, but somehow, it still captivates you. -
scripts.translation: - 基德阻止了你觸碰結晶體，但不知為何，它依然吸引著你。 -

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
..Are.. Are you alright?
What just happened?
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
...你...你沒事吧？
剛才發生了什麼？

scripts.text: Err.. Huh?!

[{0}]
..Err?
..Kidd? Someone was calling my name...
Rin! Where's Rin? What about Rayan?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
...咦？
...基德？有人在叫我的名字...
琳恩！琳恩在哪？拉揚呢？

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
Rin? Rayan?
What are you talking about?
Where the hell have you been?
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
琳恩？拉揚？
你在說什麼？
你到底去哪了？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What do you mean..
Where I've been?
..Oh yeah, I saw Rin fighting Rayan.
She was defeated by magic, and then disappeared...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你什麼意思..
我去哪了？
...哦對，我看到琳恩在和拉揚戰鬥。
她被魔法擊敗，然後消失了...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Ah?! Ah! Right!
I heard your voice once I found a strange scroll.
The scroll!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
啊？啊！對了！
當我找到一張奇怪的卷軸時，我聽到了你的聲音。
那張卷軸！

scripts.text: - Ignoring the confused look on Mr. Kidd's face, you searched your pockets, and found the mysterious scroll. -
scripts.translation: - 無視基德先生困惑的表情，你摸了摸口袋，找到了那張神秘的卷軸。 -

scripts.text:
- It wasn't a dream after all... What you saw actually happened. -
- You show Kidd the scroll and tell him what happened. -
scripts.translation:
- 原來不是夢...你看到的確實發生了。 -
- 你向基德展示卷軸，並告訴他發生了什麼。 -

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
... ..
.. Basically,
you found this from a member of Rayan's gang?
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
... ..
..基本上，
這是你從拉揚團伙的成員那裡找到的？

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
I know what this is:
it's a scroll containing a magic spell that can be used by anyone, even if they aren't trained as mages.
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
我知道這是什麼：
這是一張魔法卷軸，任何人都可以使用，即使他們沒有受過魔法訓練。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
Hmm, this scroll is sealed and needs some kind of pass code to use it.
I'll consult with the camp scholars about this scroll later.
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
嗯，這張卷軸被封印了，需要某種密碼才能使用。
我稍後會諮詢營地的學者關於這張卷軸的事。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
By the way, I saw you touch this 'Bloody Crystal of Darkness.'
There was a bright flash of light around you, and then you were suddenly drawn into the space gap.
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
順便說一下，我看到你觸碰了這個“黑暗的結晶體”。
你周圍閃過一道亮光，然後你突然被吸入空間裂縫。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
I thought I was just seeing things, but it's obvious now that it really happened.
You were actually in the past for a little while there.
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
我以為我在做夢，但現在很明顯這是真的。
你剛才確實在過去待了一會兒。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
I'm afraid this space gap hides bigger secrets than we thought.
..It not only warps space, but also time ...
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
恐怕這個空間裂縫隱藏著我們未曾想到的更大秘密。
..它不僅扭曲空間，還扭曲時間 ...

scripts.text: It warps space and time?
scripts.translation: 它扭曲空間和時間？

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
Forget it. I was just thinking out loud.
From now on, we should be extra careful about letting anything into this space gap. I need to report this incident to upper management.
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
算了。我只是隨口說說。
從現在開始，我們應該格外小心，不要讓任何東西進入這個空間裂縫。我需要向高層彙報這一事件。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
I'm sorry, but can you ask a scholar about this spell scroll?
If you don't know which scholar you should consult, then you'd better ^4d4dffask Echinacea^000000
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
抱歉，你能去問問學者關於這張魔法卷軸的事嗎？
如果你不知道該諮詢哪位學者，最好去^4d4dff問問紫錐菊^000000

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
Thanks in advance.
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
提前謝謝你了。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
Did you find a scholar to ask about the scroll?
Huh? Not yet?
If you don't know which scholar to consult, then you'd better ask Echinacea.
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
你找到學者詢問卷軸的事了嗎？
嗯？還沒有？
如果你不知道該諮詢哪位學者，最好去問問紫錐菊。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
So this scroll is from Arunafeltz, huh?
Is that why you're gathering items to unseal the scroll?
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
所以這張卷軸來自阿魯納菲茲，是嗎？
這就是為什麼你在收集物品來解除卷軸的封印？

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
I see...
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
我明白了...

scripts.text:
- Kidd is lost in thought. -
- Let's bring Defaria the items to unseal the spell scroll. -
scripts.translation:
- 基德陷入了沉思。 -
- 讓我們把解除魔法卷軸封印的物品帶給德法里亞。 -

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
Keep up the good work, adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
幹得好，冒險者。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
This must be the spell scroll, huh?
It contains a teleportation spell
that will send the user to a specific location.. Hmm...
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
這一定是那張魔法卷軸，是嗎？
它包含一個瞬間移動法術，
會將使用者傳送到特定地點.. 嗯...

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
You said you've heard Rayan ordering others to come to a certain place.
If the spell of this scroll leads to that place..
.... . No, it's too dangerous.
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
你說你聽到拉揚命令其他人去某個地方。
如果這張卷軸的法術指向那個地方..
.... . 不，太危險了。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
Then again.. Somebody will have to go there eventually..
... .. .. .
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
不過.. 遲早會有人得去那裡..
... .. .. .

scripts.text: Why are you looking at me?!
scripts.translation: 你為什麼那樣看著我？！

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
You're my assistant, aren't you?
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
你是我的助手，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
.Alright, then. Would you rather capture reincarnations of Morocc and collect their remnants?
Scholars suspect the recent space-time phenomenon has been caused by the 'Bloody Crystals of the Darkness,'
so they want to study the crystals, which they believe are remnants of the of Morocc's reincarnations.
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
好吧。你是想捕捉莫羅克的轉世體並收集它們的殘骸嗎？
學者們懷疑最近發生的時空現象是由“黑暗的血晶”引起的，
他們想要研究這些水晶，並認為它們是莫羅克轉世體的殘骸。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
That sounds way more dangerous, doesn't it? Go check that place out instead.
Both those missions are dangerous, but I think you'll be risking your life less by checking out that place.
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
聽起來那個更危險，不是嗎？還是去調查那個地方吧。
這兩個任務都很危險，但我認為去調查那個地方風險會小一些。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
Now, listen. Use the spell scroll to teleport there, and then investigate the area. Find some clues.
Don't fight them.
Don't put yourself in danger, and retreat when things get too dangerous.
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
聽著。使用卷軸瞬間移動過去，然後調查那個區域。尋找一些線索。
不要戰鬥。
不要讓自己陷入危險，情況太危險時就撤退。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
By the time you come back,
we should have figured out the cause of the strange phenomenon near this space gap.
We'll think about everything else after you come back, alright?
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
等你回來的時候，
我們應該已經查明這個空間裂隙附近奇怪現象的原因了。
等你回來我們再商量其他事情，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
Where's the scroll? Did you use it?
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
卷軸呢？你用了？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
That scroll contains a teleportation spell.
Using it will lead you to a place that has something to do with them.
You're supposed to gather some clues once you're there.
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
那張卷軸包含瞬間移動法術。
使用它會把你帶到一個與它們有關的地方。
你到了那裡應該收集一些線索。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
..I guess you haven't found any clues.
Do you remember the location of that place?
Why don't you go it check out again?
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
看來你還沒找到線索。
你還記得那個地方的位置嗎？
為什麼不再去檢查一下呢？

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
I'm sure you'll find something.
Yes, there must be some sort of clue there.
Do you understand?
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
我相信你會找到什麼的。
是的，那裡一定有某種線索。
你明白嗎？

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
That scroll contains a teleportation spell.
Using it will lead you to a place that has something to do with them.
You're supposed to gather some clues once you're there.
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
那張卷軸包含瞬間移動法術。
使用它會把你帶到一個與它們有關的地方。
你到了那裡應該收集一些線索。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
If you lost the scroll, I expect you to find that place at any cost.
Is that clear?
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
如果你弄丟了卷軸，我要求你無論如何都要找到那個地方。
聽明白了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
Did you find any clues?
What did you find over there?
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
你找到線索了嗎？
你在那裡發現了什麼？

scripts.text: - You interrupted Mr. Kidd, and told him what you heard from the basement in the empty house near the national border. -
scripts.translation: - 你打斷了基德先生，並告訴他你在國境線附近空屋地下室聽到的訊息。 -

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
..Are you sure?
And the location is.. Okay, I got it.
Thanks.
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
...你確定嗎？
位置是... 好的，我知道了。
謝謝。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
Can you go back and spy on them a bit more?
I'll follow you as soon as I report these findings to the higher-ups.
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
你能回去再監視他們一會兒嗎？
我會盡快向高層彙報這些發現，然後跟上你。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
They must be having a serious internal dispute,
meaning it's the perfect time for us to raid them.
Keep monitoring them for me, alright?
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
他們內部一定發生了嚴重的爭執，
這意味著是我們突襲他們的最佳時機。
繼續幫我監視他們，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
..Phew, now I've seen everything.
Oh, hey!
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
...呼，現在我看清楚了。
哦，嘿！

scripts.text: Where's Rayan?
scripts.translation: 拉揚在哪裡？

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
He's locked up in the basement, and Rin is interrogating him.
You know, she's the best interrogator we've got. There'll be no escape for that guy ..
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
他被關在地下室，琳恩正在審問他。
你知道的，她是我們要最好的審訊官。那個傢伙別想逃...

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
..Wait, what if the same thing happens..?
No way, that's not possible..
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
...等等，如果發生同樣的事..？
不可能，那不可能發生..

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
The crystal no longer resonates with the space gap.
Now it's exactly the same as a regular Crystal of Darkness.
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
這塊結晶體不再與空間裂縫產生共鳴了。
現在它和普通的黑暗的結晶體完全一樣。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
That means, the phenomenon that you've experienced with the 'Bloody Crystal of Darkness' can't be..
.........
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
也就是說，你之前遇到的“血腥黑暗的結晶體”的現象不可能...
.........

scripts.text: Can't be explained?
scripts.translation: 無法解釋？

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
..I guess not. It might have resonated to your mana or wavelength.
Why don't you carry it with you? Let me know if you experience any strange phenomenon again.
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
...我想也是。它可能只是與你的瑪娜或波長產生了共鳴。
你不妨把它帶在身上。如果再遇到什麼奇怪的現象，告訴我一聲。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
Oh, and please bring ^4d4dffthis journal to Rin^000000.
This will be your last assignment from me.
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
哦，還有，請把^4d4dff這本日誌帶給琳恩^000000。
這是我交給你的最後一個任務。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
..Do you have any questions?
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
...你有什麼問題嗎？

scripts.text: Is this an exchange journal?
scripts.translation: 這是交換日誌嗎？

scripts.text: Why should I carry the crystal?
scripts.translation: 為什麼我要帶著結晶體？

scripts.text: What is this last assignment?
scripts.translation: 這個最後任務是什麼？

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
..No, not at all.
We're just using one journal to record each other's work.
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
...不，完全不是。
我們只是用同一本日誌來記錄彼此的工作。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Why can't you use separate journals and then combine them later?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
為什麼不能各用各的日誌，之後再合併呢？

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
......
Ask Echinacea. I'm just doing what the boss tells me to do.
Using one set journal is a good way to keep in contact and accumulate a history of work in chronological order.
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
......
去問紫錐菊吧。我只是照老闆說的做。
共用一本日誌是保持聯絡並按時間順序積累工作記錄的好方法。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
We came up with the idea to share our experiences
and understand any relation between incidents
as quickly and easily as possible..
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
我們想出了共享經驗的想法，
以便儘可能快速、輕鬆地理解事件之間的關聯...

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
I know it's a little bit counterproductive, but I'm satisfied with the quality of information shared between us.
The notes that Rin has absent-mindedly written down can turn out to be great clues for me..
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
我知道這有點違背常理，但我對我們之間共享的資訊質量很滿意。
琳恩心不在焉記下的筆記，對我來說往往能成為絕佳的線索...

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
Yeah, I agree that the journal looks pretty disorganized.
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
是的，我也覺得這本日誌看起來挺雜亂的。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
... Intuition... I guess?
... These kind of things.
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
...直覺...我想吧？
...就是這類東西。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
Rayan has already been caught, so the task to locate him and Rin is already done.
You were just an assistant to start with.
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
拉揚已經被抓住了，所以尋找他和琳恩的任務已經完成了。
你一開始只是個助手。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
Anyways, please deliver the journal to her safely.
I'm still not done yet; Echinacea already has another task for me..
..*Sigh*..
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
總之，請安全地把日誌交給她。
我還沒忙完呢；紫錐菊已經給我安排了另一個任務...
..*嘆氣*..

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
I asked you to deliver the journal to Rin.
You didn't forget it, did you?
...
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
我讓你把日誌交給琳恩。
你沒忘吧？
...

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
By the way, I'm still not convinced that we've captured the real Rayan.
Will you tell Rin to write down the results of her interrogation in the journal?
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
順便說一句，我仍然不確信我們抓到的是真正的拉揚。
你能讓琳恩把審訊結果記在日誌裡嗎？

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
Of course, I'm pretty sure she'll do it without me reminding her.
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
當然，我相當確信她不用我提醒也會做的。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
You don't have to report everything to me.
