I can check the journal later.
Why don't you go assist Rin for now?
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
你不必事事向我彙報。
我稍後可以檢視日誌。
現在先去協助琳恩吧。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
..Things didn't turn out exactly as we hoped, but there's nothing we can do for now.
Thank you for your service;
you've been of great help to us.
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
...事情並沒有完全按照我們的預期發展，但現在也無能為力了。
感謝你的服務；
你幫了我們大忙。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
What's up?
I told you that I won't have any more work available for you. Well, for a good while, anyway..
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
怎麼了？
我告訴過你，我不會再給你安排更多工作了。好吧，至少很長一段時間內不會。

scripts.text: Want a snack?
scripts.translation: 想吃點零食嗎？

scripts.text: Mr. Defaria has sent me.
scripts.translation: 德法里亞先生派我來的。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
..I guess he's finally made a fire, huh?
Tell him thanks for these sweet potatoes.
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
...看來他終於生火了吧？
替我謝謝他送來的這些紅薯。

scripts.text: Ask about Dandelion.
scripts.translation: 詢問關於蒲公英的事。

scripts.text: Ask about Arunafeltz.
scripts.translation: 詢問關於阿魯納菲茲的事。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
I'm indebted to them, but they all died before I had a chance to pay them back.
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
我欠他們人情，但他們都在我來得及報答之前去世了。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
If you're asking about my political opinion, I'm not going to answer.
This isn't something with which I can interfere.
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
如果你是在問我的政治觀點，我不會回答。
這不是我能干涉的事情。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
My personal opinion?
Let me tell you that, from their point of view; their one last chance was destroyed.
They're probably too ashamed to even talk about it.
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
我的個人觀點？
讓我告訴你，從他們的角度來看；他們最後的機會被摧毀了。
他們可能羞愧得連話都說不出口。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
Let our diplomats use that fact to their advantage, alright?
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
讓我們的外交官利用這一事實，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
Nothing.
I have no comments.
No conflicts have arisen recently, either.
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
沒什麼。
我無話可說。
最近也沒有發生任何衝突。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
Besides, nationality isn't important to us.
What's important is whether or not they're our enemies, and whether or not they're the target of our missions.
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
而且，國籍對我們來說並不重要。
重要的是他們是否是敵人，以及他們是否是我們任務的目標。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Err? I don't have two Nice Sweet Potatoes..
Where can I get those?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
咦？我沒有兩個美味紅薯...
我該去哪裡弄到它們？

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
Don't try to understand everything.
A mission is just a mission.
Don't get too emotional or curious about it.
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
不要試圖理解一切。
任務只是任務。
不要對此過於情緒化或好奇。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
...You'd better not approach the space gap off the official route.
If you're not authorized, then turn away. This thing is too dangerous for capricious exploration.
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
...你最好不要偏離官方路線接近空間裂隙。
如果你沒有授權，就請離開。這東西太危險了，不適合隨意探索。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
{0}? {1}?!
Wake up!
- You cannot proceed with the quest when you're carrying too many items with you. -
scripts.translation: - 攜帶物品過多時，無法繼續任務。 -

scripts.text:
[Defaria]
Please step aside.
I'm experiencing a turning point in my life right now.
.....
scripts.translation:
[德法里亞]
請讓一下。
我現在正經歷人生的轉折點。
.....

scripts.text: - The fire sparked, but then it immediatly blew out. -
scripts.translation: - 火苗剛剛點燃，隨即就熄滅了。 -

scripts.text:
[Defaria]
...............
You know, that was my ninety-third attempt to make a fire with wet firewood.
scripts.translation:
[德法里亞]
...............
你知道嗎，這是我第九十三次嘗試用溼柴生火了。

scripts.text:
[Defaria]
Wait, was that the ninty fourth ot ninety fifth?
..I've.. I've lost count.
scripts.translation:
[德法里亞]
等等，是第九十四次還是第九十五次？
..我..我數不清了。

scripts.text:
[Defaria]
Please step aside.
I'm experiencing a turning point in my life right now.
......
scripts.translation:
[德法里亞]
請讓一下。
我現在正經歷人生的轉折點。
......

scripts.text: - The fire sparked, but then it immediately blew out.-
scripts.translation: - 火苗剛剛點燃，隨即就熄滅了。-

scripts.text:
[Defaria]
...............
Are you also here...............
to make fun of my stupid attempt to roast these sweet potatoes with wet firewood?
scripts.translation:
[德法里亞]
...............
你也在這裡...............
是為了嘲笑我用溼柴烤紅薯的愚蠢嘗試嗎？

scripts.text:
[Defaria]
...No? Then what brings you here?
...Huh?
A spell scroll? May I see?
scripts.translation:
[德法里亞]
...不？那你來這裡做什麼？
...嗯？
法術卷軸？能讓我看看嗎？

scripts.text:
[Defaria]
...Isn't... Isn't this?!
...Hmm...
Eek... So Echinacea referred you to me, huh?
...Does that means she knows everything...?
scripts.translation:
[德法里亞]
...這不是...這不是嗎？！
...嗯...
天哪...所以是紫錐菊讓你來找我的，對吧？
...這意味著她知道一切...？

scripts.text:
[Defaria]
...Alright then, I'll tell you.
As you can see, this scroll is sealed.
It can only be unsealed by a secret method.
...And...
scripts.translation:
[德法里亞]
...好吧，我告訴你。
正如你所見，這個卷軸是被封印的。
只有使用秘密方法才能解除封印。
...而且...

scripts.text:
[Defaria]
...It is from....
...Arunafeltz?
The way it's sealed is the same method used by the temple...
scripts.translation:
[德法里亞]
...它來自....
...阿魯納菲茲？
它的封印方式與寺廟使用的方法相同...

scripts.text:
[Defaria]
I don't know how you've gotten this scroll,
...but I'll try to help you on behalf of the respectable scholars of Arunafeltz.
scripts.translation:
[德法里亞]
我不知道你是怎麼得到這個卷軸的，
...但我會代表阿魯納菲茲尊貴的學者們盡力幫助你。

scripts.text:
[Defaria]
But remember; I'm not doing this officially. Please don't make me disgrace my country by helping you. Do you understand what I'm saying?
scripts.translation:
[德法里亞]
但請記住；我並不是在履行官方職責。請不要讓我因為幫助你而讓國家蒙羞。你明白我的意思嗎？

scripts.text: Got it.
scripts.translation: 明白了。

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不。

scripts.text:
[Defaria]
Good. Then I expect you to help me by gathering the items I need to unseal the scroll:
^4d4dff30 Holy Waters, Runes of Darkness, and Bloody Runes^000000.
scripts.translation:
[德法里亞]
很好。那麼我希望你能幫我收集解除卷軸封印所需的物品：
^4d4dff30聖水、黑暗符文和血色的輪^000000。

scripts.text:
[Defaria]
I'll be waiting for your return.
scripts.translation:
[德法里亞]
我會在這裡等你回來。

scripts.text:
[Defaria]
At first, you looked like someone who is reliable and understands the difference between official and private matters.
Your answer just proved me wrong.
Echinacea must be getting desperate if she's asking people like you for help.
scripts.translation:
[德法里亞]
起初，你看起來像個可靠且懂得區分公事與私事的人。
你的回答證明我錯了。
紫錐菊一定很絕望，才會向像你這樣的人求助。

scripts.text:
[Defaria]
Oh, you've brought everything!
Good, it wasn't hard, was it?
Okay, can you come back in a little bit?
scripts.translation:
[德法里亞]
哦，你帶齊了所有東西！
很好，這並不難，對吧？
好的，你能過一會兒再回來嗎？

scripts.text:
[Defaria]
To unseal the scroll,
I need ^4d4dff30 Holy Waters, Runes of the Darkness, and Bloody Runes^000000.
Don't forget to bring the spell scroll along with them.
scripts.translation:
[德法里亞]
要解除卷軸的封印，
我需要^4d4dff30聖水、黑暗符文和血色的輪^000000。
別忘了把法術卷軸也一起帶來。

scripts.text:
[Defaria]
While you're gathering the items, I'll be roasting my sweet potatoes.
If I could only make this fire work...
scripts.translation:
[德法里亞]
在你收集物品的這段時間裡，我會繼續烤我的紅薯。
要是我能把這火生起來就好了...

scripts.text:
[Defaria]
Welcome back; you came at the perfect time.
First, this spell scroll contains a teleportation spell.
You know what teleportation is, don't you?
scripts.translation:
[德法里亞]
歡迎回來；你來得正是時候。
首先，這個法術卷軸裡包含一個瞬間移動法術。
你知道什麼是瞬間移動，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Defaria]
You know,
it's a spell that instantly moves you to a different location.
That's the spell contained in this scroll.
scripts.translation:
[德法里亞]
你知道的，
這是一種能瞬間將你移動到不同地點的法術。
這張卷軸裡包含的就是這種法術。

scripts.text:
[Defaria]
The only difference is...
This scroll will teleport you to a specific location.
Such scrolls are generally used by ^4d4dfforganizations to gather their members^000000.
scripts.translation:
[德法里亞]
唯一的區別是...
這張卷軸會將你傳送到一個特定的地點。
這類卷軸通常被^4d4dff組織用來召集其成員^000000。

scripts.text:
[Defaria]
I don't know where this scroll will lead you..
You'll be the one using this scroll. Am I right?
Here, please take this.
scripts.translation:
[德法里亞]
我不知道這張卷軸會把你帶到哪裡。
畢竟是你自己要用這張卷軸，對吧？
給，請收下。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
'To gather members...?'
...Right! I remember
Rayan mentioned a gathering somewhere!
So this scroll will take me to that meeting?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
'召整合員...？'
...對了！我記得
拉揚提到過要在某個地方聚會！
所以這張卷軸會帶我去那個聚會嗎？

scripts.text:
[Defaria]
Um, do you mind? Would you stop talking to yourself and just leave already?
I'm sorry, but this old man needs some rest, alright?
scripts.translation:
[德法里亞]
呃，你介意嗎？能不能別自言自語，趕緊離開？
抱歉，但這把老骨頭需要休息一下，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Defaria]
Don't be so impatient.
You can come back later.
It'll take some time.
scripts.translation:
[德法里亞]
別這麼急躁。
你可以稍後再來。
這需要一些時間。

scripts.text:
[Defaria]
What are you so worried about?
You'll see how it works as soon as you use it.
scripts.translation:
[德法里亞]
你這麼擔心什麼？
等你一使用它，就會知道它是如何運作的。

scripts.text:
[Defaria]
..Huh? What do you want?
scripts.translation:
[德法里亞]
..嗯？你想幹什麼？

scripts.text:
[Defaria]
..I know they're involved in this case, but
we shouldn't talk about them.
scripts.translation:
[德法里亞]
..我知道他們與此事有關，但
我們不應該談論他們。

scripts.text: Just tell me what you know.
scripts.translation: 告訴我你知道的一切。

scripts.text: Alright..
scripts.translation: 好吧..

scripts.text:
[Defaria]
Why should I go through all that trouble?
You can go and ask Echinaea.
This old man needs some rest, alright?
scripts.translation:
[德法里亞]
我為什麼要費那個勁？
你可以去問問紫錐菊。
這把老骨頭需要休息一下，好嗎？

scripts.text: I'll do anything for you.
scripts.translation: 我為你做任何事。

scripts.text:
[Defaria]
Anything?
Are you serious?
scripts.translation:
[德法里亞]
任何事？
你是認真的嗎？

scripts.text: Haha, got you!
scripts.translation: 哈哈，上當了！

scripts.text: Yes!
scripts.translation: 準備好了！

scripts.text:
[Defaria]
What th--! How dare you fool an old man!
You little punk!
scripts.translation:
[德法里亞]
什...！你竟敢戲弄一個老人！
你這朽魔！

scripts.text:
[Defaria]
I may be old,
but I'm a representative of great Arunafeltz's scholars!
It's a mistake to trifle with me like that!
scripts.translation:
[德法里亞]
雖然我老了，
但我可是偉大的阿魯納菲茲學者們的代表！
像這樣戲弄我，可是大錯特錯！

scripts.text:
[Defaria]
Did you think I'm stupid just because I was trying to make a fire with wet firewood?!
..*Pant Pant*.. Phew, even yelling tires me out..
scripts.translation:
[德法里亞]
你以為我因為試圖用溼柴生火就傻了嗎？！
..*喘氣 喘氣*.. 呼，連喊叫都讓我累了..

scripts.text:
[Defaria]
Then...
...Umm... Can you bring me some Logs?
...And some sweet potatoes too, if you don't mind.
scripts.translation:
[德法里亞]
那麼...
...呃... 你能幫我帶些原木來嗎？
...如果不介意的話，再帶些紅薯。

scripts.text: Sure thing. How many?
scripts.translation: 沒問題。要多少？

scripts.text:
[Defaria]
...Let's see...
I need sweet potatoes for me, Mr. Kidd, and Echi... Umm...
...And then I need... Yes!
scripts.translation:
[德法里亞]
...讓我想想...
我需要紅薯，給我、基德先生和艾奇... 呃...
...然後還需要... 對了！

scripts.text:
[Defaria]
Please bring me ^4d4dff20 Sweet Potatoes and 30 Logs^000000.
I'll be waiting for your return.
scripts.translation:
[德法里亞]
請給我^4d4dff20個紅薯和30根原木^000000。
我會等你回來。

scripts.text:
[Defaria]
You seem to give up really easily.
I don't blame you. Sometimes giving up is the best decision,
not to mention that it takes a certain kind of courage.
scripts.translation:
[德法里亞]
你似乎很容易放棄。
我不怪你。有時候放棄是最好的決定，
況且這需要某種勇氣。

scripts.text:
[Defaria]
For example, Tarous that know when to abandon their hopes of getting cheese, you know, the bait in traps, are the hardest ones to catch. You know?
..Hahaha!
scripts.translation:
[德法里亞]
比如，那些知道何時放棄對乳酪的希望的白鼠，你知道的，陷阱裡的誘餌，是最難捕捉的。懂嗎？
..哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Defaria]
...Arunafeltz...?
Yes, I'm from Arunafeltz...
So what?
scripts.translation:
[德法里亞]
...阿魯納菲茲...？
是的，我來自阿魯納菲茲...
那又怎樣？

scripts.text:
[Defaria]
Be more specific about your question,
and stop being so ambiguous.
scripts.translation:
[德法里亞]
把你的問題說得更具體一點，
別這麼含糊其辭。

scripts.text:
[Defaria]
Oh, you've really brought what I wanted!
Please give them to me..
No, wait, can you pile them on the firewood over there?
scripts.translation:
[德法里亞]
哦，你真的帶來了我要的東西！
請把它們給我..
不，等等，你能把它們堆在那邊的柴火堆上嗎？

scripts.text:
[Defaria]
Make it a nice, neat pile, please.
Oh, you forgot to put the sweet potatoes on top.
Yes, good. That's perfect.
scripts.translation:
[德法里亞]
請堆得整齊漂亮一點。
哦，你忘了把紅薯放在上面。
是的，很好。完美。

scripts.text:
[Defaria]
Hopefully I can make a fire with your nice logs....
scripts.translation:
[德法里亞]
希望我能用你帶來的漂亮原木生火....

scripts.text:
[Defaria]
Oh, this is as great as I'd hoped!
I guess my magic hasn't gotten that rusty after all..
scripts.translation:
[德法里亞]
哦，這比我預期的還要好！
看來我的魔法並沒有那麼生疏..

scripts.text:
[Defaria]
If you want me to do you a favor, then
you should bring me ^4d4dff20 Sweet Potatoes and 30 Logs^000000 in return.
scripts.translation:
[德法里亞]
如果你想讓我幫你個忙，那麼
你應該作為回報給我^4d4dff20個紅薯和30根原木^000000。

scripts.text: - Defaria is blowing on a roast sweet potato, peeling off it's skin. -
scripts.translation: - 德法里亞正在吹烤紅薯，剝掉它的皮。 -

scripts.text: Excuse me, sir...
scripts.translation: 打擾一下，先生...

scripts.text:
[Defaria]
What..?
scripts.translation:
[德法里亞]
什...？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Didn't you forget something?
... Dandelion? I wanted you to tell me what you knew.
I was hoping you'd remember something about Dandelion.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你忘了什麼嗎？
... 蒲公英？我想讓你告訴我你知道的事。
我希望你能想起一些關於蒲公英的事。

scripts.text:
[Defaria]
So,
do you want me to confirm
if Dandelion is really supported by Arunafeltz?
scripts.translation:
[德法里亞]
那麼，
你想讓我確認
蒲公英是否真的得到阿魯納菲茲的支援嗎？

scripts.text:
[Defaria]
Umm... I don't know what to say... I don't feel comfortable talking about politics.
scripts.translation:
[德法里亞]
呃... 我不知道該說什麼... 我不太想談論政治。

scripts.text:
[Defaria]
...Do you mind delivering these to Mr. Kidd?
scripts.translation:
[德法里亞]
...你介意把這些交給基德先生嗎？

scripts.text: - Defaria has given you 2 Nice Sweet Potatoes. -
scripts.translation: - 德法里亞給了你2個美味紅薯。 -

scripts.text:
[Defaria]
Um, I just told you to deliver those sweet potatoes to Mr. Kidd.
scripts.translation:
[德法里亞]
呃，我剛剛才讓你把那些紅薯交給基德先生。

scripts.text:
[Defaria]
Say, did he like them?
Hahaha...
... ...
scripts.translation:
[德法里亞]
話說，他喜歡嗎？
哈哈哈...
... ...

scripts.text:
[Defaria]
Dandelion was like a ghost.
There are many different types of people in this world.
Some people want war while others are against it.
scripts.translation:
[德法里亞]
蒲公英就像幽靈一樣。
這個世界上有各種各樣的人。
有些人想要戰爭，而有些人則反對戰爭。

scripts.text:
[Defaria]
The Dandelions were the former case.
Those right-ists believed in a distorted patriotism. They thought shedding blood was the only way to make peace.
scripts.translation:
[德法里亞]
蒲公英屬於前者。
那些右翼分子信奉一種扭曲的愛國主義。他們認為流血是達成和平的唯一途徑。

scripts.text:
[Defaria]
They organized Dandelion,
and they happened to ally themselves with the warmongers in the government.
scripts.translation:
[德法里亞]
他們組織了蒲公英，
並且恰好與政府中的戰爭狂熱者結成了同盟。

scripts.text:
[Defaria]
That's how they grew so strong.
At first, their purpose was limited to gathering intel and spying on other countries.
This is just what I think, but the right information can cause chaos in a country.
scripts.translation:
[德法里亞]
他們就是這樣變得強大的。
起初，他們的目的僅限於收集情報和監視他國。
這只是我的個人看法，但正確的情報足以讓一個國家陷入混亂。

scripts.text: Then what..?
scripts.translation: 那麼接下來呢..?

scripts.text:
[Defaria]
Can't you see it by now? Isn't it obvious?
Well, if you can't take care of your own problems,
then you won't be able to handle your enemies.
scripts.translation:
[德法里亞]
你現在還看不出來嗎？這不是很明顯嗎？
好吧，如果你連自己的問題都解決不了，
那你也就無法對付你的敵人了。

scripts.text: So Arunafeltz planned all this!
scripts.translation: 所以是阿魯納菲茲策劃了這一切！

scripts.text:
[Defaria]
No, it isn't that simple. The world isn't just black and white, you know?
Just bring these to Echinacea, will you?
They're cooked very well.
scripts.translation:
[德法里亞]
不，事情沒那麼簡單。世界不是非黑即白的，你知道嗎？
把這些交給紫錐菊，好嗎？
它們烤得很好。

scripts.text: - You have received 2 steaming hot Nice Sweet Potatoes. -
scripts.translation: - 你收到了2個熱氣騰騰的美味紅薯。 -

scripts.text:
[Defaria]
I told you to deliver those cooked sweet potatoes to Echinacea.
Don't eat them, alright?
scripts.translation:
[德法里亞]
我讓你把那些烤好的紅薯交給紫錐菊。
別偷吃，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Defaria]
Muhahahaha!
Did Echinacea really say that?
She's an executive of the Rune-Midgarts army.
I can tell that what she said came from the bottom of her heart.
scripts.translation:
[德法里亞]
穆哈哈哈哈哈！
紫錐菊真的那麼說了嗎？
她是盧恩·米德加茲軍隊的執行官。
我能感覺到，她說的話是發自內心的。

scripts.text:
[Defaria]
I'm relieved that things turned out this way.
After all, they're the reason why the three countries decided to cooperate.
Of course, it's too early to say if the cooperation will last long.
scripts.translation:
[德法里亞]
事情能變成這樣，我鬆了一口氣。
畢竟，正是因為她們，三個國家才決定合作。
當然，現在說合作能持續多久還為時過早。

scripts.text:
[Defaria]
I just hope that the three countries will use this chance to form lasting, friendly relationships. Wouldn't that be great for the sake of everyone in the world?
Hrrm, but I'm not holding my breath for world peace.
scripts.translation:
[德法里亞]
我只希望三個國家能利用這次機會建立持久的友好關係。這對世界上所有人來說不是件好事嗎？
哼，不過我對世界和平並不抱太大希望。

scripts.text:
[Defaria]
I'm just a mere human who can't foresee the future, you know?
..Hahaha..
scripts.translation:
[德法里亞]
我只是一個無法預見未來的普通人，你知道嗎？
..哈哈哈..

scripts.text:
[Defaria]
Ah, your sweet potatoes are now roasted very well.
Here, enjoy them.
Thank you for trying so hard to please this whimsical old man.
scripts.translation:
[德法里亞]
啊，你的紅薯現在烤得很好了。
拿去，好好享用吧。
謝謝你這麼努力地討好我這個古怪的老人。

scripts.text:
- Defaria is lost in thought, standing with a poker in one hand
and a sweet potato in the other. -
scripts.translation:
- 德法里亞若有所思地站著，一手拿著火鉗，
一手拿著紅薯。 -

scripts.text:
- Sometimes, he looks to the sky, sighs, and then says, 'I'm envious of young people these days ..'
or something like 'I don't care anymore, no matter what happens.' -
scripts.translation:
- 有時，他會望向天空，嘆口氣，然後說：
'我很羨慕現在的年輕人 ..'
或者類似'我不在乎了，不管發生什麼'的話。 -

scripts.text: - It sounds like he's having some pretty deep moments, so let's not disturb him. -
scripts.translation: - 聽起來他正在經歷一些深刻的時刻，所以別打擾他了。 -

scripts.text:
[Defaria]
Please leave me alone unless you have extremely important business with me.
I have so many things that I want to do...
scripts.translation:
[德法里亞]
除非有極其重要的事情，否則請別打擾我。
我還有很多事情想做...

scripts.text:
You've found some half-burnt logs of high quality.
It seems somebody already roasted sweet potatoes with these logs.
scripts.translation:
你找到了一些燃燒了一半的高品質木柴。
看起來有人已經用這些木柴烤過紅薯了。

scripts.text:
You've found camp firewood that is too wet to make a fire.
It seems somebody has been futilely attempting to make a fire with them.
scripts.translation:
你找到了一些太溼而無法生火的露營木柴。
看起來有人曾徒勞地試圖用它們生火。

scripts.text:
[Jack]
Almost half of this town has been destroyed,
and yet some people still come to visit.
I must say that it's amazing that our stronghold is still intact, and withstood all the devastation.
scripts.translation:
[傑克]
這座城鎮幾乎有一半被摧毀了，
卻仍有人前來參觀。
不得不說，我們的據點依然完好無損，經受住了所有的破壞，這真是令人驚歎。

scripts.text:
[Jack]
As you see, half of this town is gone. I guess there's no real reason to control access to this tavern.
Just feel free to go in.
scripts.translation:
[傑克]
正如你所見，這座城鎮的一半已經消失了。我想沒有必要再限制進入這家酒館了。
請隨意進去吧。

scripts.text:
[Jack]
I'm impressed by your courage to step into this hell.
scripts.translation:
[傑克]
我很佩服你敢於踏入這片地獄的勇氣。

scripts.text:
[Jack]
Oh, not everyone can enter that place...!
...
Nevermind.
scripts.translation:
[傑克]
哦，不是所有人都能進入那個地方...！
...
算了。

scripts.text:
[Jack]
Since everything has changed,
just feel free to enter wherever you want!
scripts.translation:
[傑克]
既然一切都變了，
請隨意進入任何你想去的地方！

scripts.text:
^3355FFWait a second!
Right now, you're carrying
too many things with you.
Please come back after
using the Kafra Service
to store some of your items.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF等一下！
你現在攜帶的物品太多了。
請先使用卡普拉服務
將部分物品存入倉庫，
然後再回來。^000000

scripts.text:
[Karred]
Welcome.
Care for a drink?
scripts.translation:
[卡雷德]
歡迎光臨。
要來杯飲料嗎？

scripts.text:
[Karred]
What would you like to drink?
scripts.translation:
[卡雷德]
您想喝點什麼？

scripts.text: Order a Drink
scripts.translation: 點一杯飲料

scripts.text: About the mission
scripts.translation: 關於任務

scripts.text: Quit
scripts.translation: 退出

scripts.text:
[Karred]
We have Tropical Sograt
and Vermillion on the Beach.
Which one would you like to drink?
scripts.translation:
[卡雷德]
我們有熱帶的蘇克拉特
和海灘上的硃紅。
您想喝哪一種？

scripts.text: Tropical Sograt
scripts.translation: 熱帶的蘇克拉特

scripts.text: Vermilion on the Beach
scripts.translation: 赤色海灘

scripts.text: How about a free drink?
scripts.translation: 來杯免費的怎麼樣？

scripts.text:
[Karred]
Are you sure you can even hold a glass of alcohol?
You're carrying too many things on you already.
scripts.translation:
[卡雷德]
你確定自己能拿穩酒杯嗎？
你身上已經背了太多東西了。

scripts.text:
[Karred]
I can give you a special discount, but
you don't have enough money to even pay the special price.
Why don't you check your money first?
This drink is only 800 zeny for Assassins!
scripts.translation:
[卡雷德]
我可以給你特別的低價買進，
但你的錢連這個特價都付不起。
為什麼不先檢查一下你的錢呢？
這杯飲料對刺客來說只要800 Zeny！

scripts.text:
[Karred]
I'll give you a special discount.
Here, drink up.
This drink is mainly made of fruit juice,
but you still shouldn't drink too much.
scripts.translation:
[卡雷德]
我會給你特別的低價買進。
拿去，喝吧。
這杯飲料主要是果汁做的，
但你還是不應該喝太多。

scripts.text:
[Karred]
Do you even have any money?
Why don't you check your money first?
It's 1000 zeny for one glass.
scripts.translation:
[卡雷德]
你身上有錢嗎？
為什麼不先檢查一下你的錢呢？
一杯要1000 Zeny。

scripts.text:
[Karred]
There you go.
This drink is mainly made of fruit juice,
but you still shouldn't drink too much.
scripts.translation:
[卡雷德]
給你。
這杯飲料主要是果汁做的，
但你還是不應該喝太多。

scripts.text:
[Karred]
Are you sure you can even hold a glass of alcohol?
You're carrying too many things on you already.
scripts.translation:
[卡雷德]
你確定自己能拿穩酒杯嗎？
你身上已經背了太多東西了。

scripts.text:
[Karred]
I can give you a special discount, but
you don't have enough money to even pay the special price.
Why don't you check your money first?
This drink is only 800 zeny for Assassins!
scripts.translation:
[卡雷德]
我可以給你特別的低價買進，
但你的錢連這個特價都付不起。
為什麼不先檢查一下你的錢呢？
這杯飲料對刺客來說只要800 Zeny！

scripts.text:
[Karred]
I'll give you a special discount.
Here, enjoy.
scripts.translation:
[卡雷德]
我會給你特別的低價買進。
拿去，好好享用。

scripts.text:
[Karred]
Do you even have any money?
Why don't you check your money first?
It's 1000 zeny for one glass.
scripts.translation:
[卡雷德]
你身上有錢嗎？
為什麼不先檢查一下你的錢呢？
一杯要1000 Zeny。

scripts.text:
[Karred]
There you go.
Don't drink too much, alright?
scripts.translation:
[卡雷德]
給你。
別喝太多，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Karred]
.........
Get out.
scripts.translation:
[卡雷德]
……
滾出去。

scripts.text:
[Karred]
How many I help you?
scripts.translation:
[卡雷德]
我幫過你多少次了？

scripts.text:
[Karred]
...Rin? I see. So you're assisting Mr. Kidd.
Rin...she's in the room inside.
She was gravely injured not that long ago...
scripts.translation:
[卡雷德]
……琳恩？原來如此，你是來協助基德先生的。
琳恩……她在裡面的房間。
她不久前受了重傷……

scripts.text:
[Karred]
You can't expect your job to always go smoothly.
Of course there will be risks.
Why don't you go pay her a visit?
scripts.translation:
[卡雷德]
你不能指望工作總是順順利利的。
當然會有風險。
你不妨去探望一下她？

scripts.text:
[Karred]
Rin needs to rest for now. I hope you'll do what you can to help her out.
But please do take care of yourself as well.
scripts.translation:
[卡雷德]
琳恩現在需要休息。希望你能盡力幫她一把。
但請你也照顧好自己。

scripts.text:
[Karred]
You and Rin are like my children to me, and such injuries...
Sigh...it's torture for me to see.
scripts.translation:
[卡雷德]
你和琳恩對我來說就像我的孩子一樣，看到這樣的傷勢……
唉……看著真是讓人心痛。

scripts.text:
[Karred]
I hope you'll come by more often. This place is open to you always, even if you don't have missions.
scripts.translation:
[卡雷德]
希望你以後能常來。這裡永遠對你敞開大門，即使你沒有任務在身。

scripts.text:
[Karred]
Rin needs to rest in bed for a while. I hope you'll help her complete her duties.
...This is quite embarrassing to admit, but I see her like my own daughter.
scripts.translation:
[卡雷德]
琳恩需要在床上休息一陣子。希望你能幫她完成職責。
……這話說出來有點不好意思，但我把她看作自己的女兒。

scripts.text:
[Litheron]
Ah, just forget what I said. That was out of line.
I guess I'm drunk after dealing with alcohol all day.
scripts.translation:
[利瑟隆]
啊，忘了我剛才說的話吧。那是我不對。
我想我喝醉了，畢竟整天都在跟酒打交道。

scripts.text:
[Karred]
How may I help you?
For your information, the 'recommendation' has lost its effect. You'd better go back.
scripts.translation:
[卡雷德]
有什麼可以幫你的嗎？
順便告訴你，那個“推薦”已經失效了。你最好還是回去吧。

scripts.text: I'm here for Rin!
scripts.translation: 我是來找琳恩的！

scripts.text:
[Karred]
...? Why are you looking for Rin?
scripts.translation:
[卡雷德]
……？你為什麼要找琳恩？

scripts.text:
[Karred]
I see. So you're a member of the Ash Vacuum expedition.
Rin is in the inner room.
...She's been badly injured and is resting in bed. Don't do anything to shock her, alright?
scripts.translation:
[卡雷德]
原來如此，你是阿什真空探險隊的成員。
琳恩在裡面的房間。
……她受了重傷，正在床上休息。別做讓她受驚的事，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Karred]
Hmmm.
scripts.translation:
[卡雷德]
嗯。

scripts.text:
[Litheron]
Hey, wait.
Only authorized personnel can enter the inner room.
Hey Master, is it okay to let this guy in?
scripts.translation:
[利瑟隆]
嘿，等等。
只有授權人員才能進入裡面的房間。
嘿，師父，讓這傢伙進去沒問題嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I, um, I'm looking
for somebody named
Marjana? I learned
that she's around
here somewhere?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我，嗯，我在找一個叫瑪爾雅娜的人？
我聽說她就在附近某處？

scripts.text:
[Litheron]
Marjana? How did you
know that? Hey master,
what do I do with this guy?
scripts.translation:
[利瑟隆]
瑪爾雅娜？你怎麼知道這個名字的？
嘿，師父，我該怎麼處理這傢伙？

scripts.text:
[Master]
Hmm. I sense no ill intent
from this adventurer. I've
also heard a rumor that the
Prontera Church needs to
investigate poison for
some reason.
scripts.translation:
[師父]
嗯。我感覺到這位冒險者沒有惡意。
我也聽說普隆德拉教會因為某種原因
需要調查毒藥。

scripts.text:
[Master]
However, there is no
way to tell if this person
has been sent by Prontera
Church. I suppose whether
this person can enter is
really up to you, Litheron.
scripts.translation:
[師父]
然而，沒有辦法確定這個人
是否是普隆德拉教會派來的。
我想，這個人能否進入
完全由你決定，利瑟隆。

scripts.text:
[Litheron]
Hah! Did you hear that?
Alright, how about this?
I'll let you in if you buy me
a drink. Besides, you can't risk making trouble here: this place
is full of deadly Assassins.
scripts.translation:
[利瑟隆]
哈！你聽到了嗎？
好吧，這樣吧？
如果你請我喝一杯，我就讓你進去。
而且，你不敢在這裡惹事：
這裡到處都是致命的刺客。

scripts.text: Sure
scripts.translation: 當然

scripts.text: Why should I?!
scripts.translation: 我為什麼要？

scripts.text:
[Litheron]
Heh, that's what
I'm talking about!
Hey, bartender! Gimme
the usual! I like your
style, adventurer...
scripts.translation:
[利瑟隆]
嘿，這才像話！
嘿，調酒師！來老樣子！
我喜歡你的風格，冒險者...

scripts.text:
[Litheron]
Huh...
Oh, you don't even
have enough zeny to
buy water here. Oh boy...
If you really want to enter,
make sure you have the cash!
scripts.translation:
[利瑟隆]
嗯...
哦，你連買水的Zeny都不夠。天哪...
如果你真的想進來，
確保你帶夠了錢！

scripts.text:
[Litheron]
Alright, you can come
on in. But don't you dare
breathe a word about this
bar to another living soul.
scripts.translation:
[利瑟隆]
好吧，你可以進來了。
但你絕對不要對任何活人
透露這家酒吧的事。

scripts.text:
[Litheron]
Not the saavy type,
are you...? Fine, fine.
If you're not gonna do
me any favors, then why
should I help you? Go away!
scripts.translation:
[利瑟隆]
你可不是那種會討人喜歡的型別，
對吧……？算了，算了。
如果你不給我好處，
我為什麼要幫你？滾開！

scripts.text:
[Bar Master]
If you keep outsiders away from the entrance, every drink you drink today will be on the house.
So keep up the good work.
scripts.translation:
[酒吧老闆]
如果你能把外人擋在門口，今天你喝的所有酒都請客。
所以請繼續努力。

scripts.text:
[Bar Master]
Yay! Did you hear that?
That's my cue to get you outta here!
scripts.translation:
[酒吧老闆]
耶！你聽到了嗎？
這就是讓我把你趕出去的訊號！

scripts.text:
[Litheron]
What, haven't you seen a Knight before?
You think Knights don't belong here?
Looks like this is a case of the pot calling the kettle black.
scripts.translation:
[利瑟隆]
什麼，你以前沒見過騎士嗎？
你覺得騎士不該出現在這裡？
看來這是典型的“五十步笑百步”啊。

scripts.text:
[Litheron]
What, haven't you seen a Knight before?
You think Knights don't belong here?
scripts.translation:
[利瑟隆]
什麼，你以前沒見過騎士嗎？
你覺得騎士不該出現在這裡？

scripts.text:
[Litheron]
You know, I'm just here to take a break from the town restoration work.
There aren't many places that you can have a drink without being caught. You know?
scripts.translation:
[利瑟隆]
你知道的，我只是來這裡休息一下，暫時逃離城鎮重建的工作。
畢竟，能喝酒又不被發現的地方可不多。你懂的吧？

scripts.text:
[Tao]
Welcome, meow.
Say, how's it like outside? Meow?
scripts.translation:
[陶]
歡迎光臨，喵。
喂，外面怎麼樣了？喵？

scripts.text:
[Tao]
Why are you here, meow?
scripts.translation:
[陶]
你來這裡做什麼，喵？

scripts.text: Is Marjana in?
scripts.translation: 瑪爾雅娜在嗎？

scripts.text: I'm here to see you, Tao.
scripts.translation: 我是來找你的，陶。

scripts.text:
[Tao]
She's in the room on your left, meow~
But then, how d'you know she's here, meow?
scripts.translation:
[陶]
她在左邊的房間裡，喵~
不過，你怎麼知道她在這裡的，喵？

scripts.text:
[Tao]
This is no place for playing, meow..
... Hey, it's awkward you looking at me like that, meow..
scripts.translation:
[陶]
這裡可不是玩耍的地方，喵..
... 喂，你這樣盯著我看，讓我很不自在，喵..

scripts.text:
[Tao]
Tao knows what you're thinking, meow~ You're here to see big sister Rin, am I right, meow? 
Hehe, where is she, I wonder, meow~
scripts.translation:
[陶]
陶知道你在想什麼，喵~ 你是來找琳恩姐姐的，對吧，喵？
呵呵，不知道她在哪呢，喵~

scripts.text:
[Tao]
If you don't have any reason to be here, you should leave, meow!
Not everyone can enter this place, meow.
Somehow you're here, but you can't go in the room.
scripts.translation:
[陶]
如果你沒有正當理由來這裡，就請離開，喵！
不是誰都能進入這個地方的，喵。
雖然你進來了，但不能進房間。

scripts.text:
[Tao]
No, wait... I think you may be able to go in... I don't know, meow!
Tao is tired of being a door keeper, meow! Meow!
scripts.translation:
[陶]
不，等等... 我覺得你可以進去... 我也不清楚，喵！
陶受夠了當看門人了，喵！喵！

scripts.text: Hey kid, are you alone?
scripts.translation: 嘿，小孩，你一個人嗎？

scripts.text: What are you, meow?!
scripts.translation: 你是什麼東西，喵？！

scripts.text: Why do you keep meowing?!
scripts.translation: 你為什麼一直喵喵叫？！

scripts.text:
[Tao]
Who are you calling a kid?
Tao is a good door keeper!
Don't call me a kid!
scripts.translation:
[陶]
誰是小鬼？
陶是個優秀的看門人！
別叫我小鬼！

scripts.text:
[Tao]
I can tell you've got some reason for being here, but you've put yourself in trouble!
You're mistaken if you thought I would tell you
Master and Marjana are in the left room. Grrr.. Meow!
scripts.translation:
[陶]
我能看出你來這裡是有原因的，但你給自己惹麻煩了！
如果你以為我會告訴你
師父和瑪爾雅娜在左邊的房間，那你就錯了。嗚嗚.. 喵！

scripts.text:
[Tao]
Are you making fun of me being a door keeper, meow?!
Grrr...
scripts.translation:
[陶]
你是在嘲笑我是看門人嗎，喵？！
嗚嗚...

scripts.text:
[Tao]
You make me mad, meow. Get lost!!
scripts.translation:
[陶]
你讓我很生氣，喵。滾開！！

scripts.text:
[Tao]
It's a long story, meow.
It's been a long time since I started meowing one day..
That day, Tao wanted to have a Big Ribbon so badly.
scripts.translation:
[陶]
說來話長，喵。
從有一天我開始喵喵叫，已經過去很久了..
那天，陶非常非常想要一條紅蝶髮帶。

scripts.text:
[Tao]
So Tao went to find Wild Roses.
Meow?! Why am I telling you this, meow?!
scripts.translation:
[陶]
所以陶去找狂暴野貓了。
喵？！我為什麼要告訴你這些，喵？！

scripts.text:
[Tao]
Grrr!
What are you, meow?!
scripts.translation:
[陶]
嗚嗚！
你是什麼東西，喵？！

scripts.text:
[Tao]
Get out!
scripts.translation:
[陶]
出去！

scripts.text:
[Tao]
Ah, that place is protected
by security magic, so you'll
only have ^4D4DFF4 minutes^000000 to remain
there. Don't waste time, meow!
scripts.translation:
[陶]
啊，那個地方有魔法保護，
所以你只有^4D4DFF4分鐘^000000的時間待在那裡。
別浪費時間，喵！

scripts.text:
[Tao]
Sooo sorry, meow~
Someone else is already
inside. Just come back
again later, meow?
scripts.translation:
[陶]
真...真抱歉，喵~
裡面已經有人了。
請稍後再來，喵？

scripts.text:
[Tao]
Who are you, meow?!
Only authorized personnel can enter the inner room, meow!
You are not authorized!
Get out!
scripts.translation:
[陶]
你是誰，喵？！
只有授權人員才能進入內室，喵！
你沒有許可權！
出去！

scripts.text:
[Valdes]
What is it? I have nothing to ask you to do.
Could you please leave me alone? I have a bad headache.
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾德斯]
什麼事？我沒有讓你做什麼。
請讓我安靜一會兒好嗎？我頭痛得厲害。

scripts.text:
[Valdes]
...Sorry, but could you please leave?
I'm really stressed out right now.
If you're here for the request that we made earlier, you can just forget about it.
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾德斯]
...抱歉，請離開好嗎？
我現在壓力很大。
如果你是來找我之前委託的那件事的，就忘了吧。

scripts.text:
[Valdes]
I'll ask you for a help some other time.
You look pretty passionate after all.
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾德斯]
改天我會請你幫忙的。
畢竟你看起來挺熱情的。

scripts.text:
[Tao]
The room is also sealed with a security magic spell, meow.
You have ^4d4dff4 minutes^000000
to finish your quest, meow.
scripts.translation:
[陶]
這個房間也被安全魔法封印了，喵。
你有^4d4dff4分鐘^000000的時間完成任務，喵。

scripts.text:
[Tao]
We already have a guest inside.
You can wait or come back later, meow.
scripts.translation:
[陶]
裡面已經有客人了。
你可以等等，或者稍後再來，喵。

scripts.text:
[Tao]
The room is also sealed with a security magic spell, meow.
You have ^4d4dff4 minutes^000000
to finish your quest, meow.
scripts.translation:
[陶]
這個房間也被安全魔法封印了，喵。
你有^4d4dff4分鐘^000000的時間完成任務，喵。

scripts.text:
[Tao]
We already have a guest inside.
You can wait or come back later, meow.
scripts.translation:
[陶]
裡面已經有客人了。
你可以等等，或者稍後再來，喵。

scripts.text:
[Tao]
The room is also sealed with a security magic spell, meow.
You have ^4d4dff4 minutes^000000
to finish your quest, meow.
scripts.translation:
[陶]
這個房間也被安全魔法封印了，喵。
你有^4d4dff4分鐘^000000的時間完成任務，喵。

scripts.text:
[Tao]
We already have a guest inside.
You can wait or come back later, meow.
scripts.translation:
[陶]
裡面已經有客人了。
你可以等等，或者稍後再來，喵。

scripts.text:
[Tao]
This is the patient's room, meow.
Why don't you leave the patient alone to rest?
scripts.translation:
[陶]
這是病人的房間，喵。
不如讓病人獨自休息吧？

scripts.text: - You cannot proceed with the quest when you're carrying too many items with you. -
scripts.translation: - 攜帶物品過多時，無法繼續任務。 -

scripts.text:
[Rin]
...{0}...?
It's been a long time. What's going on?
scripts.translation:
[琳恩]
...{0}...？
好久不見。最近怎麼樣？

scripts.text:
[Rin]
Who are you? Only authorized personnel can enter this area.
scripts.translation:
[琳恩]
你是誰？只有授權人員才能進入這個區域。

scripts.text: Mr. Kidd sent me.
scripts.translation: 基德先生派我來的。

scripts.text: Just passing by.
scripts.translation: 只是路過。

scripts.text:
[Rin]
...?
...Ah.. Ahh, I see.
I haven't contacted him for a while, and so he's sent you to me...
*Sigh*.. *Cough*.
scripts.translation:
[琳恩]
...？
...啊...啊，我明白了。
我已經很久沒聯絡他了，所以他派你來找我...
*嘆氣*.. *咳嗽*。

scripts.text:
[Rin]
As you see, I've been feeling under the weather. I'm in no condition to contact him.
...Let me think. Where I should start..?
scripts.translation:
[琳恩]
你也看到了，我最近身體不舒服。我現在沒精力聯絡他。
...讓我想想。我該從哪裡說起呢..？

scripts.text: I don't know if you know this, but something catastrophic happened in this town before Satan Morocc resurrected himself.
scripts.translation: 我不知道你是否知道，在魔王夢羅克復活之前，這個城鎮發生過一場災難。

scripts.text:
[Rin]
R, otherwise known as 'Rayan,' performed a ritual to break Satan Morocc's seal.
scripts.translation:
[琳恩]
R，也就是“拉揚”，進行了一場儀式來打破魔王夢羅克的封印。

scripts.text:
[Rin]
We were able to gather a group of people and stop him from completing the ritual,
and although the seal wasn't broken, he succeeded in weakening it.
scripts.translation:
[琳恩]
我們召集了一群人阻止他完成儀式，
雖然封印沒有被打破，但他成功削弱了封印。

scripts.text:
[Rin]
Soon after we captured him, an army of monsters attacked this town
as Satan Morocc's angry roars echoed in the air.
scripts.translation:
[琳恩]
就在我們抓住他之後不久，一群魔物襲擊了這個城鎮，
空氣中迴盪著魔王夢羅克憤怒的咆哮聲。

scripts.text:
[Rin]
R, otherwise known as Rayan, is responsible for these series of events.
He caused everything that's happening now.
scripts.translation:
[琳恩]
R，也就是“拉揚”，是這一系列事件的罪魁禍首。
現在發生的一切都是他造成的。

scripts.text:
[Rin]
I don't know if you know this, but something catastrophic happened in this town before Satan Morocc resurrected himself.
scripts.translation:
[琳恩]
我不知道你是否知道，在魔王夢羅克復活之前，這個城鎮發生過一場災難。

scripts.text:
[Rin]
R, otherwise known as 'Rayan,' performed a ritual to break Satan Morocc's seal.
scripts.translation:
[琳恩]
R，也就是“拉揚”，進行了一場儀式來打破魔王夢羅克的封印。

scripts.text:
[Rin]
We were able to gather a group of people and stop him from completing the ritual,
and although the seal wasn't broken, he succeeded in weakening it.
scripts.translation:
[琳恩]
我們召集了一群人阻止他完成儀式，
雖然封印沒有被打破，但他成功削弱了封印。

scripts.text:
[Rin]
Soon after we captured him, an army of monsters attacked this town
as Satan Morocc's angry roars echoed in the air.
scripts.translation:
[琳恩]
就在我們抓住他之後不久，一群魔物襲擊了這個城鎮，
空氣中迴盪著魔王夢羅克憤怒的咆哮聲。

scripts.text:
[Rin]
R, otherwise known as Rayan, is responsible for these series of events.
He caused everything that's happening now.
scripts.translation:
[琳恩]
R，也就是“拉揚”，是這一系列事件的罪魁禍首。
現在發生的一切都是他造成的。

scripts.text:
[Rin]
Our job is primarily investigating Satan Morocc's whereabouts
as well as the relation between the space gap and Satan Morocc...
scripts.translation:
[琳恩]
我們的主要任務是調查魔王夢羅克的下落，
以及空間裂縫與魔王夢羅克之間的關係...

scripts.text:
[Rin]
We, however, couldn't let Rayan get away with what he's done
I've been focusing on pursuing Rayan.
scripts.translation:
[琳恩]
然而，我們不能讓拉揚對他所做的一切逍遙法外。
我最近一直在全力追捕拉揚。

scripts.text:
[Rin]
If we capture him, we might also find out some information about Satan Morocc:
we might be able to learn where he tried to summon Satan Morocc, and where we should send Satan Morocc back to...
scripts.translation:
[琳恩]
如果我們能抓住他，也許還能打聽到關於魔王夢羅克的一些情報：
我們或許能得知他試圖在哪裡召喚魔王夢羅克，以及我們應該把魔王夢羅克送回哪裡...

scripts.text:
[Rin]
I really want to know how the space gap is linked to Satan Morocc...
*Pant Pant*... ...
scripts.translation:
[琳恩]
我真的很想知道空間裂縫與魔王夢羅克之間有什麼聯絡...
*喘氣*... ...

scripts.text: And then what?
scripts.translation: 然後呢？

scripts.text: Don't strain yourself.
scripts.translation: 別太勉強自己。

scripts.text:
[Rin]
I'm sorry, but I'm not yet fully recovered... I need to speak slowly. Please bear with me.
scripts.translation:
[琳恩]
抱歉，我還沒有完全恢復... 我需要慢慢說話。請多包涵。

scripts.text:
[Rin]
Thank you for your kindness.
...*Pant Pant*...
scripts.translation:
[琳恩]
謝謝你的體貼。
...*喘氣*...

scripts.text:
[Rin]
I received these injuries from Rayan and his gang. I finally located them after a long stakeout and pursuit...
......... ...
scripts.translation:
[琳恩]
這些傷是拉揚和他的同夥造成的。經過長時間的潛伏和追蹤，我終於找到了他們...
......... ...

scripts.text:
[Rin]
Yes... I need to write this down...
scripts.translation:
[琳恩]
是的... 我需要把這些寫下來...

scripts.text: - Mumbling something, she took down notes in an old notebook as she spoke. -
scripts.translation: - 她一邊低聲唸叨著，一邊在舊筆記本上做著記錄。 -

scripts.text:
[Rin]
The Dandelions.. They're Rayan's puppets.
I was ambushed by them in a mountain far from a village...
scripts.translation:
[琳恩]
蒲公英... 他們是拉揚的傀儡。
我在遠離村莊的一座山上被他們伏擊了...

scripts.text:
[Rin]
When I woke up, I was here.
Since then, my vision's been blurry. I guess that must have been caused by my injuries...
scripts.translation:
[琳恩]
當我醒來時，我就在這裡了。
從那以後，我的視力一直模糊不清。我想那應該是受傷導致的...

scripts.text:
[Rin]
How'd you like to conduct an investigation around that area? We might find something..
Like important clues or where they've headed...
scripts.translation:
[琳恩]
你願意去那個區域附近調查一下嗎？我們可能會發現一些東西..
比如重要的線索，或者他們逃往的方向...

scripts.text:
[Rin]
^4d4dffIf you're interested in helping me, I'll continue talking.^000000
scripts.translation:
[琳恩]
^4d4dff如果你願意幫我，我就繼續說下去。^000000

scripts.text:
[Rin]
Did you just come by for no reason?
...God, I can't believe just let you come here!
Grr.. I need to teach them a lesson. Why can't they let me rest for God's sake!
scripts.translation:
[琳恩]
你是無緣無故跑來的嗎？
...天哪，我真不敢相信竟然讓你進來了！
哼... 我得好好教訓他們一頓。拜託了，他們就不能讓我休息一下嗎！

scripts.text:
[Rin]
I'm sorry, but I'm extremely tired and cranky.
If you don't have anything important to tell me, then I'd like you to leave.
scripts.translation:
[琳恩]
抱歉，我現在極度疲憊且脾氣暴躁。
如果你沒有重要的事情要告訴我，請離開這裡。

scripts.text:
[Rin]
So, are you interested in helping me?
I remember the location was... Southwest from a village called Hugel.
Do you know where to find Abyss Lake, where the Dragons reside?.
scripts.translation:
[琳恩]
那麼，你願意幫我嗎？
我記得那個地點在... 毀葛西南方。
你知道龍居住的深淵湖在哪裡嗎？

scripts.text:
[Rin]
^4d4dffWhen you pass Abyss Lake and head west,^000000 you'll arrive at stiff mountains.
I was ambushed somewhere ^4d4dffsouth of the second hill from the top of the mountain^000000
scripts.translation:
[琳恩]
^4d4dff穿過深淵湖向西走，^000000就會到達陡峭的山脈。
我在^4d4dff山頂往下數第二座山丘的南側^000000遭到伏擊。

scripts.text:
[Rin]
They ganged up on me, but I put up a good fight...
I'm sure I at least made them drop something..
Please try to find something there that might serve as a clue.
scripts.translation:
[琳恩]
他們圍攻了我，但我奮力抵抗了...
我確信至少讓他們掉落了一些東西。
請試著在那裡找找看，也許能找到線索。

scripts.text:
[Rin]
While you're gone, I'll be preparing a document to send to Mr. Kidd.
Be safe, and look out for yourself, okay?
scripts.translation:
[琳恩]
趁你不在的時候，我會準備一份檔案寄給基德先生。
保重，照顧好自己，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Rin]
I remember the location was...
somewhere south of the second hill of a mountain west from Abyss Lake.
scripts.translation:
[琳恩]
我記得那個地點是...
深淵湖西邊某座山的第二座山丘南側。

scripts.text:
[Rin]
What are you looking at?
How do I remember the location so clearly?
It's the last location where I searched for Rayan. How can I not remember?
scripts.translation:
[琳恩]
你在看什麼？
我怎麼會記得這麼清楚？
那是最後搜尋拉揚的地方，我怎麼可能不記得？

scripts.text:
[Rin]
Don't underestimate me; I'm an elite member of my guild.
scripts.translation:
[琳恩]
別小看我，我是公會的精英成員。

scripts.text:
[Rin]
Have you found anything?
scripts.translation:
[琳恩]
你找到什麼了嗎？

scripts.text:
- You told her you couldn't find anything regarding their whereabouts,
but you found the ''Bloody Crystal of Darkness'' in the bushes.
scripts.translation:
- 你告訴她你沒能找到關於他們行蹤的任何線索，
但在灌木叢裡發現了“血腥的黑暗結晶體”。

scripts.text:
[Rin]
..This is...it.
You can feel the evil spirit just by looking at it.
This...there's no doubt. It's the same kind of crystal as the ones found on Satan Morocc and his minions.
scripts.translation:
[琳恩]
..這是...它。
只要看一眼就能感受到邪惡的氣息。
這...毫無疑問。它與在魔王夢羅克及其手下身上發現的結晶體是同一種類。

scripts.text:
[Rin]
But...this crystal...left there..
..Was it them who dropped it?
So it seems Rayan and Satan Morocc...there really is something going on between those two.
scripts.translation:
[琳恩]
但是...這個結晶體...被留在那裡..
..是他們掉落的嗎？
看來拉揚和魔王夢羅克...這兩人之間確實有些關聯。

scripts.text:
[Rin]
You've worked hard. Thank you.
Ha...
Just lying here, not being able to do anything...it's so frustrating.
scripts.translation:
[琳恩]
辛苦了。謝謝你。
哈...
只能躺在這裡，什麼也做不了...真讓人沮喪。

scripts.text:
[Rin]
Here, take this journal to Mr. Kidd.
It should've been done a while ago.
Oh, bring this crystal to him as well.
scripts.translation:
[琳恩]
拿著，把這個日誌帶給基德先生。
這本該早就完成的。
哦，把這個結晶體也一起帶給他。

scripts.text:
[Rin]
Ah..the journal..Yes, I should record this incident onto the journal.
scripts.translation:
[琳恩]
啊..日誌..是的，我應該把這次事件記錄在日誌裡。

scripts.text:
[Rin]
All done. Here you go.
Here's the journal and the crystal.
Take them to Mr. Kidd for me.
scripts.translation:
[琳恩]
寫好了。給你。
這是日誌和結晶體。
請幫我帶給基德先生。

scripts.text:
- You received the journal from Rin.
Instead of a journal, it's more like a bunch of documents being exchanged. -
scripts.translation:
- 你從琳恩那裡收到了日誌。
與其說是日誌，不如說是一堆交換的檔案。 -

scripts.text:
[Rin]
..A bloody Crystal of the Darkness?
Can you show it to me?
scripts.translation:
[琳恩]
..血腥的黑暗結晶體？
能給我看看嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh, I don't have it with me. I'll go bring it right away.
^4d4dff(Wait, what did I do with it? I didn't sell it or anything, did I?)^000000
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哦，我身上沒帶。我馬上去取。
^4d4dff（等等，我把它放哪了？我沒賣掉它吧？）^000000

scripts.text:
[Rin]
Hurry up; deliver the journal and crystal to Mr. Kidd.
That's your job, isn't it?
*Pant* I need to rest now..
scripts.translation:
[琳恩]
快點；把日誌和結晶體交給基德先生。
這不是你的工作嗎？
*喘氣* 我現在需要休息了..

scripts.text:
[Rin]
My eyes are blurry...
*Pant Pant*...
scripts.translation:
[琳恩]
我的視線模糊了...
*喘氣 喘氣*...

scripts.text:
[Rin]
..Argh.. I'm still recovering .. I'm not supposed to move~
scripts.translation:
[琳恩]
..啊...我還在恢復中...我不該亂動的~

scripts.text: - You cannot proceed with the quest when you're carrying too many items with you. -
scripts.translation: - 攜帶物品過多時，無法繼續任務。 -

scripts.text:
[Rin]
Hey, you've come back at just the right time.
Look at him; this is ridiculous.
scripts.translation:
[琳恩]
嘿，你回來的正是時候。
看看他；這太荒唐了。

scripts.text:
[Rayan]
I know what I did is unforgivable, no matter how good my reason might be.
..But... *Sigh*... It's too late to regret it now, isn't it?
scripts.translation:
[拉揚]
我知道我所做的一切不可原諒，無論我的理由多麼正當。
..但是... *嘆氣*...現在後悔也來不及了，不是嗎？

scripts.text: Who is this?
scripts.translation: 他是誰？

scripts.text:
[Rin]
Don't you know? He's Rayan Moore who dared to release Satan Morocc, deceive everyone, and bring havoc to this world.
And you know what?
scripts.translation:
[琳恩]
你不知道嗎？他是拉揚·摩爾，那個膽敢釋放魔王夢羅克、欺騙所有人並給這個世界帶來浩劫的人。
而且你知道嗎？

scripts.text:
[Rin]
Not only that, he slaughtered his own comrades without mercy!
scripts.translation:
[琳恩]
不僅如此，他還毫不留情地屠殺了自己的同志！

scripts.text:
[Rayan]
...Waaah!
..I.. I.. I killed them with my own hands!
*Sob*..
I'm.. I'm sorry..
scripts.translation:
[拉揚]
...哇啊！
..我...我...是我親手殺了他們！
*抽泣*..
我...我很抱歉..

scripts.text:
- Rayan is shivering in fear.
He still hasn't gotten over the fact that he killed all of his comrades.-
scripts.translation:
- 拉揚因恐懼而顫抖。
他仍然無法接受自己殺死了所有同志的事實。-

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What is going on?
He doesn't look like the Rayan I know.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這是怎麼回事？
他看起來不像我認識的那個拉揚。

scripts.text:
[Rin]
I don't know. This Rayan seems to be a completely different individual than the one we know.
I guess this is what they call Multiple Personality Disorder.
scripts.translation:
[琳恩]
我不知道。這個拉揚似乎和我們認識的那個完全是不同的人。
我想這就是他們所說的多重人格障礙吧。

scripts.text:
[Rin]
This Rayan isn't the Rayan Moore that plotted the conspiracy,
but another personality hidden inside of him.
scripts.translation:
[琳恩]
這個拉揚不是策劃陰謀的拉揚·摩爾，
而是隱藏在他體內的另一個人格。

scripts.text:
[Rin]
Hey, calm down. Why don't you speak slowly?
scripts.translation:
[琳恩]
嘿，冷靜點。你為什麼不慢慢說？

scripts.text:
[Rayan]
..It was me.. I was only going to pretend to break the seal of Satan Morocc...
Don't you see? I meant for it to just be an act! I was going to throw the town in panic...
scripts.translation:
[拉揚]
..是我...我原本只是想假裝解除魔王夢羅克的封印...
你沒看出來嗎？那只是我的表演！我打算讓城鎮陷入恐慌...

scripts.text:
[Rayan]
..That would be my chance to spread the teachings of Freya, our messiah.
Then something went wrong...
scripts.translation:
[拉揚]
..那樣就是我的機會，去傳播我們救世主弗蕾雅的道義。
然後事情出了差錯...

scripts.text:
[Rin]
What?
Man, how can you be so stupid?!
*Sigh* Continue.
scripts.translation:
[琳恩]
什麼？
天哪，你怎麼能這麼愚蠢？！
*嘆氣* 繼續說。

scripts.text:
[Rayan]
I was studying some documents for my plan, and then I found something by accident.
That was when I became a completely different person.. *Sob*
scripts.translation:
[拉揚]
我在研究計劃的一些檔案，然後偶然發現了某樣東西。
就在那時，我變成了一個完全不同的人.. *抽泣*

scripts.text:
[Rayan]
..My plan.. It was like I wasn't myself anymore. I wanted to release Satan Morocc for real.
I kidnapped children.. Threatened my comrades.
scripts.translation:
[拉揚]
..我的計劃..感覺我不再是我自己了。我想要真正釋放魔王夢羅克。
我綁架了孩子..威脅了我的同志。

scripts.text:
[Rayan]
..I held the true ritual to break the seal and release Satan Morocc...
Wah.. My.. My head hurts.. This.. No, you can't.. Waaah!
scripts.translation:
[拉揚]
..我主持了真正的儀式來解除封印並釋放魔王夢羅克...
哇..我的..我頭疼..這個..不，你不能..哇啊！

scripts.text:
[Rayan]
..Grr.. You.. You foolish weaklings..
..I shall kill you.. No... Nooo!
scripts.translation:
[拉揚]
..嘎...你們...你們愚蠢的弱者..
..我要殺了你們..不...不！！

scripts.text:
- Suddenly Rayan started talking nonsense and then pulled his hair out in anguish.
It seems as if he is trying to resist the evil personality within him. -
scripts.translation:
- 突然，拉揚開始胡言亂語，然後痛苦地抓撓自己的頭髮。
看起來他正在試圖抵抗體內的邪惡人格。 -

scripts.text: Smack his head.
scripts.translation: 打他的頭。

scripts.text: Punch his stomach.
scripts.translation: 打他的肚子。

scripts.text: Slap his face.
scripts.translation: 打他的臉。

scripts.text: - Wanting to stop Rayan from going berserk, you smacked the back of his head with the journal. Rayan staggered and then fell to the ground. Nice job! -
scripts.translation: - 為了阻止拉揚進入狂暴狀態，你用筆記本敲了他的後腦勺。拉揚踉蹌了一下，然後倒在了地上。幹得好！ -

scripts.text: - Wanting to stop Rayan from going berserk, you sucker punched him in the 'ole bread basket. Rayan staggered and then fell to the ground...! -
scripts.translation: - 為了阻止拉揚進入狂暴狀態，你狠狠揍了他的肚子。拉揚踉蹌了一下，然後倒在了地上...！ -

scripts.text: - Wanting to stop Rayan from going berserk, you slapped his face with the journal. Rayan staggered and then fell onto the ground. Wah! -
scripts.translation: - 為了阻止拉揚進入狂暴狀態，你用筆記本扇了他的臉。拉揚踉蹌了一下，然後倒在了地上。哇！ -

scripts.text: - By your sudden violent move, the Bloody Crystal of Darkness flew out of your jacket, and rolled on the ground toward Rayan. -
scripts.translation: - 由於你突然的暴力動作，黑暗的結晶體從你的夾克裡飛了出來，滾到了拉揚身邊。 -

scripts.text:
[Rayan]
Ahh....
....? Isn't.. Isn't this?!....

[Rin]
Wah! What's going on?
Why is it suddenly..?!
scripts.translation:
[琳恩]
哇！發生什麼事了？
為什麼突然...？！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Is this a time-space phenomenon?!
Why..? There's no gap here..?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這是時空現象嗎？！
為什麼...？這裡沒有裂縫啊...？

scripts.text:
[Rayan]
Haha.. Muhahaha!
Muhahahahaha!!
He's come.. My master has arrived!!
As you command, master. I'm here to serve you!
scripts.translation:
[拉揚]
哈哈...穆哈哈哈哈哈！
穆哈哈哈哈哈！！
他來了...我的主人到了！！
遵命，主人。我來為您效命！

scripts.text:
[Voice from Rayan]
^FF0000You insignificant humans!
I'll be back at full strength,
and I'll pay you back for locking me in the darkness for hundreds of years!^000000
scripts.translation:
[拉揚傳來的聲音]
^FF0000你們這些卑微的人類！
我會以完全的力量回來，
為被你們囚禁在黑暗中的數百年討回公道！^000000

scripts.text:
[Rin]
What... What just happened?
Are you Rayan? Or are you someone else now?!
scripts.translation:
[琳恩]
剛才...剛才發生了什麼？
你是拉揚嗎？還是說你現在是別人了？！

scripts.text:
[Rayan]
You're too late. My master has already departed!
I'm his loyal servant.
You're too foolish to understand his great will.
scripts.translation:
[拉揚]
太遲了。我的主人已經離開了！
我是他忠誠的僕人。
你們太愚蠢了，無法理解他偉大的意志。

scripts.text:
[Rayan]
Haha... Muhahaha!
He's calling me!
He needs me now!
scripts.translation:
[拉揚]
哈哈...穆哈哈哈哈哈！
他在呼喚我！
他現在需要我！

scripts.text:
[Rayan]
You're Rin, right?
This is the last time you'll ever see me.
Haha... Muhahahahaha!!
scripts.translation:
[拉揚]
你是琳恩，對吧？
這是你最後一次見到我了。
哈哈...穆哈哈哈哈哈！！

scripts.text:
[Rin]
............
....Huh...?
What just happened?

[{0}]
...I don't know...
...I think he's gone...?

[Rin]
What's up?
I'm kind of busy right now.
scripts.translation:
[琳恩]
怎麼了？
我現在有點忙。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
..I've brought back the journal and something else..
..Er, sorry. I forgot to bring the journal! I'll be right back.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
..我帶回了筆記本和別的東西..
..呃，抱歉。我忘了帶筆記本！我馬上回來。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What should we do now?
You know, that voice.. Do you think it was Satan Morocc...?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我們現在該怎麼辦？
你知道，那個聲音...你覺得那是魔王夢羅克...？

scripts.text:
[Rin]
..Maybe.
B.ased on what the more normal Rayan has told us,
it seems that another personality within him was forcibly created by Satan Morocc.
scripts.translation:
[琳恩]
..也許吧。
根據那個比較正常的拉揚告訴我們的話，
似乎是他體內被魔王夢羅克強行創造出的另一個人格。

scripts.text:
[Rin]
Satan Morocc must have chosen Rayan to break his seal.
He's been controlling Rayan from deep inside his mind..
scripts.translation:
[琳恩]
魔王夢羅克一定是選中了拉揚來打破封印。
他一直在拉揚內心深處控制著他..

scripts.text:
[Rin]
And... That Mad Rayan seems to have a connection with your Bloody Crystal of Darkness.
scripts.translation:
[琳恩]
而且...那個瘋狂的拉揚似乎與你的黑暗的結晶體有某種聯絡。

scripts.text:
[Rin]
I didn't see that side of Rayan until you came; he was very cooperative and feeble up until then.
scripts.translation:
[琳恩]
在你到來之前，我從未見過拉揚那一面；在此之前他都非常配合且虛弱。

scripts.text:
[Rin]
The original Rayan seemed to remember everything that happened while he was controlled by that mad personality..
scripts.translation:
[琳恩]
原本的拉揚似乎記得在被那個瘋狂人格控制期間發生的一切..

scripts.text:
[Rin]
He was in shock after learning that he's killed all his comrades with his own hand.
He started acting differently once you approached him. I must record all of this in the journal.
scripts.translation:
[琳恩]
得知自己親手殺死了所有同志後，他陷入了震驚。
當你靠近他時，他開始變得不一樣了。我必須把這些都記錄在筆記本里。

scripts.text:
[Rin]
Right. He completely changed once he touched the crystal, as if he himself became Satan Morocc.
scripts.translation:
[琳恩]
沒錯。當他觸碰到結晶體後，他完全變了，彷彿他自己變成了魔王夢羅克。

scripts.text:
[Rin]
..Damn it.
scripts.translation:
[琳恩]
..該死。

scripts.text: What should we do now?
scripts.translation: 我們現在該怎麼辦？

scripts.text:
[Rin]
Don't worry.
I've marked Rayan's body in case he ran away.
We can trace him down.
scripts.translation:
[琳恩]
別擔心。
我在拉揚的屍體上做了標記，以防他逃跑。
我們可以追蹤到他。

scripts.text:
[Rin]
I'll give you the pattern number of his magic wavelength. Can you give the number to Echinacea?
She'll take care of the rest.
scripts.translation:
[琳恩]
我會給你他的魔法波長模式編號。你能把這個編號給紫錐菊嗎？
剩下的她會處理。

scripts.text:
[Rin]
The pattern number is...
^4d4dff[{0}]^000000
Don't leave out even one character. Okay?
scripts.translation:
[琳恩]
模式編號是...
^4d4dff[{0}]^000000
不要漏掉任何一個字元。好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Rin]
Here, bring this journal with you.
Please don't forget the pattern number. Alright? Make sure that Echinacea gets it.
scripts.translation:
[琳恩]
拿著，帶上這本筆記本。
請別忘了模式編號。好嗎？一定要讓紫錐菊收到。

scripts.text:
[Rin]
Report to Echinacea in the Ash Vacuum, and give her the pattern number.
The pattern number is ^4d4dff[SDHF92F-SDF]^000000. Don't leave out even one character. Okay?
scripts.translation:
[琳恩]
去阿什真空向紫錐菊彙報，並把模式編號給她。
模式編號是 ^4d4dff[SDHF92F-SDF]^000000。不要漏掉任何一個字元。好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Rin]
Report to Echinacea in the Ash Vacuum, and give her the pattern number.
The pattern number is ^4d4dff[VWNM94GVWN90]^000000. Don't leave out even one character. Okay?
scripts.translation:
[琳恩]
去阿什真空向紫錐菊彙報，並把模式編號給她。
模式編號是 ^4d4dff[VWNM94GVWN90]^000000。不要漏掉任何一個字元。好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Rin]
Report to Echinacea in the Ash Vacuum, and give her the pattern number.
The pattern number is ^4d4dff[CM3-TRDFGHE0]^000000. Don't leave out even one character. Okay?
scripts.translation:
[琳恩]
去阿什真空向紫錐菊彙報，並把模式編號給她。
模式編號是 ^4d4dff[CM3-TRDFGHE0]^000000。不要漏掉任何一個字元。好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Rin]
Ouch, my head...
Yes? Why are you back again?
What...you forgot the pattern number?
Sigh...Oh well.
scripts.translation:
[琳恩]
哎喲，我的頭...
是的？你怎麼又回來了？
什麼...你忘了模式編號？
唉...算了。

scripts.text:
[Rin]
Make sure you don't forget it again. The pattern number is...
^4d4dff[{0}]^000000. Don't leave out even one character. Okay?
Got it?
scripts.translation:
[琳恩]
這次可別再忘了。模式編號是...
^4d4dff[{0}]^000000。不要漏掉任何一個字元。好嗎？
記住了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Rin]
Sigh. Get going, then...
I need to take a break...
scripts.translation:
[琳恩]
唉。那你快去吧...
我需要休息一下...

scripts.text:
[Rin]
Ahhh~ I'm a sick person. I need to rest!
I don't want to do anything else~
Hurry up and go, don't bother me~
scripts.translation:
[琳恩]
啊哈~ 我生病了，需要休息！
我什麼都不想做~
快走吧，別打擾我~

scripts.text: - For some reason, Rayan is shivering in fear. -
scripts.translation: - 不知為何，拉揚正瑟瑟發抖。 -

scripts.text:
[Rin]
He's not being himself for some reason.
I'm just glad that he's sane enough to speak to me.
I don't know what's going on with him.
scripts.translation:
[琳恩]
他不知為何變得不像他自己了。
還好他神智清醒，還能和我說話。
我不知道他到底怎麼了。

scripts.text: - You cannot proceed with the quest when you're carrying too many items with you. -
scripts.translation: - 攜帶物品過多時，無法繼續任務。 -

scripts.text:
You have found a pile of dirt and deep tracks under thick bushes.
There are deep footprints and spilled blood around the area.
scripts.translation:
你在茂密的灌木叢下發現了一堆泥土和深深的痕跡。
周圍有深深的腳印和灑落的血跡。

scripts.text:
Some desperate fighting definitely happened here.
There are some broken branches to the side of a set of footprints that look like they're skidding backwards...
Somebody must have been fallen down on the ground, or...
scripts.translation:
這裡顯然發生過激烈的戰鬥。
在一串向後滑行的腳印旁，有一些折斷的樹枝...
有人一定是摔倒在地的，或者...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I've been having a strange feeling around this area...
It feels like faint mana.. ?!... Yes, I can barely see an aura.
...What is this?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我在這附近一直有種奇怪的感覺...
感覺像是微弱的瑪娜.. ?!... 是的，我隱約能看到靈氣。
...這是什麼？

scripts.text: Ignore it.
scripts.translation: 無視它

scripts.text: Take a careful look.
scripts.translation: 仔細檢視

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hmm.. This place must be where Rin fought with Rayan's gang.
I don't see anything that looks important.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯.. 這裡應該是琳恩和拉揚的手下戰鬥的地方。
我沒看到什麼重要的東西。

scripts.text:
As you took a careful look,
you notice something shining in the ground.
scripts.translation:
當你仔細檢視時，
你注意到地面上有東西在閃閃發光。

scripts.text: ^4d4dffYou have found a 'Bloody Crystal of Darkness'.^000000
scripts.translation: ^4d4dff你發現了一個“血腥的黑暗的結晶體”。^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I don't think I'll find anything else here...
I should go back now.
I hope Rin will understand.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我覺得這裡不會再找到其他東西了...
我該回去了。
希望琳恩能理解。

scripts.text:
There are traces of a battle here, including spilled blood.
There's also a pile of dirt that seems out of place.
scripts.translation:
這裡有戰鬥的痕跡，包括灑落的血跡。
還有一堆看起來格格不入的泥土。

scripts.text: There are traces of a battle here, and spilled blood.
scripts.translation: 這裡有戰鬥的痕跡，以及灑落的血跡。

scripts.text:
You find many footprints on the ground.
Considering all the blood on the ground, a battle must have occurred here fairly recently.
The footprints continue over the hill.
scripts.translation:
你在地面上發現了許多腳印。
考慮到地上大量的血跡，這裡最近一定發生過戰鬥。
腳印一直延伸到山丘那邊。

scripts.text: You found some footprints.
scripts.translation: 你發現了一些腳印。

scripts.text:
Somebody left a mark under this small tree.
The mark is weathered and faded,
but it is an arrow pointing southwest.
scripts.translation:
有人在這棵小樹下面留下了標記。
標記已經風化褪色，
但它是一個指向西南方的箭頭。

scripts.text:
There's some scribbling on the tree,
but you can't decipher what it means.
scripts.translation:
樹上有一些塗鴉，
但你無法辨認出它的含義。

scripts.text: A mysterious force is repelling you, and you're unable to push forward into this area.
scripts.translation: 一股神秘的力量正在排斥你，你無法繼續向前進入這個區域。

scripts.text:
As soon as you touched the crystal,
you feel your body being pulled into the space gap.
You remember Kidd's confused voice, screaming your name.
scripts.translation:
當你一觸碰到結晶體，
你就感覺身體被拉入了空間裂隙。
你記得基德困惑的聲音，正在尖叫你的名字。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
By the way, where am I?
Argh.. My head hurts...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
話說回來，我在哪裡？
啊...我的頭好痛...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
.. ? Wh... What's going on?
I can't see things.. I'm getting dizzy...
What just happened?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
...？什...發生了什麼？
我看不清...頭好暈...
剛才到底怎麼了？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Huh? Are they fighting?
I can hear a crowd of people coming...
Argh! It's too dark to see...!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
咦？他們在打架嗎？
我聽到人群走來的聲音...
啊！太黑了，什麼都看不見...！

scripts.text:
[Familiar Female Voice]
Shut up! It's creepy that you all look alike. Bring it on! I'm not afraid of you!
I'm not going to let you run away again!
scripts.translation:
[熟悉的女聲]
閉嘴！你們長得都一樣，真讓人毛骨悚然。來吧！我才不怕你們呢！
這次我絕不會再讓你們逃走了！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
... !!!!
Rin!!!!
Why? Why is Rin here? Wait, where am I?
Argh.. I can't move at all...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
...！！！！
琳恩！！！！
為什麼？琳恩為什麼會在這裡？等等，我在哪裡？
啊...我完全動不了...

scripts.text:
[Rin]
You're not alone. So what?
You're still coming with me!
scripts.translation:
[琳恩]
你不是一個人又怎樣？
你還是得跟我走！

scripts.text:
[Rayan]
Hah, how impressive! You run like a rabbit!
I should have you killed you when I had the chance.
I didn't expect you to be so persistent...
scripts.translation:
[拉揚]
哈，真厲害啊！你跑得跟兔子一樣快！
我本該趁早殺了你的。
沒想到你竟然這麼執著...

scripts.text:
[Rin]
That's what I wanted to say!
You played me like a chess piece,
and now I want to tear you apart in five pieces. Why don't you just shut up and surrender before I kill you?
scripts.translation:
[琳恩]
這正是我想說的！
你把我當棋子一樣擺佈，
現在我要把你撕成五塊。你最好乖乖投降，不然我就殺了你？

scripts.text:
[Rayan]
Hah.. You still have no idea, huh? You already lost this game, lady.
scripts.translation:
[拉揚]
哈...你還是不明白嗎？這場遊戲你已經輸了，女士。

scripts.text:
[Rayan]
I'm sorry that I have to do this.
...
Kill her.
scripts.translation:
[拉揚]
很抱歉，我不得不這麼做。
...
殺了她。

scripts.text:
You feel helpless: you can do nothing but watch her slowly get overpowered..
Then, the pressure on your body suddenly dissipates.
scripts.translation:
你感到無能為力：你只能眼睜睜看著她被逐漸壓制...
然後，壓在你身上的力量突然消失了。

scripts.text: - You cannot proceed with the quest when you're carrying too many items with you. -
scripts.translation: - 攜帶物品過多時，無法繼續任務。 -

scripts.text:
You have found a laceration on the dead body;
he must have been killed by Rin.
scripts.translation:
你在屍體上發現了一道撕裂傷；
他一定是被琳恩殺死的。

scripts.text: Check his pockets.
scripts.translation: 檢查他的口袋

scripts.text: Shake the corpse.
scripts.translation: 搖晃屍體

scripts.text: It's creepy to touch a corpse, but you have decided to check his pockets for any clues.
scripts.translation: 摸屍體雖然讓人毛骨悚然，但你決定檢查他的口袋，看看有沒有什麼線索。

scripts.text:
It's creepy to touch a corpse, but you have decided to shake and turn the body
to find any possible clues
And...
scripts.translation:
摸屍體雖然讓人毛骨悚然，但你決定搖晃並翻轉屍體，以尋找任何可能的線索。
然後...

scripts.text:
A scroll flew out of the body's jacket pocket.
You're not sure what this scroll is for, but obviously it seems pretty important.
scripts.translation:
一張卷軸從屍體的夾克口袋裡飛了出來。
你不確定這張卷軸是做什麼用的，但顯然它看起來非常重要。

scripts.text:
^4d4dffYou have obtained a Sealed Magic Scroll.
Let's bring this to Kidd.^000000
scripts.translation:
^4d4dff你獲得了一張封印魔法卷軸。
讓我們把它帶給基德。^000000

scripts.text: You have found a Dandelion Member who was killed by Rin.
scripts.translation: 你發現了一名被琳恩殺死的蒲公英成員。

scripts.text: It's just a corpse, but there seems to be something unnatural about it.
scripts.translation: 這只是一具屍體，但似乎有什麼不自然的地方。

scripts.text:
Now's not the time to examine corpses.
You better take care of your living enemies first!
scripts.translation:
現在不是檢查屍體的時候。
你最好先處理活著的敵人！

scripts.text:
- You find a side door that leads to the basement.
A faint light is shining through the hinges.
There are people inside, talking loudly. -
scripts.translation:
- 你發現了一扇通往地下室的小門。
門縫裡透出微弱的光。
裡面有人，正在大聲說話。 -

scripts.text:
[Male Voice]
Hey Rayan, say something.
We did everything you asked,
but...
scripts.translation:
[男性的聲音]
嘿，拉揚，說點什麼吧。
我們做了你要求的一切，
但是...

scripts.text:
[Male Voice]
...This is totally wrong.
We did something that we shouldn't have.
Come on, reconsider this.
scripts.translation:
[男性的聲音]
...這完全錯了。
我們做了不該做的事。
拜託，重新考慮一下。

scripts.text:
[Male Voice]
Rayan, Rayan!
All we wanted was just to shake up the town just a little bit,
not summon Satan Morocc! The ritual failed like we first planned, but...
scripts.translation:
[男性的聲音]
拉揚，拉揚！
我們只是想稍微搞亂一下城鎮，
不是要召喚魔王夢羅克！儀式像我們最初計劃的那樣失敗了，但是...

scripts.text:
[Voices]
That's right. It failed, but what happened? Satan Morocc resurrected himself.
He'll bring the end of this world.
What have we done?!
We can't even go back to our country now!
scripts.translation:
[眾聲]
沒錯。它失敗了，但結果呢？魔王夢羅克復活了。
他將帶來這個世界的終結。
我們做了什麼？！
我們現在甚至無法回到自己的國家！

scripts.text:
[Anxious Voice]
...We all knew that we would be disposed after we stopped being useful.. Just like pawns in a chess match.
But I'm curious.
Rayan...
scripts.translation:
[焦慮的聲音]
...我們都知道，一旦我們不再有用，就會被處理掉。就像棋盤上的棋子一樣。
但我很好奇。
拉揚...

scripts.text:
[Anxious Voice]
Rayan, say something!
What the hell's wrong with you?
Why, can't you still forget the Assassin?
...Hey, tell us. What should we do now?
scripts.translation:
[焦慮的聲音]
拉揚，說點什麼吧！
你到底怎麼了？
為什麼，你難道還忘不了那個刺客嗎？
...嘿，告訴我們。我們現在該怎麼辦？

scripts.text:
[Anxious Voice]
Let me ask you one question.
...Did you... Did you really summon Satan Morocc?
Did you?
Did you really ask us to help you resurrect Satan Morocc?!
scripts.translation:
[焦慮的聲音]
讓我問你一個問題。
...你...你真的召喚了魔王夢羅克嗎？
是嗎？
你真的讓我們幫你復活魔王夢羅克？！

scripts.text:
[Anxious Voice]
If your silence means yes, I'm out!
I didn't know then, but I know now. I'm leaving!
scripts.translation:
[焦慮的聲音]
如果你的沉默意味著是，那我走了！
我當時不知道，但現在我知道了。我要離開！

scripts.text:
[Rayan]
Incompetent weaklings.
I don't need you anymore.
Thank you for following my lead so far.
But you're nothing but puppets of the goddess.. *Giggle Giggle*
scripts.translation:
[拉揚]
無能的弱者。
我不再需要你們了。
謝謝你們一直聽從我的指揮。
但你們不過是女神的傀儡罷了。*咯咯咯*

scripts.text:
[Male Voice]
Hey, hey! What are you doing?!
Why are you doing this?!
scripts.translation:
[男性的聲音]
嘿，嘿！你在幹什麼？！
你為什麼要這樣做？！

scripts.text:
- You hear loud thuds and thumping in the midst of their yelling and screaming.
It sounds like they're having a serious dispute.-
scripts.translation:
- 在他們的叫喊聲中，你聽到沉重的撞擊聲。
聽起來他們正在發生激烈的爭執。-

scripts.text:
[{0}]
...Rayan? ...Morocc? ...Resurrect...?
I have no idea what they're talking about. Why are they fighting?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
...拉揚？...夢羅克？...復活...？
我完全不知道他們在說什麼。他們為什麼在打架？

scripts.text:
[Rayan]
You ignorant puppets..
You're too stupid to understand my master's great will...
...Oh, right. I completely forgot about 'it.' It's time to take it back.
What do you say? *Giggle Giggle*
scripts.translation:
[拉揚]
無知的傀儡們..
你們太愚蠢了，無法理解我主人的偉大意志...
...哦，對了。我完全忘了“它”。是時候把它拿回來了。
你們覺得如何？*咯咯咯*

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What the?! Does he know I'm here?!
I'd better run!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
什麼？！他知道我在這裡？！
我最好快跑！

scripts.text: - You used a Butterfly Wing.-
scripts.translation: - 你使用了一張蝴蝶翅膀。-

scripts.text:
- The side to the basement is open.
You can enter if you want. -
scripts.translation:
- 通往地下室的小門開了。
如果你想，可以進去。 -

scripts.text: Enter.
scripts.translation: 進入

scripts.text: Do not enter.
scripts.translation: 不要進入

scripts.text: You have decided to not enter the basement.
scripts.translation: 你決定不進入地下室。

scripts.text:
- This door seems to lead to the basement,
but it's locked pretty securely. -
scripts.translation:
- 這扇門似乎通往地下室，
但被鎖得很緊。 -

scripts.text: A man covered in blood is standing at a corner with a mysterious grin.
scripts.translation: 一個渾身是血的男人站在角落裡，臉上帶著詭異的微笑。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
I guess it was the right timing.
By the way, who is this guy?
He looks kind of.. He's insane, isn't he?
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
看來時機剛剛好。
順便問一下，這傢伙是誰？
他看起來有點...他瘋了吧？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Woah! Where did you come from?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哇！你從哪冒出來的？

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
...From somewhere.
Anyways...
What happened?
Who are you?
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
...從某個地方。
總之...
發生了什麼事？
你是誰？

scripts.text:
[Man]
...Who am I...?
...I think I forgot...
They're all dead.. I've killed them.
Hehehe, I just followed the will of my master.
Muhahahahaha!!
scripts.translation:
[男子]
...我是誰...？
...我想我忘了...
他們都死了...是我殺了他們。
嘿嘿嘿，我只是聽從了師父的意志。
穆哈哈哈哈哈！！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No... No way!
Rayan?!
scripts.translation: 拉揚？！

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
What? Is this really the Rayan we've been chasing?
..... !!!
Right, you said Rayan was having a dispute with his buddies..
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
什麼？這真的是我們要追捕的拉揚嗎？
..... ！！
沒錯，你說過拉揚和他的夥伴們發生了爭執..

scripts.text:
[Rayan]
...Ray... Rayan? That's my name? That's right...
I'm Rayan. Rayan Moore.
Who are you..?
scripts.translation:
[拉揚]
...拉...拉揚？那是我的名字？沒錯...
我是拉揚。拉揚·摩爾。
你們是誰..？

scripts.text:
[Rayan]
Where am I? What's all this blood?!
...Huh? Where am I? What happened to my friends?
scripts.translation:
[拉揚]
我在哪？這些血是怎麼回事？！
...咦？我在哪？我的朋友們怎麼了？

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
...I guess I was right. He really is Rayan Moore.
What's wrong with him?
He seems... He seems really confused. Maybe even unstable.
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
...看來我猜對了。他真的是拉揚·摩爾。
他怎麼了？
他看起來...他看起來很困惑。甚至可能精神不穩定。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
Well, it's the perfect time to capture this guy before he can kill us.
Rin will know if this is the real Rayan because I've never seen him without his mask..
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
好吧，趁他還沒殺了我們，現在是抓住這傢伙的最佳時機。
琳恩會知道這是否是真正的拉揚，因為我從未見過他不戴面具的樣子..

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
I'll bring this guy to Rin so she can interrogate him.
I'll see you at the camp.
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
我要把這傢伙帶給琳恩，讓她審問他。
我在營地見。

scripts.text: - You watched Mr. Kidd arrest the unconscious Rayan and take out a teleportation item. You decide to return to town. -
scripts.translation: - 你看著基德先生逮捕了昏迷的拉揚，並拿出了一件瞬間移動道具。你決定返回城鎮。 -

scripts.text:
[Man]
I live to serve my master!
Are you his enemy?
DIE!
scripts.translation:
[男子]
我活著就是為了侍奉我的師父！
你是他的敵人嗎？
去死吧！

scripts.text:
You find a horribly dismembered dead body.
It is disgusting to decribe the status of the Corpse!.
scripts.translation:
你發現了一具被肢解得慘不忍睹的屍體。
屍體的狀況令人作嘔！

scripts.text:
You find a horribly disfigured corpse.
that appears to have been crushed to death.
scripts.translation:
你發現了一具面目全非的屍體。
看起來是被壓死的。

scripts.text:
You find a terribly mutated corpse.
R.I.P.
scripts.translation:
你發現了一具變異得可怕的屍體。
安息吧。

scripts.text:
You find a terribly mutilated corpse.
Rest in peace.
scripts.translation:
你發現了一具被殘害得可怕的屍體。
願逝者安息。

scripts.text:
You find a horribly disfigured corpse.
... . . . . . !!!
scripts.translation:
你發現了一具面目全非的屍體。
... . . . . . !!!
